tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 'dzam gling dus rabs bar ma'i lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud/

tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/2sbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 50sgyug33 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
'bring rimaspobama'iklogadebanorabu'i bangamadzod
'bringarimaslobara'i0bdebazorabu'ibangarajong

dkar chaganub phyogs yo rob 'dul mkhan gong ma chen po khar lu si/ 1nub phyogs yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis ma'i nang du/ 11snye dus rabs bar ma'i me tog 21kha no sa don rkyen/ 32nor man gyi btsan 'dul/ 42skya mi ste 6 bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyan cha / 51rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis shar phyogs su btsan 'dzul byas pa/ 63i jib kyi mi rigs dpa' bo sa la khen/ 78lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug 856 or len si'i bu mo ’ 'jon ar khe/ 97wa the thi ler gyi 'os langs 105'jon hu si dang hu si'i dmag 'khrug 117khro zhan gyi ljar pan 'gog pa'i dpa' bo li hron khrin/ 127tā hwa gsar bcos/ 139krung go dang ljar pan rgyal khab gnyis kyi rig gnas spel res kyi pho nya ste btsun pa can krin/ 148mu ham sme sde dang 〈khu ran gsung rab〉/ 159a rab rtsom rig gi nor bu ste 〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉 /69

grong khyer chen mo khon si than then pho dgra bo'i lag tu shor ba/ 177rje chen si the hphan/ 186mar kho pho lo krung go ru bzhugs tshul/ 199shar phyogs su gser 'tshol bar phyin pa'i thog ma'i rkang rjes/ 209kho lom sbo yis 64skam sa chen po gsar pa mi rnyed pa/ 220sa'i go lar thengs dang por bskor ba brgyab nas mtsho skyod byas pa/ 229sngar med kyi chag sgo chen po/ 239dpa' mi zhum pa'i mo zhi kho yi en rdi an gyi mi/ 248mar then lu ther gyis chos lugs bsgyur bcos byas tshul/ 255rlabs che ba'i 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug 2666 lug gis mi sha za ba ’ dang 6 khrag dri bro ba'i khrims lugs/ ’ 2786 do med dmag gru'i ru khag rtsa gtor btang ba/ 287thun then dang khong gi 〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉/ 297le'o nār rdo rda wen khi dang 〈mtha' mjug gi dgong ja〉zhes pa/ 309snye dus rabs kyi bla srog ’ ste hre khe si phe'ar/ 320lha'i dbang por phog thug gtong phod pa'i mi ste khu pher ne khu si/ 330ru me yis nga rang 'dul mi thub / 3396 sa'i go la ni sngar ltar 'khor bzhin yod / 348

nub phyogasal rob 'dul mkhan gong ma chenawo khar lu si/ro ma nub ma'i ches mtha' ma'i rgyal po ro smu lu si zhes pa de spyi lo 476lor gnas dbyung btang rjes ro ma btsan rgyal nub ma rtsa med du song ba red/ dus de nas bzung / yo rab de dus rabs bar ma'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs su zhugs/ ro ma 'dul mkhan wa wa'ajar man pas yo rab tu rgyal khab du ma btsugs shing / de'i nang ches stobs shugs che ba ni hpha ran khe (718ba6ṣṭha༅༅)zhes pa'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab yin/ rgyal khab de lo rgyus stong lo ngo sum brgya drug bcu'i ring ma nub pa red/hpha ran khe'i rgyal po dang po ni khe lo we si ((10713 lho )yinal/khong gis btsugs pa'i rgyal rabs la sme ro we (5670766 stsam)rgyal rabs zer/ (spyi lo 481—751lo'i bar)khe lo we yis ye shu'i chos tshogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og mu mthud du phyir bskyed dmag 'khrug brgyab/ khong gi rgyud 'dzin pas kyang gang sa gang du dmag 'khrug brgyab pas mthar thug dus rabs drug pa'i dus dkyil du rgyal po'i rgyal khab de yo rob nub ma'i 'jar man pa'i ches stobs shugs can gyi rgyal khab tu gyur/ga'o lu'u (675/ ṇa)btul rjes hpha ran khe'i mis sa khongs kyi 'brel ba ltar du ma khe zhes pa'i zhing sde'i kung hre btsugs/ sa zhing ma khe la dbang zhing khang sa dang ra skor mtha' 'khor gyi sa zhing ni mi sger la dbang pa'i rgyu nor red/ rmo zhing dang rtswa sa mi sger la bgos nas mi rabs nas mi rabs la rgyud 'dzin bgyi chog kyang phyir btsong ba'am nang bshug gtong mi chog lo tog brnga bsdu byas rjes zhing sa dang 'brog sa'i mtha'i ra skor bsag

nas sa zhing ma btab pa dang 'brel nas spyi spyod 'brog sa byed dgos/ hpha ranas pa'i 〈sa le khe khrims yig〉gi khrims nga dgu par skyes pa kho nar rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang cha yod ces bris yod na'ang / dus rabs drug pa'i smad du rgyal po hel sbi le khe yis bsgrags pa'i bka' khyab cig tu bud med la'ang rgyud 'dzin dbang cha yod pa byas/ ma khe'i sa zhing lam lugs ni spyi la dbang pa'i lam lugs nas sger la dbang pa'i lam lugs su brgal pa'i rnam pa zhig red/dus rabs bdun pa'i dus stod du sger la dbang pa'i lam lugs su rim bzhin brgal tshar pas/ sa zhing sger la dbang pa ma zad da dung bshug gtong byas kyang chog cing / ma khe'i khongs mi'i nang yang dbul phyug gi khyad par byung ba hpha /na/ khe'i spyi tshogs kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin can du bsgyur ba'i go rim ni dus rabs drug pa'i dus smad nas 'go brtsamasashing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin du bsgyur ba'i go rim nang / phyogs gcig nas/ spyi tshogs kyi khongs mi gtso bo ste rang dbang can gyi zhing pa nyams zhan du song nas zhing bran du gyur/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ sku drag tsho sa zhing chen po dbang pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tu gyur/ spyi lo 751lor pho brang blon po (dang thog pho brang la bdag gnyer byed mi yin la/ rjes su sa bdag chen por gyur pa ma zad da dung rgyal khab kyi dbang cha yod tshad bdag 'dzin byas)phe phen (2691 ba /0 770( chag mtshang la gte leb zer)zhes pas chos tshogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og hpha ran khe'i rgyal po'i go sa g.yo 'phrog byas nas/ kha ro len (281011brtsa meb/:tho)rgyal rabs btsugs/ gte leb phe phen dang ro ma gyi chos rgyal bar mna' mthun gyi 'brel ba dam po btsugs nas/ mu mthud du phyi yul du dmag 'khrug brgyab/ khyad par du sa khe son gyi mi (387003 chachordo)dang sba yon (227670 ༅7 lko)༅)gyi mi la brgyab pa'i dmag 'khrug

la rgyal kha blangs pas/ hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi re en gtsang po'i phyi yul gyi stobs shugs sra brtan du btang /768lor phe phen gyi bu khar lu si ma sge nu si ((870153 566ba bya ༅7426814lo'i bar)yis pha'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byas/ khar lu si ma sge nu si ni rgyal po'i go sar lo 46la bzhugs pa dang rgyal khab kyi khongs rgya ches cher bskyed/ drag shugs spyad de tsho ba mang po dang ru sde mang po dbang 'og tu bsdus pas kha ro len rgyal po'i rgyal khab dar rgyas rtser son du thon no//khar lu si ma sge nu sis bka' khyab rab dang rim pa bsgrags nas/khong gi mnga' 'bangs (de'i nang cho lo'i mtshan thob kyi mi drag dang mnga' bdag rang dbang can gyi 'bangs mi sogs yod)tshang ma dmag dpung nang bsdus/ 〈smi so lo bka' khyab〉ces pa'i nang / tsa cho lo'i mtshan gnas can gyi mi re re dmag tu zhugs skabs/ mi gnyis shul du khur lu si ma sge nu si/bzhag nas mnga' khongs srung ba dang /kho bo'i lcam mor rogs ram byed dgos/ mi gzhan pa thams cad dmigs bsal ci yang med par de dang mnyam du dmag rgyag tu 'gro dgos mizhes dang /rang dbang can gyi mi re re 4 nges par du dmag chas rang gis bsgrigs nas mnga' bdag gi rjes su 'brangs te dmag la zhugs dgos zhes bris yod/khar lu si ma sge nu sis da dung / dmag la zhugs mkhan gyis dmag chas /nga

gis kha tshang bsgrig dgos shing / dbul po mi drug res mi gcig la dmag chas sgrig rogs byed dgos/ pa'o rim mtshan can rang gis dmag la zhugs mkhan tsho'i dmag chas 'dang min la zhib bsher byas te/ mi re re la mdung ring gcig dang / phub gcig gzhu gcig gzhu rgyud gnyis/ mda' bcu gnyis sogs e 'dang blta dgos zhes gtan 'khel byas yod/ gong smras bka'akhyab lag tu btab nas dmag gi thon khungs la khag theg yod pa yong phyir/ khar lu si ma sge nu sis da dung / 6 rang dbang can gyi mi su dang sus bdag gi bka' la mthong chung byas nas/ dmag la gtan nas mi zhugs par khyim du bsdad na mi so li sdu si (30675 lkotsho 7)60yis (pho ran khe'i sgor mo )chad pa gcod dgos/ dmag 'khrug nang phyir bros rgyag mkhan rnams 6 srog khrims la sbyar nas rgyu nor gzhung bzhes gtong dgos mi zhes gtan 'khel nan mo byas 'dug de bzhin du khar lu si ma sge nu si yis stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i dmag dpung zhig btsugs so//774lor/ khar lu si ma sge nu si'i dmag dpung ni ri bo mthon po yal phe si la brgal nas dbyi tha li la thengs dang po'i rgyang 'dul byas/ de rjes thengs/ du mar rgyang 'dul byas mthar dbyi tha li'i byang khul gyi lon sbar sde si'i mi (20468163 637)btul nas sa khul de dag rang gi dbang 'og tu bsdus7/ 78lor khar lu si ma sge nu si'i dmag dpung slar yang yo rob nub lho khul gyi phi re ne'u si ri bo (21 11ba00bya lko/477)brgal nas thengs dang por i si lum chos lugs (13187 7lo༅)la dad pa'i se phan (5981 ba pomaskya)la rgyang 'dul byas kyang / thengs 'dir khar lu si ma sge nu si la rgyal kha ma thob pas phyir mi log ka med byung / lam bar du khong gi mjug srung dmag darding la phi re ne'u si ri bo'i khrod du sba si'i mis 'jab rgol byas nas dmag

mi yongs la dmar gsod thebs/ dmag dpung 'di khrid pa'i khar lu si'i mnga' 'og gi dmag dpon ro lan zhes pa'i dpa' bo des yang 'thab nas rang srog btang / rjes su skabs de'i rgyang 'dul gyi don rkyen 'di dus rabs bar ma'i hpha ran si'i skya mi'i rtsom rig gi bcoms chos te dpa' bo'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom ro lan gyi bstod glu〉zhes pa'i brjod bya gtso bor gyur/ ro lan ni lo rgyus snyan rtsom de'i mi sna gtso bo red/ snyan rtsom de'i nang du/ khar lu si yis se phan du a rab kyi mi rigs 'go dpon smal sel dang dmag 'khrug brgyab pa'i skabs su/ smal sel gyis pho nya mngags nas mgo sgur ba'i re ba zhus zhing / khar lu si yis nā lon zhes pa phor nyar brdzangs nas smal sel dang mgo sgur bar cha rkyen gang dgos gros mol byed du bcug yin na'ang nā lon blo log nas/ smal sel la khar lu si'i dmag dpung phyir rgyal nang du log pa'i dus su de'i mjug srung dmag dpung la phar rgol byas na 'grig ces thabs 'don jus 'bul byas/ ro lan ni mjug srung dmag gi dmag dpon gtso bo yin zhing / khong gi dmag dpung go hrag nyis khri yis dka' spyad 'thab 'dzing byas mthar yongs rdzogs g.yul sar rang srog btang / mthar mjug khar lu si yis tshe las 'das pa'i 'thab grogs tshor dgra sha blangs nas dgra bo yod rgu tshar gcod btang nas/ blo log pa nā lon la srog khrims bcad pa sogs brjod yod/ lo rgyus snyan rtsom de'i nang gtso bo ro lan g.yul sar grongs pa'i skabs kyi dpa' mar zhim med kyi dpa' bo'i snying stobs dang rgyal po khar lu si la blo sems dkar pa'i skor bris yod/ lo rgyus snyan rtsom rshadiX brdod don 'gangs chen du ma ni rtog bzo byas pa'ang smos mi dgos pa ga ༵ 1lo//ra khar lu si yis slar yang se phan la rgyang 'dul byas nas/ sbar se lo nā mkhar (2870010ba ༅7776)blangs te sa khul kha shas 'phrog /sa

snye se phan mtha' srung sa khul ’ btsugs/khar lu si yis phyir bskyed dmag 'khrug lo rgyus steng / ches gal che ba'i don chen po ni sar khe son gyi mi btul ba de red/ dmag 'khrug 'di 772lo nas 'go brtsams shing 804lor mjug bsgril bar lo ngo 32'gor/sa khe son gyi mi ni yo rob dbus khul du sdod cing re en gtsang po nas el sbe (2166 5467)gtsang po'i bar gyi rgya che ba'i sa khul bzung nas sdod yod/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus smad du da rung gdod ma'i kung hre'i lam lugs kyi mtha' ma'i dus rabs su gnas shing / khar lu si yis sa khe son gyi mi 'dul ba'i dmigs yul ni de tsho zhing bran du bsgyur nas de tsho'i sa zhing 'phrog rgyu de red/ 772lo nas bzung khar lu si yis dmag dpung khrid nas sa khe son gyi mi la dmag 'khrug thengs bco brgyad brgyab/ 777lor sa khe son gyi sku drag mang che ba khar lu si'i mnga' 'og tu 'dzul/ yin na'ang rgya che ba'i sa khe pon mi dmangs kyis khar lu si'i btsan 'dul la ngo rgol byas pas 782lor 'os langs rgya chen po byas/ 'os langs pas sen ther ri bo ru hpha ran khe'i dmag dpung rdul du brlag nas/ hpha ran khe'i dmag dpon dang /pa'o rim go sa can gyi sku drag dang chos spel mkhan thams cad bsad/ 'os langs de sa khe son gyi yul khongs yongs su khyab/ khar lu si yis 'phral myur gyi byed thabs spyad de we ser (yo6361 stsa ma)gtsang po'i 'gram du sa khe son gyi mi pham ste bzung dmag 4500dmar gsod brgyab te khrom ston byas/khar lu sis sa khe son la btsan pos dbang sgyur byas nas(sa khe son bka' khyab〉bsgrags par/ 6 bdag gis mngags pa'i pho nyas bka' bzhin du gcig sdud byed pa las/ sa khe son gyi mi ni 'du tshogs bya mi chog ’ ces dang tsa rgyal por blo mi dkar pa'i spyod pa can la srog khrims gcod rgyu yin ’ zhes gakān 'khel byas yod do//

dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin yod pa red/ thengs 'dir skabs legs po de dang bstun nas snga sa nas re mos byas pa'i gong ma chen po'i cod pan e lon blta ru 'gro dgos byung / 800lo'i zla 12par khar lu si ni grang rlung chen por ma 'dzems par rgyang 'dul dmag dpung khrid de ro ma la slebs nas/ stobs shugs can gyi dmag dpung bkol nas le o sku rabs gsum pa'i dbang cha slar gso byas/khar lu si la drin lan 'jal ched/ lo de'i ye shu'i 'khrungs skar dus chen la/ san phe thi lha khang chen mo ru/ le o sku rabs gsum pas rgyal po khri la mnga' gsol ba'i mdzad sgo'i tshogs nas/ gser 'od lam lam du 'tsher ba'i rgyal po'i prog zhu zhig khar lu si'i mgo la bskon nas/ 6 gnam lha chen pos khar lu si la rgyal po'i pod can gnang ba red/ da lta rlabs che zhing ro ma la zhi bde gnang mkhan rgyal po 'de'i sku tshe ji srid bar du brtan pa dang nam yang rgyal kha len par smon lam 'debs rgyu mi zhes bsgrags/ khungs med kyi bstod tshig khrod hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab ni khar lu si btsan rgyal du gyur pa dang khar lu si yang gong ma chen por gyur pas de la bla na ma mchis pa'i dbang cha yod do// dus de nas bzung yo rob tu chos lugs kyi dbang cha dang rgyal po'i dbang cha gnyis zung 'brel byas/ chos rgyal le o sku rabs gsum par lā the ran chos khang (28 khung ba khri zo)gi byang ngos su bkal ba'i tshos ldan ri mo zhig yod par phe sde (ye shu'i slob ma zhig)yis chos rgyal la zla gam cig gnang bzhin yod pa dang / rgyal po la dar zhig gnang bzhin pa'i tshul bris shing / smon 'debs kyi tshigs su 6 phe sde mchog gis tshe srog chos rgyal le o la gnang zhing / rgyal kha ni gong ma khar lu si la gnang mizhes bkod yod/'di ni 6 sge la si a'i dam tshig zhes pa ste chos kyi dbang cha dang rgyal po'i da~Xng cha gnyis kyis thun mong du 'dzam gling dbang sgyur byed par dad sems

chen po khar lu si sku dngos su song nas zhing pa'i 'os langs la drag gnon byed myong / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin du bsgyur ba'i go rim yongs su grub pa dang / btsan rgyal nang khul gyi blo bral stobs shugs kyang nyin re bzhin je ngar du song bas/ btsan rgyal 'thor zhig tu 'gro bar phyogs/ 824lo'i zla dang por lo na 72la son pa'i gong ma chen po khar lu si de rgyal sa a khen (48050ba rsālko)tu tshe las 'das/ kho'i bu dad ldan pa le'u si (60513 1621 05ci skya de chos lugs la dad pa che bas mtshang la dad ldan pa zer)zhes pas rgyal po'i go sa bzung / le'u si'i bu gsum (lo tha'e re 60 68173 724 'jar man le'u si/ skra med khar lu si bcas gsum)pos btsan rgyal gsum du bgos shing / cung ma 'gor bar bu gsum po'i bar dbang cha rtsod pa'i dmag 'khrug byung / 833lor bu gsum po mnyam 'brel byas nas pha rgan le'u si la ngo rgol byas/ rgad po le'u si rang gi dmag mi tshos g.yul sar g.yug nas bros pas kho dang btsun mo gnyis rang gi bu'i bzung dmag tu gyur/840lor le'u si tshe las 'das/ phyi lor bu gsum po'i nang 'khrug gi 'go bcoms pa dang / 843lor da gzod wer rdun (50775ba poskya)du chings yig bzhag ste btsan rgyal chen po de dngos su rgyal khab gsum du bgos te/ shar khul sa cha 'jar man le'u si la dbang zhing de la hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab shar ma zer/ nub khul sa khul ni skra med khar lu si la dbang pa dang ming la hpha ran khe rgya po'i rgyal khab nub ma zer/ dkyil gyi zheng dog cing dkyus ring ba'i sa khul lo tha'e re la dbang pa dang gong ma chen mo'i go sa rgyud 'dzinabyas/ rjes sor rmang gzhi 'di'i steng nye rabs nub phyogs yo rob kyi /la khab gtso bo gsum ste 'jar man dang hpha ran si/ dbyi tha li grub pa yin 10

nub phyogasal rab kyilikasabakod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis gzigang du/hpha ran khe rgyal khab kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi gzhi rkang ni dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus mjug dang dus rabs dgu ba'i dus mgor dngos su tshugs/ rjes su nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab gzhan dag tu yang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs btsugs/ hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis ku'i lam lugs rmang gzhi byas pa dang / gzhis ka de dag nub phyogs yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gzhis ku'i mtshon byed mig dpe red/hpha ran khe'i rgyal khab tu/ rgyal po dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chos tshogs gsum gyis rgyal yongs kyi sa zhing mang che ba bzung yod pa ma zad/ da dung dam zhing nan pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rim pa'i lam lugs btsugs yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi ches mtho'i 'bus tshab ni gong ma rgyal po yin pa dang / de'i 'og tu bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag mang po bgos yod cing de dag la rim pa mi 'dra ba'i sku drag gi mtshan gnas yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chung ba tshos mnga' bdag chen po'i lag nas bgos skal du thob pa'i sa zhing len dgos/ rim pa re re'i gong 'og bar la mnga' bdag dang zur gtogs kyi 'brel ba yod/ mnga' bdag gis zur gtogs la srung skyob byed dgos shing / zur gtogs kyis mnga' bdag la blo dkar ba'i dam sdu/'a

'jog dgos shing tshad nges can gyi 'bul ba phul dgos la/ dmag 'khrug skabs su da dung dmag la'ang zhugs dgos pa red/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gis rang la dbang ba'i sa zhing steng gzhis ka du ma btsugs yod pas/ de ni spyi tshogs thon skyed kyi ches rmang gzhi'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi rnam pa red/ mnga' bdag re la gzhis ka gcig nas du ma yod cing gzhis ku'i che chung mi 'dra bar/ gzhis ka chen po kha shas nang tha na zhing sde 'ga' re dang sa zhing smi stong phrag du ma yod/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gi sa zhing ni ci ltar blangs pa red ce na/ de la thabs lam gnyis yod de/ gcig ni zhing pa'i sa zhing btsan 'phrog byas pa de red/ mnga' bdag chen po de dag ste khyad par du sku drag gi mtshan gnas yod pa'i mi drag tshos btsan shed la brten nas rang dbang zhing ba'i sa zhing 'phrog nas de tsho rang gi zhing bran du bsgyur/811lor khar lu si yis bka' khyab cig bsgrags pa'i nang / khrag dmar 'dzar bzhin pa'i dngos don de mtshon yod/ 6 zhing ba dbul phongs tshos kho tsho'i rgyu nor 'phrog song zhes zhu 'bod brjod bzhin 'dug de bzhin du chos bdag dang dgon bdag kho tshor srung skyob byed mkhan pa'o rim mtshan gnas can dang brgya dpon sogs kyi nag nyes bgrang gin 'dug mices dang /6 don de las mtshon don/ gal srid rang gi rgyu nor chos bdag dang dgon bdag pa'o rim mtshan gnas can gyi sku drag dang brgya dpon la ma phul na/mi rnams kyis go skabs btsal nas zhing ba der nag nyes bgrangs nas khrims chad gcod pa ma zad/ tha na btsan gyis mi de dmag nang bsdu pa dang /dbul po de'i rgyu nor btsong ba dang bshug pa'i skabs la thon pa'i bar tsam du de lta byed/ 'bul ba phul tshar ba'i mi rnams ni zhi 'jags sos bde ru rang khyidi snro sdod mices bkod yod/ gnyis pa ni rgyal pos gsol res gnang ba de

red/ gong ma chen po khar lu si yis phyi la dmag 'khrug brgyab te 'phrog pa'i rgya che ba'i yul khongs de dag yul gru chen po re re byas nas rang nyid kyi nye 'khor mdun blon rnams la gnang nas de dag gis rang la blo sems dkar po yod du bcugadus skabs der chos tshogs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin can du bsgyur bas/chos tshogs kyis sa zhing btsan 'phrog dang zhing ba bran du bkol pa'i bya 'gul nang nus shugs chen po bton yod/ tshan rig dang shes rig dar rgyas med pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu/ chos tshogs kyis shes med dang rmongs dad bed spyad de zhing bar mgo skor btang nas/ zhing ba'i rgyu nor chos tshogs la phul du bcug nas rang gi mnga' khongs je cher btang / hpha ran si'i pha ri si (2811 3)yi nye 'khor gyi san 'jar man dge sgrub khang gis phyogs gcig nas hpha ran khe'i rgyal po'i sbyin gnang len pa dang phyogs gcig nas dge sgrub khang rang gis g.yo len ham 'phrog byas par brten myur du mnga' khongs je cher btang ga/ zhis ga'i sa zhing ni khag gnyis su bgos yod/ ches gshin pa'i sa zhing khag gcig (ha lam sum cha'i gcig)mnga' bdag gi rang gnyer sa zhing yin la zhing bran gyis 'debs pa red/ khag gzhan zhig (ha lam sum cha'i gnyis)ni du mar bgo ba dang de'i nang rmo zhing dang rtswa sa/ khang pa sogs 'du la zhing bran gyi bgo skal byas nas/ mnga' bdag gis zhing bran gyi khyim tshang la byin nas bkol spyod byed du 'jugamanga' bdag dang zhing bran gyi go gnas mi 'dra ba 'dis kho tsho'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul la khyad par chen po yod pa thag gcod byas yod/ 'byor phyug can gyi mnga' bdag tsho ni brjid chags ngom shom che ba'i khang chen du sdod cing / mnga' bdag ni skya pa zhig gam/ chos dpon gtso bo zhig dirdo na

dge sgrub khang gi 'go gtso zhig yin yang srid/ gal te dbang shugs che ba'i sku drag cig yin tshe/ de la brjid nyams che ba'i mkhar rdzong chen po yang yod de/ mkhar rdzong ni rtag tu ri'i steng ngam g.yang gzar ngos su bskrun 'dug pas/ de ni sdod khang yin la 'gog srung gi mkhar rdzong yang red/ mkhar rdzong gi thog khang gtso bo ni shing dang rdo las bzos shing / de la da rung sa dong 'ga' dang / tshoms chen gcig dang phyag 'tshal khang chung chung gcigamanga' bdag gi khyim mi tsho'i mal khang sogs yod/ phyogs bzhi ru rgyang lta byed sa'i so khang yod cing / ra skor nang du mdzod khang dang g.yog po'i sdod khang yod/ mkhar rdzong chen po de brtan zhing mkhregs pa'i gyang ra mthon pos bskor pa dang de'i mtha' ru mkhar srung chu 'obs yod pas rgya sgor 'dzul sar dpyang zam 'phangs yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tshos nyin ltar bzhin mkhar rdzong chen po de 'dra ba'i nang 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/ gyang mthug po dang sge'u khung chung chung gis mkhar rdzong dang phyi yul gyi rang dbang can gyi 'tsho ba'i bar bcad pas/ mun nag dang rlan che ba'i stong grang mo'i rnam pas mkhar rdzong g.yog cing de'i nang da rung gsal cha che ba'i sgron me yang med/ mnga' bdag dang kho'i khyim mi tshor rig gnas rol rtsed kyi bya 'gul ci yang med par bro med cho med kyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug mnga' bdag tshor dga' sa gcig yod pa ni mtshon cha ste ral gri yin zhing / lcam mo tshos spro gtong sems dgyes byed sa ni tshems bzo dang me tog gtsag drub kho na red/yin yang lo re'i dus chen gtso bo la slebs dus/ mkhar rdzong nang mdzad sgo chen mo'i 'go rtsom pa dang gzab rgyas gsol ston byed de/ tha na lus rtsal 'gran bsdur yang byed/ lo gcig gi nang gi dus chen ches che shos ni ye shu'i 'khrungs skar gyi dus chen dang 'das log gi dus chen gnyis yin/ zhing bran tsho ༵༵ mkhar rdzong nang 'ongs nas dus ston la zhugs chog pa red/

gzhis ga'i nang gi zhing bran tsho kho tsho'i spyil bu'i nang sdod cing zhing bran khyim tshang du ma las grong tsho zhig grub nas bdag po'i khyim chen dang thag mi ring sar chags yod/ kho tshos nyi ma shar tshe las ka las pa dang nyi ma nub tshe ngal gso byed pa'i 'tsho ba rol ba dang / sdod khang nang sgron me nyung zhing g.yos sbyor byed kyi sa thab chung chung gcig las dron len spyad kyi me thab ci yang med/ zhing bran tshos lo gang por 'tsho ba thabs sdug bskyel pas bar bgag kāng nad yams ni grub ma ltar nam yin yang kho tsho dang 'grog nas gnas dus// rabs bar ma'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis ka so po'i chags stangs phal cher 'dra mtshungs yin/ phan tshun snol pa'i lam zhig gzhis ga'i phyogs bzhir brkyangs shing / chos khang chen po zhig gzhis ga'i lte gnas su bzhengs la/ bdag po dang zhing bran gyi sdod khang so sor rang gnas su bkar nas yod/ rmo zhing gi dkyil khul rtswa rags phra mos zhing sa shar ma du mar bcad 'dug rmo zhing gi phyi ru spyi spyod kyi rtswa sa yod cing / de ni zhing pa yongs la rtswa skam po 'don sprod bya sa red/ de las thag cung tsam ring ba'i sar spang thang dang spyi spyod 'brog sa dang nags tshal yid/ zhing bran re re la 'bru rigs mi 'dra ba ched du 'debs pa'i sa zhing yod cing kho tshos nges gtan ཿsa patā rtswa sa'i steng rtswa skam po len chog cing spyi spyod rtswa sa ru phyugs kyang 'tsho ga pa 'bye ri/ gas ni res skor nas 'debs pa dang / sa zhing yongs rdzogs dpyid rmo'i zhing sa dang ston rmo'i zhing sa/ lo der mi rmo ba'i zhing sa bcos su bgos/ zhing bran gyis sa zhing rmo ba'i dus su spyod pa'i rmo phyugs kyi gzugs stobs shin tu chung la/ rmo spyad kyi yo byad kyang ljid rdzob bkol mi bde ba red/shingagi gshol spyod pa dang sa bon lag pas gtor dgos shing 'bru ri/sdu kyi

gshasbu hā /sa /nye/ra pa re re'i bdag gnyer bya yul du bzo ba yag po dgos nges te/dper na lcags mgar dang / gser mgar/ dngul mgar/ lham bzo/ shing bzo/gri rdung mkhan/ nya ba/ ri dwags kyi rjes 'ded mkhan/ 'dag rdzas bzo mkhan/ chang sbi ra dang ku shu'i chang sogs btung bya bzo mkhan/ bag leb dang mngar sob bag leb bzo mkhan/ ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rnyi rgya dang nya rgya/ 'dab chags 'dzin byed kyi rnyi rgya bzo mkhan dang bzo ba gzhan pa mang po dgos te 'di ru so sor dper ma drangs sos de las mi rnams la gzhis ka ni rang kha rang gso'i rang byung dpal 'byor gyi sde tshan zhig yin pa gsal por bstan yod do//bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis ku'i nang du/ bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon myong mkhan gtso bo ni zhing bran gral rim yin/ khrims lugs ltar du kho tsho bran zhing dang rang dbang phyed tsam yod pa'i zhing pa/ bran g.yog bcas rim pa gsum la bkar yod kyang / dus rabs dgu pa'i skabs su zhing pa'i rim pa de gsum la khyad par chen po med par phyogs gcig tu 'dres nas zhing bran gral rim du gyur yod/mnga' bdag gis zhing bran la bshu gzhog byed pa'i byed thabs gtso bo ni sa bogs yin zhing / de'i nang sa bogs las khral dang dngos por phab pa'i sa bogs gnyis 'du/ rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul ltar na/ zhing bran gyis gza' 'khor gcig tu nyin gsum bzhi tsam la mnga' bdag gi sa zhing du las ka las dgos shing / lo tog 'breg pa'i dus sam zhing las la brel ba che ba'i skabs su da dung las ka las pa'i nyin grangs kha snon rgyag dgos/ gzhan yang / btsan shed sgos gnas skabs kyi las ka ste/ dper na zam bzo ba dang / zhing las yo byad zhig gso/ rib ma bzo ba/ sa dong brko ba dang lug bal 'breg pa sogs kyi las ka las dgos/ rjes su mnga' bdag tshos snyizlos

por phab pa'i sa bog ni zhing bogs dngul 'gyur la bsgyur nas/ zhing bran tshor lo rer tshad nges bcad kyi dngos po sprod du bcug de'i nang 'bru rigs dang gro phye/ chang sbi rag/ sgo bya/ bya sgong la sogs 'du/ zhing bran la da dung las 'gan lci mo zhig yod pa ni mnga' bdag la dpya khral mang po ste dper na mi khral/ gnyen sgrig gi khral/ gyod gtug gi khral sogs mjal dgos pa de red/ dpya khral de rigs la rtag tu dngul lor sprod dgos pas/don dngos ni dngul lor sa bogs su gyur yod pa red/ rgyal po chen po khar lu si'i〈gzhis ga'i bka' khyab〉kyi rtsa tshig 62pa'i nang las nga chos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag ches che shos 'di ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gzhis ku'i 6 gong ma'i yab chen yin pa gsal por shes thub/ bka' khyab de ru/dze // mari ci dngha ) la —— ci ༅ro/rige— mnga' bdag la sa bogs sprod bzhin pa/18

4kho bos bdag gnyer pa re rer bka' babs pa gsham ltar/ lo rer kho bor lo gang po'i nang yong sgo ga tshod yod pa bdag la snyan zhu bya dgos/ de'i nang rnam grangs gsham gsal yod de/ kho bo'i zhing rmo mkhan gyis rmo phyugs spyad de btab pa'i sa zhing dang / gzhis ku'i nang zhing pa tshos btab pa'i sa zhing / phag dang sa bogs/ 'bul dngos dang nyes chad dngul lor gyi rtsis tho/ kho bo 'thad pa ma byung bar kho bo'i nags tshal khrod brngon pa'i ri dwags dang 'dab chags/ nyes chad kyi dngul lor sna tshogs/'thag khang dang nags tshal/ sa zhing / zam pa/ gru gzings sogs kyi yong sgo/ rang dbang can gyi mi dang kho bo'i rgyal mdzod la dpya khral mjal ba'i 'os 'gan yod pa'i mi'i kha grangs/ tshong ra dang rgun 'brum ra ba/ kho bor chang 'bul rgyu'i 'os 'gan yod pa'i mi dang / gzan rtswa dang bud shing / sgron shing / shing leb dang shing cha gzhan/spang thang / sngo tshod dang 'bru rigs/ khre chu ma/ lug bal/ ya ma so ma/ gso dkar/shing tog/ zil rtog skam po che chung sna tshogs/ yal ga mthud sbyor byas pa'i shing rigs sna tshogs/ skyed mos tshal/ nyung ma/ nya rdzing / ko ba mnyes ma/ pags pa/ sems can gyi rwa/ sbrang rtsi dang sbrang tshil/ phag tshil/ skam lug gi tshil/ 'dag rdzas/ zil chang / chang btsos ma/ sbrang chang / skyur chu/ chang sbri rag rgyan chang gsar rnying /'bru rigs gsar rnying / mo bya dang bya sgong / ngang pa/ nya ba/ mgar ba/ ral gri rdung mkhan/ lham bzo bcas kyi kha grangs/ mdzod khang dang sgam gyi kha grangs/ rta sga bzo mkhan/ lcags dang lcags rigs gzhan gyi gter khung dang bzhu ra/ zha nye'i gter kha/ rgod ma dang rte'u rgyal po chen po khar lu sis ya nga med par zhing bran la btsir gnon byas nas gzhis ma'i nang gi thon skyed dngos po yod tshad kho la dbang pa ma zad/da dung btsan shed du zhing bran la dngos po mang po 6 'don sprod byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod ces thag gcod byas/ de'i nang 6 phag tshil/ nya sha/ sha bsnyal ma/ chang / skyur chu/ zil chang / chang btsos ma/ nya bsnyal nas thon pa'i chang / ske phye/ phyu ra/ mar/ gro'i phab rtsi/ chang sbi rag sbrang chang / 1snang

rdo/ sprang tshil/ gro phye sogs 'du la/ 'di dag ni thob cha med pa'i 'bul ba na/ gong ma chen po khar lu sis da dung kho pa'i blon 'bangs yod tshad kyis chos tshogs la bcu gcig dpya khral mjal dgos pa'i bka' babs/ de ni mi rang gi lo gcig gi yong 'bab dngos po'i bcu cha'i gcig chos tshogs la khral du mjal dgos pa de yin zhing/ zhing bran la mtshon na de yang khur po ha cang ljid po zhig yin no//gdug rtsub chen po'i ngang bshu gzhog byas pas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gzhis ku'i 'ching sgrog nang bcings pa'i zhing bran tsho ha cang dbul zhing phongs ba'i gnas su lhung yod/ kho tsho rtag tu phyi ru bros nas ngo rgol byed/mtshams mtshams su rgyal pos bka' babs nas phyir bros pa'i zhing bran phyir bdag por sprod du 'jug rjes su mngon sum du byung ba'i zhing pa'i 'os langs kyang byung myangs te/ gong ma chen po khar lu sis dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dus skabs su/ ser the grong sde ru zhing pas drag po'i 'os langs byas nas gzhis ku'i gnyer pa bsad/ 841 — 842lor sa khe son du zhing pa'i 'os langs rgya chen po zhig glor du langs nas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag mang po bsad pa dang phyir skyod btang / 848lo dang 866lor chos gtso ma'e dbyin si'i mnga' khul du'ang zhing pa'i 'os langs chen po re slangs pa red/ 'os langs de dag la drag gnon byas na'ang / tshad mi 'dra ba'i ngang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bdag po'i gral rim la rdung deg cung ran po zhig btang nas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bshu gzhog byed par tshad bkag byas yod pas/ spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nas shugs kyi 'phel rgyas la phan nus bton pa ma zad/ da dung nub phyogs yo rab kyi grong khyer 'byung bar cha rkyenā pyang bskrun yod pa red/

6 dus rabasathar ma'i me tog dus rabs snga ma'i dus su/ nub phyogs yo rob dang shar phyogs su ming grags can gyi grong khyer mang po yod/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi grong khyer kha shas ni ro ma dus rabs kyi sngon du gnas pa ste/ dper na spyi lo 79lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 24nyin gyi snga dro'i chu chod10pa'i steng we su le'u si (5035515bya smosmo)me ri las 'phyur pa'i zhun rdo dang me ri'i thal bas brlag pa'i dbyi tha li'i gna' mkhar phon phe (202961 1 77)zhes pa ni spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 6par bskrun/ yin na'ang ro ma btsan rgyal gyi dus mjug la thon pa'i dus su/dus rabs snga ma'i skabs kyi grong khyer dag ni me lce chen po'i nang re re bzhin nyams rgyad du song nas mi med sa stong du gyur pas/ 66de dag gi 'das pa'i dus kyi shes rig thams cad shor song ngo ’ dus rabs bar ma'i snga mo'i dus te spyi lo 9pa nas 10pa'i nang / nub phyogs yo rob tu grong khyer gsar pa re 'ga' byung na'ang / de dag ni 'gog srung gnas gzhi dang chos dpon gyi sdod tshig yang na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin lte gnas tsam las ma 'da'/ grong khyer de dag ni dpal 'byor gyi lte gnas ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs der lag shes bzo las dang zhing las gnyis so sor kha gyes med cing dngos po brje res kyi rnam pa dar rgyas su song med par rang byung dpal 'byor gtso bor bzung yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/'on kyang shar phyogs su khon si than then pho (2003 chis 100916bye/rke

712) nas sbag sge sda (2826686 377) dang / sda ma si khu si che la bya05bya mcha lko)nas khrang an sogs khyon rgya che ba'i lag shes bzo las dang tshong las kyi grong khyer du ma chags yod par gra rgyas 'du 'dzi shin tu che/ rgya gar dang rgya nag gi grong khyer kha shas su mi 'bor mang la dpal dang 'byor ba ldan pa dang / grong khyer de dag las rgyas spros dngos rdzas thon skyed byas nas/ rgyun chad med par rjes lus kyi nub phyogs yo rob tu drangs nas mi drag phyug po tshor longs la spyod du bcugadus rabs 10pa nas dus rabs 11pa'i dus la slebs dus/ yo rob spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs la gong 'phel byung bas/ lag shes bzo las dang zhing las gnyis so sor gyes shing / de ni dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob kyi grong khyer byung ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen red/ lag shes bzo las ched las can du 'gyur bar byang du chud pa'i lag rtsal dgos pa ma zad/da dung thon rdzas btsong ba'i ched du (mnga' bdag gam rang nyid kyi dgos mkho'i ched min pa) thon skyed byed dgos stabs/ lag shes bzo las dang zhing las zung 'brel bya mi dgos pa byung / kher gnyer byed pa'i lag shes bzo ba tshos tshong rdzas btsong ba'i phyir du 'dzad spyod byed mkhan la nye ba'i sa'am phyir btsong cha rkyen bzang ba'i sa ru 'dzoms 'du byas byung / nub phyogs yo rob kyi grong khyer 'byung ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gzhan zhig ni zhing las thon skyed nus shugs la mthor 'degs byung ba de yin la/ de ni rgyu cha dang 'bru rigs/ zhing las thon rdzas kyi tshong ra ni grong khyer la med du mi rung ba zhig yin pas red/ dus skabs der zhing las la 'phel rgyas chen po byung stabs/ lag shes bzo las dang tshong las kyi lte gnas su gyur pa'i gsar byung grong khyer mang po nub phyogs yo rob tu byung ba red/ 22dbyi tha li dang hpha ran si'i nub lho'i khul ni ro ma shar ma dang shar

phyogs tshong las la 'gro 'ongs che bas/ de ru thog mar dus rabs bar ma'i grong khyer dar ba yin te/ dper na we nee dzi a (500021 8 2246)dang sge ne wa (60 078 shā5skya'ikrokhru) nā phi le si (sa89163 skya'isnangacakhri46) ar le si (41163 khu1merga) mar se le (521361 50 6zlordo) dang nā phang (zasanyam)sogs lta bu red/ hpha ran si'i byang khul grong khyer byung ba yang cung snga bas pha ri si (2871 bya stsa)dang / li yon (650ba 47)grong khyer sogs byung / rjes su ne ther lan (sa 66118ba7 7 ༅)dang en sge lan (2brtsa/thabam cho 4)dang 'jar man nub lho'i sa khul/ re en gtsang po dang rdo no gtsang po'i 'bab rgyud du grong khyer ni smyo dus rabs bar ma'i me tog tu 'bod pa (yen ke si'i gsung )bzhin du gang sa gang du bzhad do//deng skabs gna' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i dus kyi grong khyer mang che ba ni tshad mthor dar rgyas byung ba'i deng rabs can gyi grong khyer chen por gyur nas/ de ru ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 6 deng rabs shes rig gis khengs 'dug la/mi rnams kyis stabs legs te ma nub pa'i chos khang chen po dang / shin tu nyung ba'i brtsigs dngos las 'das pa'i dus kyi nyams 'gyur sasal mi gsal tsam mthong thub bo//dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob kyi grong khyer du/ srang lam dog la kyag kyog yin pas lam 'gro ba dang shing rta mang po'i 'tshang kha rgyag gin zing zing mgo rnga med par 'gro ba mngon/ srang lam gi logs gnyis ni shing las grub pa'i thog khang mthon po yin la/ thog khang gi klad rim srang lam phyogs su brkyangs nas nyi 'od bkag pas/ sung lam ni lhag par nag thim mer 'dug grong khyer nang chu 'dren spu gu dang sa 'og chu lam yang med pas khromathong shin tu rdzob por snang / sung lam du mar chu rdo btang nas bzos shing lam ngos mi mnyam pas shing rta bgrod dus chog sgra sgrog gin 'dug 2snang

tsam rgya che zhing khod snyoms pa ni tshong ra kho na yin/ khrom tshogs pa'i nyin der zhing pa mang pos dngos po gang tshad blugs pa'i shing rta ded nas khrom rar 'dus te mi mang pos tshong rgyag pa'i 'khrug po che ba'i rnam pa 'byung nges red/nyin mor/ grong khyer nang du brel 'tshub ngang lag shes bzo las kyi thon skyed byed pa dang tshong las la brel zhing / mtshan mor srang du sgron me med pas/grong khyer yongs mun pas yongs su bzung nas 'dug chang khang chung chung dag gi nang du sgron mes 'od kyis bkang zhing chang 'thung mkhan tsho phar 'ongs tshur 'gro byas nas 'ur sgra sgrog gan 'dug spyir btang gi 'bangs mi'i sdod khang la mtshon na sgron me gsal la mi gsal zhig ma gtogs mthong rgyu med/grong khyer re la spyir btang du sdod dmangs stong phrag 'ga' re yod cing /dus rabs 14pa'i dus su/ en sge lan gyi skad grags can gyi grong khyer lon khon (20bskuXs ma)la mi 'bor bzhi khri lhag yod pas/ grong khyer chen mo zhig tu brtsis yod mod/ 'on kyang skabs de'i krung go'i nan cing grong khyer gyi mi 'bor de sa ya gcig las kyang brgal yod/ grong khyer de gnyis bsdur pas na dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob kyi grong khyer gyi rgya khyon ji 'dra'i chung ngu zhig yin pa gsal por mthong thub bo//dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob gyi grong khyer chen po mang che ba la ha cang mtho ba'i mkhar gyang yod pa'i steng du srung dmag kyang yod/ mkhar gyang gi nang du/ dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'thab rtsod kyis khengs 'dugagrong khyer gyi kha lo sgyur mkhan ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag yin la/ rgyu mtshan ni grong khyer de dag mnga' bdag gi mnga' khongs su chags yod pas yin la/ grong khyer kha shas ni mnga' bdag tsho thad gar nang du zhugs nas 'dzugs skrun byas pas red/ mnga' bdag tshos rang 'dod gang ltar du groX rdor de dag bkod sgrig bgyi chog ste/ dper na nang bshug gtong ba'am

bgo ba/ rjes rabs par rgyud 'dzin byed du 'jug pa sogs gang 'dod bya chog grong khyer gyi srid don do dam dang khrims 'dzin dbang cha yang mnga' bdag tshos rang gi lag tu bzung yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos grong khyer la tshong las dpya khral bsdu ba ma zad/ da dung btsan shed bkol nas sdod dmangs tsho 'u lag rgyug tu 'jug mnga' bdag tshos btsan bkag do dam 'og grong khyer gyi 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog chen po thebs/ grong khyer gyi sdod dmangs mang che ba ni bros bshol du 'ongs pa'i zhing bran tsho rim bzhin grong mir gyur pa las grub/ kho tshos lag shes bzo las dang tshong las byed cing / kho tshor srung skyob thob rgyu dang gong 'phel yong bar re ba drag po yod/ de lta na nges par du mnga' bdag gi snying rje med pa'i bshu gzhog dang btsan gnon las thar dgos/ de'i phyir grong khyer gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag la ngo rgol byas nas grong khyer rang skyong byed rgyur rtsod len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de/ dus rabs 11pa nas 12pa'i bar nub phyogs yo rab yongs su rgya cher spel ba red/dus rabs 11pa la 'thab rtsod de thog mar grong khyer dar che ba'i sa khul te dbyi tha li dang hpha ran si/ no ther lan sogs sa khul du byung / 'thab rtsod ni rgyun du dza drag can du gyur pas mtshams mtshams su tha na drag po'i 'os langs su yang 'gyur 'gro bzhin yod/ dbyi tha li'i smi lan (51 1820 lko༅)du dus rabs 11pa'i dus dkyil du mnga' bdag la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byung ba dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gi dmag dpung phyir skyod btang nas lo gsum tsam la 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas mthar rang skyong gi dbang cha thob/ grong khyer kha shas kyis 'thab rtsod ni dus yun ring po zhig gi ring la rgyun 'khyongs byas/ shul bzhag lo rgyus yig tshang lasang tshos hpha ran si'i byang phyogs kyi grong khyer ran zhes pa'i sdod da~Xs

kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi btsir gnon las dkrol phyir dang rang skyong gi dbang cha rtsod len byed ched lo ngo nyis brgya lhag gi ring 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas pa mthong thub/ ran grong khyer ni 'khal 'thag las rigs kyi lte gnas shig yin la/ de ru mnga' bdag dang chos dpon sogs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs kyis ci bsam de sgrub dang khrims med lugs med byed/ chos tshogs dang mi skya sku drag tshos thabs shes rnam pa sna tshogs spyad de grong mi'i rgyu nor btsan bsdu byas/ phyis su grong mi tshos mnga' bdag de dag la dngul mang po zhig phul nas rang skyong gi las khungs te kung hre 'dzugs rgyu'i dbang cha blu nyo byas/ yin na'ang cung ma 'gor bar ran grong khyer gyi chos dpon chen po sgo le sde yis blu yon bkol tshar song bas/ slar yang rgyu nor btsan bsdu byed dgos byung bas kha dan tshig la ma gnas par kung hre 'dzugs pa'i chod don med par bzos/ don des grong mi tshor khong khro tshad med skye ru bcug pas zing cha chen po bslangs/ gzhung zhabs pa rnams kyis rang gi las 'gan ma sgrub pa dang / lham bzo rnams kyis lham tshong khang gi sgo brgyab/ za khang gi bdag pos kha zas sna tshogs phyir ma bsham la/ grong mi tshos lkog tu 'brel gtug byas nas chos dpon dang ngan jus mnyam 'god byed mkhan tsho gsod rgyu'i 'char gzhi bkod/ 1112lo'i 'das log dus chen gyi nyin lnga ba'i nyin ral gri dang sta re kha gnyis ma/ gzhu/dbyug pa/ mdung sogs drag chas spras pa'i grong mi tsho chos dpon gyi khyim ra'i nang brgyugs/ skabs der chos dpon dang chos dpon gzhon pa gnyis kyis da dung grong mi'i lag nas dngul lor ji ltar bsdu par gros byed kyin 'dugabakas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag kha shas kyis grong mis gyen log byas pa'i gnas tshul go nas/ brel 'tshub ngang chos dpon la srung skyob bya ru 'ongs mo) /nga khro me ltar 'bar pa'i grong mi tshos de dag lnga ba'i lam du drangs/

chos dpon gyis tshul de mthong nas 'jigs skrag skyi g.ya' ba zhig skyes nas g.yog po zhig tu rdzus te sa 'og khang pa'i chang zo zhig gi nang yib rung mtha' mjug grong mi'i lag tu shor/ kho pas 6 snying rje dgos pa'i zhu ba yang yang zhus pa ma zad/ grong mi tshor deng phyin chad kho tsho'i chos dpon mi bgyi ba ma zad/da dung dngul shin tu mang po phul nas yul de las bral rgyu khas len byas/'on kyang gro mi tshos ya nga snying rje med pa'i brnyas bcos kyis chos dpon la lan slog nas sems thag rbad chod kyis chos dpon de la srog gi chad pa bcad/ lo rgyus kyi yig tshang nang da dung grong mi tsho shi zin pa'i 'dod rngam can gyi chos dpon la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas sdang sems skyes pas/sna chos dpon gyi ro yod sar brgyud pa'i mi su yin yang de'i phyogs su sa rdog tsam mi 'then pa dang kho la sdig mo yang mi byed pa gcig kyang med pa ma zad/da zung su la'ang de'i ro dur sar 'jug pa'i sems pa ma skyes pa red/’ ran grong khyer gyis bgrang bya nyis brgya'i ring 'thab rtsod byas te mthar thug rgyal kha blangs nas grong khyer gyi kung hre btsugs/grongakhyer mi nyung ba zhig gis 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud de tshad mi 'dra ba'i rang skyong gi dbang cha rtsod len byas nas/ 6 kung hre zhes pa lta bu'i grong khyer gyi rtsa 'dzugs byung na'ang / mthar srid dbang gi dbang cha tshong pa phyug po dang skyed lci'i bu lon 'jog mkhan/ sa khang bdag po sogs grong khyer gyi sku drag tsho'i lag tu shor/ dbyi tha li byang phyogs kyi grong khyer kha shas la rang skyong gi dbang cha thob pa'i steng da dung rang btsan gyi grong khyer spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs/ hpha ran si'i grong khyer kha shas (pha ri si dang le on sogs )la rang skyong gi dbang cha cha shas tsam thob pa dang / grong khyer ni gong ma dang grong khyer gyi 'thus mi gnyis kyis thun mong du bdag gnyer byed bzhin yod/ yin na'ang grong khyer chung 'bring mang po ni da dung mnga' bdag tsho'i dbang swākta tu

yodapas rang skyong gi dbang cha thob med do//dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob gyi grong khyer sdod dmangs nang /lag shes bzo las mang la/ lag shes bzo las ni grong khyer 'byung ba dang rgyas pa'i rmang gzhir gyur/ lag shes bzo ba ni lag shes bzo las khang gi bdag po yin la thad ga'i thon skyed byed mkhan yang yin/ rang gi khe phan la srung skyob bya ched/ lag shes bzo ba'i las rigs gcig pa'i spyi tshogs rtsa 'dzugs te las tshogs btsugs/ rtsa 'dzugs de dag ni lag rtsal gong 'phel byung ba dang ngal rtsol las bgos je mang la song ba dang mnyam du de bas kyang ched las can du gyur/ dper na/ ras thon skyed byed pa'i las tshogs ni bal sel bzo ba'i las tshogs dang / skud 'khal bzo ba'i las tshogs/'khal 'thag bzo ba'i las tshogs sogs su gyes yod/ grong khyer kha shas su las tshogs brgya phrag du ma yod/ pha ri si ru dus rabs 14pa'i dus mgor las zlogs 300lhag yod cing de'i khongs su lag shes bzo ba lnga khri lnga stong 'du la// sa tshogs kyi las 'gan ni las rigs de'i thon skyed legs sgrig byed par 'gan 'khur rgyu de red/ las tshogs kyis khongs mi dang de'i thon rdzas kyi rgyu spus la lta rtog nan mo byed pa dang / tha na bkol spyod byas pa'i yo byad dang rgyu cha la'ang gtan 'khel nan mo byed bzhin yod de/ dper na/ ras kyi zheng tshad dang skud pa bkol tshadasogs gtan 'khel gsal po byas yod/las tshogs la rang gi sgrig yig yod/ dus rabs 13pa'i pha ri si'i lug bal 'khal 'thag las tshogs kyi sgrig yig la don tshan 53yod cing / las rigs des thon skyed kyi phyogs so sor zhib phra can gyi gtan 'khel gsal po byas yod/las tshogs ni las rigs gcig can bar phan tshun rogs skyor byed pa'i rtsa 'ardokās shig yin pa ma zad da dung dmag don rtsa 'dzugs shig kyang yin/

des blos blangs dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ thun mong du grong khyer la srung skyob byas te/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gis drag pos btsan rgol la sngon 'gog byas/ dus rabs 12nas 13bar gyi las tshogs la sngon thon rang bzhin ldan yod/ de la yo byad legs bcos dang thon rdzas kyi rgyu spus je legs su gtong ba/ ngal rtsol las bgos gting je zab tu gtong ba/thon skyed nus shugs mthor 'degs su 'gro ba sogs kyi phyogs dge mtshan ldan pa'i don snying yod/ dus rabs 13pa nas bzung / las tshogs kyis grong khyer sku drag la ngo rgol byed pa'i nang yang nus shugs mngon gsal bton/las tshogs kyis da dung 'thus mi bdams nas grong khyer gyi gros tshogs rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ srid don mi sna bdams te grong khyer do dam byed pa dang /khral dngul bsdu ba sogs kyi bya ba bsgrubs nas grong khyer gyi 'phel rgyas la khag theg yod du bcug yin na'ang / dus rabs 14pa nas bzung / las tshogs kyi nang khul la kha bral byung zhing / de ni gtso bo thon skyen nus shugs la gong 'phel byung ba dang tshong ra'i khyon rgya je cher song ba'i stabs kyis red/kha bral 'di gtso bo phyug por gyur pa'i mi khag cig mtho rim par gyur pa dang /mi mang shas dbul por gyur nas bshu gzhog myong mkhan la gyur pa las mtshon pa red/ dus rabs 15pa'i dus mgor/ las tshogs ni lag rtsal yar thon gyi 'gog rdo dang thon skyed mu mthud du 'phel ba'i gegs char gyur pas/ rim bzhin 'thor zhig tu song ngo |lag shes bzo las thon skyed gong 'phel du song ba dang sbrags grong khyer gyi tshong las la yang rim bzhin dar rgyas chen po byung / yin na'ang tshos las dar rgyas kyi 'phel rgyas la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tshos tshad bkag dang bshu gzhog tshod med thebs/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tshos khyad dbang spyad de gang sa gang du 'gag sgo btsugs/ dper na sga long lha/ chu

phan gyi ched du snying rje med pa'i 'thab rtsod byed kyin 'dug mtshams mtshams su grong khyer kha shas kyi tshong pa'i lhan tshogs bar mna' 'brel byed bzhin yod pa dper na/ dus rabs 12pa'i dus mgor yo rob tu ming grags can gyi ru han sa (5 ba38 79)mna' 'brel ’ tshugs pas/ dus yun ring por yo rob byang phyogs sa khul gyi tshong don sger sdem byas/ dang thog han sa mna' 'brel ni grong khyer 17las grub cing / dus rabs 14pa la glongakhyer 80lhag de'i nang du zhugs/ 'jar man byang khul gyi lu sbe khe grong khyer ni mna' 'brel 'de'i lte gnas red/ mna' 'brel lhan tshogs des rang gi tshong las sger sdem gyi dbang cha srung ba'i ched du nyo tshong bkag sdom dang dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i byed thabs spyod par yang 'jom pa med/ dus rabs 16par slebs pa dang rgya mtsho'i steng gyi 'grum lam gsar pa rnyed rjes tan sa mna' 'brel 'thor zhig tu song / skabs der ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'brel ba yo rob kyi rgyal khab kha shas su 'phel mgo btsams/ dus rabs bar ma'i grong khyer kyi rnam pa la yang 'gyur ldog gsar pa byung 'go tshugs pas/6 dus rabs bar ma'i me tog ces pa de yang dus las yol ba'i me tog tu gyur to//31

kha no sa don rkyen/dus rabs bar ma'i yo rob tu/ ye shu'i chos lugs kyi chos tshogs ni ches stobs shugs ldan pa'i las khungs shig yin/ rgyal khab so so bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin can du bsgyur ba'i go rim nang dang yo rob kyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i khrod/ chos tshogs kyis nus shugs chen po 'don myong ba red/ 156lor hpha ran khe (thang baji ṣṭhacom)rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi kha ro len ((27011brtsa me'i/67)rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po gte thung phe phen (2691 ba chag)gyis/ chos rgyal gong mas kho pas rgyal po'i go sa g.yo 'phrog byas par rgyab skyor gnang bar thugs rje zhu ched/ dbyi tha li'i dbus khul gyi ra wen nā (2872baba'i (po)nas ro ma gyi bar gyi sa cha yongs chos kyi gong ma la phul nas/ chos rgyal gyi rgyal khab 'dzugs su bcug pa dang grong khyer ro ma rgyal sar gyur/ dus de nas bzung chos srid bar gyi phan tshun bed spyod byed pa'i 'brel ba lhag tu je dam du song ngo //chos kyi gong ma ni ye shu'i chos lugs kyi 'go gtso red/ chos tshogs yod sa'i rgyal khab so so ni chos khul chen po dang gtso gnyer chos khul/ chos khul bcas su bgos yod/ chos khul chen po'i gtso bzhugs chos dpon la chos dpon chen mo'am spyi'i chos dpon zer/ gtso gnyer chos khul ni chos khul chen po'i grub cha zhig yin la de'i 'go gtso la chos dpon zer/ chos khul ni gtso gnyer chos khul gyi grub cha zhig yin zhing / spyir btang du chos khang gardi/ tu chos pa gcig gis chos lugs kyi mdzad sgo'i 'go 'dzin dang chos

don do dam byed/ chos dpon chen po dang chos dpon/ chos pa/ chos tshogs zhabs zhu ba sogs la snye 'jig rten pa'i chos 'chad mkhan zer/ de las gzhan du da dung 6 chos pa tshad ldan mi zhes pa yod pa'i nang dge sgrub dang dase sgrub ma/ slong ba'i dge sgrub (nges gtan sdod gnas med par sbyin par brten nas 'tsho ba'i chos pa)sogs yod cing de dag 'jig rten 'khor bar bral nas chos lugs kyi sgrig lam nges can gyi 'og 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod/tshad ldan chos pa tshos dbul phongs dang mi rkyang / brtsi bkur dang len bya thub pa'i dam bca' bzhag yod/chos tshogs kyi nus pa gtso bo ni/ mi rnams kyi chos lugs kyi 'tsho ba gtan 'khel dang de la mdzub ston gnang rgyu de red/ yin na'ang chos tshogs kyi stobs shugs je ngar du song bas na/ rim bzhin spyi tshogasa'atsho ba'i phyogs so sor zhugs pa red/ dper na/ rig gnas slob gso'i phyogs chos tshogs kyis sger sdem gyi go sa blangs yod/ slob gso thob pa'i go skabs mang che ba chos pa tshor thob pas/ mi ser phal ba la slob gso thob pa'i dbang cha med/chos tshogs kyis btsugs pa'i slob grwa'i nang / chos pa tshos dge rgan gyi 'gan 'khur zhing / chos lugs lha'i rig pa'i ched du bkod sgrig byas pa'i slob tshan la 6 shes bya bdun 9zer/ de'i nang brda sprod rig pa dang / gtan tshig rig pa/ tshig sbyor rig pa/ grangs rtsis/ dbyibs rtsis/ gnam dpyad rig pa/rol mo bcas 'du/ de dag la chos lugs kyi khyad chos stug po yod pas/en ke sis zu dus rabs bar ma'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi rnam pa gzhan pa ste mtshan nyid rig pa/ chab srid/ khrims rig pa sogs lha'i rig pa'i nang mnyam bsdus byas pas/ de dag lha'i rig pa'i slob tshan du gyur yod ’ ces gsungs pa ltar red/ chos tshogs ni spyi tshogs kyi srid don do dam la'ang zhugs nas nyin re nas nyin rer gal 'gangs che ba'i go gnas blangakā snas/

rjes su tha na chos tshogs la khrims ra dang khrims lugs ma lag kyang yod cing de'i khrims srol la 6 chos khrims mi zer/ chos tshogs kyi khrims ra dang shin tu dam pa'i khrims srol gyis chos par thug pa'i gyod don 'dri gcod byed pa ma zad/ da dung chos tshogs kyi khyab khongs las brgal ba'i gyod gzhi mang po ste dper na gnyen sgrig dang lha la phog thug gtong ba/ kha chems sogs kyi skor yang thag gcod byed/chos tshogs ni ches che ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag yin pas/ de la zhing bran 'bor chen yod/ chos dpon dang lha khang gi 'go dpon ni don dngos su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chen po yin stabs/ kho tshor rgya che ba'i chos khul nang du/ kher dbang sgos khrims 'dzugs pa dang dngul lor bzo ba/ dpya khral bsdu ba'i dbang cha yod/ chos tshogs kyi stobs shugs je cher song bas/ 'jig rten pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang chos tshogs bar nyin re bzhin je drag yin pa'i 'gal ba ni bshol med du byung / khyon rgya che ba'i chos tshogs kyi sa zhing la 'jig rten pa'i sku drag tshos srid zhen gyi 'gram chu ldang / 'jig rten pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos thabs brgya jus stong sgos chos tshogs kyi sa zhing 'phrog pa dang / tha na drag shugs bkol rgyur yang 'jom rgyu med pa red/dus mtshungs su/ kho tshos gang nus ci thob sgos khe dbang g.yo gnyer byas nas/rang gi sha nye blo thub tshor chos kyi go sa e lon lon byas te chos tshogs kyi rgyu nor la tshod 'dzin bya ci thub byed/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chen po nas gong ma rgyal po'i bar mi su yin rung / cis kyang rang la blo dkar pa'i mi de tsho dbang cha shin tu che ba'i lha khang gi dpon po'am chos dpon gyi go sar 'jog rtsis byed/34'gal ba 'di chos kyi gong ma dang mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal gyi gong ma

gnyis kyis chos dpon bsko 'jog gi dbang cha 'phrog rtsod byas pa'i 'thab rtsod las gcig bsdus su mtshon yod pa red/mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal ni hpha ran khe shar ma nas 'phel nas byung zhing / 962lor rgyal khab btsugs dang / btsan rgyal gyi gong ma chen po la 'jar man gyi rgyal po'i dbang cha thams cad yod/ de la sa khe son rgyal rabs (dus rabs 10pa nas mgo brtsams)nas bzung chos dpon gyi go sa gnang ba'i dbang cha yod/ rgyal rabs de'i gong ma rgyal pos chos tshogs la mnga'akhongs chen po gnang ba ma zad/ mnga' khongs nang gi srid don dang khrims lugs kyi 'gan dbang yang chos dpon la gnang yod/ chos tshogs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag la zhabs 'degs zhu bas rgyal po'i dbang cha'i srog shing du gyur/ skabs der chos rgyal gyi dbang cha la cis kyang phyogs gang thad nas tshod 'dzin byas yod/dpal 'byor steng bkas bkyod rgyud 'dzin la bsgyur tshar pa dang mnyam du chos tshogs ni nyin re bzhin kun rdzob kyi phyogs su gyur/ de la sa zhing yod pa dang / tshong las gnyer pa ma zad/ da dung skyed lci'i bu lon yang gtong ba red/ chos pa tsho'i 'tsho ba rul sungs su song bas bag med long spyod kyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug pas/ chos tshogs kyi spyod drang gi snyan grags nyin re bzhin je dman du song / de lta na chos tshogs kyi stobs shugs rgyun 'khyongs byed rgyur dka' khag byung stabs/ chos tshogs nang du khe lu ne'i ((15bkro mthakhu)bcos bsgyur bya 'gul byung ngo //hpha ran si'i khe lu ne dge sgrub khang ni thog ma'i bcos bsgyur gyi 'go 'dzugs sa red/ dus rabs 10pa nas 11par slebs mtshams su khe lu ne'i phyogs khag gis chos tshogs kun rdzob tu 'gyur bar 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa'i re ba bton nas/ chos tshogs sgrig lam je btsan du btang ste/ rdoswā pa

chos dbul phongs la goms pa dang / sdom pa 'dzin pa (gtso bo gnyen sgrig mi byed pa)/ bka' la nyan pa byas nas/ chos tshogs kyi drang spyod snyan grags mthor 'degs yong e thub la hur brtson byas/ lhag tu gal che ba zhig la khe lu ne'i phyogs khag gis chos kyi gong ma gtso byas pa'i dbang cha gcig bsdus kyi chos tshogs rtsa 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / srid kyi rgyal pos chab srid steng chos tshogs la tshod 'dzin byed par ngo rgol byed pa'i re ba bton/ 1059lor ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma ne kho la si sku rabs gnyis pas bka' babs te/ da nas bzung chos kyi gong ma ni rgyal po dang ro ma gyi sku drag gis ming 'don bsko 'jog bya mi chog par ro ma gyi chos dpon dang / chos 'chad mkhan/ chos tshogs zhabs zhu ba las grub pa'i tshogs pas 'dems bsko byed dgos zhes bsgrags/ rjes su tshogs pa de'i ming la 66lu dmar can gyi chos dpon 'dems bsko tshogs pa 〉zer/ de nas bzung / 2 chos tshogs kyis nges par du 'jig rten pa'i rgyal por bkod pa gtong dgos (rje dang rgyal po gang rung)mi zhes pa'i 'bod sgra nyin re bzhin je mthor song bas/ chos kyi gong ma dang rgyal po'i bar gyi 'gal ba yang je drag je drag tu song /1073lor khe lu rna'i phyogs khag gi btsun pa nyal sde sbu ran sde (511661thabasku lo lo༅)chos kyi gong mar 'dems bsko byas shing /ming la sge re sgo re'u si sku rabs bdun pa zer/ (1073 — 1085lo'i bar dbang bzung ba) de sngon khos chos kyi gong ma sku rabs 'ga'i dus skabs nang chos skyong gzhung gi las don gnyer myong la/ rgyal por ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod nang nus pa chen po bton pa red/ kho rang khri thog tu bsdad rjes/ chos kyi gong ma'i gyi go sa dang dbang char 'chad 'grel byed pa'i bka' khyab mang po bsgrags te/ chos kyi gong mar chos dpon bsko bzhag dang brje 'then byed pa/ spyabang cha yod cing / lha chen pos gnang pa'i rje dang rgyal po'i go sa med

par gtong ba'i dbang cha yang yod ces thag gcod gsal por byas pa ma zad/da dung 6 chos kyi go ma kho nar gong ma rgyal po'i phyag 'khar spyod pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang smyo rgyal blon thams cad kyis chos kyi gong ma'i zhabs la mchu sbyor pa'i gus 'dud zhu dgos ’ pa dang / 6 chos kyi gong mar 'dri gcod ci yang byed mi chog ’ ces gtan la phabs/ de ni 'jig rten pa'i dbang char kha lan du btang ba'i ches tshabs chen gyi 'gran bsdur slong yig cig yin no//1074lor sge re sgo re'u si sku rabs bdun pas the tshom spu tsam yang ma byas par rang gi dbang cha spyad de/ 'jar man gyi chos dpon kha shas kyi go gnas 'then/ de nas lo gcig 'gor rjes/ chos tshogs bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ de bas na chos kyi gong ma dang 'jar man rgyal po'i ther gdong thug gi 'gal zla 'byung rgyu g.yol thabs med pa'i gnas bab byung skabs de'i 'jar man gyi gong ma rgyal po ni ten ri khe sku rabs bzhi pa (501ba110smo sa lko)༅tsho)red/ des sge ri sgo re'u si mig nang du ma bzhag par/ rang nyid kyi dbang cha spyad de chos dpon gyi go gnas stong bar lus pa la chos dpon mang po bsko 'jog byas te chos kyi gong ma dang kha gtad du langs/ chos kyi gong ma dang rgyal po gnyis gri bton gzhu bkang gi rnam par phan tshun la sus kyang bzod sgom mi byed pa'i tshul du gnas/ 1075lo'i zla 12par/ chos kyi gong ma sge re sgo re'u sis 'jar man gyi rgyal po lhan ri khe sku rabs gnyis par 'jig skul gyi tshig kyis khengs pa'i 'phrin yig cig bskur/ cung ma 'gor pa'i 1076lo'i zla 1por rgyal po lhan ri khe skur rabs bzhi pas yom si (g.ya0113 gloshāspyo46)ru chos lugs tshogs 'du bsdus nas sge re sgo re'u si gnas dbyung btang pa ma zad/ da dung sge re sgo re'u si la brnyas bcos kyi tshig gis khengs pa'i 'phrin yig cig bskur nas/ 6 rdoX sde

sbru re sde/ da lta khyod rang chos kyi gong ma ma yin par btsun pa rdzun ma zhig red ces zer zhing / 'phrin yig gi mjug mthar 6 kho bo ten re khe ste lha chen pos bskos pa'i rgyal pos chos dpon thams cad dang mnyam gcig tu shod rgyu'i tshig ni/ phar song zhes pa'i tshig 'di'o//mi zhes bris yod/chos kyi go ma sge re sgo re'u yis kyang gnya' ma sgur bar/ zla gcig gi rjes su chos lugs kyi tshogs chen zhig gi steng / nyen ri khe sku rabs gnyis pa'i rgyal po'i go gnas dang dbang cha med par btang ba dang / chos tshogs las phyir skyod btang la blon 'bangs kyis de la blo dkar ba'i mna' tshig kyang med par bzos pa khyab bsgrags byas/cung ma 'gor ba'i sngon du nyen ri khe sku rabs bzhi bas sa khe son gyi 'os langs la drag gnon byas kyang / sa khul so so da dung zhi 'jags su yong med/ chos kyi gong mas 'jar man gyi blon 'bangs kyis gong ma rgyal por blo sems dkar mi dgos pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / de'i dmigs bya gtso bo ni gong ma rgyal po'i sems mi bde ba byed pa dang rgyal phran gyi rgyal po rnams gong mar rgyab 'gal byed du 'jug pa'i ched red/ gal te 'os langs kyi me lce gsar pa 'bar ba dang rgyal phran gyi rgyal po tsho skabs dang bstun nas zing cha bslangs na/ ten ri khe la mtshon na rdung rdeg chen po zhig yin pas/ kho la skyi g.ya' ba 'dra ba'i 'jig skrag cig skye ru bcug gnas bab de 'dra'i dbang gis gnas skabs su 'os med 'grig thabs mi byed ka med byung bas/1076lo'i zla 10bar chos kyi gong ma la gnya' bskur nas deng phyin chad chos kyi gong ma la blo dkar rgyu khyab bsgrags byas/chos kyi gong ma sge re sgo re'u si sku rabs bdun pa ni skabs der dbyi tha li yi kha ni hra mkhar rdzong du byes su bzhugs shing / yul de ni bud med pa'o yi go /spyas can smar thi rda zhes pa'i yul khyim yin/ 'jar man gyi gong ma nyen

re khe sku rabs bzhi ba ni sku ngo mar kha no hra mkhar rdzong du chos kyi gong ma la rang nyes 'gyod bshags dang gu yangs zhu bar 'gro rgyu thag bcad de/ thog mar pho nya mngags nas chos kyi gong ma la dgongs dwangs gu yangs zhus te/rang gi nor 'khrul yo bsrang byas nas/ chos kyi gong mas nyes chad mi gcod pa'i thugs rje gnang ba dang smon lam btab na/ cha rkyen gang yod thams cad dang len byed rgyur khas len byas/ de nas nyen ri khe sku rabs bzhi ba grang ngar chen por ma 'dzems par 'jar man la bral nas dbyi tha li ru phebs/lam bar du kho rang kha ba dkar pos g.yog pa'i al phe si ri bor brgal nas 1077lo'i zla dang por ab phen ne no (4990bas1 saX ༅gtso)ri bo'i khrod kyi kha no hra mkhar rdzong du phebs/ nyen ri khe yis zhabs zhu ba 'ga' las dmag dpung ma khrid cing / rgyal po'i rtags mtshon gyi 'dogs cha yod tshad phud de/ rang nyes 'gyod bshags mtshon pa'i ras rtsub po'i phyi lwa zhig gyon nas kha ba dang grang ngar khrod rkang rjen du mkhar rdzong gi sgo ru nyin gsum tsam langs nas bsdad/ khros chos rgyal la phul ba'i dam bca'i yi ge'i nang 66sngar gyi nor 'khrul yo bsrang bya rgyu khas len byas nas/ khengs skyong sgos 6 nga tsho'i bdag po sge re sgo re'u si chos kyi gong ma nyid ri bo'i sa mtshams brgal nas byang phyogs su phebs pa'am 'dzam gling gi yul khongs gang du phebs tshe/ khong nyid dang khong srung skyel byed mkhan/ zhabs 'brangs pa'am/ yang na 'dzam gling gi yul gang rung du mngags pa'i pho nya/ 'dzam gling yul gang rung nas yong ba'i mi rnams kho tsho rgyal mtshams las brgal ba'am yul der bzhugs skabs/ kho bo dang kho bos dbang 'og tu yong shas che ba'i bdag 'dzin pa'i phyogs nas de tsho'i bde 'jags la khag theg bya rgyu yin/ de tsho'i tshe srog dang phung por gnod mi skyel ba dang 'phrog bcom mi byed pa ma zad/ nga tshos de dag gi la rgya la gnod pa'i bkag 'gog ci yang mi yong bar khag theg bya rgyur khas blangs pa yin/ gal srid kho tshor lam bar du gong smos don dag ci zlogs
tolhosgormen+ya /kholapo du du ra༄tshomatsho hūṃ / sri nga 8// /pha zhen/ rdo sa (sta༄sdeca (377 ) dubazlo sde02 421 ri

rang nyid gong ma chen po'i khri la bzhugs pa'i mdzad sgo tshogs su bcug sge re sgo re'u si yis lho phyogs dbyi tha li yi nor man gyi mi la skyabs 'jug zhus pa dang / nor man gyi mi 'ongs nas 'jar man gyi dmag dpung phyir bskrad na'ang / ro ma grong khyer gtsang bcom ma lus kun 'phrog rgyas/ de'i phyir sbyar sge re sgo re'u si yang gzhan yul du 'khyam pa'i lam bar du tshe las 'das rjes su ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma dang 'jar man gong ma gnyis bar gyi 'thabartsod je drag je drag tu song / 1122lor phyogs gnyis kyis〈wom si chos lugs kyi chod yig〉ces mna' tho bzhag nas 'os med 'grig thabs byas shing / chos kyi gong mas chos tshogs la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha yang je zhan du btang / yin na'ang rjes kyi dus rabs 'ga'i ring du chos srid gnyis kyi 'gal ba ni nub phyogs yo rob tu rgyun ma chad pa dang des yo rob kyi spyi tshogs kyi chab srid 'tsho bar shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod pa red/41

nor man gyibatsana'adul/yo rob nub phyogs khul gyi nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i khrod kyi sbi re thi gling tshom ni/ gling phran 5500las grub cing / de'i nang ches che shos ni sbi re thi si chen po'i gling phran yin la yo rab kyi skam sa chen po dang phan tshun kha gtad du yod cing / de'i bar gyi kha zheng dog pa'i rgya mtsho ni dbyin ji'i mtsho 'gag ces pa red/ dbyin sge lan (rsā ༅)dngasu'u kho lan/ (500 /thabazu smocho༅) nyelisi(yam bya lo )gsum ni sbi re thi si gling phran chen po'i cha shas gsum yin la/ deng rabs dbyin ji'i gtso khag red/e sbi re si'i (166103 cha lko12)mi ni dbyin ji'i mi'i ches snga mo'i mes po red/ kho tshos dus yun shin tu ring ba'i yi ge ma byung gong gi lo rgyus kyi dus rabs brgyud cing / phal cher spyi lo sngon gyi 800 sngon gyi 700lo nas bzung / yo rob nas yong ba'i khel the si'i ((61 bya porsha)mis sbi re thi si gling phran la btsan 'dzul byas nas rim bzhin e sbi re si'i mi dang 'dres pa dang de'i ming yang sbi re thi si'i mi zhes par gyur/ spyi lo sngon gyi 55 4 sngon gyi 54loragazi gzir gyi dbang sgyur 'og gi ro ma gyi mi dbyin ji mtsho 'gag la 'phred du brgal te/ sge li nas sbi re thi si gling phran chen mor btsan 'dzul byas/ bgrang bya 90'gor rjes kyi spyi lo sngon gyi 43 — spyi lo 69lor ro ma gyi mis gling phran de dbang du bsdus nas/ ro ma btsan rgyal gyi ches rgyang thag ring ba'i zhing chen zhig tu gyur/ ro ma gyi mis yul de lo ngo bzhi brgya tsam la dpa~X sgyur byas shing / spyi lo'i dus rabs lnga pa'i dus mgor da gzod kho tsho

phyir bsdu/ sdo byed sbi/ re thi si'i mi la rang dbang thob pa'i dus yun shin tu thung ste/ spyi lo 449lo nas bzung / yo rob skam sa chen po nas 'ongs pa'i 'jar man tsho khag gi an sge lo sa khe son (sa 610 3820bcu cha ma༅༅)gyi mis skor tshogs dang skor tshogs byas nas sbi re thi si gling phran la btsan 'dzul byas/ sbi re thi si'i mis dpa' ngar zhum med sgos bkag 'gog byas rung /an sge lo sa khe son gyi mis bgrang bya 150lhag ring drag pos btsan 'dul byas pa'i ngo ldog ma thub/ mthar thug dbyin ji'i mi rgyud la mnyam bsres thengasaganyis pa thebs/ de rjes sbi re thi si ru 'jar man gyi rgyal po'i rgyal khab bcu lhag byung shing / dus rabs drug pa'i dus mjug tu de dag rgyal khab bdun du gyur pa dang so so'i bar du lo ngo nyis brgya'i ring la dmag 'khrug brgyab/ dus rabs 9pa'i dus stod du/ da gzod smyo rgyal khab bdun gyi dus rabs kyi mjug bsgril nas/ dbyin sge lan sa khe si nub ma'i rgyal po e gi sbor the (26631 tsho /khre6)yis gcig gyur gyi dbyin sge lan rgyal po'i rgyal khab btsugs so//sbi re thi si gling phran chen po dang bar du rgya mtshos bcad pa'i sgre lan ḍi (/752ba bras༅)gling phran phyed ma'i steng / 'jar man byang mar gtogs pa'i nor man gyi mi (saX17lnga tsho byang phyogs pa zhes pa'i don yin)yis 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/ de'i nang gi ru lag gcig ste ten mag (280181ji'acho)gi mi yis dus rabs 8pa'i dus mjug tu sbi re thi si gling phran chen por btsan 'dzul byas pa dang lo ngo 300lhag tu rgyun ma chad/ dbyin ji'i rgyal pos dmag dpung khrid de khen mag gi mi dang yang dang yang du dmag 'khrug brgyab rjes/ 879lor phyogs gnyis kyis zhi ba'i chings yig bzhag ste/gnas skabs dmag 'khrug gi mtshams chad mod/ 'on te dus rabs 1shuzlo'i

dus mjug dang dus rabs 11pa'i dus mgor/ khen mag gi mis slar yang btsan 'dzul byas pas/ mthar thug 1017lor dbyin sge lan yongs phab nas dbang du bsdus/ ten mag gi rgyal po kha ne'u the (1017 — 1035lo'i bar rgyal po'i go sa bzung ba)yis dbyin sge lan dang rten mag su'e ten/(54068ba sa ) norawe (sa07775 77)bcas rang gi mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa btsan rgyal zhig tu grub kyang / kha ne'u the tshe las 'das rjes btsan rgyal de 'phral mar 'thor song ba red/ 1042lor an sge lo sa khe son rgyal po'i rgyal rabs rnying pa'i sku drag e sde war sde (208817 skya lha)yisargyal po~X go sa bzung nas/ an sge lo sa khe son gyi chab srid kyi rang btsun slar ga byazlo /re thi si gling phran chen po'i steng gi gral rim so sor gyes nas bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin lam lugs su bsgyur ba'i go rim ni/ snga mo'i dus kyi rgyal khab bdun gyi dus nas bzung 'go bcoms pa red/ ten mag pa dang 'thab pa'i skabs kyang go rim 'di'i rgyun ma chad cing / dus rabs 11pa'i dus mgor thon tshe de la 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ yin na'ang / skabs de'i dbyin ji'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs ni de 'dra'i 'thus tshang ba zhig ma red/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhis ku'i lam lugs de 'phel rgyas su song yod kyang / zhing ba mang che bar mnga' bdag gis bshu gzhog byas tshad dang / kho tsho mnga' bdag la brten pa'i chu tshad la khyad par chen po yod de/ rang dbang can gyi zhing pa da dung shin tu mang / an sge lo sa khe son gyi mi'i gna' rabs yig tshang du/ mi rnams kyis skabs de'i gzhan brten gyi gnas su yod pa'i zhing pa tshos rnyog 'dzing ha cang che ba'i 'u lag dang khral sna tshogs kyi khur po 'khur dgos pa mthong thub/ kho tshos bkas bsdidī rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gi sa zhing 'debs dgos pa ma zad/ da

dung dngul lor dang chang sbi rag dang gro sogs sprod dgos pa'i steng las khral yang mjal dgos/ lo re re'i 'das log gi dus ston steng / ba mo gcig dang lu gu gcig re sprod dgos/ lo gcig gi nang gza' 'khor gsum ma gtogs (dgun nyi ldog gi gza' 'khor dang 'das log dus ston gyi gza' 'khor/ skyabs 'jug nyin gyi gza' 'khor)mnga' bdag gi thag bcad pa'i dus tshod ltar las ka las dgos/ las khral las gzhan gyi dus tshod la 6 rang gi dus tshod ’ zer zhing / gzhan rten zhing pa re res 6 rang gi dus tshod spyad de sa zhing smu gsum 'debs chogadus rabs 11pa'i dus dkyil du 6 nor man pas btsan 'dul mibyas pa des/ dbyin ji'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs su bsgyur ba'i go rim je mgyogs su btang nas yongs su 'grub tu bcug de ni dbyin ji'i lo rgyus steng dus rabs 'byed pa'i don rkyen zhig yin no//nor man pa ni dpa' rgod 'thab la mkhas pas ming grags che/ nya 'dzin rgyu gtso gnyer byed cing / grang ngar che ba'i gnam gshis la goms la/drag rlabs nam mkhar 'phyo ba'i rgya mtsho'i steng 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/ nor man gyi dpa' rtul tsho shing gru chen po'i steng rgyang 'dul du bskyod de/ rang tsho'i nya skam dang pags pa sogs rgyan chang dang / snam bu/ lag cha sogs la brje res byed pa'am yang mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul so sor song nas 'phrog bcom byed/ kho tsho'i rkang rjes ni sbi la khe (2180) bya02 lha)rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs dang yo rob kyi nub phyogs mtsho 'gram/ se phan gyi mtsho 'gram sogs la khyab yod cing / tha na dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor bskyod nas hpha ran si'i nub khul mtsho 'gram dang dbyi tha li la phar rgol byas nas sgo ri si ru thon/ dus rabs 9pa'i dus mjug tu/ nor man gyi dpa' rtul tshos pha ri si la bskor nas rgol myong / dus rabs 10pa'i dus mgor/ hpha ran khe rgyal pos /la
spre /khro/ripo ༷ jiX// sde ༄//nyu1———/ngatsho/6454)kyi waX—74bye tres ra nganye/she)ni7༄ ༄ / ri tre du/——ga/(rdo riX /bhyoX)////rdoX/ pa di rne/byete / parlomirabye mi rdo

sge lo sa khe son gyi khrims lugs ltar du/ 'dems bsko byas pa brgyud har ro sde (587106 077)zhes pa dbyin ji'i rgyal por bskos te/ nor man gung cu'i yis re ba la kha ya ma byas/ we lem shin tu khros te sbi re thi si gling phran chen por dmag dpung chen po drangs nas drag po'i thabs su gong ma'i go sa len rgyu thag gcod byas shing / kho pa'i ham sems la ro ma gyi chos kyi gong mas kyang rgyab skyor byas/zla 9par we lem gyis dmag mi 9000khrid de dbyin sge lan nub khul nas skam sar slebs/ dmag dpung 'di'i dmag chas sgrig sbyor shin tu legs shing de'i nang gzhu ring po spyod mkhan mi nyis stong lhag yod/ dbyin ji'i rgyal po har ro sde rtab rtab por pha rol po'i gdung bsus nas g.yul la zhugs/ kho'i dmag dpung ni rang gi nye dmag nyung ngu dang skabs thog bsdus pa'i zhing pa las grub/ dmag ltar dang mdung / phub/ gdod ma'i rdo star sogs ni de dag gi lag cha thabs chag red/ de bas na dmag dpung gnyis kyi stobs shugs la khyad par shin tu che'o/zla 10pa'i tshes 14nyin/ dmag dpung gnyis kyis hwa si tshen si ru g.yul chen po bshams/ mtha' mjug an sge lo sa khe son gyi mi rnams stobs shugs che ba'i nor man gyi dmag dpung gis cham la pham ste rgyal po har ro sde yang bsad/ cung ma 'gor bar lon tun grong khyer gyi mkhar sgo yang nor man pa la mi 'byed thabs med byung / rgyal kha can gyi we lem gyis dmag dpung khrid de grong khyer nang 'ongs pa dang gong ma chen po'i go sar bsdad cing de ni we lem sku rabs dang po (1066— 1087lo'i bar go sa bzung)zhes pa yin no// dus de nas bzung / dbyin ji'i gong mas yo rob gling chen gyi skam sa'i steng gi nor man sde'i mnga' khongs chen po bzung ba red/we lem sku rabs dang pos an sge lo sa khe son gyi bkas bkodwa /da

'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho'i sa zhing chen po 'phrog len byas nas/ rang nyid kyi sha nye dang zhabs zhu ba sogs byin zhing / dus mtshungs su rang dbang can gyi zhing pa mang po zhig zhing bran du bsgyur/ 1069— 1071lo'i bar dbyin ji'i byang phyogs su rang dbang can gyi zhing pa'i 'os langs che shos langs nas/btsan 'dul mkhan gyi zhing bran du gyur par ngo rgol byas na'ang / we lem sku rabs dang pos snying rje med par gdug rtsub thabs lam la brten nas 'os langs la drag gnon byas/ tha na sdod dmangs dmar gsod btang ba dang /zhing sde yongs mer bsregs te 'os langs byas pa'i sa khul mi med spang rgod du btang /so de bzhin du btsan 'dul mkhan gyis dbyin sge lan dbang 'og tu bsdus nor// man gyis btsan 'dul byas par drang bden gyi rang bzhin med mod/ 'on kyang des dbyin ji la mjug rjes che po thon du bcug yod/ mar khe sis kyang 6 dbyin ji'i ches thog ma'i spyi tshogs kyi rmang gzhir gyur pa'i rang dbang can gyi zhing ba ngo ma ni rim bzhin je nyung la song / (we lem gyis)btsan 'dul byas pa des bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyis dbyin ji'i sngar 'das kyi rang dbang la phyir 'bud gtong tshad je ngar la btang ba dang je mgyogs su btang / /ces gsungs/ dbyin ji'i snga sa nas 'go bcoms pa'i gzhis ma'i lam lugs gong 'phel la 'gro tshad kyang je mgyogs su song bas/ dus rabs 12pa'i dus bar du thon tshe/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs ni mthar mjug sbi re thi si gling phran chen po'i steng grub cing sra brtan du chags/ nor man gyis btsan 'dul byas pa'i mjug 'bras gzhan zhig ni/ stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i rgyal po'i dbang cha grub pa de red/ we lem sku rabs dang pos sa zhing gi 177dang nags tshal che/ sbya du ma rang gis sger 'dzin byas pas/ rgyal yongs kyi bkas bkod rgyud

'dzin gyi mnga' bdag ches che shos su gyur/ de lta na/ sa khongs so sor kha thor du yod pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chung chung (zur /togs rgyal phran)de dag gis bcad bzung rang btsan byed thabs med pa da/ sa zhing gi dpya khral dang zur gtogs rgyal phran gyis gong ma chen por bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'os 'gan yod par khag theg yod pa bgyi phyir/1086lor we lem sku rabs dang pos mnga' 'og gi dpon po du ma dbyin sge lan yongs su mngags nas/ rgyal yongs kyi sa zhing la rtog dpyod byed pa dang / mi re re'i sger gyi rgyu nor tho gzhung bzo ru bcug ste/ mthar gzhugazhus zhing gsal tho〉zhig bcoms shing / de'i nang don shin tu rgya che la phra zhib ldan pa zhig yin/ rgyal po dang chos skya bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos sa zhing bzung ba'i gnas tshul dang / gzhis ka re re'i rgya khyon/phyugs zog dang yo byad kyi kha grangs/ zhing pa sna tshogs kyi mi grangs sogs zhib brtsis byas yod/rtog zhib tho 'god kyi go rim ni shin tu zhib cing nan po yin pas/ mi su yin yang so sor dngos don drang mor bshad dgos pas/ yongs khyab tu 'jigs skrag gi tshul du lhung ste/ ye shu'i chos lugs su bshad pa'i skal ba 'jig nyin de la slebs la khad yod pa'i tshul du gyur/ de bas na/ 〈sa zhing gi gsal tho〉de la dus mjug gi bcad khra〉zhes kyang 'bod/ gsal tho de las gong ma rgyal pos mi re re'i dpya khral ci 'dra zhig sprod dgos pa'am sprod thub pa gsal por shes thub/ 〈dus mjug gi bcad khra〉de las mi rnams kyis dbyin ji'i sa khul mang che ba bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho la dbang zhing / rgya che ba'i thad ga'i thon skyed mkhan mang che ba zhing phran du gyur pa shes thub/ shul du lhag pa'i rang dbang can gyi zhing pa nyung ngu rdo /nga

dgar gzhis ka las bral chog cing rang gi sa zhing bog mar gtong ba'i dbang cha yang yod/ 'on kyang dngul lor gyi sa bogs nyung nyung tsam sprod dgos pa red/ don dngos su rang dbang can gyi zhing pa de dag gi thob thang la khrims lugs kyis srung skyob thob rgyu shin tu khag po yin la/ de ni zhing bran mnga' bdag la brten pa'i 'brel ba de las cung tsam lhod pa tsam du mngon pa de'o//nor man gyi btsan 'dul byas pa nas dus rabs 12pa'i dus stod du bgrang bya chig brgya tsam las ma 'gor rung / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gzhis ma'i lam lugs dbyin ji ru dngos su tshugs nas/ dbyin ji ni gong ma'i dbang cha chen po ldan pa'i gcig gyur gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal khab cig tu gyur pa red/

skya mi ste 66bkasabakod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyan cha mi/4'thab 'dzing pa re res rang gi mnga' bdag gi ched du tshad pa drag po dang g.yul sar zhugs pa/ dka' ngal sogs bzod bsran bgyi dgos/rang gi khrag rngul dang lus phung la ser sna bgyi mi rung kha— ro lan gyi bstod glu〉nas/dus rabs bar ma'i nub phyogs yo rob kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i rtsom rig bcoms chos phal mo che'i nang / skya mi'i (drag rtsal pa)sgyu rtsal snang brnyan ni med du mi rung ba zhig red/ skya mi tshos 'thab 'dzing ji snyed khrod du/ chos lugs kyi ngag rgyun gtam rgyud dang pho mo'i brtse dung gi gtam rgyud du nam rgyun mi sna gtso bo'i tshul du mngon gyi 'dug skya mi'i 'tsho ba dang skya mi'i snying stozlos ni lkog gsang dang 'char yan gyi rnam pas dam du bcings yod/ dus rabs bar ma'i lo rgyus kyi gar stegs stong skya mi tshos 'khrab bya'i mi sna gal chen gyi 'gan dang len byas pa smos mi dgos pa zhig yin/ lo rgyus smra mkhan kha shas kyis skya mi de dag la 6 dus rabs bar ma'i rgyan cha ’ zhes 'bod/skya mi ni skya mi tsam yin mod/ dus rabs bar ma'i skya mi'i lam lugs la/ gting zab cing ched dmigs kyi nang don yod cing / de ni spyi lo dus rabs 9par hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab tu byung ba red/ hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyis a rab kyi mi dang dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i skabs su/ go cha lce mo gon pa'i rta dmag skor zhig btsugs shing / mi dang rta la khrab mthug po bskon 'dug dmag dpung de'i 'thab 'dzing nus shugs shin tu sdo zlos/

srol rgyun gyi rkang dmag las ldab du ma'i stobs shugs yod/ khar lu sis dbangasgyur byed pa'i skabs su/ dus yun ring por dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i dgos mkhor bstun nas ched las rang bzhin gyi dmag dpung zhig 'dzugs 'go brtsams/ dmag dpung de la dgra po 'ded rdung byed pa'i skabs su shin tu bgyogs myur yin pa'i steng da dung gar btang go chod cig yin dgos shing 'thab nus kyang shugs ldan yod dgos/ de'i ched du khar lu si yis lcags khrab lcags dmag 'dzugs rgyu ches gtso gal che ba'i bya ba zhig tu brtsis pa dang 'di ni skya mi'i lam lugs byung ba'i dmag don gyi rmang gzhi red/mnga' gzhis lam lugs ni skya mi'i lam lugs byung ba'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi red/ sngar yin na hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyis cha rkyen ci yang med par sa zhing yod tshad mnga' 'og gi blon 'bangs la sbyin pa red/'on kyang de bzhin du dus tshon yun ring 'gor bas na gong ma rgyal po'i dmag don dang dpal 'byor stobs shugs nyin re bzhin nyams zhan du 'gro nges pa smos med red/ rgyal khab kyis skya dmag gi dmag chas gcig gyur du gtong ba dang / 'gro song che ba'i dmag dpung zhig skyong rgyu ni shin tu khag po red/de'i phyir gong ma chen po khar lu si yis dus rabs brgyad pa'i lo rabs 30pa nas bzung mnga' gzhis lam lugs lag bstar byas pa ste/ sa zhing mang che ba ni mnga' gzhis kyi tshul du chos skya gnyis kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho la bgos shing / mnga' bdag chen po chos sa zhing khag cig ma spyad par mnga' bdag 'bring rim pa tsho la bgos/ 'bring rim mnga' bdag tshos de bzhin du sa zhing skor zhig rang gis ma spyad par mnga' bdag chung chung tsho la bgos nas sbyin/ sa zhing thob mkhan rnams nges par du dmag dpung (skya dmag)nang zhugs dgos shing de ni sa zhing gi bgo skal thob pa'i cha rkyen gtso bo ༵༵/ de lta na da gzod tshe gang por sa zhing de bdag 'dzin pa'am bkol

spyod byed chog pa'i dbang cha yod/ khar lu si'i dus skabs su/ mnga' bdag 'bring ba dang chung ba rmang gzhi byas pa'i skya mi'i lam lugs yongs su btsugs/hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rim ldan lam lugs ni gtor gzugs mchod rten ji bzhin yang rtser yod pa ni rgyal po yin zhing / de'i mnga' 'og tu rim pa ltar gung cu'i dang pa'o cu'e/ nan cu'i sogs chos dang 'jig rten pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag mang po yod cing / ches mtha' ma ni skya mi yin/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rim ldan lam lugs de mnga' gzhis lam lugs dang phan tshun 'brel ba che ste/ skya mi ni rim ldan lam lugs nang gi ches chung ba'i mnga' bdag yin zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rim ldan lam lugs ni skya mi 'byung ba'i chab srid kyi rmang gzhi yin no//bsam blo'i rmang gzhi gzhan zhig yod pa la'ang mthong chung bya mi rung la de ni skya mi tsho ye shu'i chos lugs can du bsgyur ba de red/ gna' rabs snga mo'i dus su/ ye shu'i chos lugs ni ro ma btsan rgyal gyi chab srid lag cha ru gyur cing / rjes su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur ba rnams kyis chos lugs de dmag dpung gi bsam blo'i brten gzhi la bsgyur bar dga' po byed/496lor hpha ran khe'i rgyal po khe lo wi si ((10713 mchi 481 —511)yis dmag mi 3000khrid de chos lugs kyi khrus dbang blangs pa nas bzung /dmag dpung ye shu'i chos lugs can du bsgyur 'go brtsams/ de nas bzung chos tshogs kyis skya mi chos chos tshogs la blo dkar dgos tshul dang lha chen gong mar dad pa'i ched du 'thab dgos pa sogs 'ud sgrog shugs chen byas shing /de bzhin du ye shu'i chos lugs 'di dus rabs bar ma'i skya mi'i bsam blo'i rten gzhir gyur pa red/khar lu si'i btsan rgyal kha 'thor sna 'thor la song rjes/ sngar gyi ༵༵na

rgyal gyi lte gnas sa khul hpha ran si ru thog mar skya mi'i lam lugs dngos su tshugs/ dus rabs 11par thon rjes/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab so sor skya mi'i lam lugs yongs su tshugs/ dus rabs 11pa'i lo rabs 90pa nas 'go brtsams pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs su btsan 'dzul byas pa des/ skya mi'i spyi tshogs kyi go sa la sngar byung ma myong ba'i mthor 'degs byung / dus rabs 12par thon tshe/ lam lugs de nub phyogs yo rob tu 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas yang rtser byon pa'i dus skabs la slebs/skya mi'i dpung sde ni dmag 'khrug gi rgyal pham thag gcod pa'i stobs shugs kho nar gyur/ skya mi'i khrims srol dang skya mi'i 'os 'gan/ skya mi'i bsam pa yang rim bzhin grub pa dang dus mtshungs su/ skya mi'i 'tsho ba brjod don du sdir pa'i skya mi'i rtsom rig yang nub phyogs yo rob tu dar rgyas chen po byung ba da/ dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i mkho ba bzhin du skya mi tshor dmigs bsal can gyi phyi rnam zhig grub yod par/ mgo bor rmog gon zhing rmog gi mdun phyogs su mi'i gdong ngo btum byed kyi rno khrab yod/ 'thab lu'i steng la lcags leb du ma shan pa'i ko khrab ste sgrog khrab ces pa byon/ rjes su lcags khrab kyis sgrog khrab kyi tshab byas/ lag par bzung ba'i lag cha ni rgya gram rnam pa'i yu ba can gyi ral gri dang mdung chen dang phub red/ kho tsho'i lus la gyon pa'i go cha ni shin tu lci bas/ gal srid rta gong nas mar lhung tshe sus kyang yar slong mi thub/ṭā tsho/ zhinā rta la lus stobs dang gzugs phung che la der yang lcag khrab ljid ba / sa /ba/ sa bar ma'i skabs kyi nub phyogs yo rob tu/ zhing bran ni dmag dpung nang zhugs mi chog pas kho tsho skya mi bya bsams kyang bya thabs med/dpa/ dpung nang zhugs rgyu ni dbang bsgyur gral rim ste mnga' bdag gral
