rim la ched du yod pa'i dbang cha zhig yin pas/ ched las dmag mi yin pa'i skya mi tsho yang gral rim de las 'ongs pa smos med du mngon/ de'i phyir sku drag mnga' bdag tsho'i bu phrug ste ma 'ongs pa'i skya mi tsho la/ na chung dus nas bzung skya mi'i sbyor brdar byed dgos shing / gtso bo rta zhon pa dang dmag 'thab byed thabs sbyangs nas/ 'thab la spro ba dang rang srog blos gtong thub pa'i bsam blo skyed bsring byed bzhin yod/dmag 'khrug ni sku drag tshor smyo gcig pur dbang ba'i don ’ zhig yin te/sku drag dmag don can du bsgyur bas skya mi la spyi tshogs kyi go gnas khyad par can yod pa byung ba dang / skya mi'i mtshan yang gzi brjid can gyi mtshan snyan zhig tu gyur/ de bas gong gi rgyal po dang 'og gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag rim pa so so'i mi su yin yang rang nyid skya mi phul du byung ba zhig tu skyed bsring bya 'dod yod/ mi su zhig gi bu phrug skya mi bya snyam na/ chung ngu'i dus nas byis g.yog byed pa nas 'go rtsom dgos/ lo na 14la slebs pa na da gzod zhabs zhu ba ste gra sgrig skya mi byas nas/ skya mi ngo ma'i rjes su 'brangs te g.yul rgyag par skyod de skya mi'i rta dang lag char bdag gnyer byed chog cing /lo na 21la slebs tshe da gzod skya mi'i mtshan snyan len thub pa red/ skya mi'i mtshan snyan ster ba'i mdzad sgo ni g.yul sar phye chog mod/ dus rgyun chos lugs dus chen te dper na ye shu'i 'khrungs skar gyi nyin dang 'das log gi nyin sogs la skya mi'i mtshan snyan ster ba'i mdzad sgo tshogs pa mang / skya mi'i mtshan snyan len mkhan tshos thog mar chos khang nang nyin mtshan gcig la smon lam 'debs pa dang / phyi nyin chos 'chad mkhan gyis mchod stegs steng kho tsho'i dam bca' dang du blangs rjes/ chos pa des skya mir ral gri 'dogs pa dang rgyab la thal lcag gcig brgyab nas/ 6 dpa' ngar ldan pa'i skya mi zhig bgyi dgos mi zhes bslab bya gnang ba red/ 55

kyi rsha rsha0 ༄ ༄ wa/ |smyu / ( snyechakhri/—1shā/tshone sa 〉〉kwa mo kṣi/ ༷ ne/mo//sa / 4 1waX / dwa sa/ 7༄/skurdoX/saX /riske ri —4 6 2(34rdoXrmyu tswa spro rjo ti/spreb sa'iXng)

skya mi re re'i ches bla na med pa'i 'os 'gan ni/ rang gi gong ma chen po'am mnga' bdag la blo dkar ba dang / dka' khag yod tshad khyad du bsad nas/tha na rang gi khrag dang tshe srog gtong dgos pa de yin/ de las kyang nga tshos skya mi ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur mkhan gyi rgyug khyi yin la/ skya mi'i lam lugs ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sgrig lam la srung skyong byed pa'i lag cha gal chen zhig yin pa shes thub bo//nub phyogs yo rab kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos skya mi'i stobs shugs je drag tu btang nas/ sa zhing slar yang bgo bya byed pa brgyud skya mi'i mi grangs la kha snon chen po brgyab/ dper na/ 1150lor 'jar man gyi skya mi'i khyim rgyud 2000nas 3000tsam yod kyang / 1300lor nyis khri lhag tu 'phel/ skya mi'i lam lugs 'phel rgyas su song ba dang sbrags sa gnas srid gzhung yang dmag don can du gyur/ hpha ran khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab nang / sbo cu'e yis mnga' khongs ni sa gnas srid don sde khag yin la/sbo cu'e ni srid don dpon po yin thog da dung dmag sna 'dren mkhan gyi dmag don mgo gtso yang red/ dmag srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'di mthar thug sger btsugs kyi rnam pa'i gong ma'i rgyal khab tu gyur/ skya mi'i lam lugs kyis mnga' bdag chab srid can du bsgyur te/ mnga' bdag tsho thad kur srid don dang nor srid/ khrims 'dzin sogs las don la zhugs pas sger dbang gi rang bzhin shin tu che/ mtha' 'bras ni dmag don sku drag tshos rgyal khab kyisrid dbang bzung nas/ yul khongs so so sger 'dzin byas pa dang / phan ljon bar dmag 'khrug brgyab pas yo rab g.yul sa chen po zhig tu bsgyur ba de da/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi dus rabs bar ma'i skya mi'i rim pa'i bsam blo'i phu/sdu 'dun ni/ rtsom rig steng cha tshang du mtshon yod pas skya mi'i rtsom rig

ces pa grub/ dus rabs 12nas 13bar du/ skya mi'i rtsom rig shun tu dar pa'i dus skabs shig la thon pa dang / rtsom rig de dar srol ches che sa ni hpha ran si red/ skya mi'i rtsom rig gis khyon yongs nas 6 skya mi'i bsam blo mi mtshon yod/ skya mi'i bsam blo grub byed kyi rmang gzhi'i nang don ni dmag 'khrug dang chos lugs/ pho mo'i brtse dung bcas yin/ pho mo'i brtse dung gis skya mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang go gnas gal chen bzung yod cing / brtsams chos nang kho rang tshos sku lcam rnams la sems pa shor ba dang gus dad byed cing de dag la zhabs 'degs zhus pa'i skor mtshon yod/ skya mi tsho dus rgyun pho mo'i mdza' dung gi ched du cis kyang nyen kha gang la'ang mi 'dzems pa red/ kho tshos sems su de lta byas tshe gzod sku lcam rnams kyi yid sems 'gug thub pa'i stong / da dung nyen gnas brgyud de rgyal kha len thub cing mtshan snyan grags kyang thob na de ni skya mi'i gzi brjid cig red snyam par 'dug skya mi'i dung sems mtshon pa'i snyan rtsom mam yang na skya mi'i ngo mtshar gtam rgyud gang yin yang brjod bya gong smos dag las 'da' thabs med/ mdza' dung dang snyan grags/ chos lugs dad pa'i ched du nyen khar mi 'dzem pa'i snying stobs ni skya mi'i rtsom rig gi 'gyur ba med pa'i brjod gzhi gtso bor gyur/ mdzes ma rnams ni skya mi tshos phrag dog dang zhe sdang bslangs nas kher thug gting thag gcod pa'i dmar 'thab rgyag pa'i gzhi ru gyur yod/ skya mi'i rtsom rig gis de bzhin du tsa skya mi'i mdza' brtse la bstod bsngags byas yod kyang / dngos gnas de ni tha shal gyi spyod pa zhig yin la/ dmag don bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sku drag gi dul sungs rang bzhin mtshon pa de red/dus rabs bar ma'i si phan gyi rlabs che ba'i rtsom pa po ser wan the si (51650160 (615thab 03 5887661222cholo spyi lo 1547— 1616lo)yis skya mi'i bsam blo'i rul sungs kyi ngo bo dang skya mi'i rtsom rig gi lo/ sbyod

dang bcos ma'i rang bzhin la mthil rtog byung bas/ 〈than rje kho sde〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung ring po shig bris nas/ kha tsha gdung gtugs sgos skya mi'i ngo mtshar gtam rgyud la 'do zungs med pa dang ngan shugs che bar kha rdung drag po btang ste/ skya mi'i bsam blo dang skya mi'i lam lugs la ci nus gang dgar zur za byas pa red/brtsamasasnrung de'i brjod bya ni gsham gsal ste/ than rje kho sde ni yul lung zhig gi grong gseb kyi mi drag cig yin la/ skya mi'i mtshar gtam bklags nas de'i nang mgo bo 'khor bas/ grogs po sgrig rgyu dang drang bden la dga' ba'i skya mi zhig byed rgyu las gzhan ci yang bya 'dod med/ khos go cha ral hrul kha tshang zhig btsal zhing / rta pho sha med lus nyams shig la zhon te skya mi'i bzod ltar lad mo byas nas/ khyim mtshes sde ba'i phag pa gso ba'i bu mo zhig rang gi mdza' grogs su brtsis shing tshe gang por de la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu thag bcad/ mkho dngos yod tshad gra sgrig byas tshar rjes/ kho rang rang khyim dang bral nas yul 'grim du byin pa dang dpa' rtul drang bden la dga' ba'i skya mi'i las su zhugs nas/ stong snang du shar pa'i dgra bo dang 'thab pa red/dang thog kho rang gcig bu yul lung 'grim du song yang rmas skyon phog pas phyir mi log thabs med byung / rjes su khyim mtshes san kho zhes pa rang gi zhabs phyi par bkug nas mnyam gcig tu phyi yul 'grim par bskyod/ kho pa'i sems khongs su skya mi'i ngo mtshar can gyi gtam rgyud sna tshogs kyis khengs pas/ gang sa gang du bdud 'dre yod par rlom/ khos rlung 'khor ni mi chen stobs ldan la brtsis pa dang / mgron khang mkhar rdzong yin pa/ skra bzhar gyi zags gzhung sgyu ma mkhan gyi rmog tu snang ba/ lug khyi dgra dpung yin pa/ sdug khral babs pa'i btson ma ni mnar gcod thebs pa'i skya mi yin pa sogs kyi 'phrul snakā snros pas/ lag mgor mdung ring btegs nas pha rol por rgol pa'i

dgod spro 'do med kyi bzod lta gang mang bstan pas/ gzhan la khe gyong btang pa'i steng rang nyid kyang gzhan gyis brdungs nas rmas skyon du ma phog yin na'ang mi de ni rmongs gnyid las sad rgyu ma yod pas/ mthar thug rang gi tshe srog kyang shor la khad du thug ste phyir rang khyim du khur nas yong dgos pa'i gnas su lhung / kho rang tshe las 'das khar da gzod shes rtog thob pas rang gi gnyen mi gcig po ste tsha mor cis kyang skya mi la bag mar 'gro mi chog pa'i kha chems bzhag ser wan the si'i smyu gu'i 'og gi grogs po sgrig par spro zhing drag bden 'dzin par rlom pa'i skya mi ni de 'dra'i dgod spro pa zhig yin la/ skya mi'i bsam pa ni khungs med 'do med du snang ba dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tshos ni ji 'dra'i rul sungs kyi 'tsho ba spyod bzhin yod pa gsal por mtshon zhing / de las kyang skya mi'i lam lugs de mi ring bar nyams rgud du 'gro nges pa shugs nas shes thub bo//skya mi'i lam lugs nyams rgud du song ba dus rabs 14pa nas 'go brtsams/ en khe sis gsungs don/ 6 dus rabs bar mas nga tshor gnang pa'i sngon thon 'ba' zhig ni rta dmag gsar 'dzugs byas pa de red/’ 'di ni skya mi'i lam lugs kyis dmag don sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs su bzhag pa'i byas rjes bstan pa red/ yin na'ang dus rabs 14par slebs rjes/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi tshong las dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas chen po byung pas/ rang byung dpal 'byor rmang gzhi byas pa'i mnga' gzhis lam lugs kha 'thor sna 'thor la song ba des/ skya mi'i lam lugs kyi brten gzhi la gtor bshig btang ba dang / gzhan yang / mde'u 'phen pa'i lag cha rgya chen por spyad pa des kyang skya mi'i lam lugs la rdung deg tsha po btang / rgyu mtshan ni skya mi'i go cha mde'u lhas rtol thub pa dang mkhar rdzong btsan po yang gtor sla por gyur pas yin 61

gal te skya mi'i lam lugs kyis nub phyogs yo rab kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin can du bsgyur ba'i go rim nang sngon thon gyi nus pa zhig 'don myong yod pa red zer na/ dus rabs 14par slobs tshe skya mi'i nus pa de gzhi nas shor tshar ba red/ mi kha shas kyi sems pa lam lugs de la da dung mos pas gang thub ci nus sgos 'ud sgrog byed cing / tha na slar gso byed dgos zer yang de ṭī lo rgyus kyi gar stegs steng gi dgod slong ba'i zlos gar tsam las ma 'das

rgyaspam rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis shar phyogs sugatsan 'dzul byas pa/476lor ro ma btsan rgyal nub ma rmeg med du song rjes/ ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma da dung mu mthud du gnas shing khon si than then pho zhes pa rgyal sa byas yod/ de'i mnga' khongs la bhal khon gling phran phyed ma (2mji ba por) dang a she ya chung ba/ si ri a/(3771 tha mas/sgro) pha le si phan/(2163 18ba ༅777) yi jib/(2679 ṣṭhaṣṭha) sme so pho tha smi a/(503090 8—1 ma chorsālo7sko༅)dang sgo kha so'i phyi khul gyi sa cha kha shas bcas 'du/ ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma'i rgyal po sgra si the ne an nee (/53 101801 thab tsho 1 2 527 — 565lor) go sar bzhugs dus/skabs tsam a hphe ri ka byang ma dang dbyi tha li sogs sa khul yang dbang du bzung myong / dus rabs 7pa nas bzung / ro ma shar ma ni bran g.yog lam lugs nas rim bzhin bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin ring lugs kyi lam lugs su brgal pa dang dus rabs 11pa la slebs tshe gzod yongs su grub/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi mi mang che ba'i sems khongs su/ ro ma shar ma ni lkog gyur gyi rnam pas g.yog pa'i rgyang thag ring ba'i shar phyogs yul khams shig yin la/yul de ha cang 'byor phyug ldan zhing / rgyal sa khon si than then pho ni lha sgrub nang gi grong khyer zhig dang 'dra ste/ brjid chags mdzes sdug ldan pa'i pho brang mang zhing / rgyal po'i mdzod khang nang gser dang rin po che'i bkang pa dang /rje blon sku drag rnams kyis lha yul dang mtshungs pa'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin ༷/ga

snyam mo// ngo mtshar gyi skad cha de dag sgro btags nas nub phyogs yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho'i rna bar thon pas na/ de dag la ngo mtshar gyi stong bsam skyes zhing tshad med kyi 'dod rngam bslangs/yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag che chung gang rung gis dbyi tha li'i tshong pa'i lag nas shar phyogs las thon pa'i mig dbang 'phrog pa'i rgyas spros longs spyod dngos rdzas dang / dar gos/ spus legs lag cha/ dri zhim bro rdzas/ rgun chang sogs nyo thub pas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod mu mthun du je mthor song / skya mi chos skyid po'i 'tsho ba rol ba dang bags med 'dod sred kho nar brtson pas/ tha na reb bcom sdeb 'phrog dang lha khang la 'phrog bcom dang tshong pa'i ru khag la 'jab rgol byed/ sku drag bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang skya mi tshos rang gi mnga' khongs kyi rgya je che dang rgyu nor je mang la gtong bar re ba byed kyin 'dug 'byor phyug ldan pa'i ro ma shar ma dang a rab sa khul ni kho tsho'i rmi lam du'ang thob par re ba'i dmigs gzhi yin pas/ drag thabs kyis sa khul de dag btsan len byed par re ngan gting las bcangs yod do//dbyi tha li yi rje nā wa (60ba'i ma sa smo64)dang phi sa/(21 37 669) we ne dzi a (760621 7 777)sogs kyi tshong pa tshos sngar gyi dus nas bzung ro ma shar ma sogs sa khul la tshong las kyi 'brel ba btsugs yod/ kho tsho ni shar phyogs dang nub phyogs tshong las gnyis kyi bar mi yin la/ ro ma shar ma ru ches gal che ba'i tshong las phyogs kyi khe phan dang dmigs bsal dbang cha yod pa dang / de ru rang dbang du tshong rgyag pa'i dbang cha yod pas/ khon si than then pho ru gru kha dang srang lam bzung yod/ yin na'ang ro ma shar ma'i tshong pa dang a rab kyi tshong pa'ang tshong rgyag par shin tu mkhas shing / dkyil 'khor rgya swārdo'i shar khul du tshong las phyogs kyi gal che'i go gnas bzung yod stabs/

dbyi tha li'i tshong pa kho tsho'i 'gran zlar gyur/ dbyi tha li'i grong khyer tshong pa la mtshon na/ drag shugs kyis rang gi do zla med par du btong ba dang / shar phyogs dang nub phyogs bar gyi tshong las sger gcod du bzung ste/ rang gi tātnakārdorsha tu dngul mang pos bkang rgyu ni ches rtsa 'gangs che ba'i don dag skabs der nub phyogs yo rob kyi zhing pa ni yid skyo'i sdug bsngal gyi gnas mor lhung 'dug bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'os 'gan lci mos mnan pa'i steng bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag tsho'i bar gyi dus yun ring po'i dmag 'khrug gis kho tsho mu mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi mun dong nang bcug dus mtshungs su rang byung than skyon dang nad yams kyis dus rgyun kho tshor gtses pas/ 970lo nas 1040lo'i bar du yo rob tu bgrang bya 48lhag la than pa byung bas/ 'tsho thabs bral pa'i zhing pa tsho rgyun du rtswa med chu dkon du gyur pa'i pha yul la bral nas skor tshogs skor tshogs byas nas gzhan yul du 'khyams dgos byung / kho tsho la'ang shar phyogs su song nas rang dbang spya spro ra zhig btsal nas rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos byed 'dod kyi re ba sa/ chos kyi gong ma'i 'go 'dren 'og gi ye shu'i chos lugs kyi chos tshogs kyis kyang shar phyogs la ham pa skyes nas 'gram chu ldang gan 'dug dus rabs bar ma ru sil bur gyur pa'i nub phyogs yo rob tu chos tshogs ni rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i chab srid stobs shugs sheg yin pa ma zad/ da dung de la mthong chung bgyi mi rung pa'i dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs kyang yod/ ro ma gyi chos kyi gong mas yo rob tsam la dbang sgyur byas pas sems pa ma khongs pas/kho pas drag shugs brgyud de ye shu'i chos lugs yod tshad thams cad la dbang bsgyur byas nas shar phyogs kyi chos tshogs so sos kho la blo dkar gus gā spyad

pa'i steng / da dung i si lem chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan rnams kyang ye shu'i chos 'og tu bsdus te/ shar phyogs su rang gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i ye shu'i chos lugs kyi yul khongs gsar pa 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba bcangs/de bzhin du yo rob kyi gral rim dang rim pa/ chab srid kyi stobs shugs te bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang skya mi/ tshong pa/ zhing pa/chos tshogs yongs kyis dmigs yul mi 'dra ba bzung nas dmigs rgyang phyogs gcig pu ste shar phyogs su 'phangs/ drag shugs spyod rgyu ni dmigs bya yongs su 'grub pa'i thabs shes 'ba' zhig yin pas/ dus rabs bar ma'i lo rgyus steng dus yun ches ring ba'i dmag 'khrug ste rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs su btsan 'jug byas pa'i don rkyen de byung ngo //rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi 'gul skyod de ni nub phyogs yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang tshong pa chen po/ ro ma gyi gnam bdag chos lugs kyi gzhung gis dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar phyogs sa khul du brgyab pa'i btsan 'dzul rang bzhin gyi rgyang 'dul dmag 'khrug cig yin zhing / de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab so so btsan 'dul bya rgyu de red/ dmag 'khrug de 1096lo nas mgo brtsams shing bsdoms pas g.yul chen po thengs 8la brgyab pa 'di lta ste/thengs dang po/ 1096— 1099lo'i bar/thengs gnyis pa/ 1141— 1149lo'i bar/thengs gsum pa/ 1189— 1192lo'i bar/thengs bzhi pa/ 1202— 1204lo'i bar/thengs lnga pa/ 1217— 1221lo'i bar/thengs drug pa/ 1228— 1229lo'i bar/66zengs bdun pa/ 1248— 1254lo'i bar/

thengs brgyad pa/ 1270lo/1291lor rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis ches mtha' ma'i gnas gzhi shor ba dang shar phyogs su btsan 'dzul byas pa'i mjug bsgril pa dang / snga gzhug tu bsdoms pas lo ngo 195tsam 'gor pa red/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs su btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'gul skyod de ci ltar byung ba yin zhe na/ thog mar gsal po 'chad dgos pa'i don zhig yin te/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar khul gyi pha le si than gyi dkyil khag tu ming grags che ba'i gna' rabs grong mkhar rnying pa sgre ru sa lem (/015byam07 ༅ṭha phya)zhes pa yod/ grong khyer de'i lho phyogs su spyi le 17yod pa'i sa ru sbe le tem (26 stu116607 5tshelko/khri)zhes pa'i yurme zhig yod par kho lha sde ru 'bod pa'i brag khung zhig mchis pa ngag rgyun du ye shu 'khrungs yul yin par bshad/ sgro ru sa lum ni ye shu shing gi rgya gram steng 'dzer nas bgrongs pa'i yul yang red/335lor gna' rabs ro ma gyi gong ma khon si than then si sku rabs dang po'i ma yum btsun mo nye lun nā sgre ru sa lum du yul skor la phebs skabs yul der 'das log gi chos khang zhig btsugs/ de'i phyir ye shu'i chos lugs kyi dad ldan rnams kyis sgre ru sa lum ra gnas mchog 9tu bkur pa red/ dus rabs 7par a rab yongs gcig gyur byas rjes/ gna' bo'i mkhar grong de i si lem chos lugs kyi 6 gnas mchog tu yang gyur/ rgyu mtshan ni shod rgyun la i si lem chos lugs gsar sgrun byed mkhan smu ham sme sde (55'i kusku sku ༅sa )ni yul der mchog gyur gyi rdo zhig gi steng bzhugs nas gnam la 'phur zer pas yin no// i si lem chos lugs kyi dad ldan chos yul der gnas mjal du 'ongs pa'i ye shu'i chos lugs pa tsho gu yangs kyi rnam pas bsus te/kho tsho rang dgar gnas mchog tu 'gro 'ongs byed du bcug na'ang / ro 6lha gyi

chos kyi gong ma wur pan nu si (pungakhyims53 677)sku rabs gnyis (1088— 1099lo'i bar)pas yo rob ye shu'i chos lugs kyi dad ldan pa tsho'i chos lugs smyo sems kyi me lce sbar te/ tsa mchog don dmag 'khrug ’ brgyab te tsa mchog gnas bcings 'grol gtong dgos zhes ngan skul dkrug slong brgyab/ 1095lo'i zla 11par/ hpha ran si'i lho khul gyi khe re man du tshogs pa'i chos lugs tshogs chen steng chos kyi gong ma wu pan sku rabs gnyis pas gral rim dang rim pa so so'i mang tshogs mang po'i khrod stobs 'phel dpa' skyed kyi gtam bshad byas shing / gtam bshad des mi rnams kyis chos lugs kyi snying nad dang zhe sdang drag bslangs byas/ ye shu'i chos lugs kyi chos kyi gong ma des/ gal te chos log tshos (ye shu'i chos lugs la mi dad pa'i mi ste 'di ru i si lem gyi dad ldan pa bstan)kun 'jon lha chen por dad pas blo bstan zhing ye shu la brten pas spobs pa'i khengs mi rnams btul pas na/ de ni ji 'dra'i ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi don zhig ma yin nam/ gal srid khyed tshos rang nyid dang 'dra bar ye shu'i la dad pa byed pa'i mi rnams la rogs ram byed rgyu dang len ma byas na/ gnam bdag gis khyod tshor dmod tshig dang gshe gshe gtong gi red ces ngan skul brgyab/ kho pas da dung dad ldan pa tsho song nas chos log pa tsho'i lag nas gnas mchog bcings 'grol byed dgos zhes 'ud sgrog byas te/ 6 da lta phar song nas ye shu la dad pa mi byed pa'i mi dang 'dzing res gyis dang / snga mo'i dus nas bgyi dgos pa'i 'thab 'dzing 'di mthar thug bar du rgyag dgos ’ zhes ku co brgyab zhor/ bsam blo dang dngos po'i steng mi rnams slu brud byas nas/ 6 yul de na spro ba dang rgyu nom pas khengs 'dug pa dang dbul po rnams kyis 4 ji srid bar du 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rngan pa thob thub ’ pa ma zad/ da dung 4 ldab gnyis kyi rngan pa thob thub ’ pa daX /pha rol du skyod pa'i mi rnams la/ gal te lam bar te skam sa dang rgya

mtsho'i stong du/ yang na chos log pa tsho dang 'thab pa'i skabs tshe las 'das na/ de dag gi sdug nyes cig car du med par 'gro ཿzhes 'chal gtam du ma bshad/ye shu'i chos kyi gong ma'i gtam bshad der tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i mi rnams kyis dga' spro'i ngang dang len byas/ mi mang po zhig gis rgyang 'dul ri zhugs rgyur khas blangs pa ma zad/ rang gi lwa ba'i steng rgya gram rtags dmar po btsem pa dang / chos lugs kyi phyi lwa gyon pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi 'gul skyod de bzhin du mgo bcoms pa red/khe re man chos lugs tshogs 'du ni dmag 'khrug skul slong byed pa'i tshogs 'du zhig yin pas/ yo rob yul khongs chen por btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrugagi smyo sems kyis khengs te/ 2 mi su yin yang la lung du khyab pa'i ye shu'i chos kyi gong ma'i skad cha thos rjes/ rang gi khyim mtshes dang gnyen mi tshor gnam bdag gis gnang ba'i lam du 'gro dgos par skul slong byas/ gong ma'i srid gzhung gi mi drag blon chen tsho'i spro sems me ltar 'bar ba dang /bar rim skya mi tshos kyang phyogs gang nas gra sgrig byed bzhin 'dug skabs der dbul po rnams kyi dpa' ngar me dpung du gyur te me lce 'ur 'ur du 'bar/ gnas bab de 'dra'i 'og su yin yang rang gi yong sgo dkon par do snang mi byed pa dang / su yin yang phar btsong ba'i khyim gzhis dang rgun 'brum ra ba'i rin gong la sems khur mi byed par ches dma' ba'i rin gong du rang nyid kyi ches legs pa'i rgyu nor btsong 'dod skyes pas/ mi de btsan bzung byas nas mun nag khrod kyi btson rar bcug pa dang / sgug long med par dngul lor gyis rang lus blu dgos pa lta bur gyur/’ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ thengs dang por rgyang 'dul byed mkhan ni drag chas skya mi min par/ hpha ran si dang 'jar man nas sbyangs

pa'i zhing pa dbul po red/ de ni kho rang tsho shin tu dbul zhing phongs pas 'tsho thabs bral bas/ sgug dbang med par rang gi kha bsod dang lus dbang ji 'dra yin par tshod lta mi bya ka med yin pas red/ 1069lo'i dpyid mgor/mi de dag la lag cha med cing 'bru rigs kyang shin tu nyung yang / na rags lus zhan dang bud med bu phrug skor tshogs shig khrid de 'tshang kha rgyag zhor 'ur 'ur zing zing du mchod mjal du 'gro ba'i lam chen ded de shar phyogs su dal bur bskyod/ de ni 'thab mo ba ma yin te dkres ltogs kyis mnar bzhin pa'i yul 'khyar pa'i tshogs skor zhig red/ kho tshos thon thon sar 'phrog bcom byas shing lam bar du 'phrad pa'i grong khyer thams cad la rdog brdzis btang /dbyar dus kyi mjug rdzogs pa'i dus kho tsho khon si than then pho ru slebs shing /de su mi grangs phyed ka tsam las lhag med/ de nas kho tsho rgya mtshor brgal nas a she ya chung bar thon tshe 'phral du gru gu'i dmag gis drag rgol thebs pas/zhing pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung 'di phal cher rmeg med btang bas/ 1710las ma lhag pa phyir khon si than then pho ru bros pa red/thengs dang por shar phyogs btsan 'dul byed pa'i dmag dpung gi gtso shugs ni skya mi'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung red/ 1097lo'i dpyid kur/ phyogs so so'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung khon si than then pho ru 'dzoms/ nor man pa phu e man sde zhes pa de tsho'i spyi'i dmag dpon byas/kho tshos spo si pho ru si (20390753 morsā glo)mtsho 'gag la brgal nas dka' ngal shin tu che ba'i a she ya ru rgyang 'dul gyi mgo brtsams/ ri bo mthon po dang bye thang/ tshad pa drag po dang 'thung chu dkon pa sogs kyis mnar pas go cha lci mo gyon pa'i skya mi tsho re re byas nas sa 'gyel te tshe srog shor/btsan bsdu byas pa'i grong khyer rtsod pa'i ched du skya mi tsho'i bar du nang 'khrug yakā sdung byung / 1099lo'i zla 7par gzod skya mi'i dmag dpung de sgre ru sa

lem gyi grong khyer logs su slebs/ zla 7pa'i nyin zhig rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis mkhar rdzong phab byed kyi shing skas bzos/ zhogs par phar rgol gyi dmag dung bus pa dang / rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas drag rgol byas nas phyi dro'i chu tshod lnga tsam du mtshams ma bzhag rung / i si lem gyi dad ldan tshos dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyis 'gog rgol byas pas mkhar rdzong phab ma thub/ mtshan mor rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis btsan rdzong phab byed kyi skas stegs chen po bzos te kha rog tu mkhar gyang rtsar ded de gyang rtser 'dzegs brtsis byas kyang / i si lem dmag gis gdu bzhin yod pa'i snam khu mar blugs pas/ dgra po'i skas stegs chen po mer bsgron pa red/ de bzhin du phan tshun gnyis kur shi rmas kyi gyong kha chen po thebs rjes/ phyi nyin snga dror rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis mkhar sgo phab ste sgre ru sa lem mkhar nang du brgyugs pas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dar mkhar gyang gi rtse ru bsgrengs/ de'i 'phro ru dmar gsod chen po'i 'go brtsams pa dang / gdug rtsub can gyi rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis i si lem gyi chos la dad pa byed mkhan dang a rab kyi mi/ i gzi yu phi a'i mi (2 61091 tha ṣṭha tsho ༅)yod tshade dmar gsod byas/so lo mon (501010ba sgo /cig)lha khang du mi chig khri lhag gi srog blangs/ lo rgyus kyi yig cha'i nang lha gal te khyod rang de ru yar langs nas bsdad na/ khyod kyi rkang mgo nas bla yi bar du khrag dmar gyis sbags nges pa red/ da ni shod rgyu ci zhig yod/ kho tsho'i khrod sus kyang tshe srog rgyun 'khyongs byed mi thub/bud med dang phru gu su yin yang thar ba ma thob/ khyod tshos mig sngon du mngon pa 'di lta ste/ nga tshos skya mi'i zhabs zhu ba dang dmag mi dbul po tshos mi shi bo'i gsus pa gshags nas de tsho ma shi gong khog tu mid pa'i gser sgor len de'i ched du kho tshos nyin 'ga' yi ring mi ro spungs nadi sar

bsregs pa dang de lta na gser 'tshol sla ba red de lta bu'i khrag chen phyung rjes/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag mi tsho grong mi'i khyim du brgyugs nas yod tshad 'phrog bcom byas/ mizhes bris yod/ rgya gram rtasas can gyi dmag gi jag pa'i rtsub spyod ni ya nga dang snying rje med pa zhig yin pa de las shes thub bo//sgre ru sa lem btsan 'dzin byas rjes/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis rim bzhin dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram khul du rgya gram rtags can dmag gi rgyal khab kha shas btsugs/ de'i nang ches che shos ni sgre lu sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab yin zhing / des zheng dog la dkyus ring pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi sa khongs bzung yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur la srung skyong dang mi dmangs kyi ngo rgol la drag gnon bya ched/ rgya gram rtags can dmag gis sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab tu chos lugs rang bzhin can gyi dmag don rtsa 'dzugs khyad par can te chos lugs kyi skya mi tshogs pa btsugs/ de'i nang lha khang skya mi tshogs pa dang sman khang skya mi tshogs pa/ ming grags can gyi the'o thon (105 001 lko 1)skya mi tshogs pa bcas 'du/ tshogs pa de'i khongs mi ni 'thab mo ba yin la chos 'chad mkhan yang yin/ gnyen mi sgrig pa dang sgrig khrims brtsi bkur dang len bya bar khas len dam bca' bzhag yod/ de dag gi las ka gtso bo ni dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu dang 'phrog bcom bya rgyu yin la/ zhor du tshong las gnyer zhing skyed lci'i bu lon yang gtong bzhin yod pa red/rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis thengs dang por shar phyogs btsan 'dul byas pas/ thog mar yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rang lugs kyi mnga' bdag dang rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpon tsho la khe phogs chen po tholha kto bcug pas kho tsho tshang ma 'byor phyug 'jon thang can du gyur/ dbyi tha

sogs grong khyer gyi tshong pa la'ang khe spogs chen po thob/ grong khyer de dag gi tshong pas dngul dang gru gzings kyis rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag la rogs ram byas pas/ tshong las dpya khral mjal mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal yod/dper na 1124lor khyab bsgrags byas pa'i(we ne dzi a'i tshong par sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab tu yod pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha'i chings yig〉ces pa'i nang / sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi grong khyer yod rgu ru/ 6 we nee dzi a'i tshong pa tshor rang gi chos tshogs dang srang lam cha tshang zhig dang /thang chen zhig dang khrus khang / bag leb bzo khang sogs yod dgos/ rgyu nor de dag la mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha yod/rgyal po'i rsha nor bzhin du dpya khral yod tshad mjal mi dgos/ we ne dzi a'i tshong pas 6 rgyun goms gang rung dang rgyu mtshan gang rung gis thag bcad pa'i khral dngul ster mi dgos/ rgyal khab khongs su zhugs pa'am sa cha zhig tu gnas sdod byed pa'i khral mjal mi dgos/ phar btsong tshur nyo dang rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs la bral ṅge'i khral yang sprod mi dgos mi dbyi tha li'i tshong pas gom gang mdun spos sgos shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi tshong las kyi rgya che ru btang bas kho tsho yang sngar las kyang je phyug tu gyur/rjes su nub phyogs yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chos thengs gnyis pa dang thengs gsum pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag shar 'dul rtsa 'dzugs byas kyang tshang ma pham nas mjug bsgril/ sgre ru sa lem yang i jib kyi mis phyir 'phrog nas bzung / ye shu'i chos kyi gong ma en no sen the si (100000sa 1 53 rsā sme)sku rabs gsum pa ( 1198 — 1216lo)sa rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs btsan 'dul thengs bzhi ba bslangs kyang / thengs 'di'i dmigs 'ben ni gzhan ma yin par ro ma brdo/ rgyal shar ma red/ 1203lo'i zla 6pa'i zla mjug tu rgya gram rtags can

gyi dpung chen po khon si than then pho yi sngon du slebs/ 1204lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 13nyin gna' bo'i mkhar grong de dgra bos phab/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis yang bskyar mi'i rigs la go na ha las pa'i byas nyes bzos/ kho tshos snying rje med par grong mi dmar gsod byas shing dpe mdzod khang chen mo me la bsregs/ san so hphe ya chos khang (58218 50961 ma charsārsā༅)la 'phrog bcom brgyab/ ri ltar spungs pa'i dmag thob dngos rdzas dang grangs las 'das pa'i sgyu rtsal thon rdzas nub phyogs su bskyel/ dmag mi rer 'phrog thob dngos rdzas las gzhan da dung rgyu nor gyi skal re sbyin/ ye shu'i chos lugs la dad pa byed pa'i ro ma shar ma la'ang de 'dra'i brnyas bcos dang gtor brlag byas pa des/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi cu chos lugs kyi ched dmag 'khrug rgyag mices pa'i phyi lu bkog nas ngo bo dmar rjen du mngon/ ro ma btsan rgyal gyi mnga' khongs dum bur bgos shing / rjes su slar yang phyir slar gso bya thub pa byung yang / sngar gyi 'byor phyug 'jon thang ldan pa'i rnam pa ni 'das pa'i dus kyi mi lam tsam du gyur ro//dus rabs 13pa nas bzung / rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis rgyang 'dul byed pa'i dril bsgrags la dang ma bzhin du spro sems sgos dang len byed mkhan ma byung zhing / da lta dril bsgrags de'i mang tshogs kyi sems pa 'gug pa'i nus pa ye nas shor/ zhing pa tshos rgyang 'dul ni tshe srog gtong ba'i don zhig tu 'dod/ skabs der dgod bro zhing khungs lung med pa'i 'chal gtam zhig sgrog gin 'dug par/ byis pa kho nas dar ma tsho'i 'grum mi thub pa'i gzi brjid las 'gan te gnas mchog bcings 'grol gtong ba'i las 'gan 'grub thub par bsgrags pas/ hpha ran si dang 'jar man las 'ongs pa'i phru gu tsho'i byis pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung btsugs nas phru gu sum khri lhag smar se ru (587301 110 67)'dzoms/ 1212lor gru bdag tshodi ṭā tsho

pha le si than ru bskyal 'go bcoms/ yid gdung zhing sems skyo ba'i las dbang phru gu de tsho'i mgo ru babs/ skor zhig rlung chen drag rlabs khrod rgya mtsho'i gting du nub nas shi ba dang/ skor zhig i jib du bran g.yog tu btsong / 'di ni rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs btsan 'dul byas pa'i lo rgyus steng ches yid gdung zhing sems sdug la ngo tsha che ba'i le tshan zhig yin no//shar phyogs rgyal khab so so'i shugs ldan rgol lan slog pa'i gnas bab 'og tu/ rjes su thengs 'gar btsan 'dul du 'ongs pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung la 'bras bu ci yang ma lon par pham kha myangs/ 1291lor rgya gram rtags can gyis bzung ba'i ches mtha' mjug gi gnas gzhi a khe grong khyer (pha le si than gyi byang khul du yod)yi si lem chos lugs la dad pa rnams kyis bzung bas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs la btsan 'dzul byas pa ni de bzhin pham pa'i ngang mjug rdzogs pas/ de dag gis shar phyogs su bzung pa'i rgya che ba'i mnga' khongs yongs su shor tshar ba red/yun ring rgyun sring du brgyab pa'i btsan 'dzul rang bzhin gyi dmag 'khrug 'dis dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram khul gyi mi rigs so sor brjod kyis mi lang pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar btang bas/ de ga'i spyi tshogs thon skyed la gtor brlag chen po bzos/ mi 'bum phrag du ma dmar gsod brgyab pa dang bgrangs kyis mi lang pa'i rin po che dang rgyu nom pa 'phrog bcom byas/ nye shar rgyal khab so so dang ro ma shar ma'i spyi tshogs lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog thebs shing / dus yun ring po'i dmag 'khrug gis yo rab mi dmangs la'ang sdug bsngal dang god chag chen po bzos pa red/yin na'ang rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs btsan 'dul byadi ༵ des shar phyogs kyi chu tshad mtho ba'i lag rtsal dang rig gnas nub

phyogs su ngo sprod byed pa'i nus pa bton/ rjes su shar nub gnyis bar gyi phan tshun 'gro 'ongs la shugs snon dang phan tshun bar gyi tshong las kyang lhag tu dar rgyas su song bas/ nub phyogs yo rob spyi tshogs dpal 'byor te lhag par du dngul lor dpal 'byor gong du 'phel ba je mgyogs su btang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi tshong las khrod/ a rab kyi mi dang ro ma shar ma'i mi'i go gnas je dman du song zhing / yo rob kyi tshong pa ste lhag par du dbyi tha li'i tshong pa ni su las kyang hur por mngon pa red/

ji jib kyi mi'ags dpa'atho sag khen/rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis shar phyogs la btsan 'dul thengs dang po'i byas nas sgre ru sa lem phab nas bzung rjes/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram gyi grong khyer so sor tshur rgol byas/ skabs der grong khyer de dag i jib kyi mnga' khongs yin/ i jib kyi mtsho dmag dang grong khyer srung ba'i dmag dpung gis dpa' ngar zhum med sgos btsan 'gog byas pas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis 1099 — 1124lo'i bar lo ngo 29ring la drag rgol byas rung a khe re (8070 lo༅)dang thi re pho li (171 9011 ṭha ṣṭhatsho) sbe ru the (21 075 yi 6)sogs grong khyer kha shas las phab ma thub/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis nye shar du btsugs pa'i rgyal khab gtso bo ni sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab yin la/ ming gi thog nas de la gtogs pa'i rgyal khab la e sde sa (266338 47944)dang an the'o khi a (mes 100618 alkomawa)/ thi re pho li gsum yod/rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi rtsub spyod kyis 6 shar phyogs kyi i si lem chos lugs la dad mkhan tshor bzod dka' ba'i khong khro chen po bslangs/ midus rabs 12par i si lem chos lugs la dad pa'i gru gu pa'i sul than (501 thab rsā7 a rab skad du dbang thang can te gong ma rgyal po'i don/sgyur pa po nas)rnams kyis sems pa gcig tu bsgril nas rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag la ngo rgol byed 'go tshugs/ 1144lor smo sul (5035/ sgo(7)gyi sbyo spyapon tsong tu'u yis e sde sa rgyal khab bsgrubs nas/ thad kur an tho

khi a la 'jigs snang bskul/ i jib rgyal khab kyis rgyun chad med par rang gi pha le si than bca' sdod dmag dpung gi gnas gzhi nas skam dmag dang mtsho dmag btang nas rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi rgyal khab la phar rgol byas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis pham kha yang yang zos shing thengs gnyis pa'i shar 'dul pham na'ang / i jib la btsan 'dzul byed rgyu mtshams ma bzhag 1153lor/ i jib kyi dmag don mdun phyogs so pa lta bu'i grong khyer gnad chen a si kha lon zhes pa dgra bo'i lag tu shor pas bkag sgo med par gyur/ 1164— 1169lo'i bar/ sgre ru sa lem gyi rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis khyon yongs nas i jib la btsan 'dzul byas stabs/dmag 'khrug gi me lce rgyal khab nang khul du sgron te/ rgyal sa khe ro (5go nga0 77)dgra bos bskor stabs nyen gnas chen por lhung ngo //i jib la 868lor a rab btsan rgyal gyi dbang bsgyur 'og las rang btsan thob rjes/ snga gzhug tu thu lon rgyal rabs (868—905lo'i bar)a sba si rgyal rabs (26683 ༅77 905—935)dang e hi si sde rgyal rabs/(7 lko 935 — 969lo'i bar) pho thi smi sde si rgyal rabs (77 1—163stsa lho )69 — 1171lo'i bar)sogs kyis dbang bsgyur byed myangs/ hpha thi smi sde si rgyal rabs kyi dus stod la/ krung dbyang srid dbang la stobs shugs che zhing dpal 'byor shin tu dar bas rgyal sa khe ro la yang 'du 'dzi ha cang che/ yin na'ang dus rabs 11pa'i dus mjug nas bzung / rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis tshur rgol byas pa'i rnam pa'i 'og i jib kyi mnga' khongs mi nyung ba zhig shor bas/ rgyal khab kyi stobs 'byor nyin re bzhin je zhanadra song stabs/ snye khe ro bskor nga/'i gnas tshul de lta bu byung ba red/rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis dpa' ngar rtul phod sgos 'thab rtsod byas /sbyar/

da gzod khe ro bskor pa'i nyen kha dkrol nas sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi rgya gram rtags can gyi dgra dmag phyir bskrad pa red/ tag tag dus der i jib kyi dus rabs bar ma'i dpa' bo zhig lo rgyus kyi gar stegs steng 'dzegs shing de ni sa la chen zhes pa yin no//sa la chen ni khur sde (5516 sgolo6)zhes pa'i mi rigs kyi mi yin zhing / ha lam 1138lor i rag (1789 777)byang khul gyi thi khe ri the (11smong1 / chamatshoṣṭha)ru sku 'khrangs/ gzhon nu'i dus su khong rang ḍa ma si khu si (23183053 mcha sna)yi gung chen po nor ldan zhes pa'i zhabs 'og nas las ka bsgrubs myangs shing / nor ldan gyis mngags pa bzhin rang gi a khu a sa sde then khur kho wa'i (ḍa ma si khu si gung chen po'i dmag don bkod 'doms pa yin)rjes su 'brangs nas thengs gsum ring i jib du dmag rgyag tu 'gro myangs zhing / g.yul ngor zhugs pa dang dmag don phyogs kyi phul du byung ba'i blo gros mngon du thon/ 1169lor/ sa la chen gyis i jib kyi blon chen gyi 'gan bzhes/ 1171lor nye srung dmag gis rgyab skyor byas 'og srid 'gyur bslangs nas hpha thi smi si rgyal rabs kyi kha li phog (5571187 427)a thi sde zhes pa go sa las phab te rang nyid sul than)(gong ma rgyal po)du bzhugs nas/ a yu spe the (4756 0 777)rgyal rabs btsugs/(1171— 1250lo'i bar)sa la khen gyis rgyal rabs gsar pa btsugs rjes/ thog mar a rab rgyal khab gcig gyur byed pa'i las don mdzad/ khong gis hpha thi smi sde si rgyal rabs ro langs rgyag pa'i lkog g.yo rdul du brlag pa'i steng rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gi tshul rgol cham la pham/ lo ngo bcu phrag ring gi dus tshod brgyud sa la chen gyis i jib dang si ri a/ i rag gsum phyogs gcig tu ba/sdu pa ma zad/ da dung mu mthud du a hphe ri kha'i byang phyogs su rang gi

stobs shugs kyi rgya bskyed pas/ mthur mjug i jib lte gnas byas pa'i gcig gyur gyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i a rab kyi rgyal khab chen po zhig btsugs so// tshode nas sa la chen gyis rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag la 6 chos don ciri dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i 'go bcoms te/1187lor rgya gram rtags can gyi rgyal khab la phar rgol byas/ zla drug pa'i zla smad du/ sa la ten gyis mi drug khri lhag gi dpung chen po khrid de the sbe re a si ri nyamatshe'u (11 6671 'bya sa༅7)7)yi nye ji snye /'dabs kyi hwad then (28 1ba ṣṭha༅)thang chen du phyogs kun nas phar rtsol sa la ren gyi sku brnyan/byas te sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyis bzung pa'i the sbe re a si grong khyer bskor nas nyin drug ring drag rgol byas mthar mkhar de phab/ 'khrug chen de'i nang sa la chen gyis rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gi gtso shugs nyis khri lhag tshar gcod byas thog g.yul la zhugs su 'ongs pa'i sgre ru sa lem gyi gong ma rgyal po re sen mun sde khe dang lha khang skya mi rta dmag tshogs sde'i tshogs gtso gnyis gson bzung byas/ khong gis sgre ru sa lem gyi gong ma la gu yangs btang ba na'ang / nag nyes dgu 'dzoms kyi rta dmag tshogs gtso de la srog khrims bcad de pasad/cung ma 'gor par sa la chen gyis rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gi gtso shugs tshar gcod byas pa dang grong khyer so sor srung dmag nyung pa'i skabs dang bstun nas/ 'gog bral sha 'od chen po brgyugs 'dra'i spyadis

dang myur tshad kyis snga gzhug tu dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram gyi grong khyer te dper na/ a khe re (sa070 tham)dang / sbi ru the/(231 75 khra 7) si sdon/(51 70ba po smo) khe sa re a/((2638128 glu/lo1lko/༅) a si kha lon bcas blangs nas/ sgre ru sa lem rgyal po'i rgyal khab dang yo rob kyi 'grim 'grul 'phred du bcad/ de nas sa la ten 'phral mar kha phyir ldog ste nang khul bskyod de sgre ru sa lem grong khyer la btsan rgol byas/ zla 9pa'i tshes 20nas zla 10pa'i tshes 2bar nyin bcu lhag ring phar rgol byaso mthar gna' mkhar de yongs su blangs/sa la khen gyis rgyal kha dang bstun nas rgya gram rtags can gyi rgyal khab la phyogs yongs nas phar rgol byas te/ si ri a (5711 8 85lko1krokhru)dang le sba non (2668ba0ba khu )sogs pha le si than gyi grong khyer dang btsan rdzong mang che ba blangs/ 1189lor slebs dus/ ther grong khyer dang the ri pho li/an the'o khe a sogs khor rkyang du lus pa'i grong khyer chung ngu khag cig da dung phab med pa ma gtogs gzhan thams bcad blangs tshar pa red/gnas mchog sgre ru sa lem shor ba dang sa la ḍin la rgyal kha thob pa des yo rob gling hang sang pa tsam du btang / nub phyogs yo rob rgyal khab kyi rje bo rnams te 'jar man gyi gong ma hphe ri sde ri khe (711 071106 1 2816870338tshi shā5)smra ra dmar po can dang dbyin ji'i gong ma seng ge'i snying can char le si/ hpha ran si'i gong ma hphe leb phe u sgu si the (261 11996 smo sa5653 rngusajime lhamos)bcas kyis sku ngo mas dmag dpung chen po khrid de rgya gram rtags can gyi shar phyogs btsan 'dul thengs gsum pa byas shing char le si yis gtso sna khrid/ kho tsho dang rgya gram rtags can gyi rgyal khab gyi shul lhag stobs shugs mnyam 'brel byas nas/ sa la khen gyi dmag dpung gis bzung brdi ༵ khe re grong khyer la tshur rgol byas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis a

khe re grong khyer len rgyu ni a rab kyi mi'i lag nas smyo sngar shor yul khongs mi phyir 'phrog pa'i 'gag rtsa yin par snyam pas ngar shugs gang yod sgos drag rgol byas/ sa la ḍin gyis kyang dpung chen khrid de a rab kyi mi la rogs ram du phebs nas/ a khe re grong khyer srung ba'i dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms byas/rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis rgya mtsho'i stong dang skam sa gnyis las dus gcig tu i jib kyi mtsho dmag dang skam dmag la tshur rgol byas/ kho tshos mda' 'phen 'phrul 'khor dang mkhar rtol gtum bu/ rdo 'phen 'phrul 'khor sogs mkhar rdzong la rgol byed kyi lag cha spyad kyang / kho tshor i jib kyi dmag dpung gis rgol lan drag po thebs pas rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag ni mkhar rdzong gi nye sar yang bcar ma thub/ seng ge'i snying can char le si yis byed thabs gang yod sgos dmag mi tshor phar rol por drag tu rgol dgos pa'i skul 'ded dang yang na phar btsan 'ded byas pa ma zad/ tha na mkhar gyang steng las so phag gcig bkog nas khyer 'ongs thub pa'i mi la bya dga' chen po byin/ 1189lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 27nas 1191lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 12nyin bar gyi bgrang bya gnyis tsam ring sa la ḍin gyi dmag dpung gis a khe re grong khyer brtan srung byas pas rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag la god chag tshabs chen bzos rjes/ da gzod a khe re grong khyer ma srung bar phyir 'then byas/ rjes su sa la chen gyis slar yang char le si yis sgre ru sa lem la tshur rgol thengs gsum byas pa cham la pham pas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag gis dmag 'khrug bskyur nas 'dum 'grig yong re mi zhu thabs med byung / 1192lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin/ sa la ḍin dang char le si gnyis kyis zhi chings bris te/ther zhes pa'i yul nas sgra hpha (38118 ṣṭha)zhes pa'i yul khongs rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung la dbang ba dang / nang khul dang gnas mchog sgre ru sa lem ni i jib la dbang na yang / yo rob kyi gnas mjal ba rdo /nga

dgar gnas mchog tu mjal bar yong chog rung lag cha ci yang lus su 'dogs mi chog par thag gcod byas/ de bzhin du rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gis thengs gsum par shar phyogs btsan 'dul byas pa pham nas mjug bsgril/sa le khen gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag la ngo rgol byas pa'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa ni/ i jib mi dmangs kyis btsan 'dzul la 'thab rtsod byas par thob pa'i rgyal kha yin zhing / nub phyogs yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi dmag don mi ser spel yul bya 'gul la btang ba'i rdung deg drag po zhig kyang red/ rgyal kha 'dis i jib kyi sger dbang srung skyob byas pa dang / i jib kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la skul spel byas pas/ bar shar sa khul nub phyogs pas mi ser spel sbyal gyi bran g.yog tu stasgyur pa'i 'phel rim yang phyir 'gyangs byas yod pa gud/ sa la ḍin ni i jib dang a rab kyi dpa' bo dang phul du byung ba'i dmag don spyi dpon zhig yin la/ khong gis smu si lem (55367 7lo7)shes rig la mdzad rjes chen po gnang yod/ 1193lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 19nyin/khong la rgyu tsha'i snyung gzhi thebs nas ḍa ma si khu si (7770053 (cha lko)ru sku gshegs/ khong gi dgongs pa rdzogs na'ang khong gi mdzad rjes ni ji srid bar du mi rnams kyi sems khongs su gnas te/ a rab mi dmangs kyis nam byi( stu/ sdo gus zhu brtsi bkur byed pas/ da lta'i bar khong la rjes dran byed 84

'otshogirgya'i dmag 'khrug1337lo nas1453lo'i bar/ dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i bar bgrang bya brgya yi ring gi dmag 'khrug brgyab cing de la lo rgyus steng 6 lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug zer/dmag 'khrug 'di byung bar lo rgyus kyi 'byung rtsa gting zab mo zhig yod pa ni/ thog mar dus rabs 12pa dang 13pa nas bzung rgyal khab gnyis kyi gong ma tshang gis skam sa chen po'i mnga' khongs (pho ran si'i mnga' khongs su yod)rtsod res byas par rgyun mthud byas pa de red/ dus rabs 11pa'i snga gzhug gi hpha ran si ni/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyis sa khongs bcad bzung byas shing / mnga' bdag la stobs shugs che bas/ gong ma rgyal po'i bdag tu bzung ba'i yul khongs ni tha na mnga' bdag las kyang chung ba red/1154lor hpha ran si'i an yu'u (sa )05 67)sgo cu'e yis ma rgyud tsha bu'i ming du (kho'i ma yum ni dbyin ji'i gong ma nyen re sku rabs dang po'i bu mom 1168redatadasgyur pa po)dbyin ji'i gong ma'i go sa blangs shing ming la nyen re sku rabs gnyis pa (50ba17 0 stos/patsho)zer/ kho la hpha ran si'i gong ma'i zur gtogs tshul du an smu'u dang (sa 305 67) man ne (5 21 brngu che'iṣṭha)thu'u re ne/(1057go ba0 shā1྅jo)nor man ḍi/(saX77707skyaterga༅(6) pho wa thu'u (201 05sto ṣpetsā'i)sogs mnga' khongs bzung yod pas/hpha ran si'i gong ma tshang gi mnga' khongs las ldab drug che stabs/ ches stobs 'byor can gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag zhig yin no// nā /na

hpha ran si'i khrims mthun gong ma rgyal po yin zhing rmu lan sder gyi ches mtho'i mnga' bdag yin par khas len byas/ dbyin jis kyang yul de bdag 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha gtong 'dod med pa shod mi dgos pa'i don zhig yin no//'o na lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug slong ba'i kha mchu 'khrug rtsod kyi 'go gang nas byung zhe na/ de ni hpha ran si'i rgyal po'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha bcod pa de yin no// dbyin ji'i gong ma e sde war sde sku rabs gsum pa ni hpha ran si'i gong ma sngon ma hphe leb phe sku rabs bzhi ba'i sras mo'i bu red/1328lor hpha ran si'i kha phe then rgyal rabs ((296 10bca rdo 17)kyi rgyal rgyud chad pas rgyal rabs kyi mjug rdzogs/ hphe leb phe sku rabs bzhi ba'i tsha bo hphe leb phe sku rabs drug pas gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byas/ yin na'ang e sde war sde yis kyang hpha ran si'i gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i re ba bton nas hphe leb phe sku rabs drug pas gong ma'i go sa bzung bar ngo rgol byas/ de ni hphe leb phe sku rabs drug pas bzod dka' ba'i don zhig yin stabs/ 1337lor hpha ran si'i gong ma hphe leb phe sku rabs drug pas dbyin ji la dmag rgyag pa'i brda khyab btang ba dang lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go btsams pa red/don dngos su de'i sngon du dbyin ji'i snga sa nas dmag 'khrug rgyag par gra sgrig byas yod/ dbyin ji'i gong mas shugs gang yod bton nas 'jar man gyi gong ma rgyal po dang sku drag tsho rang gi phyogs su 'then pa dang / dbyin ji dang dbyi tha li'i dngul khang pa tsho'i lag nas dngul mang po bskyis pa dang /hphu lan sder nas dngos po'i phyogs kyi rogs skyor mang po thob/ dbyin ji'i gong mas rgyu stobs chen po dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho'i rgyab skyor 'og dmag dpung stobs shugs ldan pa zhig btsugs/ dmag dpung gi srog shing ni rang dbang can gyi zhing pa las grub pa'i glas dam/ din

la sgrig lam shin tu dam/ dus mtshungs su da dung phul byung 6 mda' 'phen mkhan gyi dpung tshogs ’ sheg btsugs/ mda' ba gcig gis chu tshod skar ma gang gi nang mda' 10 — 12'phen thub/ de ni skabs de'i yo rab la mtshon na 'gran zla med pa'i dmag rtsal zhig red/ gong dang bsdur tshe/ hpha ran sis dmag 'khrug la gra sgrig byas pa shin tu zhan/ kho tshos dbyi tha li'i rje nā wa las glas pa'i mda' ba tshos chu tshod skar ma gang gi nang mda' mo bzhi las 'phen mi thub/ gnas bab des dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus su hpha ran sis dbyin ji'i do zla mi 'ongs pa de thag gcod byas 'dug go/1337 — 1360lo'i bar ni dmag 'khrug gi dus skabs dang po red/1340lor dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gis si lu si (31513 tshomatsho stsa)dutpa ran si'i mtsho dmag dang 'thab pa las rgyal stabs/ rgya mtsho'i steng pha rol las stobs shugs ldan pa rgyun 'khyongs byas/ de'i 'phror 1346lor khi re si'i (07005 770)g.yul 'gyed byung zhing de ni lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi g.yul 'gyed thengs dang po red/ hpha ran si'i gong ma rgyal po hphe leb phe sku rabs drug pas a phe wer grong mkhar nas dmag dpung khrid de khi re si'i phyogs su bskyod/ grong khyer nas dbyin le drug tsam bskyod pa dang dbyin ji'i dmag dpung dang gdong thug brgyab/ hpha ran si'i rgyal pos mdun skyod bya rgyu mtshams bzhag nas g.yul bsre bar gra sgrig gyis shig ces bka' babs kyang /bka' la nyan mkhan su yang ma yod par dmag mi tsho 'tshab 'tshub ngang yar brgyugs mar brgyugs byas pas nyog 'dres shing zing zing por gyur/ hpha ran si'i rgyal po dang dmag dpon chen po rnams kyis rang gi dpung sde bkod pas bcings ma thub par tab tab por gyur pa'i tshe/ dbyin ji'i dpung tshogs chen po ni shar ma gsum gyi 'thab gral bsgrigs te g.yul du zhugs par ba/sdus 'dug dpung tshogs gnyis kyis g.yul dngos su g.yul bsre skabs/

hpha ran si'i rgyal pos khong gi mda' ba tshig khri lnga stong la gzhu bkang nas mda' 'phangs nas 'thab 'go rtsom dgos pa'i bka' babs kyang / mda' ba chos da dung 'thab 'dzing dpung sde rtsa 'dzugs byas ma tshar pas/ da rung cung ngal ba gso dgos zer/ rjes su mda' ba rnams rgyal po'i bka' btsan por zhed nas pha rol la rdo gzhu bkang ste 'phangs/ dbyin ji'i gong ma'i sras thu bo ste ming la 6 sras nag mi zer pa'i gzhon gsar e sde war sde yis bkod 'doms 'og dbyin ji'i mda' ba tshos kyang 'phral du gzhu bkang nas pha rol po'i tshur rgol la lan sprad pas/ bgrangs kyis mi lang pa'i mda' mo hpha ran si'i dpung tshogs nang 'phur nas/ hpha ran si'i dmag gi 6 mgo bo dang dpung ba/ brang dang lto bar zug stabs/ mi mang po zhig gis lag gi gzhu sa la g.yug pa dang gzhu rgyun bcad de mu tig gi phreng ba 'thor bzhin la lung du bros/mi pho ran si'i gong ma rgyal po khong khro rab tu langs pas g.yul ngo las phyir bros pa'i dmag mi tsho ming gi lhag mar gtong dgos pa'i bka' babs te/go mtshon btsan po can gyi rta dmag rang gi mda' ba'i dpung tshogs khrod rgyug tu bcug nas mi mang po lnga ba'i lam du drangs/ dbyin ji'i dmag gis hpha ran si'i dpung tshogs zi ling dgu ling dang rang gis rang la nang dme byed pa'i skabs dang bstun te/ slar yang hpha ran si'i go mtshon btsan po thogs pa'i rta dmag steng mda' mo ji snyed 'phangs pas/ hpha ran si'i rta dmag ni mi shi rta 'gyel dang sa la 'gyel pa rnams rtas rkang rdzis btang bas/ hpha ran si'i rta dmag mang che ba ni dbyin ji'i dpung tshogs sngon du ma thon gong dbyin ji'i mda' mo phog ste tshe srog shor/ skabs der dbyin ji'i rkang dmag gis ral gri chen po thogs nas leb tu rgol bar brgyugs/ de bzhin du hpha ran si'i dmag la pham nyes tshabs chen byung bas/ rta dmag 1500lhag gis g.yul du srog shor na'ang dbyin ji'i dmag la rta dmag 3dang rkang hā/ga

40tsam gyi chag gud las ma byung / phyi lor dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis kha le si gru kha ((ma 1 ca rdo stsa)bskor nas phab cing / de nas bzung kha le si ni dbyin ji'i skam sa chen po ru bzung ba'i gnas gzhi gal chen zhig tu gyur ro//1348lor 'jigs yer pa'i 'phyi nad yo rob yongs su khyab pas/ lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug de gnas skabs zhi 'jags su song / 1356lor slobs pa dang / dbyin hpha gnyis kyis hpha ran si'i nub khul kyi pho a thi re (201 1616077)ru g.yul chen po bshams te 'thab pa dang / 6 sras nag e sde war sde yis dbyin ji'i dmag dpung khrid de slar yang hpha ran si'i dmag dpung cham la pham te/ hpha ran si'i gong ma rgyal po 'jon (/680 0 12 20ba skrus)dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag mang po 'dzin bzung byas/rgyal kha thob pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag gis smyos pa ltar btsan bzung byas pa'i sa khul la 'phrog bcom byas te/ dmag thob dngos rdzas rdzogs mtha' med pa dbyin ji ru bskyel/ dbyin hpha dmag 'khrug gis hpha ran si la skyi g.ya' ba'i gtor brlag byas rkyen mi dmangs kyi khur po je lci la song ba'i steng / 'gal ba sna tshogs kyang dza drag can du song mthar/ pha ri si grong khyer gyi grong mis 'os langs brgyab pa dang hpha ran si'i zhing pas 'os langs kyang byung / 'os langasade dag la grong khyer gong rim grong mi dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos drag gnon byas pa red/1360lor hpha ran si dang dbyin ji gnyis kyis sbu re tha ne (226 8600lo1/147)ru zhi chings bzhag ste/ e sde war sde sku rabs gsum pas hpha ran si'i gong ma rgyal po'i go sa thob par re ba mi 'chang ba dang / hpha ran sis kha le si ((mtha1 3 me'ilkoṣṭha)gru kha dang sku'i ne/(651 ba 0 66) sga si kho ne (6༵༵006ba mebazos7)sogs dbyin ji'i mnga' khongs su sprod dgos thag

rabs drug pa (2681163 5 44)yis gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byas/(1380— 1422lo'i bar go sa bzung) yin na'ang rjes su de la smyo nad byung bas/ don dngos su rgyal khab bdag skyong bya mi thub pa red/ de bas na nang du gling los byung ste dbang sgyur gral rim pa tshos dbang cha 'phrog rtsod bya slad nākā 'khrug brgyab pas grong khyer dang zhing sde'i mi dmangs la gnod 'tshe chen bsnang/ 'khrug de las phyi gnod kyang nang du drangs/ dbyin ji'i gong ma nyen re sku rabs lnga pas (50121105 5 4lko/)slar yang dmag 'khrug gi 'go bslangs/ 1415lo'i zla 8par dmag dpung drug khri lhag khrid de/ nor man sde ru skam sar slebs pa ma zad da dung hpha ran si'i gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin bya rgyu yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas pas/ lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi dus rim gsum pa'i 'go tshugs/ phyogs gnyis kyi dpung chen pos a dzin khur the (421ba005nga ma sgo7)ru gting thag gcod pa'i g.yul chen po bshams shing / hpha ran si'i skya mi'i dmag dpung ni dbyin ji'i dmag gis khyon yongs nas rdul du brlag dbyin ji'i dmag gis rgyal kha dang bstun nas mu mthud du 'ded rdung byas te hpha ran si'i nub byang sa khul blangs pa ma zad/ lho phyogs sa khul yang leb phyags byas pas/ hpha ran si'i gong ma ten re sku rabs drug pas 'dum 'grig yong re mi zhu ka med byung / 1420lor phyogs gnyis gas(thi ro ye si chings yig〉(110763 tshe 7〉81)bris/ chings yig de rgyal kha can gyi dbyin jir yongs nas phan khe chen po yod pa smos med red/ lhan re la hpha ran si'i yul khongs chen po thob pa ma zad/ hpha ran si'i gong ma char le si sku rabs drug pa shi phyin/ nyen re yis hpha ran si'i gong ma'i go sa 'dzin chog pa dang char le si'i bu mo kha the len btsun mor len rgyu sogs bkā snrod byas 'dug yin na'ang / 1422lor dbyin ji'i gong ma ten re sku

rabs lnga ba dang hpha ran si'i gong ma char le si sku rabs drug pa gnyis snga gzhug tu tshe las 'das/ nyen re sku rabs lnga ba'i sras lo 'khor gcig kyang ma lon pa'i ten re sku rabs drug pa ni dbyin ji dang hpha ran si rgyal khab gnyis kyi gong ma rgyal po yin par bsgrags kyang / char le si sku rabs drug pa'i bu char le si yis hpha ran si'i gong ma'i go sa de ltar shor bar sems gting nas ma bzod pas ro yo le gtsang bo'i lho rgyud kyi zheng dog cing sna ring ba'i sa khul chung chung du phyin nas gong ma rgyal po'i dbang cha bkol spyod byas/1428lor lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi dus rim bzhi ba'i 'go bcoms/dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis stobs ci yod dang rtsal ci yod kyis tshur rgol byas te/ hpha ran si'i lho phyogs su brkyangs pa'i btsan rdzong or len si (07128bcu po4)bskor pas hpha ran si 'thor zhig tu 'gro bar nye ba'i mtshams su bcar/ skabs der hpha ran si'i rgya che ba'i mi dmangs yar langs byas pas/ dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo la 'gyur ldog byung pas da ni dmag 'khrug de rgyal khab gnyis kyi gong ma tshang gis dbang cha rtsod pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rnyog dra'i dmag 'khrug ma yin par/ hpha ran si'i phyogs su mtshon na/dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug cig yin la/ dbyin ji'i phyogs su mtshon na drang bden min pa'i btsan 'dzul gyi dmag 'khrug cig yin no// hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis rang btsan srung skyob byed pa'i ched du 'thab 'dzing byas pa dang / zhing pa dang grong khyer gyi dbul po rnams kyis 'jab rgol ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te gang sa gang du dgra bor rdung deg byas/ bud med dpa' bo 'jon ar khe (/dzithab 0 6 470 77)ni kho tsho'i gtso 'dzin du gyur/ dus yun ring po'i nang dka' spyad 'thab rtsod byas mthar/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis bstud mar rgyal kha blangs te/dbyin jis bzung ba'i yul khongs thams cad rim bzhin tshur blangs ༵ byed/

dpung phyir bskrad kyang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho gnas ni skyo thag chod pa'i sdug mtsho'i nang du lhung ba dang / rgyal kha'i 'bras bu longs su spyod mkhan ni hpha ran si'i gong ma rgyal po dang rim pa so so'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho yin pas gong ma rgyal po'i dbang cha sra brtan la btang / hpha ran si ru tshad ldan rkang dmag dang rgyun grabs rta dmag btsugs pa des sgrig lam lhod cing 'thab stobs zhan pa'i skya mi'i dmag dpung gi tshab byas/ gsar du btsugs pa'i dmag dpung gis dus gang rung du bkod gtong la bsgugs te/grong khyer dang zhing sde'i mi dmangs kyi ngo rgol la drag gnon byed/ dus rabs 15'i dus smad du/ hpha ran si'i yul khams yongs gong ma'i dbang 'og tu bsdus stabs/ sngar gyi sil bur 'thor te mnga' bdag gis bcad bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul de rtsa ba nas med par btang zhing / hpha ran si'i dpal 'byor yang rim bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel du song ngo golo brgya'i dmag 'khrug de dbyin ji pham pa dang mjug bsgril/ dmag 'khrug skabs su/ dbyin ji'i gong mas dbyin hpha dmag 'khrug de yun ring du rgyun bsrings bya phyir/ mu mthun du dpya khral dang 'u lag je lci la btang bas/mi dmangs kyi ma 'dod pa'i bsam tshul mngon du thon pa ma zad/ cung tsam phyug po yin pa'i rim pa la'ang 'khang sems chen po skyes pa red/ de'i phyir lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug ma rdzogs gong zhing pa'i 'os langs mang po byung / dmag 'khrug gi mjug bsgril ma thag/ dbyin ji dbang bsgyur tshogs khag nang gi khyim rgyud chen po gnyis te yor khe (1016 77)khyim rgyud dang lan kha si ther si (2kṣas083 673 210lo/rtse)khyim rgyud kyis gong ma'i dbang cha rtsod pa'i 'go brtsams shing / 6 rgya se dkar dmar gyi dmag 'khrug ’ tu 'bod pa'i dmag 'khrug lo ngo 30lhag ring brgyab/( 1453 — 1485lo'i bar) mthar mjug lan kha si ther si khyim rgyud kyis rgyal kha blangs/ snyisna de
/sa shugs je zhan du song zhing sku drag ) tshogs kyi chab srid nus shugs nyin re skong ma'i dbang cha yang je brtan du song

66mor len si'i zhu mo ri 'donathor khe/hpha ran si'i byang khul gyi rem si (221 7bya ༅77)grong khyer du chos khang chen mo zhig yod cing de ni rgyal rabs so so'i gong ma rgyal po khri la bkod pa'i mdzad sgo tshogs gnas yin/ chos khang chen mo'i mdun du rta la zhon zhing lag tu ral khri thogs pa'i dpa' nyams grung 'khyug gi bud med dpa' mo'i sku 'dra zhig yod/ de ni le'u gong mar gleng myangs pa'i lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi dus mjug tu byung ba'i rgyal gces dpa' mo 'jon ar khe zhes pa red/'di ru skabs de'i gnas tshul rags tsam brjod rgyu yin te/1380lor hpha ran si'i gong ma char le si sku rabs lnga ba tshe las 'das rjes/gong ma'i go sa rgyud du bzung pa'i char le si sku rabs drug par smyo nad yod stabs don dngos su rgyal khab skyong mi thub par gyur/ de dus dbang sgyur gral rim gyi nang khul ni/ rgyal po'i gcung po khor len si gung cu'e tshogs khag dang we ro wa khyim rgyud kyi tha chung rgyud de sbyar sgun sde gung cu'e tshogs khag gnyis su gyes yod/ phyogs gnyis kyis dbang cha rtsod pa'i phyir phan tshun dmag 'khrug brgyab/ dbyin ji'i gong ma dang sbur sgun sde gung cu'i yi tshogs khag ngan 'brel byas nas/ dmag gi dpung chen po khrid de hpha ran si la btsan 'dzul byas/ 1415lor a dzin khur the'i dmag 'khrug nang hpha ran si pham te mi 8000tsam ming gi lhag mar gyur/ nang rtsod phyi 'khrug gi gnas tshul 'ogagi 1420lor hpha ran si'i rgyal po'i btsun mo i sa pho yis btsan dbang sgos char le si sku rabs drug par/ sras mo dbyin ji'i gong ma lhan re sku rabs drug par mna' mar ster bar khas len du bcug pa ma zad/ rdo/ re

ni hpha ran si'i song ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed mkhan yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas la/ char le si sku rabs drug pa'i bu ste rgyal sras char le si'i gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha 'phrog len byas thog da dung kho rang hpha ran si'i lho khul du phyir skyod btang / 1422lor/ ten re sku rabs lnga ba dang char le si sku rabs drug pa gnyis snga gzhug tu tshe las 'das la/ 'o gcig kha 'khor yang 'dang med pa'i ten re sku rabs drug pa dbyin hpha gnyis kyi gong ma rgyal po'i khri la bkod cing / kho'i 'thus tshab pa ste sbe thi hpho gung cu'e yis hpha ran si'i byang khul dbang bsgyur byas pa dang / rgyal sra sa char le si yis (rjes kyi char le si sku rabs bdun pa ste dus 'dir da dung gong ma'i khri ru bkod med) don dngos su hpha ran si'i lho khul sa cha la dbang bsgyur byas 'dug 1428lor dbyin ji'i dpung chen po lho phyogs su drangs nas lho phyogs kyi btsan mkhar or len si blangs/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis rgyal khab la btsan 'dzul thebs pas gzhan gyis btsan ('dzin dang brnyas bcos byas pa'i rdzo sgyungaganas bab 'dir sems 'phral chen po byed kyi 'dug 'jon ar khe/hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyi rgyal gces sems shugs rab tu rgyas pas/rgya che ba'i zhing pa dang grong mi/ rim dman chos bshad mkhan tsho rang 'gul sgokā spya 'dzugs byas nas/ mes rgyal srung skyob byed pa'i drang bden gyi 'thab

rtsod nang zhugs/ dbyin jis bzung ba'i sa khul du/ kho tshos 'jab rgol ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ gzhan gyis rdog brdzis thebs pa'i rang yul gyi yul khongs so sor dgra bo la rdung deg byas/ gzhung drang gshis bzang gi zhing pa tshor/ rang gi sems khongs kyi gnam lha'i dgongs pa'i 'thus tshab ste char le si ni hpha rin si'i gong ma dngos su gyur te kho rang tsho'i 'go khrid nas nyen khe'i gnas su lhung ba'i mes rgyal skyob pa'i re ba skye bzhin 'dug1429lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 8nyin/ ming la 'jon ar khe (3082 01meng0)ru 'bod pa'i zhing sde'i bu mo he non grong du phyin nas rgyal sras char le si dang mjal te rgyal khab skyob pa'i jus chen bton/'jon ar khe ni 1412lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 6nyin hpha ran si'i byang khul mtha' mtshams kyi sdom re smi (7707075 7sto /lko)zhes pa'i grong sde'i gnam bdag chos lugs la dad pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu 'khrungs// kho mo byis pa'i dus lug khyu'i rjes ded nas lug dzi'i 'tsho ba rol/ kho mo'i pha yul la dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul pa dang sbur sgun sde sku drag tsho'i dmag dpung gi brnyas bcos thengs du ma thebs pas/ sa zhing spang rgod du gyur la zhing pa mang po yul 'khyar du song / gzhon nu ma 'jon ar khe yis btsan 'dzul pa tshos bran du bkol ba'i sdug bsngal tshad med myangs/ kho mos rna bar mi rnams kyis hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis dbyin 'gog 'thab rtsod nang byung ba'i dpa' bo'i byas rjes kyi gtam rgyud mang po thos myangs/ rgyal gces kyi sems pa drag tu skyes pa dang chos lugs kyi g.yo med dad sems des/ kho mos dbyin jir 'gog rgol byed pa'i bla na med pa'i 'gan 'khri 'di dang du len par skul lcag btab cing / kho mo rang nyid la'ang mi dmangs kyi 'go khrid de/sdug bsngal dang god chags byung ba'i mes rgyal de dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i lag nas skyob par yid ches yod pas/ rgyal sras mjal bar phyin nas ༵༵ga

'khrug tu zhugs rgyu'i re ba zhus/ 'jon ar khe'i spro sems dang spobs par mi rnams kyi gzengs bstod dang rgyab skyor thob/ yul mi tsho dang nye 'khor gyi grong mi chos kyang kho mo'i 'gan 'khri legs grub bya ched kho mor mtshon cha dang dmag rta gra sgrig byas/ dang ma'i lug rdzi bu mo de da ni mi rnams kyis gus bkur byed pa'i 'thab mo ba zhig tu gyur/'jon ar khe yis he non mkhar du rgyal sras dang mjal nas/ rang nyid ni lha chen po'i pho nya yin te/ dbyin ji bkag nas mes rgyal skyob pa'i bla med 'gan 'khri yod zer zhing / rgyal sras char le si la/ 4 bdag gis khyed la zhu rgyu ni/ lha chen pos thugs rje'i phyag skyor 'og khyed rang ni hpha ran si'i gong ma'i rgyud 'dzin pa ngo ma red mi ces dang / da dung blo brtan 'gyur med sgos 6 bdag la dmag dpung gnang dang / bdag 'phral mar or len si skyob du 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad/ char le sis bsam blo yang yang btang rjes mjug mthar kho mo'i re bar yid 'thad byung bas/ kho mor ral gri gcig gnang nas or len skyob pa'i dmag don bkod 'doms par bsko bzhag byas/ 1429lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 27zhin/ mi rnams kyi dga' spro'i 'bod sgra'i khrod mtshon thogs 'thab mo ba chig khri lhag gis bstod mgur gtong zhor or len si'i phyogs su bskyod/ 'jon ar khe yis lag tu ral gri bzung zhing lus la go cha gyon te rta pho dkar dkar zhig la zhon nas dpung sde'i mdun ma byas shing /mi rnams kho mo'i rjes su 'brangs nas rgyal kha'i dpung skyod la zhugs so//'jon ar khes pho nya mngags nas/ dbyin ji'i gong ma dang sbe thi hphu gung cu'e la 'phrin yig cig bskur te/ blo brtan 'gyur med sgos btsan 'dzul pa tshor tha tshig bsgrags par/ dzikho mo zhi ba'i gros mol bya bar rbad de yid 'thad yod khyod tshor (dbyin ji'i1 ༵༵kho mo'i yid tshims pa zhig bya bar 'thad pa yod na/ hpha ran si phyir sprod dgos

la btsan bzung byas pa'i chag sgor skyin tshab mjal dgos/ khyod tsho'i mda' ba dang dmag don mi sna/ sku drag yor len si'i g.yul sar zhugs pa'i mi gzhan pa tsho rang gi rgyal khab nang phyir 'then bya dgos/ gal srid de lta ma byas na/ nga gzhon nu ma'i skad la sgags dang / khyod tshor 'phral mar thob rgyu ni chag sgo chen po red/ gal te dbyin ji'i gong ma rgyal po khyod kyis de lta ma byas na/ dmag 'khrug gi kha lo bdag gis 'dzin rgyu yin la/ khyod kyi mnga' zhabs tsho sa cha gang du thon rung / bdag gis de dag zil gyis mnan te rang 'gul dang yang na btsan shugs kyis dpa' zhum gom bshol gyi gnas su skyel nges yin/ gal te kho tshos dang len ma byas na/ bdag gis kho tsho tshang ma tshar gcod bya rgyu yin zhes bris yod/dbyin ji'i gong mas cis kyang de la kha ya ma byas/ nyin shas 'gor rjes 'jon ar khe yis dmag dpung khrid nas khor len si'i g.yul sar slebs/skabs der or len si mkhar gyi grong mi tshos khrag bton dmar 'dzing gi grong khyer srung ba'i 'thab 'dzing byed bzhin yod/ 'jon ar khe yis myul zhib pa mngags nas dbyin ji'i dmag gis o len si bskor ba'i dmag dpung gi shugs zhan sa gar yod zhib tu shes rjes/ stobs shugs gcig tu bsdus nas de la drag rgol byas rjes dgra bo'i bskor rgya gtor ba red/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis pha rol po ma khog par pham ste phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung /zla 4pa'i tshes 29nyin gyi mtshan mor/ 'jon ar khe yis dmag dpung khrid de or len si'i mkhar grong nang slobs pa dang / de ga'i mi dmangs kyis me lce lhab lhab tu 'bar pa'i dpal 'bar lag tu bzung nas dpa' mo de dang de'i khrid pa'i dmag dpung la dga' bsu byas shing / mi rnams kyis lhag bsam rnam dag sgos kho mor 2 or len si'i bu mo mi zhes 'bod do//or len si dmag 'khrug ni hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis dbyin 'gog 'thab rtsod la thob pa'i rgyal kha'i 'go rtsom sa red/ rgya che ba'i mi dma~X la

skul 'ded chen po thebs pas/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'jon ar khe'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'thab 'dzing gsar par zhugs te/ dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag dpung phyir gtsang skyod rgyag rgyu'i re ba zhus/ 'jon ar khe yis rgyal kha thob mur mu mthud du dgra bor phar rgol byas shing / rang la rmas phog kyang g.yul ngo nas phyir 'khor ma byas par dgra bor rdung rdeg btang / zla 5pa'i zla stod kyi nyin 'ga'i dus thung nang or len si'i mtha' 'khor gyi shul lhag dgra bo thams cad tshar gcod byas pa dang / de dus 'jon ar khe'i dmag dpung myur du mi sum khri lhag tu 'phel yod/'jon ar khe'i sems su/ 'phro ma'i don chen ni rgyal sras char le si gong ma'i khri la bton nas de rang hpha ran si'i gong ma dngos su gyur nas hpha ran si gcig gyur yong bar skul 'ded bya rgyu de red snyam/ rem si (2617byaphramo)chos khang chen mo ru hpha dan si'i rgyal po khri la 'don pa'i mdzad sgo tshogs ched/ nges par du de ru yod pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag dpung nas grong khyer phyir len dgos pa red/ 'jon ar khe yis char le si la smyo bdag gi rjes su shog dang / rem si ru khyod la 'tsham pa'i gong ma'i cod pan len du shog dang ’ zhes skul ma btab/ 1429lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 27nyin nas bzung / hpha ran si'i dmag dpung gis shugs chen po'i sgo nas phar rgol byas te/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud du the ro ye si (110763 667)chalon ((6100 7/ 2)grong khyer gnyis phab nas blangs/ zla 7pa'i tshes 16nyin la slebs tshe da gzod rem si ru yod pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag dpung phyir gtsang bskrad brgyab te/grong khyer gyi sgo chen rgyal sras char le si la phye ba red/zla 7pa'i tshes 17nyin char le si gong ma'i khri la 'don pa'i mdzad sgo ni rem si'i chos khang chen po'i nang du gzab rgyas ngang tshogs shing / rgyal sras cha/ /2 si ni hpha ran si'i gong ma char le si sku rabs bdun par gyur/ tshogs

'du'i steng 'jon ar khe yis lag tu dar cha bzung nas rgyal po'i logs su langs zlo// ar khe'i mtshan snyan rgyal yongs su grags shing / rgyu mtshan ni kho mos mi dmangs la skul slong dang mi dmangs rtsa 'dzugs byas nas dbyin 'gog gi rlabs rgyun drag po'i nang zhugs su bcug pa'i rkyen gyis red/ de'i phyir kho mo hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyi sems khongs kyi rgyal kha'i dar cha ru gyur/de bas na hpha ran si'i sku drag tsho dang dmag dpon tshos ma bzod pa ma zad da dung kho tshor zhed snang dang som nyi yang skye bzhin yod/ kho pa tsho 'jon ar khe yis bslangs pa'i rgyal gces kyi spro sems chen po de la skrag snang skyes pas/kho sbya kher rkyang du phud pa'am tha na lkog tu dgra bor sprod rgyu'i g.yo jus 'then pa da1/430lo'i zla 5pa'i zla smad du/ 'jon ar khe yis khrid pa'i dmag dpung gis khom phi ne (60791 06bca 'a 7) grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su/dbyin ji'i dmag dpung dang spur sgun sde'i sku drag gi dmag dpung gnyis la dmag 'khrug brgyab/ dmag dpung phyir 'then nas phyir grong khyer nang slobs nas mkhar sgor thon pa tsam la/ mkhar sgo'i dpyang zam glo bur du yar bkyag ste mkhar sgo brgyab/ 'jon ar khe ni phyir mkhar grong nang 'dzul ma thub pa dang / rgyu mtshan ni hpha ran si'i sku drag tshos kho mo dgra bor g.yo 'tshong byas pas red/ da ni phyir bgrod pa'i lam bu med pas/ shi gson thag gcod kyi dmag 'thab mi byed ka med byung / yin na'ang nyung bas mang ba ma thupa par kho spya spur sgun sde'i sku drag gi dmag dpung gi lag tu shor nas 'a na dro/rno asdo kṣiṃ /zla 6la khrims mun du bcug rjes/ hpha ran si'i sbur sgun sde'i sku drag chos hpha ran si'i sgor mo khri bzhi'i rin gong du/ mi dmangasdu spyas

gces bkur byed pa'i bu mo de dbyin ji pa la btsong / 1430lo'i zla 12par/kho mo lu ang du brdzangs skyel byas/ dbyin ji'i mis chos lugs kyi khrims ra zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas nas 'jon ar khe la 'dri gcod byas cing / kho mor 46log lta ba midang 4 lha ma yi'i nag nyes yod ces nyes med nyes 'gel byas nas mngon sum 'dzem med du srog khrims bcad/ 1431lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes30nyin 'jor ar khe yis lu yang gi thang chen du me lce'i nang du dpa' ngar zhum med sgos rang srog btang zhing de dus kho mo lo na bcu dgu ma gtogs lon med/ kho mo 'chi khar da dung dpa' bar sgos 6 bdag ji srid bar du rang gi las don ni drang bden gyi don zhig yin par yid ches yod ’ ces zer/'jon ar khe ni dgra bos bkrongs kyang / kho mo'i las don la bar chad ma byung bar/ kho mo'i rgyal gces ring lugs kyi rang srog 'bul ba'i snying stobs kyis/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs mthun sgril byas nas/ mu mthud du dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa dang 'thab rtsod byed par skul 'ded byed kyin 'dug pas/ 1436lor pha ri si phyir blangs pa red/ 1453lor slebs pa dang lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug de ni hpha ran si'i mi dmangs la rgyal kha thob pa mnyam du mjug bsgril pa red/'jon ar khe ni hpha ran si'i lo rgyus stong gi rgyal gces ring lugs kyi dar cha dang po red/ 1456lor hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis re ba nan zhu byas 'og ro ma gyi chos kyi gong mas mchog mchan gnang ba brgyud/ 1431lor dbyin ji'i chos lugs khrims ra'i dpyad mtshams phyir 'then byas pas/'jon ar khe la dkar dag thob pa dang / dngos su hpha ran si'i mi rigs dpa' bo yin pa khas len byas so//104

wa the' ler gyi 'osagangs/1380lor dbyin ji pham pas lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug kyi dus rim gnyis pa'i mtshams bzhag phyi lor dbyin ji'i rgyal nang du rlabs che ba'i zhing ba'i 'os langs chen po ste wa the thi ler (ya 17161 76 67)gyi 'os langs glo bur byung ngo //thengs 'di'i 'os langs ni dbyin ji'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang chab srid 'phel rgyas byung ba'i thon dngos shig red/dus rabs 14par dbyin ji'i zhing bran lam lugs nyams rgud du 'gyur 'go tshugs pa dang / tshong las dngul lor 'brel ba gong 'phel byung zhing / dngul lor sa bogs zhing sde ru rgyugs che la/ skya mi'i mnga' zhabs sa cha ru gnas bab yag po zin/ des zhing pa gral rim kha gyes su 'gro tshad je mgyogs su btang bas/ zhing pa nyung shas phyug por gyur pa dang mang che ba sa zhing med pa'i zhing bar gyur pas/ kho tsho sa bdag tshang du las ka 'tshol du mi 'gro ga med byung stabs dbul zhing phongs pa'i zhing pa gla ba ru gyur/ yin na'ang / dbyin ji'i shar lho khul gyi mnga' sde so sor zhing bran mang po yod pa'i sku drag dang chos tshogs kyi mnga' zhabs sa zhing steng / sa bogs las khral lag bstar byed bzhin yod pa ma zad/ tha na shugs je cher 'gro ba'i gnas tshul yang mngon par 'dug pas/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas la sngon 'gog tshabs chen byas yod/ lo rim lo rgyus su/ rgya che ba'i zhing bran ni 6 las khral lci mo mi 'khur dbang med kyi gnas su gyur mi pa dang / 6 duspya /gro

bzhin du btsir gnon thebs/ 6 kho tshos da ni bzod thabs med par gyur/’ gnya'aganon thebs pa'i zhing bran tsho'i sems su/ rang nyid ni tsa lha yi pho nya min la gdon 'dre yang min par/ mnga' bdag tsho dang mtshungs pa'i mi yin zhes dang / 2 gal te mnga' bdag tshos kho tshor bzo byed pa'am las ka gzhan bsgrub tu bcug tshe/ kho tshos kyang mi gzhan pa dang 'dra bar phogs len dgos misnyam zhes bkod yod/ gong dag las sa bogs las khral gyi bshu gzhog la ngo rgol byas pa mthong thub la/ de ni zhing bran tsho'i sems khongs kyi re skad drag po red/1348lor byi dug gi yams nad yo rob skam sa chen po nas dbyin ji ru 'gos/ 1349lor slobs tshe gling phran yongs su khyab pas/ zhing sde dang grong khyer gyi 'og rim mi dmangs la sdug bsngal chen po bzos/ byi nad byung tshar rjes/ dbyin ji'i mi 'bor gyi phyed ka phal cher shi tshar rkyen ngal rtsol pa shin tu dkon pas/ gla ba'i phogs kyang de dang mnyam du je mthor song / 'on kyang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos gang thub ci thub sgos sa bogs las khral je phyir btang la/ tha na dngul lor sa bogs kyang sa bogs las khral du bsgyur nas log tu bskyod de/ zhing pa'i dpya khral je lcir btang /de bas zhing pa'i 'tsho ba ni sngar las lhag tu je sdug tu song ngo //grong khyer dang zhing sde'i ngal rtsol pa ha cang dkon pa'i gnas tshul 'og1349lor dbyin ji'i gong ma e sde war sde sku rabs gsum pas/ 〈ngal rtsol bzo ba'i khrims 'dzugs〉zhes pa khyab bsgrags byas pa dang de'i nang / lo na 12nas 60bar gyi pho mo dar ma tshor rang la sa zhing dang 'tsho rten gzhan med tshe/ nges par du las ka zhig 'tshol dgos kyang / zla phogs kyi tshad thig ni byi na/ /6 khyab gong dang gcig yin/ de lta ma byas na btson khang du 'jug rgyu

yin/ zla phogs mthon po ster bar gros mol byed mkhan gyi gla paṃ dang gla bdag la dngul gyi chad pa gcod rgyu yin zhes gtan 'khel byas yod/1351lor rgyal po des slar yang bka' khrims bkram nas/ gla pa gla ba'i khrims lugs la gtor brlag gtong ba'i bzo ba la lcag sgrog bskon nas btson la 'jug rgyu gtan 'khel byas yod/ lo bcu 'gor rjes kyi 1361lor khyab bsgrags byas pa'i bka' khrims nang da dung / gla bdag las bral pa'i gla pa la khrims lugs kyis srung skyob bya mi chog pa ma zad/ lcags ngar mas lus phung steng bsregs rtags rgyag rgyu yin zhes gtan 'khel byas yod/ gla pa'i khrims 'dzugs lag bstar byas pa des/ rgya che ba'i zhing pa tsho 'dzad ma tha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang dor bas/ zhing ba tshos mna' 'brel tshugs nas ngo rgol byas pa red/grong khyer nang mtshon na grong mi mang che ba ni las rogs bzo ba dang dus tshigs bzo ba red/ ngal rtsol bzo ba'i khrims des kho tshor gnod pa chen po bzos/ dbyin ji'i gong ma e sde war sde sku rabs gsum pa'i ngal rtsol bzo ba'i khrims 'dzugs zhes pas/ gla pa'i ches mtho'i gla phogs gtan 'khel byas yod kyang / gla phogs ches dma' ba'i tshad thig gtan 'khel byas med/de bas na/ de'i dmigs yul che ngal rtsol pa la bshu gzhog byed pa'i ched red/’ gla pa dang las rogs bzo ba chos/ gla phogs mtho ru 'degs pa dang lag shes bzo las kyi thon rdzas kyi rin gong je mthor btang nas/ ches dma' tshad kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad rgyun 'khyongs bya ched/ mna' tshogs rtsa 'dzugs byas nas las mtshams 'jog pa sogs kyi thabs kyis 'thab rtsod byas/ dus yun ring po'i ring gi lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gis dbyin ji'i gral rim 'gal ba je drag tu btang / dbyin ji'i gong mas dmag 'khrug gi dus rim gnyis pa'i nang pham kha myangs pa'i dka' gnas las thar phyir/ 1377lo nas sdusang /

shugs gang yod bton nas zhing grong gi ngal rtsol mi dmangs la bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon bya 'go tshugs la dus mtshungs su grong khyer gyi mi dmangs la'ang khur po shin tu lci mo kha snon brgyab pa red/spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba nyin re las nyin rer dza drag can du gyur pa'i gnas tshul 'og dus rabs 14pa'i dus smad du/ dbyin ji'i rgyal khab nang khul du chos lugs bcos bsgyur gyi bya 'gul rgya chen po langs/ don des ma 'ongs par 'byung ba'i zhing pa'i 'os langs la thad ku'i shugs rkyen bzhag yod/ dus yun ring po'i ring / chos rgyal gong mas dbyin ji'i chos tshogs la bkog sdom nan po byed pa ma zad/ da dung dbyin ji las dpya khral ji snyed bsdu/ dbyin ji'i chos tshogs kyis sa zhing mang po bzung yod pas/ kho tsho ni ham 'dod tshims med kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag red/ rgya che ba'i zhing pa tsho ma zad/ skya mi dang grong mi tshos yang chos gong mar mjal bya'i dpya khral je nyung du gtong dgos pa dang / dbyin ji'i chos tshogs kyi lag nas sa zhing phyir len dgos pa'i re ba drag po bton/ thog mar chos tshogs bsgyur bcos byed pa'i bsam 'char 'don mkhan ni/ o khe si hpho sde slob grwa chen pa'i dgere rgan chen mo 'jon we khe le hphu (/0 0 0611160 tshogis tshamasdi shākyi zlo/ dasgos/ pa zhig la/ skabs de'i dbyin ji'i chos tshogs kyi ches 'og rim gyi chos pa tsho'i sprang po dang khyad par med pa'i dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/ kho chos mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal gsal po shes pa'i stong gdung sems kyang mnyam skye bya bzhin yod cing / chos tshogs kyi gong rim pa tshor sdang sems kyi bsam pa 'dzin gyi 'dug de'i phyir cung tsam drag skyod kyi 6 chos pa dbul po'i mi phyogs khag (lo lar sde(200816 ༅ṣṭha /phyogs kha/ /cir ba'o)gi dril bsgrags bya 'gul zhes pa byung / 'og rim gyi chos pa

mi dmangs kyi khrod du dril bsgrags byas nas/ spyi tshogs kyi gtan nas 'dra mnyam med pa'i snang tshul ther 'don byas te/ mi rnams la go rtogs sad du 'jug //sna zlozlo /yis gsungs par/dzing tshos nyes pa ci zhig bsags song / mnga' bdag gi ched du ngal las byed don ci yin/ nga tsho thams cad mes po gcig ste ma sdem (1664 ༅zo)dang hwa wa (༅ ma nu'i ṭha)gnyis kyi phyi rabs pa red/ kho tshos nged cag g.yog tu spyad de kho tsho'i tshab tu las ka las su bcug nas gla phogs nyung ngu zhig ster ba las/ kho tsho phyogs gang zhig nas nged cag las mchog par mngon/ kho tsho'i rgyab tu gos chen mtha' ru rnga khul gyis brgyan pa'i gyi lu gyon zhing / nged cag gis ras rtsub thed pos lus phung g.yog dgosadon ci yin/ kho tshor chang zhim spus bzang steng spus legs bag leb yod kyang /nged cag la phub ma dang rtswa rul dang chu dngas las med don ci yin/ kho tsho rgyas sbos kyi thog khang chen mo'i nang sdod kyang / nged cag srang lam dang zhing khar nyal dgos don ci yin/ nged cag gis lo gang bor spang thang du ngal las byas kyang / ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu kho tshos khyer 'gro don ci yinanga'ajon sbru'o yis mi tshang mar 66rang gi thar lam rang gis 'tshol dgos ’ zhes dang / 6 thams cad spyi la dbang ba dang / zhing bran zer ba med cing mi drag zer ba yang med ’ pa'i bsam blo mngon du 'gyur bar skul brda btang /khongagis dril bsgrags byas par mi rnams la rgya khyab tu yid mthun byung bas/khong la mi rnams kyi dga' bsu gus bkur thob/ gna' rabs lo rim lo rgyus nang / zhe don ngan bsgrub sems can gyi mi ('os langs pa bstan pa)tshang mas kho'i skad cha thams cad bden don du brtsis zhes bkod/ sbru'o yis skad cha la lung du sgrog spel byas pa dang / kho tshos gsang ba'i ngang bya 'gul spel ba ma zad/ tha na mnga' sde so sor mi mngags nas 'brel gtus byed kyin 'dug11spyang pa'i 'os langs byung ba'i thad ku'i rgyu rkyen ni mi khral mjal bar ngo

rgol byas pa de red/ 1377lor char le si sku rabs gnyis pa gong ma'i stegs bur thon pa dang / mu mthud du lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug rgyag par dmag gron bsdu ba'i phyir/ mi khral bsdu rgyu'i bka' bsgrags te/ lo na 14yan gyi pho mo su yin yang dbul phyug la ma ltos par phe ne (26ba sna lnga ༅)0bzhi'i mi khral sprod dgos pa thag gcod byas/ 1379lor yang thengs gcig bsdus shing /1380lor yang thengs gsum pa'i mi khral bsdus pa ma zad khral gyi dngul grangs sngar las ldab gsum la 'phar bas/ rgya che ba'i zhing pa tsho ni shi nyen gyi gnas su sdug bsngal tshad med myong bzhin 'dug la/ 'tsho gnas 'phral mar je sdug tu song stabs mthar thug 'os langs byas pa red/1381lo'i zla 5bar/ thog mar shar lho'i khul gyi e si khe si (23327tshi ༅7)dang khen the (50ba 66)mnga' sde gnyis kyi zhing bas drag pos 'os langs byas te gyen log gi me phung bsgron pa mgyogs myur du rgyal yongs su mched/'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin ni zhing sde'i ar las bzo ba wa the thi ler zhes pa yin pas thengs de'i 'os langs la wa the thi ler gyi 'os (langs zhes 'bod/ 'os langs kyi dpung chen po lon tun phyogs su bskyod/ kho tshos wa the thi ler/khral bsdu mkhan bsad pa dang gzhis ka gtor/ 'bru rigs dang phyugs zog blangs shing grangs tho dang gan 'dzin me la bsregs/ zla 6pa'i tshes 10nyin/'os langs dmag gis khen the mnga' sde'i chab srid kyi lta gnas khan ther sbu ri rjo dbyin ji'i sgor po ༷577jigacigaji ba skyabargyayin sgyur papos/ 111
