((thab 016577 775tshe )zhes pa'i grong khyer blangs te/ san tho ma si'i (58100 160183 7667)chos khang du chos bdag chen po su'u sde sbe le zhes pa lag tu ma tshud mod/ kho pa rgyal 'tshong nang rul pa zhig yin pas nges par du srog khrims 'bab pa khyab bsgrags byas/ khan ther spu ri'i mi ser tshos dga' spro tshad med ngang 'os langs dmag la dga' bsu dang brtsi bkur byas/wa the thi ler gyis phyogs so sor mi mngags nas 'brel gtug byas nas/mnga' sde so so'i 'os langs pa tsho lon tun phyogs su bskyod de lon tun bskor nas rgol rgyu kha chad bzhag wa the thi ler gyi dmag dpung da dung lon tun dang dbyin le bzhi tsam las med pa'i sar dmag sgar btab pa'i skabs su/lon tun grong khyer gyi 'go gtso ne kho la wol wo si la 'jigs skrag tshad med skyes pas/ myur du mkhar sgo rgyag dgos pa dang lam sne so so 'gog srung byed dgos pa'i bka' bab/ yin na'ang rgya che ba'i lon tun gyi grong mi tshos 'os langs dmag la re sgug byas 'dug 'os langs dmag gis mkhar grong gi phyi rol nas rma sa shi'o btson khang sogs phab nas de'i nang btson du bcug pa'i mi rnams lhod dkrol btang / zla 6pa'i tshes 12nyin/ lon tun gyi grong mis mkhar sgo phye nas 'os langs dmag nang du bsus pa ma zad/ da dung 6 chang dang sha yis kho tshor sne len byas/ wa the thi ler gyis dmag mi nyis khri khrid de lon tun du khrom skor byas nas 'os langs dmag gi dpa' stobs ngoms/dbyin ji'i gong ma char le si sku rabs gnyis pa lon kun mchod rten zhes pa'i mkhar rdzong nang bskungs/ mtshan mo der lon tun grong khyer gyi 'go gtso dang sku drag gros khang 'thus mi tshos lkog tu mi 8000lhag gi drag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ 'os langs pa tsho gnyid du yur pa'i dus dang bstun nas 'jab rgol bya rgyu thag bcad mod/ rjes su lag 'gul rog ma chod de rgyu mardo/ spya 'os langs dmag la mi khri phrag du ma'i stobs shugs yod pas kho pa

tsho spa bkong bas red/ phyi nyin/ 'os langs pa tshos khrims med lugs med kyi las la spro ba'i khrims dpon skor zhig bzung nas srog khrims bcad/de nas dbyin ji'i gong ma 'os langs pa dang gros mol byed rgyur yid mthun byung / zla 6pa'i tshes 14nyin gyi snga dror/ dbyin ji'i gong ma smel en thang chen du 'os langs pa khri phrag du ma'i mdun du 'ongs/ kho pas ma yin yinakhul sgos 6 kye gshis bzang rnams pa tsho/ kho bo ni khyod tsho'i rje bo yin/khyod tshor mkho ba ci zhig yod/ khyod tshor 'chad 'dod ci zhig yod mi zer skabs/ wa the thi ler gyis 'os langs pa'i tshab tu dbyin ji'i gong ma la drang bden gyi re ba 'ga' bton zhing / gtso bo ni zhing bran lam lugs med par bzos nas/ zhing bran yongs la rang dbang ster dgos pa dang / 'os langs pa tsho btson 'grol chen po gtong dgos pa/ 'os langs ni khrims dang mthun pa/ rgyal yongs kyi tshong las rang dbang la khag theg nan tan byed dgos pa/goms su chags pa'i dpya khral dang las khral yod rgu'i khur po med par bzo dgos pa/ sa zhing smu hri gang gi sa bogs ni phe nee bzhi yin dgos pa sogs bton/ dbyin ji'i gong ma des 'os langs pas re ba dang len bya khul byas nas/ grong sde re nas 'thus mi gnyis gsum tsam shul du 'dug pa las mi gzhan pa thams cad phyir rang yul du log dgos zer/ kho pas na re tsa kho bos khyod tshor bden dpang gi yi ge zhig 'bri ru bcug nas steng du kho bo'i tham ka rgyag nges yin/ yi ge'i nang du khyod tshor mkho ba'i re ba thams cad 'du/ kho bos yi ge de khyod tsho'i 'bus mi'i lag tu 'jog nges yin/’ de nas kho pas 'phral du drung yig 30lhag la bden dpang yi ge stewa dmigs bsal chog dbang gi yi ge 'bri ru bcug nas zhing ba tshor byin/ 'byor ba cung tsam yod pa'i zhing ba kha shas gong ma de'i skad char rlom nas lon tun las bral/ yin na'ang zhing ba dbul po mang che ba lon tun las bral 'dod med de rgyu1 /rdon

ni kho tshor ci yang ma thob pas red/ kho tshos wa the thi ler la dbyin ji'i gong ma dang grol mol thengs gnyis pa bya dgos pa'i re ba bton/tshes 16nyin gyi srod dus su/ si sme si hphel sde thang chen du gros mol thengs gnyis pa byas/ skabs der dbyin ji'i gong mas dmag dpung bsdus nas 'os langs dmag la phar rgol bya rgyur gsang ba'i bkod sgrig byas yod/'os langs dmag gi phyogs nas/ wa the thi ler gyis grogs po tshor/ snye bdag song nas gong ma dang gros mol bya/ khyod tsho 'di ru bsdad de bdag gi lkog brda ma thob bar ma 'gul bar sdod cig ces nan bshad byas rjes/ khong rta mchog gi rgyab la mchong nas gong ma'i phyogs su brgyugs te/ chos tshogs kyi sa zhing yod tshad gzhung bzhes btang nas zhing bar bgo dgos pa dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gi dmigs bsal dbang cha 'phrog dgos shing ngal rtsol bzo ba'i bka' khrims med par bzo dgos zhes lhag tu drag skyod kyi re ba bton/ skabs der lon tun gyi 'go gtso ne khu la yol wo si yis mtshon cha yongs su thogs pa'i rta dmag 12khrid de tshur thon/ de'i nang gi mi zhig ris bsam btsugs nas wa the thi ler la khyod ni jag rkun red ces sdig mo dang 'phya smod byas nas drag 'thab byed pa'i ngar bslangs/ de mur dbyin ji'i gong mas da lag pa 'gul dang zhes bshad ma thag lun ton gyi 'go gtso des ral gri phyung nas shugs gang yod ngang wa the thi ler gyi mgo la bsnun pas thi ler rta gong nas sar lhung / rta dmag de dag gis mgyogs por thi ler dkyil du bskor nas rgyang ring gi 'os langs dmag la tshul de mthong du ma bcug pa dang mnyam du ral gris thi ler gyi khog smad sog la shugs kyis bsnun/wa the thi ler ni de bzhin du dgra bos lkog g.yo'i 'og rang srog blos btang /de nas gong ma rgyal po de 'os langs dmag gi mdun du 'ongs nas/ 6 da kho bodi di ler la rje si'i go sa byin yod/ khyod rang tsho'i re ba la'ang kho bos khas

len byas zhes mgo skor btang bas na/ gzhung drang pa'i zhing pa tsho rlom nas phyir rang yul du chas/ kho tsho'i bsam yal las 'das pa ni dmar gsod chen po zhig gis kho tshor bsgugs bsdad yod pa de red/dbyin ji'i gong ma phyir lon tun du slebs pa dang bka' yig cig bsgrags nas/ lon tun gyi sdod mi min pa'i mi yod tshad dang lon tun du bsdad nas lo gcig 'gor med pa'i mi thams cad nges par du lon tun las bral dgos/ gal srid phyi nyin zhogs gsar nyi ma shar dus mi de 'dra lag tu shor na srog len rgyu yin zhes zer/ de bas 'os langs la zhugs pa'i phyi yul gyi mi mang po myur du lon tun las mi bral thabs med byung / 'jon sbru'o dang 'os langs kyi 'go khrid gzhan rnams 'dzin bzung byas nas dmar gsod byas/ kho tsho dang thi ler gyi mgo bcad de lon tun zam par bkal nas nyes chad khrom ston byas/de nas dbyin ji'i gong mas drag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ rgyal yongs kyi sa khul so sor mngags nas 'os langs byas pa'i zhing par drag gnon byas/ gong ma de tha na rang nyid dngos su 'os langs kyi 'byung gnas khen the mnga' sde'i a si phu len grong sder song nas/ thang chen du zhing pa tsho bsdu sa nas/ mi mang gi mdun du 'os langs kyi 'go gtso 7'gegs gsod byas/ kho pas da dung btsan gyis zhing pa tshor sngar rang gis byin pa'i dmigs bsal chog dbang gi yig ge phyir sprod du bcug nas ther tshal sbar tshal du dbral/sa cha gzhan du yang de bzhin du 'os langs pa la ya nga snying rje med par gdug rtsub ngang drag gnon byas nas/ bsdoms pa'i mi 1500lhag dmar gsod btang / wa the thi ler gyi 'os langs ni/ gong ma rgyal po'i dam tshig ༵ snang

dgar yid ches byas thog 'os langs dpung sde'i rang steng gi zhan cha ste dper na rtsa 'dzugs kyi rang bzhin zhan pa dang / gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid gtso snying ma grub pa/ blo 'gel chog pa'i mna' mthun dmag med pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis pham song na'ang / de ni dbyin ji'i lo rgyus steng gi zhing pa'i 'os langs ches che shos yin pas/ dbyin ji'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs la rdung deg shugs ldan byas pa dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag gral rim la g.yo 'gul chen po btang / dus mtshungs su/ dbyin jir ngal rtsol pa shin tu dkon par gyur pas/ bshu gzhog byed pa'i byed stangs mi bsgyur ga med byung / dus rabs 14pa'i dus mjug tu/ dbyin ji'i zhing pa mang che bas mi lus rang dbang rtsod len byas nas thob pas sa bogs kyang dngul lor sa bogs su bsgyur pa red/ 116

'don hu si dang hu si'i dmag 'khrugaspyi lo dus rabs 10pa'i dus su/ ya rab kyi sbo he smi a (206611 tha malkoskokrokhru)lte gnas byas nas rang btsun gyi rgyal khab cig chags la de ni rje khe ((200stu1 0 chom)red/ rje khe'i mi ni si la we a (51871 tha omoṣṭha)nub ma'i rigs kyi yan lag cig yin zhing / dus rabs 12par slebs dus/ rje khe'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin can du bsgyur ba'i go rim ni ha lam yongs su grub pas zhing pa mang che ba zhing bran du gyur/ dus mtshungs su/ thon skyed stobs shugs mgyogs por 'phel rgyas byung bas/ lag shes bzo las te lhag par du gter 'don pa'i phyogs shin tu rgyas pas/ mdog ldan lcags rigs kyi gter rgya chen por bsko 'don byas par/ dngul gter 'don tshad yo rob kyi yang rtser son yod/ dus rabs 13pa nas dus rabs 14pa'i bar/ rje khe ni yo rob kyi ches stobs 'byor mnga' thang che ba'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur/bzo las dang tshong las phyogs kyi lte gnas te grong khyer dar rgyas su song zhing dper na phu ra sge (212350 777)dang phul 'dzin/(2120ba porsā) a si the ra wa/ (༅mo7)ma sger (2661 ṣṭha )sogs de dus dar/ de'i nang phu ra sge ni ches che shos kyi grong khyer yin la rje khe'i rgyal sa yang yin/ dus rabs 14par de ru rje khe'i ches thog ma'i slob grwa chen mo ste phu ra sge slob gru chen mo btsugs/yin na'ang / snga mo'i dus kyi rje khe rgyal po'i rgyal khab la don dngos kyi rang btsan med par/ dus yun ring por mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal ༵ ltor

gtogs su gnas/ 'jar man gyi gong ma dang sku drag tshos blo rtse gcig mthun du cis kyang rje khe'i 'byor phyug ldan pa'i yul khongs dang gter kha ham 'phrog byed par re ngan 'chang bzhin 'dug 1086lor/ mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal gyi gong ma rgyal po lhan re sku rabs bzhi bas/ rje khe'i gung chen po la wi la sde si la we yi (1062— 1092lo'i bar)rgyal po zhes pa'i mtshan gnang zhing /de nas bzung rje khe ni mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal gyi grub cha zhig tu gyur/dus rabs 13par rje khe'i rgyal po ni btsan rgyal gyi gong mar bsko 'dems bya chog pa'i rgyal phran rgyal po bdun nang gi gcig yin pas/ de la btsan rgyal gyi gong ma rgyal po 'dems bsko byed pa'i nang zhugs pa'i dbang cha yod/dus rabs bcu gnyis pa nas bzung / 'jar man gyis rje khe ru rgya chen por yul mi gnas spo byed du bcug la/ 'jar man gyi chos tshogs kyis yul mi gnas spo'i bya 'gul gyi gdong len pa byas/ 'jar man gyi chos tshogs kyis rje khe'i chos tshogs sger gcod du bzung ba ma zad/ da dung rje khe'i sa zhing gi phyed ka bzung nas/ rje khe'i zhing par ya nga ba'i bshu gzhog byas/rje khe'i gter kha mang po yang 'jar man pas bzung zhing / sa zhing 'phrog pa'i zhing pa tsho gter brko bzo bar gyur/ dus mtshungs su/ rje khe'i rgyal pos rgyal mdzod kyi yong sgo je mang du gtong ched/ 'jar man gyi lag shes bzo las pa dang tshong pa mang po rje kher bkug nas/ de dag la khrims lugs kyi dmigs bsal can gyi dbang cha du ma byin/ 'jar man gyi tshong pa dang lag shes bzo las pas mgyogs por rje khe'i grong khyer gyi do dam dbang cha bzung nas grong khyer gyi sku drag rim pa grub/ de bzhin du rje khe ru 'jar man gyi mi skya dang chos pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang grong khyer sku drag gter kha'i bdag po las grub pa'i spyi tshogs tshogs khag gis/gan/ zlob yag pa'i spyi tshogs go gnas dang dmigs bsal can gyi dbang cha

bzung nas/ rje khe'i ngar shugs ches che ba'i bshu gzhog mkhan dang gnya' gnon mkhan du gyur kyang / rje khe'i sku drag dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag kyang rim bzhin 'jar man can du bsgyur nas/ 'jar man gyi yul 'ongs pa'i sku drag dang phan tshun ngan 'brel byas/ rje khe'i mi dmangs la mi rigs dang gral rim gnyis zung gi gnya' gnon thebs pas spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba nyin re las nyin rer dza drag can du gyur ro//dus rabs 14pa'i dus mjug tu/ rje khe'i tshong las dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas/ grong khyer yang chig brgyar nye ba tsam byung/ rje khe'i rgyal po ni yo rab kyi ches 'byor phyug mnga' thang ldan pa'i rje bo yin pas mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal ru mtshan snyan grags shin tu che/ de bas rje khe'i rgyal po char le si sku rabs dang po (1346 — 1378lo)ni 1347lor mchog gyur ro ma btsan rgyal gyi gong ma chen por bskos/ des ro ma gyi chos kyi gong mas dang lag sbrel pa'i srid jus spel bas/ rje khe'i mi rigs kyi khe phan la gnod pa chen po btang / lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug gi rkyen gyis ro ma chos kyi gong ma dbyin ji'i nor srid yong sgo la gnod pa tshabs chen thebs pa sa/ chos kyi gong mas rje khe'i chos tshogs brgyud rje khe ru 'dzem bag med par 'phrog bsdu shugs chen byas nas/ chos kyi gong ma gzhung gi rgyu nor gyi 'byung khungs gtso bo ru gyur/ de'i phyir chos tshogs ni rje khe'i mi dmangs kyis 'thab rtsod bya yul gtso bor gyur/ de bas na/ mthur thug chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed rgyu gtso byas pa'i chos lugs kyi bsgyur bcos bya 'gul zhig byung ngo //rje khe'i chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi 'go khrid pa la 'jon hu si (380 653 pa lo7 1369'am 1371 — 1415lo) zer/khong ni zhing pa dbul po zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs/ 1394lor phu ra sge slob grwa chen po nas mthar phyin rjes slob grwa de ru dge rgan gyi las 'gaspya1 snar/

1401lor chos 'chad mkhan du gyur/ phyi lor phu ru sge slob grwa chen po'i slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes/ hu si yis chos khang du chos gsung ba'i dus su/ gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi rul sungs la kha rdung drag po btang / khong gis mi rnams la/ chos tshogs kyis sa zhing mang po bzung ba ni nyes pa yod tshad kyi 'byung khungs yin pas nges par du gzhung bzhes gtong dgos zhes gsungs/khong gis da dung 'jar man gyi chos spel mkhan tsho'i ham sems dang rul sungs/ 'phrog bcom bcas kyi nyes spyod la snying rje med par smyo ba na skye smad med po zhig gi am phrag tu yod pa'i ches mtha' ma'i sgor zur gcig po yang chos pa tshos ngo tsha med par ham 'phrog byas nas/ smi sa'i ①steng spyod cing /de'i phyogs ma spyad na/ chos pa tsho'i gshin rdzas steng spyod pa dang / gsol 'debs steng bkol ba'am yang na dur sbas thog gtong ba red/ chos 'chad mkhan tsho ni jag pa las kyang g.yog sgyu dang gdug rtsub che/ skad cha 'di mi bden nam zhes ther 'don byas/ hu si yis rje khe'i skad cha'i thog chos kyi mdzad sgo 'tshogs dgos shing dad ldan pa tsho dang mdzad sgo'i dbu 'dzin chos 'chad mkhan gyis smi sa'i khrod mi gzhan dang mnyam du bag leb (ye shu'i lus kyi mtshon byed) dang rgyan chang (ye shu'i khrag gi mtshon byed)len dgos/(gnam bdag chos lugs kyi thag gcod ltar na/ dad ldan pa tshos smi sa'i khrod bag leb gnyis las len mi chog) hu sis chos spel pa mi rnams kyi sems gting du bab pas/ rgya che ba'i rje khe mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor byas/1412lor/ chos rgyal gong ma 'jon sku rabs nyer gsum pas/dmag 'khrug gi gron dngul gra sgrig bya ched/ rje khe ru mi mngags nas 66nyes 1༷ba'i sa zatā sna pa ṭī sprun/ ktarsha1 /pa ཿshā kū ddhi rdoswā ཿsna swāskyurdo nā sbo //byi shā /ga/ zlo / shāb rmi rgyan chang

dag yi ge mi btsong du bcug chos tshogs kyis rgya nyes dag yi ge ’ nyos bas na/ nyes can gyi rnam shes dag zhing du 'gro thub ces 'ud sgrog byas/ mi la mgo skor gtong ba'i jus sdug de ni/ mngon sum 'dzems med kyi bshu gzhog cig yin pas mi rnams kyi 'khon sems dang zhe sdang bslangs/ hu si yis phu ra sge slob grwa chen mo'i rtsod gleng tshogs chen steng / snying rje med pa'i sgo nas chos rgyal gong mas rje khe mi dmangs kyi rgyu sta ninor btsir len byas pa'i khrel med kyi g.yo 'jan hu sa/thabs ther 'don mdzad/ phu ra sge yi 'og rim yul mi dang slob grwa chen mo ba tshos rngam zil che la gzhi rgya che ba'i sgo nas khrom skor byas pa dang / chos rgyal gong mar zur za byas pa'i 'khrab chas spras pa'i zlos gar 'khrab ston byas/ hu si'i mtshan snyan grags dang phu ru sge mi dmangs kyi rgol gtam gtong ba'i bya 'gul gyis 'jar man sku drag dang chos tshogs la zhe 'khon bslangs/ 'jar man sku drag gi kha la nyan rkyang rkyang gi rje khe'i dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis mang tshogs kyi khrom skor la drag gnon byas te/ slob grwa chen mo ba gnyis la srog khrims bcad pas/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la lhag tu khong khro bslangs pas/ chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas/ rje khe'i rgyal pos hu si la nyes khag bkal nas/ hu si chos lugs kyi sgrig khongs nas phyir 'bud byas thog pha ra sge nas kyang phyir skyod btang /red/me de la nyes dag gzungs yig 7kyang zer la gnam bdag chos tshogasakyis dpar pa'i gzungs byang zhig121

debs hu si rgyal sa las bral nas rje khe'i lho khul du mi phebs ga med byung / de lta yin yang / khong gis thugs su bden don la cis kyang rgyal kha thob nges yin pas/ 'thab rtsod la mtshams 'jog mi rung bar mu mthud du zhing pa'i khrod du tshig mtshon rnon pos ngang sgrog sbyang 'grel bshad byas/ khong gis zhing pa'i kha skad kyis gsol 'debs byas pa dang / 〈dam pa'i gsung rabs〉yang rje khe'i yi ger bsgyur/ khong gis da dung dpyad rtsom du ma bris shing / 〈ye shu'i chos 'chad pa'i sgo〉dang 〈mi dmangs gros tshogs〉sogs kyi nang / ro ma gyi chos rgyal gong ma'i chos kyi dbang cha dang ro ma gyi chos tshogs yongs la kha rdung drag po sprad/ hu sis dril bsgrags khrod zhing bran bshu gzhog lam lugs la gshe gshe btang zhing / sku drag tshos khrims ra'i nang zhing par brnyas bcos btang bar ngo rgol byas/ hu si'i bsam blo dang 'dod mos des rje khe mi dmangs kyi rgyal gces rang bzhin gyi mi rigs ring lugs kyi 'don blo mtshon pa ma zad/ 'og rim mi dmangs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon la ngo rgol byed pa'i re 'dun yang mtshon yod pa red/hu si yis da dung 'phrin yig bskur pa'i tshul gyis phe ra sge yi chos tshogs dang 'jar man sku drag la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod la mdzub ston gnang /hu si yis lho phyogs zhing sde ru mdzad pa'i phyag las la/ 'jar man sku drag dang chos tshogs/ ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma gzhung la khong khro tshad med bslangs/ kho pa tshos 'jigs skul dang slu brid kyi g.yo thabs spyad pa ma zad da dung chos lugs khrims gcod kyi thabs ngan bkol nas gnod 'tshe gtong thub thub byas/ smyo kho bos tshe srog shor yang mi dmangs la rogs ram byed pa'i ched du skad cha mi 'chad ga la rung ’ zhes gsung bzhin hu si yis gnya' mi sgur par kho pa tshor rgol lan sprad/121414lor/ khan si than dzi (5thabacu thabaku spomacho)ru tshogs pa'i

yo rob yongs kyi chos lugs tshogs chen gyi dmigs yul ni/ gcig nas chos tshogs kyi snyan grags je mthor gtong ba dang / gnyis nas hu si la nag med nyes 'gel byed pa'i phyir red/ hu si tshogs chen la zhugs dgos pa'i skad brda brgyab cing / 'jar man gyi gong ma rgyal po si rje si mun sde (51 6137507gloshāmo 7)yis hu si la gnod pa mi skyel bar khas blangs pa ma zad/ da dung khong la srung skyob byed pa'i yig cha yang byin/ zhing pa tshos hu si than si than dzi ru tshogs 'dur 'gro mi nyan pa'i kha ta byas kyang / hu si'i thugs su tshogs 'du tshogs pa'i go skabs 'di la brten nas rang gi 'dod blo gsal bshad zhib po dang srung skyob byed thub snyam nas/ the tshom spu tsam med par khan si than dzi ru phebs/ yin na'ang / chos lugs tshogs chen gyis khong la gsung bshad gnang du ma bcug pa'i mi tshad/ kha dan tshig la ma gnas par hu si 'dzin bzung byas nas btson khang nang bcug ste/ snye log lta mi can zhes ma nyes kha g.yog gi nyes pa zhig kyang khong gi mgo la bskon/ hu si yis da ni gson pa'i bskal ba med pa shes rung / rang nyid kyi lta ba ma bor par/brjid rngam ldan pa'i sgo nas bden don ni ru dur khung nas yar byung ste 'phel rgyas su song nas/ de la yun brtan gyi rgyal kha thob nges yin zhes bsgrags/'jar man gyi gong ma si rje si mun sde ni 2 ngo tsha med pa'i gzhan brten 'bu phra dang le lo can/ sprang po/ yul gyar pa/ chang rkyal/ bzhad slong zlos gar pa/sdar ma dang mgo skor gtong mkhan yin mi(mar khe si'i gsung)pas/ kho pas hu si la byin pa'i srung skyob yig cha ni shog hral zhig tu gyur/ 1415lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 6nyin/ khan si than dzi thang chen du hu si la mer bsregs pa'i srog khrims bcad do//hu si'i bden don srung ba'i ched du rang srog blos btang / rje khe mi dmangs kyis/ chos tshogs dang 'jar man gyi gong mas hu si lkog 1)/da

btang ba de rje khe'i mi rigs spyi la gnod 'tshe btang ba yin par snyam nas/phe ra sge ru rgol gtam gtong ba'i 'du 'dzom thengs mang po byas/ grong khyer gyi sdod dmangs kyis 'jar man gyi chos pa phyir skyod btang zhing / bsdam rgya la ma 'dzems par 'jig rten pa chos chang phor spyad de chos zas gsol ba'i chos lugs mdzad sgor zhugs pa lag bstar byas pa dang / zhing sde'i drag po'i gyen langs kyi 'go yang bcoms pas/ zhing sde'i chos 'chad mkhan tshos chos tshogs la bcu gcig sa bogs sprod mi dgos pa'i skul brda btang ba ma zad/da dung 6 mnga' bdag yod tshad pham par gtong dgos ’ zhes 'bod tshig kyang bsgrags/ 'thab rtsod de dag phyogs gcig tu 'dres nas drag rlabs chen por gyur te/ 1419lo'i dpyid kur 'os langs chen po gzhi nas byung ba red/zhing pa'i 'os langs chen po ni hu si'i dar cha'i 'og byung bas/ rdo la hu si dmag 'khrug zer/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs la ngo rgol dang gnam bdag chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i ngo bo yod pa dang / dus mtshungs su mi rigs rang btsan gyi nang don dang ngo bo yang yod/ 'os langs kyi gtso shugs ni zhing pa dang lag shes bzo las pa/gter brko bzo ba dang grong khyer gyi grong mi dbul po sogs yin/ kho tsho'i gnas gzhi sa khul ni lho phyogs tha sbor (18601 777)grong khyer yin pas/ de la tha sbor phyogs khag zer zhing bya 'gul gyi g.yon ru byas/ 'byor 'bring gral rim dang sku drag chung ba/ zhing pa phyug po skor zhig kyang 'os langs su zhugs shing bya 'gul gyi g.yas ru byas/hu si dmag 'khrug gi 'go brtsams pa dang / chos skya bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho la dngangs skrag ches cher skyes pas/ si rje si mun sdoyis 'jar man dang rje khe'i log spyod stobs shugs yongs su spyad de 'os la sdu 4pa la rgol bar 'ongs/ 1420lo'i zla 4pa nas 1431lo'i zla 8pa'i

bar/ bsdoms pas thengs lnga la rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas zhing pa'i 'os langs la drag gnon byas/ 'os langs dmag gi gtso 'dzin phul byung dmag spyi 'jon rdze dzi kha (/thab 21216 tshogi rke 76)yis 'os langs dmag dpung gi 'go khrid de rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung la rdung rdeg chen po brgyab/ dze dzi kha yis 6 dmag spyod shing rta'i btsan rdzong zhes pa 'thab jus te lcags thag gis shing rta sbrel ba'i dkyil du rkang dmag bskungs shing / steng du me skyogs btsugs pa 'gul thub pa'i btsan rdzong la 'dra ba spyad de pha rol dgra bo bskor pas/ rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung gi rta dmag la thar pa'i bskal ba ma yod par thams cad ming gi lhag mar btang / yin na'ang dmag spyi rdzi dzi kha nyid rgya gram rtags can gyi dmag dpung thengs gsum par cham du pham pa'i skabs su tshe las 'das/'os langs dmag gis mu mthud du 'thab 'dzing byas te bstud mar rgyal kha blangs mod/ 'on kyang skabs der 'os langs dmag gi g.yas ru ba tshor khe phan mi nyung ba zhig thob yod pas/ dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs rgyu thag bcad/ de bzhin du g.yas ru g.yon ru gnyis kyi bar la 'gal ba byung /1434lo'i zla 5bar nang khul 'gal ba de mthar thug nang 'khrug tu gyur te/phyogs gnyis kyis phe ra sge yi nye 'dabs kyi li phan (21 ji ba 46)zhes pa'i yul du g.yul chen po bshams shing / mjug mthar sbor tha phyogs khag yongs su pham pas/ mi mang po dmar gsod dang me bsregs nas bkum/ de bzhin du hu si'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs la 'os langs kyang pham pa red/hu si'i mtshan snyan grags dang hu si dmag 'khrug gnyis dam du sbrel yod/ bla na med pa'i chos lugs bsgyur bcos mkhan dang rgyal gces pa/rangasrog shor yang bden don srung ba'i 'thab mo ba hu si yis/ rje khe'i mi rigs dang mi dmangs kyi ched du rang srog blos btang / khong ni sdo 2) mi

dmangs kyi lhag bsam rnam dag gi bu phrug yin pa smos med yin pas/ ji srid bar du rje khe mi dmangs kyis rjes dran byed pa red/ hu si'i dmag 'khrug gis 'jar man btsan 'dzul pa la rdul deg drag po byas nas/ rje khe 'di dus tshod nges can zhig gi nang chab srid rang btsan yin par khag theg byas pas/ rje khe'i mi rigs rig gnas dang skad cha 'phel rgyas byung bar skul 'ded byas te/ rje khe'i lo rgyus steng dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyi le tshan zhig bris yod pas shugs rkyen gting zab yun ring zhig bzhag yod do//

khro zhan gyisngar pan 'gog pa'i dpa' bo li gron khrin/sdu ma mtsho 'gag kyi rgya mtsho'i ngos su bgrangs kyis mi lang pa'i g.yor grus khengs shing / dmag 'khrug gi du sprin long long du 'khrug dmag gru 700las grub pa'i dmag gru'i ru khag chen po zhig tu/ skam dmag sa ya gcig dang khri drug gi steng / chu dmag khri gsum bzhi lhag bcug nas nub byang phyogs su mgyogs myur du bskyod bzhin yod/ nyin shas rjes su/ dmag gru'i ru khag de khro zhan gling phran phyed ma'i shar lho'i khul gyi rmu hran gru kha nas skam sar 'bab 'go bcoms la/ de ni khyon rgya shin tu che ba'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug cig gi 'go bcoms pa yin la/ nyin de 1592lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 13nyin red/ljar pan nas 'ongs pa'i dmag dpung de ni ches mtho'i dmag spyi hphen khrin zhi'u ci yis bka' ltar khro zhan la btsan 'dzul byed du 'ongs pa red/ljar pan gyis lo brgya tsam gyi 4 dmag 'khrug rgyal rabs dus mi kyi sde zing 'thab 'dzing brgyud rjes/ rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs nyams dmas su song zhing thon skyed la'ang gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs/ 1590lor slebs pa dang / we krang (ṭhaṣṭha)zhes pa'i rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon hpheng khrin zhi'u ci (ro༅rsālha)yis lo ngo du mar dpung 'jug g.yul 'gyed byas rjes/ lngar pan gcig gyur byas mod/ 'on kyang lo gnyis las ma 'gor bar/ thengs 'di'i rgya chen por khro zhan la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go bslangs/ rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ ma gzhir hpheng khring ci zhi'u yis 1)snag

'khrug gi thabs shes la brten nas rgyal khab gzhan gyi rgyu nor 'phrog nas/rgyal nang gi dpal 'byor phyogs kyi dka' khag tshabs chen sel pa dang rgyal nang gi 'gal ba'i kha phyogs gzhan du skor rgyu ma zad/ khro zhan bar zam tsam byas nas krung gor btsan 'dzul byed rgyu'i phyirayin la/ hpheng khring ci zhi'u yis ham sems ci 'dra chen po bzung ba nga tshos de las shes thub bo//dus rabs 16pa'i dus mjug gi khro zhan ni/ da dung li tshang gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs rgyal rabs (1392lor btsugs) kyi dbang sgyur 'og gnas shing / dbang 'dzin pa ni rul sungs nus med du mchis pas/rgyal mdzod stong bar song la nang zing mang po byung zhing rgyal srung gi stobs shugs shin tu zhan/ de bas khro zhan gyis ljar pan dmag dpung gis 1592lor 'jab rgol byas pa 'gog thabs med par gyur/ khro zhan gyi rgyal po shan tsu'u (rsā7)zhes pa rgyal sa han khring nas dngangs 'tshab ngang khe khring (77)dang phen rang (lto )phyogs su bros/ de rjes ljar pan gyi dmag dpung mu mthud du byang phyogs su bskyod nas phen rang blangs/ zla ba gnyis gsum tsam gyi dus thung nang / khro zhan gyi mnga' khongs mang che bar lngar pan btsan 'dzul dmag gis rkang brdzis thebs/ ljar pan dmag gis bzung ba'i grong khyer dang zhing sde so so gtsang 'phrog byas la nyes med kyi mi mang po dmar gsod brgyab/ han khring gi gser dngul rin po che thams cad gtsang 'phrog byas nas rgyal po'i pho brang la me bsgron nas gyang ro mkhar shul tsam du btang / de bas na khro zhan ni mi rigs kyi nyen kha tshabs chen zhig la thug yod/skabs der khro zhan gyi rgya che ba'i mi dmangs rang 'gul sgos rtsa 'dzugs byas nas btsan 'dzul pa la 'gog rdung byas/ ching hrang ta'o (ṣṭhalo7)yi shes yon can 64lu dmar dmag dpon mi ko tse yi'u yis thog mar 'os langs kyi /sdu cha bsgrengs/ khong gis khyim 'khor ba yongs rdzogs btsong nas/ nus

pa gang yod sgos lngar pan gyi btsan 'dzul dmag 'gog pa'i 'thab rtsod nang zhugs te/ 'os langs dmag khrid nas dpa' ngar sgos dgra bor rgol nas sa cha mang po zhig phyir blangs pa red/khro zhan gyi li tshang rgyal rabs kyi rgyal gces dmag dpon kha shas kyis kyang / mes rgyal dgra lag tu shor pa ma bzod par/ dgra bo 'gog pa'i 'thab rtsod nang zhugs/ ming grags can gyi dmag dpon li hron khrin (cholko༅)ni de'i nang gi phul du byung ba'i mtshon byed mi sna red/ snyan grags che ba'i mi rigs dpa' bo 'di ni 1545lor 'khrungs shing / cing ci ta'o khe hpheng gi mi yin/ gzhon nu'i dus nas bzung drag rtsal sbyong zhing / rjes su drag tshan la rgyugs blangs nas 'phrod pas dmag dpung du zhugs shing g.yul du mar zhugs par dpa' bo do med cig tu gyur/ yin na'ang li hron khrin la dus ring por dbang btsan blon pos nyes med nyes 'gel byas pas/ las gnas gal che sar ma bskos pa ma zad/ tha na ma nyes kha g.yog gi gyod gzhir gyur nas btson du 'jug myangs/ljar pan gyis rgyun chad med par khro zhan la btsan 'dzul zing slong byas kyang / li tshang rgyal rabs la nus ldan dmag dpon zhig ma yod pas/1591lor mi gzhan gyi mtshams sbyor byas pa brgyud/ da gzod li hron khrin chon lo ta'o yi chu dmag spyi dpon la bskos stabs/ khong gis rgyal khab srung skyob byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi las 'gan lci mo phrag tu blangs/ 1592lor ljar pan gyi dmag khro zhan du thogs med shar skyod byas shing / li tshang gong ma'i gzhung byang phyogs dbyi kro'u (5 7)la bros pa'i skabs/ li hron khrin gyis dgra bo 'gog pa'i gra sgrig gang legs byas yod/ khong rang dmag don la mkhas pas/khro zhan chu dmag gi srol rgyun rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i steng / zu rus sbal gru gzings ’ zhes pa'i dmag gru gsar skrun byas nas/ ljar pan btsan1 ༵༵la

pa la rdung rdes chen po byas/ rus sbal gru gzings kyi ring tshad la khri tse brgya dang bcu tsam yod cing zheng tshad la khri tse bcu lhag yod la phyi dbyibs rus sbal gzugs su mngon par lcags leb kyis btum yod pas/ dgra bos me yis bsreg mi thub pa red/ gru khebs steng rgya gram dbyibs kyi bgrod lam zhig bzos pa las gzhan thams cad gri dang mdung sogs rno ngar gyi drag chas btsugs nas dgra bo pha rol gru steng nas mchongs nas tshur yong bar sngon li hron khrin/'gog bgyi spyad byas/ gru mgo 'brug dbyibs su bzos shing ring tshad la khri tse bzhi dang tshun gsum yod cing zheng tshad la khri tse gsum yod pa'i nang mu zi sogs 'bar rdzas blugs yod pas/ 'brug mchu las me dang du zhags 'phen pas dgra bor mgo skor gtong thub la rang phyogs srung yang thub/ dmag gru'i nang du phyogs chen btsugs par gru gzings kyi phyogs bzhi ru skyogs mig 72yod/ gru gzings kyi logs gnyis su gru skya bcu re yod pas bgrod tshad shin tu mgyogs/ rus sbal dmag gru la khyad chos de dag yod pas de ni skabs de'i 'dzam gling stong gi nye mtsho'i 'thab 'dzing khrod kyi ches phul du byung ba'i dmag gru yin pa ma zad/ da dung 'dzam gling steng ches snga shos kyi lcags khrab can gyi dmag gru yang yin no//li hron khrin gyis dmag dpon rnams pa bsdus nas dgra bo 'gog pa'i 'thab jus la gros mol gnang skabs/ dpa' dang spobs pa khengs pa'i ngang rgya rastu /ga ma shor bar du/ dgra bo'i tshang du brgyugs te bdud 'dre rdul du

brlag nas/ 'u cag la btang ba'i brnyas bcos dang thub tshod la skyin pa gang thub sprod dgos mi zhes rang srog 'chor bar mi 'dzems par dgra bo 'gog pa'i sems thag bcad/ de nas dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis khro zhan chu dmag khrid de 'jar man gyi dmag dpung gi gdung bsus rus sbal dmag gru/nas dgra bor rgol par bskyod/ zla 5pa'i tshes 7nyin/ cus ci (༅lko)gling phran gyi shar byang phyogs kyi g.yu phu (1lko)rgya mtsho'i ngos su dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis dmag gru 85khrid de/ ching hring chu dmag gi spyi dpon yon con gyis khrid pa'i dmag dpung dang bsdebs nas/ ljar pan gyi dmag gru 50lhag la 'jab rgol byas/ de dus dgra dmag skam sar bab 'dug pas dmag 'khrug la gra sgrig ci yang byas med/ kho pa tshos khro zhan chu dmag thon pa tshor pa'i tshe/ 'drog 'drog por gyur nas 'jigs skrag dang sbrags gru la 'dzegs nas 'bro rtsis byas rung / dmag dpon chen po li hron khrin rjes su snyegs nas drag tu rgol dgos pa'i bka' bab nas dgra bo la rdung deg drag po byas te dmag gru 30lhag gtor pa dang dgra dmag mang po bsad pas rgyal kha chen po blangs/ g.yu phu rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs pa des ljar pan gyis rgya mtsho'i steng nas khro zhan la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i dmag dpung la rgyab skyor byed pa'i 'char gzhir gtor brlag byas pas/ dgra bo'i dngos po'i mkho sprod la dka' khag chen po byung stabs/ dgra bos tshur rgol byed par mtshams mi 'jog ga med byung / dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin g.yu phu mtsho thog dmag 'khrug gi rjes su/ 6 ci hran ta'i hphu mi(zlorsālkolko)zhesdusa'i

dpon sar bskos/ zla 5pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi phyi dro nas phyi nyin bar khong gis bkod 'doms byas pa'i chu dmag gis ho phu dang khri trin phu gnyis las kyang mtsho thog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs pas/ dgra bo'i dmag gru 40lhag gtor nas mtshon cha dang 'bru rigs sogs du ma thob rung / khro zhan phyogs su dmag gru gcig gi god kha yang ma byung / ngo mtshar che ba'i rgyal kha 'dis rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi 'jar 'gog spobs sems la skul 'ded chen po btang ba red/zla 5pa'i zla mjug nas bzung / dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis dmag dpung khrid de thengs gnyis par dgra bor phar rgol byas shing / rus sbal dmag gru'i 'thab 'dzing gi nas shugs gang legs bton nas bsdud mar thengs bzhi la rgyal kha blangs/ zla 5pa'i tshes 29nyin si hrus ( 77)rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug khrod/ dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis rang lus la rmas skyon phog kyang dmag la bkod 'doms byas nas dgra bo'i dmag gru 12rtseg med du btang / zla 6pa'i tshes 2nyin thang phu rgya mtsho'i steng gi dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha chen po blangs te dgra bo'i dmag gru 20tsa med du btang /dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin yang 66tsi zhan ta'e spru (lkolkolkolko)zhes pa'i go sar bskos/ rjes su zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin thang zhang phu rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug dang / zla 6pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi yung tin phu mtsho'i thog gi dmag 'khrug khrod kyang dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i dmag dpung la rgyal kha thob/ skabs der chon lo ta'o ni khro zhan skam dmag dang chu dmag gi dgra'i rgyab phyogs kyi gnas gzhi sa khul gal chen du gyur pas/dgra bos phyogs gcig nas skam sa nas de la tshur rgol byas shing / phyogs gcig nas chu dmag nub phyogs su skyod du bcug dgra bo'i tshur rgol byas pa/ nāmigs nas/ dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis zla 7pa'i tshes

6nyin chon lo ta'o yi chu dmag gi spyi dpon li dbyi ci dang ching hrang ta'o yi chu dmag spyi dpon yo con gnyis dang 'brel nas/ mnyam 'brel gru dpung btsugs nas thengs gsum pa'i phar rgol gyi 'go bcoms/zla 7pa'i tshes 8nyin/ dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis khrid pa'i dmag gru'i dpung chen na'e lang (7༅ de ni cus ci gling phran gyi nub phyogs su yod pa)du thon dus/ ljar pan gyi dmag gru bcu phrag du ma rgya mtsho'i ngos su bsdad yod pa mthong nas/ ljar pan gyi dmag gru shan hran ( zla7)gling phran gyi mtsho ngos su slu khrid byas nas drag tu phar rgol byas pas rgyal te dgra bo'i dmag gru 73gtor shing dgra dmag brgya phrag du ma'i srog blangs/ tshes 10nyin rgyal kha'i ngang nas shar phyogs su bskyod pa dang / an ku'u phu'u ru dgra bo dang nyin gcig ring drag tu 'thab pas pha rol cham la pham nas dmag gru 40ming gi lhag mar btang / rgyal kha de gnyis la sna shan hran gling phran gyi rgyal kha chen mo :zer/ ljar pan gyi mtsho dmag gtso shugs pham par btang ba dang / dgra bos skam chu gnyis las mdun skyod byed pa'i 'char gzhir pham nyes byung bas/ phen rang nas byang phyogs su skyod ma phod pa red/1592lo'i zla 7par/ dmag dpon chen mo lpe hron khrin gyis thengs bzhi ba'i phar rgol bya rgyu thag bcad de rmu hran la phar rgol byas/ skabs der dgra bo'i dmag shugs mang po hphu hran ru bsdus yod cing / tshes 24nyin dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis li dbyi chi (sto/rnga )yi chu dmag dang mnyam du sbrel nas dmag gru 100lhag li khron nas hphu hran phyogs su bskyod/spru hran la slobs pa'i dus su/ de ru dgra bo'i dmag gru 400lhag bsdus yod pa mthong / dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis stobs ldan zhing kha grangs mang ba'i dgra dmag mthong ba na dpa' ma zhum par/ 'phral du rus sbal dmag grus gdung len byed dgos pa dang dmag gru gzhan de'i /sdu su

'brangs nas dgra bo'i phyogs su skyod dgos pa'i bka' babs/ thengs 'gar pham kha zos pa'i ljar pan gyi chu dmag ni khu ta mda' 'drog ltar du gyur pas tshur gdung blangs nas 'thab tu yong mkhan gcig kyang ma byung ba ma zad/ la las dmag gru bskyur nas bros bshol du phyin/ dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byas nas dgra bor drag tu rgol bas/ nyin gcig gi 'thab 'dzing brgyud dgra bo'i dmag gru 100lhag gtor ba dang dgra dmag mang po bsgral ba dang rmas su bcug mod/ li hron khron gyi chu dmag la dmag gru gcig gi god ka yang ma yod/ rmu hran gyi rgyal kha chen po blangs pa des dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyi mtshan snyan grags phyogs bzhir khyab pas/ gong ma'i srid gzhung gis dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin la bya dga' chen po gnang ba ma zad/ da dung chon lo dang ching hrang /krung ching bcas ta'o gsum gyi chu dmag gi thog ma'i dbang sdem spyi dpon du bsko 'jog byas shing / chon lo'i chu dmag gi spyi dpon zhir 'khur gnang du bcugaskabs der krung go'i ming rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis khro zhan srid gzhung gi re ba ltar/ dpung rogs khro zhan du btang nas/ khro zhan dmag dmangs dang mnyam du 'thab 'dzing la zhugs te ljar pan gyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol bya rgyu thag gcod byas/ 1592lo'i zla 12par meng rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis li ru'u sung (lhokreb7)shar skyod dmas dpon du bskos nas dmag mi sum khri bzhi stong khrid de khro zhan phyogs su bskyod/ phyi lo'i zla dang por krung khro rgyal khab gnyis kyi dmag dpung gnyis mnyam du dmag 'thab la zhugs nas ljar pan btsan 'dzul pa rdul du brlag nas/ phen rang dang khe khring / han khring bcas snga gzhug phyir blangs/ ljar pan gyi dmag dpung gzhi/ 4rjes gnyis mthud du pham pas/ g.yul phyogs mu mthud du lho phyosas su

bsdur pas/ lho khul gyi mtsho 'gram sa rgyud tsam mi srung thabs med du gyur/lngar pan btsan 'dzul pas dbugs ngal gso ba'i ched du/ krung go dang khro zhan phyogs su zhi gros byed khul gyi g.yo zol slu jus spyad/ 1593lo'i zla 4pa nas 1597lo'i zla 1pa'i bar/ phyogs gnyis kyis lo gsum ring gros mol byas/ 6 zhi bde'i 'brel gtug ces pa'i dus skabs su/ hpheng khrin zhi'u ci yis khungs med kyi re ba rab dang rim pa bton nas/ khro zhan btsan 'dzin dang tshod 'dzin byed pa'i re ngan bcangs/ krung go dang khro zhan gnyis kyis kho pa'i re ngan gtan nas khas ma blangs/ 1597lo'i zla gnyis par/hpheng khrin thi'u ci yis gros mol la kha ma 'cham par kha g.yar nas/ dmag mi /ga /bum bzhi khri dang dmag gru brgya phrag du ma khrid de slar yang dmag 'khrug 'a rno/sdig /ga/ ga gi skabs de la rgyal gces dpa' bo li hron khrin la blon ngan yon con gyi nag med nyes 'gel byas pas/ rgyal sar btsan khrid byas nas srog khrims 'bab pa'i nyes pa yod pa byas/ khong gi las 'gan te spyi dpon gyi go sa yang yon con gyis bzung / rjes su blon chen po kring kru'u yis yar zhu srung skyob byas pas btson las bkrol/yon con gyis khrid pa'i khro zhan gyi chu dmag gis ljar pan dmag dang g.yul 'gyed byas pa kyang gcig rjes gnyis mthud du pham pas dmag shugs phal cher shor stabs/ gong ma'i gzhung nas slar yang li hron khrin chu dmag spyi dpon du mi bsko ga med byung / zla 9pa'i tshes 16nyin dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis 'jigs med dpa' bo'i snying stobs sgos dmag gru 12tsam dang dmag 120lhag khrid de men leng ( tsho)mtsho 'gag tu dgra bo'i dmag gru 330dang dka' spyad tshad med kyis drag 'thab byas/ men ling mtsho 'gag gi sa bab la nyen kha shin tu che/ nyin rer thengs bzhi la mtsho rlabs 'a~X ba

dang 'grib pa res mos byed/ mtsho rlabs rgyas pa'i dus su rlabs chen po dgong sngon dbyings su 'phyur la ldir sgra kun tu sgrog dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis mtsho 'gag gi phyi nang du lcags thag gnyis lkog 'dzugs byas/tshes 16nyin khro zhan chu dmag gis dgra bo'i dmag gru lcags thag bar la slu khrid byas shing cung ma 'gor bar mtsho chu 'grib pas/ dgra bo'i dmag gru 'gul thabs bral pa'i skabs dang bstun nas khro zhan chu dmag gis dgra bor drag tu rgol bas/ dgra bo'i dmag gru 30lhag rtsa gtor byas shing dgra dmag shākaX0pham par btang bas/ men leng mtsho thog dmag 'thab la rgyal kha chen ba1/598lor/ dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyi dmag dpung ku'u cin (43)gling phran du gnas spos te/ ming rgyal rabs kyi chu dmag dang mnyam du 'dzoms/ ming rgyal rabs kyis mngags pa'i chu dmag ni khrin len (ṣṭha )dang ting tse lung (༅12)gnyis kyis khrid cing bsdoms pas dmag mi 5000yod/ hpheng khrin zhi'u ci yis rang gi chu dmag la krung khro gnyis kyi dmag dpung gis rdung deg drag po btang bas dmag mi chos dpa' zhum pa mthong ba dang / cung ma 'gor par kho par nad phog ste zhi khro zhan la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ljar pan gyi dmag dpung phyir rang yul du log rtsis byas kyang /zla 9par krung khro gnyis kyi mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag skor khag gsum du bgos nas skam dmag dang mnyam du/ dgra bos bzung ba'i we hran dang si khron/ hron then gsum dam du bskor/ hron then srung ba'i ljar pan gyi dmag dpon hran zhi shin krang gru la bsdad de 'bro rtsis byas pa dang si khron gyi rang dmag la rogs ram byed pa'i re brda btang / zla 11pa'i dus dkyil du si khron srung ba'i ljar pan gyi dmag dpon ta'o cin dbyi hung gi dmag gru 500lhag drangs te hon then nyen gnas las skyob par 'ongs/ tshes 18nyin 136

gyi mtshan mor/ krung khro mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gis lu'u leng mtsho ngos su dgra bor drag rgol byas/ rgya mtsho'i ngos su me lce dang du nag lhog lhog tu dgung la 'phyur/ dmag 'khrug de nam langs pa tsam du brgyab cing / dgra bo'i dmag gru 40lhag gtor na'ang / da dung 'chi kha'i 'phag 'tshag rgyag gin 'dug tshes 19nyin 'thab 'dzing de ches drag shos tshad du thon zhing /dmag dpon chen mo li hron khrin gyis sku ngo mas rang nyid bzhugs pa'i dmag grur bkod 'doms byas nas dgra bo'i phyogs su bskyod/ mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gis rgyun chad med par dgra bo'i dmag gru'i stong me lce gtor spyad kyis me lce gtor bas/ rlung chen po'i khrod du dgra bo'i dmag gru brgya phrag du ma me yi mtsho ru nub/ skabs der ming rgyal rabs kyi dmag dpon rgan pa ting tse lung ni me lce drag por ma 'dzem par dgra bor phar rgol byed dus/ stabs ma legs par me spung zhig khong gi dmag gru'i steng lhung bas dmag grur me chen po 'bar/ dgra bo yang skabs de dang bstun nas khong gis phyogs su bskor 'ongs pas/ dmag dpon gon pa ting tse lung nyen gnas tshabs chen du lhung / li hron khrin gyis tshul de mthong ba dang nyen khar ma 'joms par mgyogs myur du dmag dpon ting tse lung skyob tu brgyugs na'ang / khong la dgra bos 'phangs pa'i lcags ril zhig brang kha g.yon par phog pas/ dmag dpon chen mo gnyis ni me lce drag po'i khrod du dpa' ngar sgos rang srog blos btang / thengs 'di'i tsa lho mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi khrod du/ khro krung gnyis kyi dpa' rtul chos dgra dmag chig khri sum stong rdul du brlag cing / dgra bo'i dmag gru 300lhag rtsa gtor byas nas/ gzi 'od 'phro ba'i rgyal kha blangs/ btsan 'dzul pa ljar pan gyi dmag dpung la dmag gru 70lhag shul du lus pa phyir ljar pan du bros/khro zhan mi dmangs kyis ljar pan btsan 'dzul par 'gog gosdu snas

nas rgyal khab srung pa'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug bsgril/ khro krung rgyal khab gnyis kyi mi dmangs kyis dpung ba mnyam gshib tu 'thab 'dzing du zhugs nas khrag dang tshe srog gis gtor thabs med pa'i 'thab 'dzing gi mdza' brtse btsugs/ khro zhan mi dmangs kyi rlabs che ba'i rgyal gces dmag dpon li hron khrin gyis mes rgyal srung skyob byed ched dpa' ngar sgos rang srog blos btang ba'i mdzad rjes ni mi yi sems pa yongs su 'gug cing rang dbang med par mchi ma 'khor pa zhig yin no// khong gis rang gi ral gri'i steng sku ngo mar bris pa'i dam tshig de mngon du 'gyur/ de ru 'di ltar gsungs yod de/ral gri 'di yis gnam la dam bca' 'jog/mes po'i yul 'dir dgra bos brnyas bcos na/drag mtshon 'di yis dgra bor drag tu 'thab/kho bos khrag gis sa gzhi sbags kyang the tshom med/138

tā hwa gsarabacos/wa waljar pan rgyal khab bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs las brgal ba/(tā hwa lo gnyis pa'i dpyid zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin/ rten 'brel zhu mchod kyi mdzad sgo rdzogs rjes/ gsar bcos byed rgyu'i skor gyi gong ma'i bka' bsgrags/ spyi lo 646lo'i zla dang por/ ljar pan gyi zha'o sde gong mas bka' yig bsgrags te/ gsar bcos kyi 'go bcoms shing / de nas bzung ljar pan lo rgyus stong dus rabs 'byed pa'i don snying ldan pa'i dus skabs shig gi 'go tshugs so//lngar pan ni pa'i he ta'o (mo'i cha)dang pin kri'u/(87) si go ci'u kri'u (77)dang gling phran chung chung du ma la sa grub pa'i gling phran gyi rgyal khab cig yin/ rang rgyal dang mtsho chu gcig gis bar bcad pa'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyang yin/ rgyal khab des dus yun shin tu ring ba'i ya thog kung hre'i dus skabs brgyud cing / rjes su tsho pa mang po grub ste/ spyi lo dus rabs dang po'i dus su byang phyogs ci'u kri'u sa khul du 6rgyal khab brgya lhag (tsho pa)yod pa ma zad/ da dung skam sa chen po'i steng gi krung go dang 'brel ba btsugs/dus rabs 3pa'i dus dkyil du/ pin kro'u dkyil khul du ming la tā ho (shā7)zhes pa'i rgyal khab kyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang dar rgyas su song / tā ho gong ma'i srid gzhung gis drag shugs la brten nas sa khul gyi mi drag btsan shed can dang 6rgyal khab chung chung btul nas dbang 'og tu bsdus/ dus rabs 5par slebs tshe/ phal cher rgyal khab gcig gyur byed pa'i las don bsgrub tshar/139

dus rabs 5ba dang 6pa nas bzung / ljar pan gyi spyi tshogs thon skyed stobs shugs la mu mthud du mthor 'degs byung / tsho 'bangs lam lugs ni gnas bab de dang bstun thabs ma yod kyang / tā ho gong ma'i khyim tshang dang sku drag tshos da dung tshod 'dzin med par mnga' zhabs sa cha'i rgya je cher btang nas/ 'bangs mi yang rgya chen por bzung ba ma zad/ rang dbang can 'bangs mang po yang khyim gzhi 'chor du bcug nas tsho 'bangs su bsgyur/ rgya che ba'i tsho 'bangs ni phyi bros dang rten 'bul nor rdzas mi 'bul pa'am yang na thun tshang dang then krong la 'jab rgol byed pa sogs kyi thabs la brten nas sku drag gi gnya' gnon la ngo rgol byas/ dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nang khul du yang krung dbyang sku drag dang sa gnas sku drag bar du khe phan gyi ched du 'gal zla byung bas dmag 'khrug rgyun chad med par byung / rgyal nang gi spyi tshogs kyi nyams nyen dang gral rim gyi 'gal ba shin tu tshabs chen zhig tu thon yod/dbang sgyur gral rim gyi khrod kyi dpyod ldan kha shas kyis/ kho tsho'i dbang sgyur gyi go sa mu mthud du rgyun 'khyongs dang sra brtan gtong ba'i ched du nges par du gsar bcos dgos par 'dugadus rabs 6pa'i dus dkyil du/ tā ho krung dbyang sku drag nang khul du phyogs khag gnyis byung zhing / su'u wo tshang (776)gtso byas pa'i sku drag tshos/ krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig tu sdud pa'i lam lugs btsugs nas/nang pa'i chos lugs spel nas sku drag gi bsam blo gcig gyur yong thabs byas/phyogs khag cig shos telu sbu tshang (776)gtso byas pa'i rnying zhen pa tshos gong gi bsam tshul de la ngo rgol byas/ phyogs khag gnyis kyis 'thab rtsod byas mthar/ su'u wo tshang la rgyal kha thob/ 593lor su'u wo tshang gis rang gi zhang rgyud tsha mo thu'o ku (ṣṭhaṣṭha)zhes par gong ma chen po'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed du bcug cing / de'i bu sun ci'u (76)rgyal sras kyis rgyud 'dzin rgyal ༵༵ kyi

ming du srid dbang bskyangs/(593 —622lo'i bar) de la hring te (47)rgyal sras zhes 'bod do//hring te rgyal sras ni gsar dar bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bdag gral rim gyi sngon byon pa red/ khong gis phyi tshul nas dbang cha dngos su bzung ba'i su'u wo tshang la 'os med 'grig thabs byed zhor du/ hur brtson sgos gong ma'i dbang char shugs snon byas/ khong gis chung ba'i dus nas krung go'i bstan bcos mang po klog myong zhing / krung go'i rig gnas la shin tu dad pas/ thengs du mar su'o rgyal rabs dang thang rgyal rabs la pho nya mang po brdzangs pa ma zad/ slob ma mang po yang krung gor mngags nas slob sbyong byed du bcug 603 — 604lo'i bar khong gis ru'u rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang ru'u chos lugs kyi snying don gtso bor bzung nas bsgyur bcos mdzad de/snga gzhug tu 6 dpon gnas rim pa bcu gnyis mi dang 4 rtsa khrims bcu bdun gtan 'bebs byas/ sngon ma ni dpon rigs sku drag gi dpon rim lam lugs yin pas/ dbang thang che ba'i khyim rgyud kyi stobs shugs la tshad bkag byas/ rjes ma ni rgyal khab la do dam byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'gangs chen yin la/de ru 6 rgyal khab gcig la rgyal po gnyis yod mi chog cing / mi dmangs la bdag po gnyis yod mi rung / rgyal khongs kyi 'bangs khri phrag du mas/ gong ma rgyal po gtso ru bkur dgos mi zhes pa'i bsam blo bton yod/ dmigs yul ni krung dbyang gi rgyal po'i dbang cha mtho ru 'degs pa'i ched red/ rgyal sras hring te'i bsgyur bcos las thon pa'i nus pa ni kung dbyang gi gcig sdud dbang cha la shugs snon byas nas/ sku drag rnying pa'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su btang zhing / krung go'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs dang rig gnas spos 'dzugs byas te/ gom gang mdun spos sgos bsgyur bcos la rmadi sdus bting pa de red/ yin na'ang / spyi tshogs nyams nyes kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu

mtshan ni gong ma'i khyim rgyud gtso byas pa'i sku drag stobs shugs kyis tshod 'dzin med par sger dbang sa zhing (thun tshang dang then krong)bzung ba dang tsho 'bangs lam lugs yin pas/ hring te rgyal sras kyis rgyu mtshan de ma mkhyen pas/ khong gi bsgyur bcos ni mtha' 'khyol ba zhig ma yin no//622lor hring te rgyal sras kyi dgongs pa rdzogs rjes/ gsar bcos las don gyi mtshams chad/ su'u wo ru'u lu gtso byas pa'i su'u lo'i khyim rgyud kyis slar yang dbang cha gcig 'dzin byas te/ hring te rgyal sras kyi sras hran pe tā shung zhes pa bkrongs pa ma zad/ rang tshang gi go sa gong ma tshang las mtho bar brtsis shing / tha na mngon gsal 'dzems bag med par gong ma tshang gi mnga' zhabs sa cha su'u lo tshang la bcad sprod byed dgos zer/ btsan po dbang shed can rnams kyi btsan sgril dmag 'khrug gi rgyun ma chad pa'i steng /lo rer lo mthun du than skyon dang mu ge byung bas/ spyi tshogs ni lhag tu lhing 'jags med par gyur to/skabs der gong ma hung ci khri la bzhugs mod/ kho mo ni gnyon chung nus med kyi rgyal mo zhig red/ kho mor rgyal sras gnyis yod par gcig la krung tā shung zer zhing cig shos la tā ha'e rin zer/ rgyal sras krung tā shung gis nan yon ching an dge rgan du brten nas krung go'i rig gnas sbyangs/ nan yon ching an ni krung gor song nas lo ngo 32ring la krung go'i rig gnas sbyangs pas de la shin tu byang chub par 'dug khong gi slob ma gzhan zhig ste thing yon len tsu'u (de la krung khrin len tsu'u yang zer)dang krung tā shung rgyal sras gnyis blo sems gcig mthun gyi grogs por gyur pas/ nam rgyun bsgyur bcosabyas nas rgyal khab skyong ba'i jus chen la gsang ba'i sgo nas gros mol byed kyi 'dug la/ de nas rim bzhin gsar bcos kyi phyogs khag cig grub/nanayon ching an dang btsun pa men (krung go ru lo 24lhag ring /ṭīkas

myangs)zhes pa sogs krung gor slob grwar 'gro myangs pa'i slob ma rgan pa rnams kyis rgyun du/ 6 nges par du krung go thang rgyal rabs mig dper blangs nas/ gong ma rgyal po'i dbang char shugs snon byas te/ sgrig gzhi cha tshang ba'i rgyal khab cig 'dzugs dgos zhes tsha 'bod gyis pas gsar bcos kyi re ba je drag tu song /645lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 12nyin/ hphe yan pan ke zhes pa'i pho brang gi the ci tshom chen du/ khro zhan gyi pho nyar bsu ba byed pa'i mdzad sgo'i steng / krung tā shung rgyal sras kyis skabs de dang bstun nas rnyog slong zhing glo bur du su'u wo ru'u lu la 'jab rgol byas pas su'u wo ru'u lu bsad de ra ba'i nang g.yugadus mtshungs su gsar bcos phyogs khag gis ci dbye hpha shin zhes pa'i dgon pa gnas gzhi byas nas dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ su'u wo tshang gi shul lhag stobs shugs dang gting thag gcod par 'thab rgyu'i thag bcad/ zla 6pa'i tshes 13nyin/ su'u wo ru'u lu yi pha su'u wo sha dbyi zhes pas da ni rang phyogs rtsa ba nas pham pa rtogs te rang nyid la me bsgron nas rang srog bkum/lo ngo chig brgya lhag ring dbang chen kher 'dzin byas pa'i su'u wo tshang gi khyim rgyud mthar mjug rmeg med du gyur/ zla 6pa'i tshes 14nyin/ su'u wo tshang gis go sar bskos pa'i gong ma hung ci zhes pa rgyal po'i khri las phab te/ kho mo'i gcung po ching (ṣṭha)zhes pa gong ma'i khri la bkod/ de la gong ma zha'o te (67)zer zhing / lo rtags la (tā hwa mi btags te/ rgyal sa yang nan po (deng skabs kyi tā pan yin)ru spos/ srid dbang gsar pa'i gtso snying mi sna ni gsar bcos phyogs khag nang gi rgyal sras krung tā shung dang sku drag chen po krungakhrin len tsu'u yin la/ btsun pa men dang ku'o zhang shon li (nan yon ching an dang mnyam du kung gor slob sbyong du 'gro myangs)ni 6 rgyal khab kyi kun sdusan mkhas pa mi ru bskos/(chab srid kyi blo 'dri sa/)

gsar bcos phyogs khag la rgyal po'i pho brang gi srid 'gyur khrod rgyal kha thob pa'i phyi lo ste 646lo'i zla dang por/ rtsom yig mgo ru brjod pa'i gsar bcos kyi bka' yig de khyab bsgrags byas/ de'i 'phror rgyal yongs kyi khyab khongs su bcos bsgyur rab dang rim pa byas shing de'i nang don gtso bo ni phyogs gsum yin pa gsham du gsal/gcig dpal 'byor steng / tsho 'bangs lam lugs med par btang ste/(gong ma'i srid gzhung gi lag shes bzo las kyi tsho 'bangs de'i nang mi thenargyal yongs kyi sa zhing dang mi dmangs yod dgu rgyal khab la dbang ba byas/6 pan then rtsis sprod kyi khrims mi gtan 'khel byas nas/ mi grangs ltar du sa zhingabago sprod byas te/ lo drug la thengs gcig bgo/ bud med (lo drug yan)la thob pa'i zhing skal ni skyes pa'i 273yin la/ g.yog mo'i zhing skal 173yin/(khyim bdag la sprod pa) sa zhing de ni tshe gang bor spyod chog cing tshe las 'das rjes phyir sprod dgos/ sa zhing blangs pa'i mi yis rgyal khab la dpya khral mjal dgos/ de la 'bru rigs 'bul dgos pa dang / mi gcig gis lo gcig la nyin bcu rer 'u lag byed dgos/ rten 'bul la lo rer ras khri tse bcu gnyis 'bul dgos/gnyis/ chab srid steng / dpon po'i lam lugs bsgyur bcos byas nas/ mi rabs bar du rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha dmigs bsal can med par bzos te/ krung dbyang gi gcig sdud dbang cha 'dzin pa'i rgyal khab kyi las khungs btsugs/ krung dbyang la dpon po gnyis dang /(mchod dpon gyis mchod 'bul la bdag gnyer dang / srid dpon gyis srid don gnyer dgos)hring (phra)brgyad dang tha'e (6)gcig gi sgrig gzhi btsugs/ sa khul du zhing chen (༅)dang con dang (7)li (2)(2 dang4 'dra ba)bcas rim pa mi 'dra ba'i las khungs btsugs/ de dag la dpon po1 dī/sa

nas bdag skyong byed du bcug de'i nang zhing chen dang con gyi dpon po krung dbyang gis bsko 'jog byed cing li yi dpon po sa gnas kyi tsho dpon gyis 'gan 'khur dgos/gsum/ dmag don steng / dmag mi bsdu ba'i lam lugs lag bstar byas/ rgyal sa ru gzhung srung sde lnga btsugs/ sa gnas su dmag dpung gi tshogs sde btsugs shing de'i dbang cha krung dbyang la dbang /bsgyur bcos kyi bgrod lam ni de'i 'dra'i snyoms po ma yin te/ bsgyur bcos kyi 'go bcoms ma thag dbang thang can gyi khyim rnying tshos ngo log byas pa'i don rkyen rab dang rim pa byung / 652lor slobs tshe/ pan then lam lugs da gzod ha lam dngos su gtan la phab thub pa byung ba dang khyim tho yang btsugs/ yin na'ang gong ma zha'o te tshe las 'das rjes/ rgyal sras dbyug rma (76)gtso byas pa'i rnying zhen phyogs khag gi stobs shugs kyis blo log rgyu'i lkog g.yo byas pas/ gong ma'i srid gzhung gis 664lor dbang stobs can gyi khyim tshang rnying bar sa zhing dang tsho 'bangs skor zhig dbang pa'i lam lugs slar gso mi byed ga med byung / 672lor/ 'jar pan rgyal nang du gong ma'i go sa rtsod pa'i 'thab rtsod byung zhing / rtsod mkhan gtso bo ni rgyal sras he tā rin ( lko4)dang rgyal sras tā dbyug (lkoṣṭha)gnyis red/ phan tshun 'thab pa'i mjug 'bras ni he tā rin la rgyal kha thob pas rgyal po'i go sa blangs shing / de la gong ma than wu'u ((7)zer/ gong gi zing cha la chu 'brug lo'i zing cha zer/ btsan dbang stobs shugs che ba'i khyim rgyud rnying ba tshor nang 'khrug nang rdung rdeg tshabs chen thebs pas/ gong ma then wu'u la mngon par mtho ba'i dbang thang yod pa gtan 'khel byas/ 676lor/ gong ma then wu'u yis 664lor slar gso byas pa'i dbang stobs can gyi khyim tshang gi dki/sdu bsal dbang cha med par bzos/ (cing g.yu yon gyi 'dul khrims〉

zhes pa gtan du phab ste/ tā hwa gsar bcos kyi 'bras bu khrims lugs kyi rnam par gtan du phab/ de bzhin du dus rabs phyed ka tsam gyi 'thab rtsod brgyud/ tā hwa gsar bcos mthar thug yongs su grub/mngon gsal dod po zhig la/ tā hwa gsar bcos ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyis gong nas mar du lag bstar byas pa'i chab srid kyi bsgyur bcos zhig yin la/ de ni 'jar pan gyi spyi tshogs gna' rabs bran g.yog lam lugs nas dus rabs bar ma'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs su brgal ba'i mtshon rtags kyang red/ tā hwa gsar bcos kyis sku drag gis sa zhing btsan bsdu byed par sngon 'gog dang / sku drag gis sa zhing dang tsho 'bangs yongs su bzung ba bcings 'grol byas nas/ tsho 'bangs mang che ba pan then lam lugs 'og gi zhing par gyur/ thon skyed pa la rgyal khab nas sa zhing thob/ sa bogs dang 'u lag gi 'gan khur yod kyang de la tshad bkag yod pas sngar dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba red/ de bzhin du tsho 'bangs kyis bran g.yog gi ngal rtsolakhyed pa'i go gnas 'gyur te/ rang btsan gyi rang bzhin nges can zhig thob pas/ thon skyed kyi brtson sems la mthor 'degs byung stabs/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas skul spel byas/ de'i dbang gis tā hwa gsar bcos kyi 'bras bu ni/ tsho 'bangs bran g.yol lam lugs ha lam rtsa ba nas mjug sgril ba dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi thon skyed 'brel ba thog mar grub pa de yin no//147

krung go dngasnar pan rgyal khab gnyis kyi'ag gnas spel res kyi zhog stegatsun pa can yin/krung go dang ljar pan gnyis kyis gna' snga mo'i dus nas phan tshun la 'gro 'ong byed myangs/ rgya yig gi 〈lo rgyus deb ther〉(〈4 7〉)zhes pa'i nang du gong ma chin hri hong gi rnam thar brjod dus/ gong ma des zhu'o hphu'u zhes pa phing le lha'i gling phran du 'chi med tshe ring gi sman mchog 'tshol du mngags kyang phyir ma 'ongs par gar song cha med du gyur zhes bkod yod/deng skabs ljar pan gyi ho ko hran (777)rdzong zhin kung (0lha)grong khyer du rgya zhu'e hphu'u yi dur sa zhig yod pa/ ngag rgyun du kho rang de dus rgya mtshor brgal nas ljar pan du 'byor zhing krung go'i rig gnas yul der khyer 'ongs zer/ de la khungs yod med da dung zhib 'jug bya dgos mod/ cis kyang(han yig rjes ma tung dbyi'i rnams thar〉(〈chom 〉)nang ches snga mor krung go dang ljar pan gnyis kyi 'gro 'ongs bkod pa gsham gsal/5kong lu'u krung yon (lkos zlo)gyi lo gnyis par/(spyi lo 57lo)ljar pan gyi legs skyes khyer nas gong mar mjal du 'ongs/ pho nya des rang gis rang la tā spru zer/gong ma kong lu'u yis kho la tham long gnang khahan shar ma'i gong ma kong wu'u yis gnang ba'i gser gyi tham ka 'di/spyi lo 1784lor ljar pan gyi kre te (lhum)gling phran du rnyed pas/ gong smos lo rgyus ni dngos don yin pa ra sprod byas/ de ltar brtsis na/ krung go dang ljar pan gnyis kyi phan tshun 'gro 'ong la lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi lo rgyus yod do//14bye'i rjes su/ krung go dang ljar pan gyi phan tshun gyi 'gro 'ongs rgyun ma

chad pa red/ ches 'phyi yang dus rabs 5par/ rgya'i yi ge ljar pan la spel zhing dar 'go bcoms/ rgya yig sgra rtags su bzung nas ljar pan skad cha yig ngor phab/ dus rabs 6pa'i dus mjug tu su'e rgyal rabs btsugs rjes/krung go dang ljar pan bar gyi 'gro 'ongs sngar las kyang je mang la song / 6 tā dbye lo gsum pa'i lor (607lo)/ ljar pan gyi rgyal po rdo li si sbe khu yis pho nya brdzangs nas mjal bar 'ongs/’ ljar pan gyis sngar skam sa chen po las gnas spos 'ongs pa'i mi las bar brgyud nas krung go'i rig gnas sbyong ba'i byed thabs de bsgyur nas/ thad kur su'o rgyal rabs la pho nya dang slob ma/btsun pa sogs mngags nas krung go'i rig gnas slob sbyong byas/ mi de dag gru gzings thog tu lngar pan gyi gling phran so so nas rlabs chen po dgung la 'phyur zhing mu mtha' bral ba'i rgya mtshor bskyod nas dka' ba tshad med myangs rjes/ da gzod krung hwa sa gzhi chen po'i steng slebs la/ bkres la zas dang skom la chu ltar krung go'i rig gnas sbyangs/ de'i nang mi kha shas krung go ru lo ngo 30lhag la bsdad/ su'e rgyal rabs kyis kyang mdza' mthun gyi pho nya ljar pan du mngags myangs te/ dper na 608lor su'e rgyal rabs kyi gong ma su'e dbyang ti (lo67)yi pho nya tpa'o hri ching (0tsho lta)zhes pa shar phyogs lngar pan du song bar ljar pan mi dmangs kyi dga' bsu thob/ krung go'i rig gnas dar khyab tu song ba des/ ljar pan gyi tā hwa gsar bcos byung bar thad kur skul 'ded kyi nus pa bton/ btsun pa can krin ni dus rabs bar mar krung go dang ljar pan gnyis kyi rig gnas brje res lo rgyus steng gi rmad du byung ba'i mtshon byed mi sna zhig red/tā hwa gsar bcos kyi rjes su/ lngar pan gyis krung go'i rig gnas bsdu len byed rgyu ni lhag tu dgos gal che bar gyur/ 630lo nas bzung / thang rgyal rabs su pho nya dang slob ma/ btsun pa mang po rgyun chad med snar

mngags nas slob sbyong byed du bcug skabs der/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyang ljar pan du dar 'go brtsams pas/ krung gor mngags pa'i btsun pa ni nyin re las nyin rer je mang la song / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang srung skyong byed ched/ ljar pan gyi gong ma rgyal pos sangs rgyas chos lugs ni ches nus shugs ldan pa'i dbang sgyur bsam blo ru brtsis pas/dgon pa gsar 'dzugs rgya chen byas nas/ nang pa'i chos lugs dar spel gnang / sangs rgyas chos lugs la dar spel byung ba des yang / krung go'i rig gnas bsdu len byed pa'i thabs lam zhig tu gyur/ dus rabs 8pa'i dus stod du/ lngar pan du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar nas lo ngo nyis brgya lhag 'gor bas btsun pa'i grangs ka shin tu mang yang / btsun pa dang btsun ma rnams kyis srung bya'i tshul khrims cha tshang zhig bzos med cing / tshad ldan du rab byung sgrub pa'i lam lugs kyang gtan du ma phab pas chos pa tsho rgya yan du shor pa dang / ga sa ga ru tshul khrims dang 'gal ba'i don gyis khengs 'dug pas/ de ni ljar pan gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs 'phel rgyas go rim nang 'phral du thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don chen por gyur/de'i phyir/ 733lor rung ru'e (lko )dang phu'u kra'o (rsā༅)zhes pa'i btsun pa gnyis thang rgyal rabs su phebs nas/ gong ma'i bka' bzhin du 'dul khrims la byang ba'i krung go'i bla ma skyes chen zhig ljar pan du gdan 'dren pa'i 'gan dang du blangs/ 742lo'i dgun stod du/ khong gnyis dbyang kri'u (77)du phebs nas tā men dgon pa (lko.arsha)ru btsun pa ming grags can can krin ( 〉rsā)dang mjal nas/ khong nyid ljar pan du phebs par gdan 'dren zhus/btsun pa can krin (688 — 763lo) gyi skya ming la khron g.yu (glor)ze/ /zlo / khong ni cang su'u zhing chen gyi cang dbyin (ṣṭha༅)rdzong gi mi yin/

lo ngo bcu bzhi'i stong dbyang kri'u tā yun dgon par (shārkersha)song nas chos sgor zhugs te rab byung bsgrubs/ cung ma 'gor par lo dbyang dang khrang an sogs su phebs nas bla ma grags can du ma'i mdun du chos gsan/ khong nyid kyis sbyong bar hur brtson 'bad 'bungs dang chos la dka' spyad /ribartson zhib gnang ba ma zad/ da dung chos rispra /dupa sdirā kārji kṣiṃ shā gyi /zlo /( // btsun pa can krin gyi sku brnyan/sogasasbyong bar mnyam bzhag gnang / dgung lo rtsa drug pa nas bzung /khong nyid dbyang kri'u tā ming dgon par bzhugs nas chos gsungs shing 'dul khrims kyi gzhung lugs spel mdzad gnang / thang rgyal rabs kyi kha'e yon then pa'o (6zalkotsho)lo yi bar/ khong nyid hu'e nan cang pe (ṣṭhatshe 'ize'i)sa khul gyi gzhan la rab byung sgrub mkhan gyi bla ma ming grags can du gyur pa ma zad/ khong la da dung spyan rgyang ring po dang blo rtsa brtan po yod pas/khong gi thugs su nang pa'i chos 'di phyogs bzhi kun tu spel nas/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las 'grol rgyu ni/ sangs rgyas chos lugs pa zhig gis nges par du bsgrub dgos pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin dgongs yod/rong du'o dang phu'u kra'o gnyis dbyang kri'u du phebs nas btsun pa can krin ljar pan du chos spel bar rga/dan drangs pa'i skabs/ khong nyid dgung lo 55slebs yod/ khong gis rang gi slob ma bcu phrag du ma yod par/ zu khyod tsho'i nang lngar pan du chos spel bar 'gro mkhan e yod mices dris pas na/slob ma chos yun tsam kha mi grags la/ cung tsam 'gor rjes ming la thastu din

(76)zhes pa'i slob ma zhig gis lan du smyo rgyal khab de yul thag shin tu ring bas/ lam bar du gson thabs med/ rgya mtsho mu mtha' med pas/ mi brgya song yang gcig slobs pa dkon zhes zer/ de nas can krin gyis blo brtan po'i ngang 6 chos kyi don la srog la 'joms pas ci/ khyod tsho mi 'gro na kho bo 'gro'o mi gsungs/ de nas khong gi rang don rgyab skyur gyi snying stobs kyis sems pa bkug pas/ zhang yan sogs slob ma bcu gcig kyang khong dang mnyam du ljar pan du 'gro bar thag bcad/ de nas bzung khong dang khong gi slob bu tshos shi gson 'dzem med du thengs drug tu shar phyogs ljar pan yul du skyod pa'i sobarjid nyams ldan zhing yid dbang 'gug pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'go bcomacho 42/lo/ nas 748lo'i bar/ btsun pa can krin thengs lnga la shar phyogs su bskyod de/ dka' ngal du ma khyad du bsad nas phar phyogs su thon par hur brtson gnang rung / thengs gnyis la rang byung gi bar gegs thebs pa dang / thengs gsum la mis bzos bar chad btang / shar phyogs su skyod thengs ba'i ba pham rjes/ can krin ni gzhan yul 'grum nas hphu'u kri'u (rsā 7)yi khrong hphu'u dgon par (lkochorsha) mi bzhugs thabs med byung /748lor khong nyid thengs lnga par shar phyogs su skyod rgyu'i gra sgrig mdzad/ zla 6par khrong hphu'u dgon pa nas gsang ba'i ngang gru la bzhugs nas shar phyogs ljar pan phyogs su phebs/ zla 10par rgya mtsho'i steng char rlung drag por 'phrad pa dang gru yi kha lo bsgyur khag por gyur pas/ gru kha lho phyogs su bskor nasarlabs kyis ded cing mjug mthar ha'e nan gling phran ( tshelo)steng slebs shing de bzhin du thengs lnga par shar phyogs su bskyod pa'ang ma 'grub pa red/ de nas can krin sogs kong kri'u (97)la phebs par/ yul de'i se/ ༵ mang pos de ru bzhugs dgos pa'i re ba yang yang zhus pas/ tā yun

dgon du lo gcig tsam bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel/ skabs der yid skyo ba'i don zhig byung ba la ljar pan gyi btsun pa rung ru'e tshe las 'das/ khong nyid gong ma'i bka' bzhin thang rgyal rabs su phebs nas bgrang bya bcu lhag song zhing / can krin dang mnyam du thengs lnga la rgya mtsho'i steng shar phyogs su bskyod de/ dka' ba tshad med myangs na'ang / phugs 'dun bzang po ma 'grub par gzhan yul du dgongs pa rdzogs/ cung ma 'gor bar btsun pa can krin la ngal dub myangs drag pas snyung gzhi phog pa ma zad/ tsha ba chen pos spyan gnyis gtses pas spyan gnyis ka long bar gyur/phyir dbyang kri'u la log pa'i lam bar du/ yang skyo gdung skye ba'i don zhig byung bar/ slob dpon dang skyid sdug mnyam myong du shar phyogs su thengs lnga la skyod pa'i slob bu zhang yan yang tshe las 'das/ khong grongs khar can krin logs su bos nas/ byams brtse che ba'i slob dpon gyi mdun du dkyil dkrung du bzhugs nas dgung du gshegs/ spos dud dang skyo gdung gis khengs pa'i ngang tshul khrod can krin lags kyang rang dbang med par spyan las mchi ma shor nas bshum mo//yin na'ang / btsun pa can krin gyi shar phyogs ljar man du phebs nas nang pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i blo sems la g.yo ba med pas/ 753lor ljar pan nas thang rgyal rabs su theng yon ching ho ( a ma)sogs pho nya thengs bcu mngags 'ongs shing / phyir ljar pan du log khar ched du dbyang kri'u yi lung zhin dgon par (2〉rsha)song nas bla chen can krin la mjal ba dang /rgyal khab kyi tshab byas nas khong rang ljar pan du phebs nas 'dul khrims spel dgos par dngos su gdan 'dren zhus/ dgung lo 66la slebs shing spyan gnyis long ba'i can krin lags kyis kyang lngar pan du phebs rgyur khas mchis/'on kyang srid gzhung gis lung zhin dgon par nyen zon byas nas canā byin

ljar pan du phebs par bkag 'gog byas/ khong gi slob bu rin kun (khrir)gyis gnas tshul de shes rjes/ rang nyid kyi gru chung gtsang po'i 'gram du bsgug tu bcug nas slob dpon nyid gsang pa'i sgo nas gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byas/zla 10pa'i tshes 19nyin gyi mtshan mor/ can krin lags kyis slob bu 'ga' khrid de mun pa stug po dang bstun nas/ rin kun gyi gru chung la bzhugs nas chu'i bzhur rgyun ltar du shar phyogs su phebs shing / hong si phu'u ( ma )ru ljar pan gyi thang la mngags pa'i pho nya'i rgya mtshor skyod pa'i gru chen steng bzhugs nas rgya mtsho chen por kha phyogs nas shar lngar pan phyogs su bskyod/thengs 'di'i shar skyod mkhan la btsun pa 20lhag yod/ nyin 40tsam gyi dka'akhyad mtsho skyod byas shing / rgya mtsho'i rba chu'i byabs khrus brgyud mthar/da gzod tsa nyi ma 'char pa'i yul mi ljar pan la 'byor/ 754lo'i zla 2par/btsun pa can krin sogs ljar pan gyi rgyal sa ne lang (lkoṣṭha)zhes par phebs shing mi mang po'i dkyil du bskor nas rim bzhin tung tā dgon chen (lkolkorsha)du phebs so//ljar pan ru mtho sa nas gong ma rgyal po dang dma' sa nas 'bangs mi ser su yin rung / mtshan snyan dgung la thon pa'i bla chen can krin ljar pan du phebs par spro sems 'khol pa'i ngang dga' bsu byas/ cin krin lags kyis kyang 2tshe srog la ma 'dzems par ljar pan du 'byor ba 'di ni kho bo'i lo ngo du ma'i ring gi 'dun pa yin zhing / da ni re 'dun 'di dngos su grub bo mi zhes gsungs so// de nas khong gis krung go nas khyer 'ongs pa'i rin po che ngo mtshar can sna tshogs ljar pan gyi gong ma'i gzhung la phul/ de'i nang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang / byang chub shing gi 'bras bus bzos ba'i phreng ba/ yig gzungs par ma sogs 'du/ cin krin lags kyis da dung rgya yul na/ nur 'ongs pa'i bstan bcos brgya phrag du ma ste/ dper na/ 〈〈dam chos

padma dkar po'i mdo 〉〉(〈698〉〉)dang 〈〈dkon mchog brtsegs pa 〉〉((lkorsā4〉〉)dang 〈〈tshig le'u phye ba 〉〉(〈lko42〉〉〉sogs bstan bcos tung tā dgon par gdan drangs nas/ ched du chos dpe bshu ba'i las khungs btsugs nas btsun pa tshor chos dpe bshus dar khyab tu gtong gi bcugacan krin lags ljar pan du slebs pa nas bzung / ljar pan gyi gong ma'i gzhung gis khong nyid la 'dul khrims lam lugs cha tshang du bzo ru bcugakhong gis sku ngo mas gong ma'i yum chen dang gnam bskos gong ma/ rgyal sras bcas la go rim bzhin dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang / dge tshul khrin zhi'u (tshoṣṭha)zhes pa sogs mi 440lhag la rab byung bsgrubs/ 755lor/ can krin lags kyis rna lang tung tā dgon du tshul khrims gling zhes pa btsugs nas/ched du tshul khrims len mkhan rnams kyi gnas su gyur/ de'i nang rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i sku bzhengs yod/ zla 10pa nas bzung de ru sdom khrims dang du len pa'i mdzad sgo tshogs 'go bcoms/ dus de nas bzung ljar pan du mi zhig chos sgor zhugs tshe gong ma'i gzhung gis chog mchan ltar/ ched du tshul khrims len par 'gan bzhes pa'i dge slong gi mdun du rab byung ma bsgrub na/gong ma'i gzhung gis khas len pa'i btsun pa zhig tu mi 'ongs pa red/can krin lags kyis khong gi tshe srog gi ches mtha' mjug gi lo 10ring ljar pan du bzhugs shing / de'i ring khong dang khong gis slob bu tsho dang mnyam du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ba ma zad/ krung go dang ljar pan bar gyi mdza' brtse'i 'gro 'ong dang rig gnas brje res phyogs don chen du ma mdzad pa gtso bo gsham gsal las mtshon yod/gcig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ba/can krin lags kyis gsar du bzhengs pa'i tung tā dgon du tshul khrims gling btsugs nas chos gzhung gsungs shing / rgyun du mi 30༷༷snag

gis khong gis gsungs la nyan/ khong ni ljar pan nang bstan gyi 'dul khrims grub mtha'i srol gtod mkhan yin la/ ljar pan then tha'e grub mtha' yi srol 'byed mkhan yang yin/ can krin lags kyis lngar pan gyi btsun pa'i sdom pa gtan 'khel byas pas/ de nas bzung smyo ljar pan gyi sdom pa rim bzhin je btsan du song zhing / bla ma rabs nas rabs su mar brgyud pas/ sa gzhi kun tu de bzhin du khyab/ ’gnyis/ sku ngo mas gtso bzhugs gnang nas thang kra'o thi dgon pa (jos rsha)bzhengs/can krin lags dang khong gi slob bu tshos 759lo'i zla 8par ljar pan gyi rgyal sar brjid chags mig dbang 'phrog pa'i dgon pa ste thang kra'o thi dgon bzhengs/ chos dgon de'i phyi dbyibs ni krung go'i chos dgon gyi dbyibs dpe ru blangs nas bzos pas/ ljar pan ar las lo rgyus stong du rnam pa gsar gtod dang shugs rkyen shun tu che ba'i brtsigs dngos su gyur stabs/da lta'i bar du da dung 'jigs med pas/ lngar pan then pheng (lkog)dus skabs kyi ches rlabs che ba'i ar las brtsigs dngos shig yin no// can krin lags dang khong gi slob bu tshos bzhengs pa'i lha'i sku brnyan ni/ rtsi skam po'i thabs kyis bzos pas/ de la mthug cing brtan pa/ brjid nyams che la nyams dod che ba'i khyad chos ldan pas/ bzo rtsal gyi yang rtser son 'dug pas lha sku la gson nyams dod po ldan/ krung go'i thang rgyal rabs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi gzi 'od thang kra'o thi dgon du rab tu 'phros pas/ ljar pan then pheb dus rabs kyi sgyu rtsal tshad mthor grub par skul spel byas yod/gsum/ krung go'i gso ba rig pa'i shes bya dar spel byas pa/can krin lags gso ba rig par byang bas/ khong gis spyan shor yod kyang /zlos kyis sman gyi dbye ba 'byed thub/ ljar pan gyi gong ma dang gong

ma'i yum chen sogs la sman gso mdzad myangs/ can krin gyi gsang ba'i sman tho ni ljar pan du dar khyab che bas/ lngar pan gso ba rig pa'i 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes chen po gnang yod/gzhan yang can krin lags kyis ljar pan du drangs pa'i spus legs yig gzugs 'bri rtsal gyi bcoms chos te dper na wang zhi kri dang wang zhan kri pha bu gnyis kyis dngos su bris pa'i yig gzugs dang gtsag drub ri mo bcas kyis kyang ljar pan gyi rig gnas dar 'phel la shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod/ljar pan mi dmangs kyis can krin lags la dad gus chen po byed pas/khong la slob dpon mtsho las brgal (7 lko 7)du 'bod/ gnam bskos gong ma chen po khron rin (cho42)gyi lung las/ can krin la 6 hwa shang chen po zhes mtshan gnang nas/ 6 nam yang bkur ste dang dad gus byed dgos ’ pa'i bka' bsgrags so//763lo'i zla 6par/ can krin nyid kyis da ni rang nyid 'jig rten 'dir cher mi bzhugs pa mkhyen nas/ rjes don bkod sgrig mdzad tshar rjes dkyil dkrung du bzhugs nas dgongs pa rdzogs shing / de dus khong nyid dgung lo 76la slebs yod/ ngag rgyun du khong nyid dgong du gshegs rjes kyi nyin gsum ring khong gi dbu la da dung tsha drod yod cing / gdung bzhus pa'i dus su ri lung kun dri zhim gyis khengs par bshad/ khong nyid sku ma gshegs gongadu/ slob bu rin ce (khuzlo)zhes pas sku ngo ma'i tshad kyi 'dra sku zhig bzos shing / de ni ljar pan lo rgyus yig tshang steng cu dus rabs shig gi mchog gyur dang / mdzes nyams do zla dben pa ’ zhes su brjod pa de yin/ da lta'i bar du nyar ba'i lngar pan gyi ches snga mo'i ches phul du byung ba'i 'jim rkos sgyu rtsal gyi bcoms chos yin pas rgyal khab kyi nor bu la gyur/ bla chen can krin gyi mdzad rjes bka' drin nam yang brjed thabs med pa zhig yin te/15/nga

nyid kyi byams brtse ldan pa'i bzhin ras dang rgya mtsho'i gting dang 'dra ba'i mkhyen rabs/ 'gyur ba med pa'i snying stobs/ bla na med pa'i shes rtogs kyi 'jon thang gis krung go dang ljar pan gnyis kyi mi dmangs kyi 6 yul khongs so sor yod kyang nyi zla gcig tu rol ba mizhes pa'i srol rgyun gyi brtse dung de lhag tu je zab tu gnang yod do//

mu nyam sme dang 〈khu ran gsung rab〉/a she ya'i nub lho'i khul gyi a rab gling phran phyed ma'i khyon rgya la spyi le gru bzhi ma 300lhag yod pas/ de ni 'dzam gling steng gi gling phran phyed ma che shos red/ gling phran phyed ma phal cher mu mtha' bral bye thang gis bzung zhing sa rgyu zhan pa'i zhing sa ni tsha ba che ba'i gnam gshes 'og tu yod/ gna' snga mo nas bzung / phyugs 'tsho ba'i mi rigs sbe sdulu en gyi mis (20705103 12lngalko)yul de'i 'khor yug sdug po'i nang 'tsho ba skyel bzhin 'dug kho tshos rtswa chu ded de ru 'bab cing / mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rnga mo dang ra ma/ rta sogs 'tsho bzhin 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba rol/ spyi lo dus rabs 5pa nas 6pa'i bar/ sbe sdulu en gyi mi rnams ni gdod ma'i kung hre'i lam lugs kyi dus rim nang gnas so//a rab gling phran phyed ma 'di ru sa zhing 'debs par 'phrod pa'i yul du bye thang spang ljongs nyung shas dang nub lho'i khul gyi ye men (1070ba /cika)sa khul las med/ ye men gyi gnam gshes dro zhing ljam la char chu yang 'dzoms pas/ 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhing las sa khul zhig yin pas/ mi rnams kyis 6 a rab kyi dga' tshal ’ zhes 'bod/ gna' snga mo'i dus te spyi lo sngon gyi 1000lo'i yas mas su/ yul de bran g.yog spyi tshogs su slebs zhing /mkhar grong gi rgyal khab kyang kha shas byung ngo //a rab gling phran phyed ma'i nub khul gyi mtsho 'gram sa khul du/ ye men nas he sgre dzi (50382 ma cho)brgyud si ri a (5711 tha mas/༅)yi sdu/ ni/

gna' bo'i tshong lam zhig yin te/ tshong 'dren pa'i gru gzings kyis shar phyogs nas bskyel 'ongs pa'i tshong dngos mang po ye men nas sa la phab rjes/ 6 bye thang gru gzings ’ rnga mong la bkal nas tshong lam de brgyud si ri a ru bskyel ba dang de nas yo rab phyogs su skyel 'dren byed/ lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring / shar phyogs dang nub phyogs bar gyi tshong las kyi bgrod lam ring po'i steng / rnga mong ske yi dril bu'i sgra yis sing sing du sgrog cing / tshong ba'i ru khag ni rgyun chad med par kyag kyog lam du bgrod bzhin 'dug dus yun ring du 'gor bas na/ rim bzhin tshong sde'i bgrod lam gyi logs gnyis su/tshong pa tshos ngal gso sa'i sdod gnas re 'ga' byung zhing rim bzhin tshong las grong khyer du gyur/ de'i nang ches gal che ba'i grong khyer ni sme kha ( 5666tha'itshomeX)dang ya the ri sbu (18 6716 7747)gnyis yin/sme kha ni tshong lam gyi lte gnas su yod cing / dus rabs drug pa'i skabs su/ mi grangs kyang nyis khri lhag tu son la/ grong khyer nang dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshong las dang rgya khyon che ba'i tshong ra yod/ tshong pa'i ru khag gis de ru ngal gso ba ma zad/ da dung de ru tshong rgyag pa dang brgyud 'dren byed/ sme kha'i lte gnas su/ sgor dbyibs kyi khyams ring lha khang rnying pa 6 bkag dgon zhes pa yod cing / lha khang de'i lte bar rdo gru bzhi mas brtsigs dngos shig yod par khor sbe zer/(rdo gru bzhi ma'i khang pa zhes pa'i don yin la/krung go'i i si lem gyi rgya yig chos gzhung du (7 ste gnam gyi khang pa zer)rdo khang de'i shar lho'i zur gyi gyang ngos su skar rdo nag cing 'od bkra ba zhig shan yod/ ngag rgyun du rdo de ni gnam las mar lhung ba'i 6 mchog gyur gyi dngos po ’ zhig yin pas/ a rab kyi mi rnams kyis de la dad gus byed zer/kher sbe lha khang ni gna' rabs a rab kyi lha mang chos lugs kyi mchod gnas gardo ༵༵ gyur/ lo re'i dpyid dus su/ sa khul so so nas 'ongs pa'i a rab

kyi mi rnams sme kha ru 'ongs nas skar rdo der mjal bar 'ongs/ sbe sdulu en gyi mi yis kyang phyags khrid de chos tshogs steng 'ongs nas rang la mkho ba'i dngos rdzas dang (rje res byed/ skabs der sme kha la 'du 'dzi shin tu che zhing de ga'i gnas sdod mkhan mang che ba ni khi re si tsho pa'i mi red/ gdung rgyud tsho pa'i sku drag mang che ba ni tshong ba chen po yin pas/ kho tshos lo rer tshong zog dang bran g.yog gi tshong brgyab pa las khe spog gang mang blangs/ dus mtshungs su/ kho tshor da dung kher sbe lha khang srung ba dang dpya khral bsdu ba'i dmigs bsal dbang cha yod/ de bzhin du/ sku drag chen po dang lha khang gi mchod bdag tsho 'phral du phyug por gyur nas spyi tshogs kyi gong rim du gyur/ sme kha grong khyer gyi dbul po dang bran g.yog tshor sku drag tshos ya nga med pa'i bshu gzhog dang btsir gnon byas te bran du bkol pas nyin re las nyin rer dbul phongs su gyur stabs/ gral rim gyi 'gal ba dza drag can du song zhing /spyi tshogs la'ang zing cha langs pa dang gyen log gyi don rkyen yang je mang je mang du byung ngo //ye men sa khul gyi shar nub gnyis kyi tshong lam de yang / dus rabs bar ma'i dus stod la thon dus snga sa nas 'jags po med par gyur/ shar phyogs ro ma gyi mna' mthun rgyal khab e tho phi a (2 610918 tshi ma ༅)yis dmag dpung drangs nas 525lor ye men yongs su bzung / 570lor i ran gyis e tha phi a'i mi phyir skyod btang nas de'i tshab tu 628lor phyir 'then byas pa'i bar du ye men bzung / dus yun ring po'i dmag 'khrug gis a rab kyi ri lung kun sme ngag gis bkang zhing / a rab mi dmangs la mnar gcod tshad med thebs pa dang / shar nub tshong lam yang phal cher mkho med du lus/ tshong las 'phel rgyas su gtong ched dang mi dmangs la gnya' gnon bya ched/ a rab sku drag tsho la gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab/ gcig gyur ༵ /da

dbang dang dad sems shig gi dgos mkho byung / dus rabs 7par byung ba'i i si lem gyi chos lugs kyis dgos mkho 'di mtshon pa red/dus rabs 6pa'i sngon du/ a rab kyi mi la chos lugs dad pa du ma yod/sme kha'i kher sbe lha khang nang lha rnam pa sna tshogs bkur yod cing de'i nang tsho pa so so'i srung lha gzhi bdag yod/ de'i thog da dung chu mig dang brag rdo bcas kyi rang byung gi lha sogs kyang bkur yod/ de'i nang khe re si tsho pa'i gtso lha rdo.an lha mi (855 67 de ni lha zhes pa'i don yin) ni ches mtho shos kyi lha na/ i si lam gyi chos lugs kyi ston pa'i rkarathong sgyuming la mu ham sme sde (55687477 7༅ /tshe sne'akhrini sa )zer/ 570lor sme kha grong khyer gyi sku /tsho drag tshong pa zhig gi khyim tu 'khrungs/ kho mi — tshos44/zang(634(yul du ma thon pa'i zla gnyis sngon la kho'i pha / snaX sna dze tshe las 'das/ lo drug la thon skabs ma 60/'i sto yang tshe las 'das/ lo brgyad dgu tsam la thon skabs kho rang stor skyong byed mkhan gyi —a mes yang shi bas/ kho'i a khus kho rang a rab kyi yi ger bkod pa'istor skyong mi byed ga med byung stabs/ kho'i 〈khu ran gsang rabasnabyis pa'i dus ni shin tu skyo ba'i tshul du skyel stodagosabyung / de nas cung tsam nar son pa dang / lug dzi dang tshong pa tsho'i srung dmag byed myangs la/ rjes su yug mo phyug po ho sdi khre zhes pa dang mnyam du tshong las gnyer/ mu ham sme sde ni a rab sa khul dang a hphe ri kha byang ma kun tu 'grum myangs pas/ spyi tshogs kyi shes bya dang rang byung gi shes bya/chodi ṭīkas kyi shes bya sogs phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsags/ pho lo 25steng
