mo lo 40la son pa'i bud med ho sdi khre dang gnyen bsgrigs pas phyug po chen por gyur/ yin na'ang kho rang chos 'chad pa'i bya 'gul la shin tu spro/ kho'i sems su sku drag gi khe phan gyi ched du a rab la gcig gyur gyi chos lugs dad pa zhig dgos snyam par 'dug610lor mu ham sme sde pho lo 40la lon pa'i dus su/ kho rang sme kha grong khyer gyi rje la (61 /lnga lkoṣṭha)ri bo'i brag khung zhig tu zhi ljam ngang sgom brgyab nas ri khrod du sdod 'go bcoms/ khos bshad pa ltar na/ nyin zhig an lha yis pho nya sga po li zhes pa mngags nas brag khung nang slebs shing / kho la 6 an lha'i tshab tu chos 'chad mkhan ’ zhes pa'i dbang bskur/ de ni an lhas kho la thengs dang por mu go rtogs sad 'jug mi gnang ba yin la/ an lhas gsung las/ mu tam sme sde ni ma 'ongs par lā sur (pho nya)du 'gyur nges yin zer pas/ dus de nas bzung kho rang an lha'i dgongs pa'i 'thus tshab ru nā spe mi (mngon shes can )tu gyur pa red/mu ham sme sde yis dgye'u yi chos lugs dang ye shu'i chos lugs kyi snying don kha shas ltar/ a rab kyi srol rgyun la 'phrod pa'i chos lugs gsar pa ste i si lam chos lugs gsar gtod byas/ i si lam (13187 lta mo༅)ni kha la nyan pa'am dad pa byas pa'i don red/ i si lam chos lugs kyis 6 an lha ’ ni lha nyag cig tu bkur nas tsa gnam sa dang bya dngos yod dgu an lha la dbang zer zhing / mngon shes pa mu ham smu sde ni an lha'i pho nya yin par bshad/ i si lam chos lugs la dad pa rnams la smu si lem (55367 lko 46tho)du 'bod cing / de ni an lha la dad pa dang mngon shes can gyi bka' la nyan mkhan gyi don red/mu ham sme sde yis lo ngo 20lhag ring chos spel te chos de'i snying bo bshad/khos bshad pa ltar na/ chos kyi snying don de dag ni an lha yis mngon ༵༵ pa

brgyud 'jig rten khams kyi mi rnams la 6 go rtogs sad 'jug ’ gnang zhing /de'i nang sngon shes pa la sme kha ru thob pa'i phu go rtogs sad 'jug le'u 86dang / sme sdi nā ru thob pa'i 6 go rtogs sad 'jug mile'u 28bcas bsdoms pa'i le'u 114yod/ mu ham sme sde'i slob bu tshos 6 go rtogs sad 'jug ’ de dag pags pa dang rdo leb/ bza' shing gi yan lag lug gi sog rus steng phab cing / dus rabs bdun par phyogs bsgrigs byas nas dpe cha dpar skrun byas/ de bzhin du i si lam chos lugs kyi bstan bcos 〈khu ran gsung rab 〉zhes byung zhing / khu ran (95 18baṣṭha༅)zhes pa ni klog deb ces pa'i don yin no//〈khu ran gsung rab 〉ni i si lam chos lugs kyi spyod lam kun gyi ches mtho'i tshad gzhi yin/ de ni an lha'i che go rtogs sad 'jug mi gi gsung ma yin par/ mu ham sme sde yis skabs de'i a rab spyi tshogs kyi gnad don sna tshogs la dmigs nas de dag thag gcod byed pa'i thabs shes bton pa yin pa smos med red//〈khu ran gsung rab 〉yi le'u dang po yongs bshus pa gsham tu gsal/dzisnying rje chen po can gyi an lha'i ming du/bsngags brjod yod tshad an lha nyid la dbang / 'dzam gling yongs kyi bdag po/snying rje chen po can gyi bdag po/ rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyin gyi bdag po/ nga rang tshos khyed la dad pa byed cing khyed la skyabs 'jug 'ba' zhig zhu/ khyed kyis nga rang tshor drang po'i lam du 'dren rgyu zhu/ khyed kyi mdzad pa'i lam ni/ sun 'byin thebs mkhan gyi lam ma yin la/ rmongs nor mkhan gyi lam yang ma yin no/ lha nyag cig can gyi chos lugs nan mos a rab gling phran phyed ma'i steng gi lha du mar dad pa'i chos kyi tshab byas pa des/ a rab sa khul gcig gyur du 'odasdu sna'i dngos yod re 'dun mtshon pa red/ i si lam gyi chos lugs kyis

smu si lem zhig yin phyin thams cad spun zla yin par 'dod la/ de bzhin du chos lugs kyi 'brel bas sngar gyi rus rgyud gnyen nye'i 'brel thag gi tshab byas pas/ a rab gling phran phyed ma gcig gyur du 'gro bar phan nus che/ 'on kyang / 〈khu ran gsung rab 〉yi nang du/ rang dbang can dang bran g.yog la so sor rang rang gi go gnas yod cing / go gnas mi 'dra ba'i mi la gnod 'tshe btang na/ skyin tshab mi 'dra ba sprod pa dang / sger dbang rgyu nor la srung skyob byed dgos pa nan du gtan 'khel byas yod/ de bas na gral rim la gyes 'gyur byung ba khrims mthun du brtsis te/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyi khe phan la srung skyob byas yod/ chos dpe des da dung dge sdig las 'bras dang / mi rnams kyis yin lugs tshul ldan dang kha nyan bzod bsran byed dgos pa dril bsgrags byas yod/ rgya che ba'i dbul po dang bran g.yog bsdu len bya ched/〈khu ran gsung rab sminang / snye pha ma la brtsi bkur dang gnyen nye bzang skyong /dwa phrug la snying rje/ dbul po la sbyin gtong / khyim mtshes nye ring dang bza' zla la gces sems yod pa/ mgron po la sne len gzab rgyas/ bran g.yog la gu yangs sne len byed pa'i skabs su zhes bkod cing / de ni spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba je lhod du gtong ba'i mos 'dun bcangs pa tsam yin no// 〈khu ran gsung rab 〉yis le tshan du ma spyad de chos lugs kyi mdzad sgo dang sgrig srol lam lugs la gsal bshad byas yod de/ smu si lem re res rtsa ba'i 'os 'gan lnga nges par du sgrub dgos pa thag gcod byas 'dug pa ste/ 6 byed las lnga zhes pa/’ gcig klog pa'i byed las/ an lha ni lha nyag cig yin zhing mu ham sme sde ni an lha'i pho nya yin par dad pa dang blor 'don dgos/gnyis/ phyag mchod kyi byed las/ nyin rer phyag thengs lnga 'tshal dgos/gza' 'khor rer spyi dmangs kyi phyag 'tshal bkur sti'i mdzad sgo thengs gcig tshogs dgos/ gsum/ sbyin pa'i byed las/ mi re res rgyu no/ ñtsha 17

40phul nas/ dbul por rogs ram dang lha khang bzo skrun byed spyad dang /srid gzhung gi 'gro song du bkol dgos/ de la gnam gyi byed las kyang zer/bzhi/ smyung gnas kyi byed las/ lo re'i smyung gnas kyi zla ba ste kha che'i lo'i tho'i zla 9pa'i nang / nyin dkar kha zas bza' mi chog lnga/ mchod mjal gyi byed las/ tshe gang bo'i nang sme kha'i khor sbe lha khang la thengs gcig mjal bar 'gro dgos pa bcas so//dang thog mu ham sme sde'i chos lugs dril bsgrags dang len byed mkhan la/ kho'i bza' zla dang pha spun gyi gcung po/ grogs po sogs nyung shas las med/ sme kha'i sku drag dang tshong pa phyug po tshos i si lam chos lugs dang len mi byed pa ma zad/ da dung thabs brgya jus stong gis mu ham sme sde la gnod 'tshe btang ste/ kho'i skad cha ni 6 ston pa'i 'chol gtam red )zer/ de bzhin du mu ham smu sde ni sme kha ru sdod thabs ma yod par/ 622lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 20nyin gyi mtshan mor/ kho dang kho'i grogs mchog sbe kher gnyis dang blo dkar pa'i dad ldan drug khrid de/ khyim las ri mgo'i brag khung du gnas spos zhing / myul zhib pas rjes snyeg par mgo bskor mthar ya the ri sbu (18 67167747)ru phyin/ de ni i si lam chos kyi snga mo'i lo rgyus steng gi don rkyen chen po zhig red/ de nas bzung / lo de ni i si lam chos lugs kyi srid lo'i rtsis 'go tshugs sa byas/ ya thi ri sbu la yang sme sdi nā (50718ba losmos)yi ming btags te/(mngon shes pa'i grong khyer zhes pa'i don) i si lam chos lugs kyi gnas mchog gsum (sme kha dang / sme sdi nā/ sgre ru sa lem bcas )nang gi ya gyal zhig tu gyur/sme sdi nā yi mis mgyogs por i si lam chos lugs dang len byas nas/mu ham sme sde'i stobs shugs mu mthud du je cher song / khos sme sdi nā lte gnas byadi spyazlo sme kha'i sku drag la ngo rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs yod tshad dang mnyam

'brel byas nas chos srid zung 'brel gyi lha dbang rgyal khab cig btsugs/de'i 'phror drag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas te nye 'khor gyi yul khongs btsan bsdu byas nas/ sme kha'i sku drag dang 'gran 'go brtsams/ mu ham sme sde yis dad ldan rnams la chos lugs dril bsgrags byas nas/ smu si lem rnams kyis an lha'i ched 'thab dgos par skul brda brgyab/628lor mu ham sme sde yis smu si lem mchod mjal tshogs skor khrid de/gnas mchog sme kha ru lo re'i mchod mjal la zhugs rgyu byas rung / sme kha'i sku drag tshos don der khas len ma byas/ phyogs gnyis kyis gros sol byas rjes/smu si lem mchod mjal du yong chog pa dang / phyogs gnyis kyi g.yul mtshams lo 10la 'jog rgyu sogs kyi chod yig bkod/ lo gnyis 'gor rjes sme kha'i sku drag tshos chod yig rtsis med rdog ral du btang / de'i phyir/ mu ham sme sde yis 630lor sme kha dmag drangs nas g.yul 'gyed byas/ sme kha sku drag gi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog thebs pa'i sbe rdu en gyi mi rnams kyis sme kha 'dul rgyu ni rang nyid la bcings 'grol gtong ba'i 'thab rtsod dang gcig tu brtsis nas/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud du g.yul sar zhugs nas mu ham sme sdi la rgyab skyor byas/ smu si lem gyi dmag dpung gi grangs tshad tshig 'bum lhag tu thon pas/ rngam rngam brjid brjid ngang sme kha'i mkhar sgor 'byor/ sme kha sku drag tshos ngo rgol byas pa 'phral du rdul du brlag nas mu ham sme sde yis sme kha grong khyer blangs/ khos kher sbe lha khang nang gi lha sku yod rgu bshig pa dang skar rdo nag po gcig pu shul du bzhag nas/ smu si lem rnams kyis mjal yul gyi mchog dngos su bsgyur pa dang / kher sbe lha khang yang kha che'i phyag khang la bsgyur pas/ i si lam chos lugs kyi mchod mjal byed gnas su gyur/sme kha phab pa ni/ mu ham sme sde yis i si lam chos lugs dar char bzung nas/ a rab gling phran phyed ma gcig gyur tu gtong ba'i gnad1 ṭīkag

rang bzhin gyi rgyal kha zhig red/ 630 — 631lor/ gling phran phyed ma'i tsho pa'i 'thus mi tsho sme kha ru 'ongs nas mu ham sme sde la mjal nas/ i si lam chos lugs la dad pa byed rgyu khyab bsgrags byas/ khas mi len pa'i tsho ba nyung shas dag i si lam dmag dpung gis cham la pham/ dus mtshams 'di la thon pa dang / a rab pa tsho'i gcig gyur gyi chos lugs dad pa ste i si lam gyi dar cha'i 'og gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig grub/ 6 mngon shes pa mu ham sme sde ni lha'i dbang dang srid dbang gcig lcog tu yod pa'i ches mtho'i gtso 'dzin du gyur/ sme sdi nā rgyal khab gsar pa'i chab srid lte gnas yin zhing / sme kha ni sngar mus su a rab kyi chos lugs lte gnas byas so//632lor mu ham sme sde sme kha ru mthar mjug gi mchod mjal la song zhing / phyir sme sdi nā ru log rjes/ si ri a ru dmag drangs nas pha rol 'dul grabs byed skabs/ glo bur du snyun gzhi zhig byung bas zla 6pa'i tshes 8nyin tshe las 'das/ kho'i tshe gang po'i nang gi mdzad rjes ches che shos ni i si lam chos lugs gsar gtod byas pa dang / chos lugs kyi stobs shugs la brten nas a rab gcig gyur tu gtong ba'i las don grub pa de yin la/ de ni skabs de'i a rab spyi tshogs mdun du bskyod pa'i mtshon byed red/ yin yang i si lam chos lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i snying po ste/ lhag par du 6 chos pa tha dad pa ’ la smyo chos don g.yul 'gyed ’ byed pa sogs las/ gtso bo a rab sku drag gi chab srid dpal 'byor gyi re ba mtshon yod/ de'i phyir mthar gtug nas bshad na/ chos lugs de ni bshu gzhog gral rim la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin no//168

a rab coma'ag gi nor du ste 〈mtshan mo stong dang gciganyigana' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i a rab kyi yul khams su/ gtam rgyud cig kun sar khyab pa 'di ltar brjod/gna' rabs shar phyogs su rgyal khams sheg yod par sā sang zer/ de'i rgyal po'i ming la san klu g.yar du 'bod/ kho la btsun mo mdzes ma yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yod pas/ rgyal po nam rgyun du phyi rol du phebs pa'i skabs dang bstun nas/ pho brang nang du zhal ta ma dang g.yog po tsho dang mnyam du bag med longs du spyod de mi las dgu las byed/ cung ma 'gor bar/ rgyal pos gcung po'i kha nas gnas tshul de thos rjes ha las shing yid mi ches par lus/ rna bas thos pa rdzun dang mig gis mthong ba dngos yin snyam nas/ da ni rang ngo mas don der rtsad gcod gsal thag chod pa zhig byed dgos snyam nas/ nyin zhig grong khyer phyi rol du ri dwags rngon du 'gro khul byas nas/ lam bar tsam du kha phyir 'khor te glo bur du pho brang nang phyin pa dang / btsun mo'i spyod ngan skyugabro ba mthong rjes/ khong khro rab tu langs te btsun mo dang zhal ta ma/ g.yog po thams cad bsad/ dus de nas bzung rgyal po san klu g.yar ni bud med kun la zhen pa log pas/ sha 'khon len rgyu las dran pa ci yang ma skyes/ khos nyin rer gzhon nu ma zhig btsun mor len kyang phyi nyin zhogs par bsad 'gro ba red/ de bzhin yun ring 'gor pas na/ grong khyer de'i bu mo tsho bsad pa'am phyi yul du bros tshar pas/ mthar mjug gzhon nu ma gcig kyang ma rnyed/ rgyal por gzhon nu ma 'tshol bar 'gan khur pa'i blon po zhig yod tshoskyo gdung dang zhed 'jigs kyis mnar 'dug blon po der mdzes ga dang blo gros ldan pa'i bu mo ming la san klu gtso sde zhes pa zhig yod pas/don de go rjes nyes med kyi gzhon nu ma tsho skyob pa'i phyir/ rang 'thad sgos rgyal po de'i btsunalo byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ gzhon nu ma de pho brang du slebs pa sdoX 9yid

gdung zhing sems skyo ba'i ngang ngu bzhin bsdad/ rgyal pos kho mor khyod rang ci'i phyir ngus zhes dris tshe/ gzhon nu mas bdag rang gi gcung mo dang mtha' ma'i ngo zhig thug dgos zer/ don der rgyal por yid 'thad byung / de nas gcung mo pho brang du 'ongs rjes san klu gtso sde yis kho mor skyo sangs su yotshong pa dang bdug 'dre'i gtam rgyud 7zhes pa bshad pa dang / rgya pos kyang logs su gtam rgyud la nyan/ gtam rgyud bshad tshar rjes nam langs pa dang / yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtam rgyud des rgyal po'i sems pa bkug pas/ skabs thog gzhon nu ma de mi gsod pa'i thag bcad/ san klu gtso sde yis bde 'jags ngang mtshan mo dang po skyel/ dus de nas bzung kho pos mtshan mo re reragatam rgyud shod kyang / bstud mar mtshan mo stong dang gcig la ngo mtshar che zhing yid dbang 'gug pa'i gtam rgyud bshad/ rgyal po de la'ang rang nongs kyi ngos rtogs thob pas/ gshes rgyud bzang zhing blo rig bkra ba'i btsun mo san klu gtso sde dang gtan 'grog tu 'tsho ba skyel bar pos mthun byung ngo spyogong smos kyi ngag rgyun gtam rgyud la lo rgyus khungs ma'i rin thang med na'ang / gtam rgyud des a rab kyi ming grags che ba'i rtsom rig bcoms chos〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉ces pa'i grub cha'i khungs sne grub 'dug dngos don la bcoms chos 'di ni gna' rabs bar ma'i dus kyi a rab mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis thun mong blo gros kyi grub 'bras yin la/ dus yun ring por dmangs khrod du khyab che ba'i gtam rgyud phyogs sgrig cig yin no//〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉nang gi gtam rgyud la yong khungs gtso bo gsum yod de/ gcig ni/ pho gzi'i gtam rgyud phyogs sgrig ho rdzor e hphu bza' ni〉(de ni gtam rgyud stong gcig ces pa'i don yin)yin la/ gtam rgyud phyogs sgrig de ni rgya gar nas 'ongs shing / dang thog legs bsgyur skad nas dar la rjes su pho gzi'i skad du bsgyur ba dang / de nas a rab kyi skad du bsgyur te a rab kyi dmangs khrod du khyab/ gnyis ni/ i rag gi sbe gi red (2/shā/686 khu lha)gtso byas pa'i ab sba si (46683 ༅7lo)rgyal

rabs (750— 1258lo)dus skabs su ngag rgyun du dar pa'i gtam rgyud sna tshogs red/ gsum ni/ yib ji'i sme ma li khe rgyal rabs ( 1250 snye1517lo)dus skabs su ngag rgyun du dar pa'i gtam rgyud yin la/ gtam rgyud de da/ gisdu gtso bo 1441 — 1550lo'i bar gyi i jib kyi yul srol goms lugs snang py-i sa rsha/tam rgyud thams cad rtsom pa po gcig gis brtsams pa ma yin pa dang / dus rabs gcig gi nang grub pa'ang ma yin te/ dus yun shin tu ring po zhig brgyud de/ a rab btsan rgyal gyi dus skabs su (dus rabs 8pa'i dus dkyil du chags pa)dbus shar dang nye shar gyi srang lam sgyu rtsal pa dang yig rigs mkhas pa tshos/ ngag rgyun du dar pa'i gtam rgyud dag lo ngo brgya phrag du mar bsdu nyar dang btsos sbyang / kha snon bcas byas nas grub pa red/ 〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉ces pa'i dpe cha'i ming 'di dang thog dus rabs 12pa'i dus dkyil du byung / de'i sngon la(mtshan mo chig stong〉zer zhing rjes su gcig ces pa'i yig 'bru bsnan te〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉ces thog la/ de ni shin tu mang ba'i don bstan la a rab kyi skad kyi goms lugs shig yin no//〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉gi gtam rgyud kyi brjod bya'i nang don shin tu rgya che bas/ de'i nang lha sgrung dang byis sgrub / pho mo'i mdza' dung gi gtam rgyud/ nyen mchong gi lo rgyus/ mi ming grags can gyi ngo mtshar gtam rgyud/gong ma'i pho brang nang gi mtshar gtam sogs 'du/ gtam rgyud nang zhib 'bri byas pa'i mi sna la ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med de/ mtho sa nas gong ma chen po dang rgyal po/ blon po/ rje bo/ dma' sa nas tshong pa dang lham bzo/ nya ba/zhing pa/ lag do ba/ byis pa zhabs zhu ba/ g.yog po g.yog mo yod pa ma zad/da dung lha klu bdud 'dre'i rigs kyang yod do// brjod bya phun sum tsho/sdu pa

dang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan du ma las gna' rabs bar ma'i a rab btsan rgyal gyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i brjid nyams che zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i snang brnyan grub te/ dbus shar dang nye shar sa khul te nang sgos su i jib kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs dang yul srol goms lugs mtshon yod pa red/〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉nang gi gtam rgyud mang che ba'i brjod byar skyon gyis ma gos shing 'jig rten khams dang mi tshe'i gnas lugs ldan pa yin pas/ mi rnams la go rtogs sad 'jug dang rig pa'i blo sgo 'byed du 'jugagatam rgyud mang po zhig gis ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba bzang po'i phugs re mtshon pa dang / khong tsho'i chags sdang gsal 'byed kyi bsam blo dang gzhung drang gshis bzang gi spyod par bstod bsngags byas yod/ de'i nang gi ming grags che ba'i gtam rgyud kha shas dus yun ring po'i nang mthong ba kun mos su gyur 'dug dper na/ 〈a li sba sba dang jag rkun bzhi bcu〉zhes pa'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo ni dbul po me shing 'thu mkhan zhig yin la/ kho spyang grung ldan zhing dpa' ngar che bas/ g.yog mo sme sga nā yi rogs ram 'og jag rkun las rgyal te/ nor bu bskungs pa'i brag khung nang 'dzul nas rin po che bgrangs kyilha mi lang pa rnyed kyang / khos rang sger du ma blangs par sme sga nā la phyed ka ba sa/〈sba gi ted kyi rkun ma〉zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyi mi sna gtso bo ni/ rkun ma ngo ma zhig ma yin par/ kho ni gshis drang spyod bzang dang / bden pa'i rgyab tu langs mkhan dang / gzhan la rogs ram byed par spro ba'i mi zhig yin pas/ mi rnams kyis brtsi bkur byed pa'i dpa' bo zhig red/ g.yo sgyu dang gdug rtsub che ba'i blon pos rgyal po'i go sa 'phrog pa'i re ngan bcangs pa dang / sna rkun ma mi yis rgyal por rogs ram byed rgyu sems thag bcad kyang /blon ༵༵ sgyu 'phrul gyis kho rang khyi gu zhig tu bsgyur/ yin na'ang kho'i gnya'

ma sgur par/ dka' sdug tshad med myangs rjes/ lha yi mig brkus 'ongs pas gnam la 'phur thub pa'i nor bu 'phur gdan thob pa dang / mthar mjug rgyal po bskyabs te blon por srog khrims bcad/ rgyal pos kho la bka' drin zhu ba'i ched kho dang blon por bskos kyang dang len ma byas par 'phur gdan du bsdad nas 'phur song ba red/〈a la ten dang lha'i sgron me〉zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyis kyang ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi spyod bzang la bstod bsngags byas pa'i gtam rgyud grags can zhig red/ de'i mi sna gtso bo ni 'tshem bzo ba zhig gi bu yin la/ kho la lha'i sgron me thob rjes/ rgyal po'i sras mo'i mag par gyur pas dbang thang chen po thob/ yin na'ang khos sngar ma'i rang dang mtshungs pa'i dbul po tsho ma brjed par/ dus rgyun du dbul po tshor rogs skyor gnang bas/ rjes su mthu nus 'dzad mtha' med pa'i sgyu ma mkhan gyis lha'i sgron me dang sras mo 'phrog song pa'i skabs/ 'bangs mi ser gyis kho la ram 'degs byas nas sgyu ma mkhan cham la pham te/ sras mo bskyabs shing lha'i sgron me phyir 'phrog pas drang bden dang gshis bzang ngan pa tha shal las rgyal lo//〈mtshan mo stong dang gciganyinang gi gtam rgyud kha shas kyis ham sems sred zhen can dang skyid 'dod las g.yol gyi mi la zur za dang kha rdung btang yod/ 〈sba sba a sbu rdal dang sdar we si'i gtam rgyud〉ces pa'i nang gi sba sba a sbu rdal ni/ sba gi khed kyi sku drag sras sros shig yin la/ kho pa skyid rtsed longs spyod dang / rgyu nor bag med du spyod par spro bas/ pha rgan 'das po'i shul bzhag rgyu nor lhag med stor brlag byas tshar/ rjes su sems bzang gzhon nu sdar we si dang 'phrad cing / sdar we sis rang gis rnyed pa'i gser dngul nor bu'i rigs kyi phyed ka de la byin/ yin na'ang sba sba a sbu rdal gyi 'dod sred la khong pa med pas/ snar we si'i rin po che'i rigs yongs rdzogasdu 7/ la

ster dgos zer ba ma zad/ da dung snar we si kho la rin po che'i rigs de las mang po 'tshol rogs byed dgos zer/ sred zhen can la mjug 'bras bzang po mi yong bas/ sba sba a sbya rdal yang seng ge zhig gis gtsang bzhes btang bas shul tu grib ma tsam yang ma lhag par gyur/〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉gis da dung khro ngar skad cha spyad de/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur gral rim la chog shes ngo tsha med pa dang gdug rtsub gtum drag che bar ther 'don byas yod/ (nu'u lon ten a li dang e nee si mdzangs li si'i gtam rgyud〉ces pa'i nang / rgyal po sde hwa kho yis blon po la/ rgya khyod kyis kho bor deng skabs gnam 'og gi ches yid dbang 'phrog pa'i mdzes ma zhig 'tshol dgos/ kho mo'i byad bzhin mdzes pa'i ma chog da dung lus gzugs phra la mnyen lhug ldan pa zhig yin dgos la/ kho mo'i gshes ka yang 'jam zhing dul ba zhig yin dgos ’ zhes bka' babs/ mdzes ma'i phyir du gser sgor chig khri brlag kyang rgyal po de la phangs pa med/ gong ma'i gzhung dang blon po tshos tshad med longs spyod byas pa de ni ngal rtsol mi dmangs la mtshon na gnod 'tshe ches chen po zhig yin no//〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉nang gi gtam rgyud mi nyung ba zhig tu pho gzhon mo gzhon tshos mdza' dung brtan po dang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i ched du dpa' ngar zhum med du 'thab rtsod byas pa brjod yod/ gtam rgyud mang po zhig tu/ tshong pa dang mtsho skyod pa tsho rgya mtsho'i thog bskyod pa'i lo rgyus bris shing / de'i nang dus rabs bar ma'i a rab kyi tshong las la dar rgyas che ba'i rnam pa mtshon yod de/ a rab kyi tshong ra ru 'tshong bya'i dngos rdzas la lta ba'i chog mi shes pa'i shar phyogs khyad chos can gyi tshong rdzas mang po yod pa ma zad/da dung bu mo na chung ma yang yod/ kho mo tsho'i lo na gzhon zhing byad gzugs mardoswā ༵/ shes bya dang bkur sti che ba/ glu dang bro la mkhas pa/ de ni bdag

po tshos rin gong mtho ru 'degs phyir ched du sems sgrim nas skyed bsring byas pa'i rjes 'bras red/yin na'ang kho mo tsho'i go gnas shin tu dma' bas bran g.yog dang gcig mtshungs su bdag po tshos nyos nas/bkod spyod dang brnyas bcos myong bas kho mo tsho'i las bskal ni shin tu skyo por snang /des kyang dus rabs bar ma'i a rab spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i phyogs shig mtshon yod pa red/〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉gi khrod kyi gtam rgyud kha shas su/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la mgo skor gtong ba'i chos lugs kyi snying don dang / pho bkur mo dman/ gser dngul kun thub sogs bshu gzhog gral rim gyi 'du shesakhyab bsgrags byas yod la/ de ni gtam rgyud phyogs sgrig 'di'i nang gi snyigs ma yin rung / dus mtshungs su a rab lo rgyus ring mo'i khrod kyi grub cha zhig yin pas/ de yang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i dngos don mtshon pa tsam yin no//〈mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉ni a rab rtsom rig gi nor bu yin la/dus snga mo zhig nas yo rob tu ngo sprod byas yod/ de ni dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi 6 ches brjid nyams mdzes sdug che ba'i dran rten gyi rdo ring zhig yin (kor ci'i gsung) stabs/ dus rabs bar ma'i yo rob kyi rtsom rig dang ri mo/rol mo sogs kyi 'phel rgyas la skul spel gyi nus pa nges can bton yod/'dzam gling gi rtsom rig nor mdzod nang gi skad grags che ba'i brtsams chos〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉(dan then thab 0 411261 011 khri1 )dang〈nyin bcu'i gtam〉(sbo kha khe'u61 0sgyu bas1 20007001 ༷ khri2)〈khan the sbe re'i gtam rgyud〉(khyonyu ser 600(1707 9525007 74)〈rdon rje khi sde〉(ser wan the si 51 6501 66 267 thab 03 58876678 (47)sogs brtsams chos la mtshan mo stong dang gcig〉gi shugs rkyen thebs yod/gtam rgyud phyogs sgrig 'di'i nang gi gtam rgyud du ma zhig ni da lta'i bar 'dzam gling yongs su mi kun gyis blo ngor yod pa dang sus kyang shod nātā spro
mi byed

grong khyer chen mo khon si ngan then 'o dgra'ajigag tu shorab/wa ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma meg med du song ba/1543lo'i zla8pa'i tshes 29nyin/ o si man thur khi (037 ba mo44༅༅)kyi dmag dpung gis nyin zhag 53ring btsan rgol dka' 'thab byas mthar/ da gzod khon si than then pho phab pa dang sbrags ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma yang rtseg med du song / rgyal khab de'i lo ngo chig stong lhag gi lo rgyus kyi mjug sgril ba red/ro ma shar ma btsan 'dul byed mkhan o si man thur khi pa'i rgyal khab kyi ming la o si man btsan rgyal zer zhing / sbe rdzan them (212thab 157 0tshe༅)dang sa mtshams 'brel cing de la lo ngo nyis brgya tsam gyi lo rgyus yod/dus rabs 13par/ a she ya chung ba'i nub byang khul gyi sa kha ri a (5878718cha lko/sgro)chu bo'i 'gram ngogs su/ bzos bgos sa cha chung ngu zhig yod pa o si man gru gu'i (thur khi ni gru gu zhes pa'i bsgyur tshul gzhan zhig yin)tsho dpon zhig gi bdag skyong byed khongs yin/ a si man (1282 — 1326lo)gyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus su/ gung rim gyi rang btsan rgyal phran zhig yin pa khyab bsgrags byas/ o si man gyis mu mthud du phyir skyed dmag 'khrug brgyab te a she ya'i sa khul mang po bzung / 1326lor da dung ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma'i lag nas sbu ra sa (27538 lo cha)grong khyer btsan tu 'phrog ste rang gi rgyal sa byas shing / de ni o si man btsan rgyal 'dzugs pas /go

brtsams pa tsam yin la/ gzhan 'dul bya bzhin du btsugs pa'i rgyal khab de'i thur khi'i mi la o si man thur khi'i mi zer/ gong ma or khan (075sku ba6lo 9)gyis dbang bsgyur pa'i dus skabs (1326— 1359lo)su/ o si man thur khi'i mi yis rkang dmag dang rta dmag gnyis su stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i rgyun gral dmag dpung btsugs nas/ rgya chen po'i sgo nas phyi phyogs su khongs rgya bskyed pa'i bya 'gul gyi 'go bcoms te/ 1331lor sbe rdzan them kyi ne se a (smo1 08682po༅)grong khyer blangs/ 1354lor/ ḍar ḍan rnal si mtsho 'gag la brgal nas/ yo rob gling gi rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi rja ri spel (2811khyim meXlko1ṣṭhatsho)btsan len byas/ rjes su yul de ni rdzi re si la phar rgol byed pa'i rten gzhi ru gyur/ de'i 'phro'i lo ngo bcu phrag du ma'i nang / o si man btsan rgyal gyis rdzi re si'i shar phyogs yongs blangs pa ma zad/1367lor rgyal sa'ang a sde ri a no pho (4671800916 khu1'grokhya1༅lhung)ru spos/1371lor/ stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i o si man btsan rgyal gyi dmag dpung gis rma ri tsha ( 5821 38 946)chu bo'i nye 'gram du ser sbi a (50161 8 tshojopomo'isgro)dang pur ka ri a (24168118 yame'ilko1༅)wa la chi a (sa/ma khustu1 7 7ro'i(6krokhru)bcas kyi mnyam 'brel dmag dpung la 'thab nas rgyal kha chen po blangs/ ser sbi a yis o si man btsan rgyal la gnya' mi sgur ga med byung / 1389lor/ o si man thur khi gyi dpung chen po dang sbol khan (2 baji ba khupor)rgyal khab so so'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung bar/ kho so wo (503070 rnye/46te'u)ru mnyam rub 'khrug chen brgyab par o si man thur khi la rgyal kha chen po thob pas ser sbi a rang gi mnga' khongs 'og tu bsdus/ lo bzhi'i rjes su/ btsan rgyal des sbol sge ri a dang ar pa ni ya (sa/thab1 8 slo1po yonatshokhru)la btsan 'dul byas/ de nas lo gsum 'gor rjes kyi 11//6lor o si man thur khi yi dmag dpung gis no khe pho ru hang ga ri/

(55ba6811 7skyas/) pholan/(201807 74) gzekhi khe/((262610 77) pho ran si/ 'jar man sogs kyi skya mi'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung pham nas wa la chi a zur gtogs yin par khas len du bcug skabs der sbol khan gling phran phyed ma yongs rdzogs o si man btsan rgyal gyi mnga' 'og tu bsdus/o si man btsan rgyal gyi ches mtho'i gtso 'dzin la su'u tan (557thab00)zer cing kho ni btsan rgyal gyi yul khongs thams cad kyi ches mtho'i bdag po yin/ rgyal yongs kyi ches bzang pa'i sa zhing thad kur su'u ḍan la dbang / gzhan yang / sa zhing khag cig zhi drag blon chen gyi phogs zhing du bgos shing / de la che hwa si /zer/ sa zhing khag cig byas rjes can dang sku drag la bgos shing de la 6 mur khe zer/ i si lam chos tshogs kyis sa zhing skor zhig bzung bar 6 wa khe hphu /zer/ sa zhing gi bdag pos sa zhing ni zhing pa la bogs mar btang nas 'debs su bcug ste/ gtso bo dngos por phab pa'i sa bogs len/ 'di lta bu'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'brel bas o si man btsan rgyal du gtso khrid go gnas bzung yod/ 1421lor smu ra sde (55186ṣṭhaṣṭhaṣṭha)sku rabs gnyis pa go sar bsdad pa dang / skabs der o si man btsan rgyal gyi stobs shugs shin tu chen por son yod pas/ 1430lo nas bzung / ro ma btsan rgyal shar mar yang bskyar phar rgol byed pa'i 'go bcoms so//skabs der ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma 'di byung nas lo ngo 1000lhag 'gor yod/ ro ma shar ma'i zhing las thon skyed nang / zhing bran lam lugs cung yongs khyab tu song yod la/ bran g.yog ngal rtsol gyis gtso khrid kyi go gnas bzung med/ rgyal khab nang du da dung rang dbang zhing pa yod pas/ro ma shar ma la ro ma nub ma lta bu'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi nyams nye/ snang

med/ ro ma shar ma la da dung dar rgyas che ba'i lag shes bzo las dang tshong las/ gra rgyas phun tshogs kyi grong khyer dpal 'byor sogs yod/ khon si than then pho ni yo rob tu ches 'byor phyug ldan zhing / mi 'bor ches mang ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig yin la/ de ru 'dzam gling sa cha so so nas 'ongs pa'i mtsho gru yod pas/ 6 shar phyogs dang nub phyogs bar gyi gser gyi zam pa mi (mar khe si'i gsung) ru gyur yod/ rgyal khab kyis tshong las la sger gcod byas nas/rgyal khab la lo re rer nor srid kyi yong sgo 'bor chen bsdu bar khag theg byas nas dbang sgyur srung skyong byed stabs/ krung dbyang srid dbang cung brtan po yin/ gong smos yod tshad ni gna' bo'i btsan rgyal 'di dus yun ring po zhig la gnas thub pa'i rkyen du rig yin na'ang dus rabs 15pa'i dus stod la slebs tshe/ ro ma shar ma ni nyin re bzhin je nyams yin zhing / rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs kyang je chung nas je chung la song ba ma zad/ da dung dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nang khul du phan tshun 'gran zla langs pa'i phyogs khag mang po grub/su'u ḍan smu ra sde sku rabs gnyis pas dpung chen po khrid de rgyal mtshams su thon pa'i skabs/ ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma'i gong ma 'jon sku rabs brgyad pa gtso byas pa'i phyogs khag gis ro ma gyi gnam bdag chos rgyal gong mar rogs skyor bya bar skyabs 'jug zhus nas/ ro ma chos rgyal gong ma'i ches mtho'i go sar khas len byas/ ro ma shar ma'i shar 'dul chos lugs kyi chos tshogs kyi (de ni ro ma btsan rgyal gyis tshod 'dzin dang bed spyod byed cing ro ma shar ma'i rgyal khab kyi chos lugs yin)tshogs dpon gtso byas pa'i phyogs khag (de'i nang sku drag skor zhig 'du)gis ro ma chos rgyal gong mar gnya' sgur bar ngo rgol byas nas/ smyo khon si than then pho ru thur khi pa'i mgo dkris mthong rung /ro ma chos rgyal gong ma'i cod pan mthong na mi 'dod 9zer/ da dung phyogs kha/ tāspyan zhig yod pa thur khi la blo nye zhing de dag ni/ thur khi dang bar

dpal 'byor dang chab srid thad 'brel ba yod pa'i sku drag dang tshong pa las grub/ kho tshos rang gi rgyu nor dang khyad dbang gegs srung bgyi ched/ thur khi la mgo btegs kyang 'gyod sems med pa byas/ro ma shar ma'i dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nang khul du phyogs 'gal de 'dra chen po yod pas/ nus shugs ldan pa'i sgo nas mi dmangs la 'go 'dren dang rtsa 'dzugs byas nas thur khi dmag dpung gi btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byed ga la sdidī/51lo'i lo stod la/ o si man btsan rgyal gyi su'u ḍan smu ra sde sku rabs gnyis pa nad kyis gum/ zla 2pa'i tshes 18nyin kho'i bu mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pa gong ma'i khri la bkod/ su'u ḍan gsar pa 'di go sar bsdad pa'i phyi nyin bka' babs nas/ rang gi zla brgyad tsam las ma lon pa'i gcung po dmar gsod btang zhing / de'i dmigs yul ni pha gcig ma mi gcig pa'i gcung po nar son rjes kho dang rgyal po'i dbang cha 'phrog res byed par zhed pas red/ de'i 'phror mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas khon si than then pho blangs te rtsa ba nas ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma 'dul rgyu thag bcad/ skabs der ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma'i mnga' khongs la/ don dngos su khon si than then pho dang de'i nye 'khor gyi yul khongs chung chung ma gtogs lhag med/ mu tams sde sku rabs gnyis pas gra sgrig gi bya ba gang legs bsgrubs te/ phyi 'brel steng so sor we ne rdzi a/(50ba021 lnga thamo)hang ga ri (5506775bskyas/)dang chings yig bzhag nas de dag la khe phan chung ngu byin nas bar sdod rgyal khab byed du bcug dmag don stong sbo si pho ru si mtsho 'gag (20395753 glo0 mo)gi a she ya'i phyogs kyi mtsho 'gram du an nā rdo ru si ser mkhar rdzong bskrun pa dang / mtsho 'gag de'i 'gag dog sa'i yo rob phyogs su sbo sga dze khe ren mkhar rdzong bsgrun/ de lta na sbal khe rgya1 /rdor

'gro 'ong byed pa'i bgrod lam bkag sdom nus ldan byed thub/ mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas da dung phyogs chen bzos pa dang dmag gru'i ru chen 'bor chen btsugs pa red/ yod tshad thams cad gra sgrig byas tshar rjes/1453lo'i zla 4pa'i zla stod la mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas sku ngo mas dmag dpung chig 'bum lnga khri dang dmag gru 300khrid de ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma la mthar mjug gi g.yul chen po 'gyed 'go bcoms shing / zla 4pa'i tshes 6nyin/ thur khi'i dmag dpung gis khon si than then pho bskor/ ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma'i ches mtha' ma'i gong ma khon so than then sku rabs bcu gsum pa ni mi'i blo la mi 'bab pa'i mi zhig yin pa'i steng / kho'i lag 'og gi mkhar srung dmag dpung yang mi mang ste/ we nee dze a dang rje no wa (60baX lnga sa ༅)yi glas dmag 3000nang du brtsis kyang da dung dmag mi chig khrir mi 'dang / 'on kyang khon si than then pho la mkhar rdzong mthug cing brtan po yod pas dus thung thung nang phab mi thub/ gser zur mtsho khug gi 'jug sgo ro ma gyi mis lcags thag gis sbrel shing gru mang po mtsho nang du bying du bcug nas bkag sdom byas te/ thur khi'i drag stobs can che ba'i dmag gru'i ru khag mtsho khug der 'dzul dka' bas gser zur mtsho khug nas tshur rgol bya mi thub pa byasamu/ ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas gnas bab la zhib 'jug byas rjes/khon si than then pho len dgos na/ cis kyang phar phyogs kyi 'gog srung ches zhan sa ste gser zur mtsho khug rtol dgos shing / de rtol na nges par du dmag gru'i ru khag mtsho khug der bgrod thub dgos zer/ 'o na thur khi'i dmag gru ji ltar mtsho khug gi lcags thag dra ba'i bkag sdom las brgal dgos par zhib 'jug byas rjes/ mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas skam sa'i steng nadi ༵༵ga gru mtsho khug nang 'ded rgyu thag bcad de/ gser zur mtsho khug
nyanya snyidzorshazheḥ/spya spyanamar ma la mtsho/

ma thub pa'i steng / ro ma shar ma'i phyogs kyi nub phyogs dmag rogs thon la khal yod pa go nas/ thur khi dmag dpung gi nang khul du g.yo 'gul dang zing cha langs/ blon po skor zhig gis khon si than then pho la bskor rgol byed mtshams bzhag nas dmag dpung phyir 'then pa'i re ba bton yang / de la mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pa la yid 'thad gtan nas ma yod par/ khos sems su nub phyogs rgyal khab so so'i bar du 'gal ba sna tshogs yod pas/dus thung ba'i nang mna' 'brel shugs ldan zhig bsgrigs pa'i shas mi che bas/dmag dpung btang nas 'gyel la nye ba'i ro ma shar ma la rogs ram byed mi thursha stabs/ mu mthud du mkhar rdzong phab pa'i bar du phar rgol drag po byed da sa zlo/sa/ gnyis kyis nyin 53la dka' 'thab sdug 'dzing byas rjes kyi zla 5pa'i tshes 29nyin thur khi'i dmag dpung gis slar yang drag tu phar rgol byas/nyin der mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pa sku dngos su g.yul sar song nas dmag mi tshor dmag 'thab ma brgyab gong gi skul slong byas te/ kho bo la grong khyer 'ba' zhig las rgyu nor ci yang mi dgos/ mkhar rdzong phab pa'i nyin khyod tshos zhin gsum ring rang dgar gang mkho 'phrog bcom bya chog cing / gser dngul rin po che dang bzung dmag g.yog po g.yog mo thams cad khyod tshor dbang zhes lab pas/ dmag mi tsho'i ngar shugs drag tu 'phel bas nyin der btsan mkhar phab nas grong mkhar nang du brgyugs/khon si than then pho yi srung dmag ni khyon yongs nas thor zhig tu song zhing khon si than then sku rabs bcu gsum pa'ang dmar gsod byas/ thur khi'i dmag mi grong khyer nang slebs pa dang rang dgar gang spros su 'phrog bcom dang dmar gsod/ me gtong ba'i las la brel zhing de ga'i sdod da~X rnams bran du bzung ba dang / brjid chags mdzes sdug gi pho brang

nang gi rgyu nor 'phrog rjes mer sgron nas bsregs/ rin thang bral ba'i gna' rabs kyi sgyu rtsal thon rdzas rtsa chen thams cad rtsa gtor btang / de nas o si man btsan rgyal gyi rgyal sa yang khon si than then pho ru spos te grong khyer de'i ming yang i si than spul (13 thaba'i51 77777)du bsgyur nas o si man btsan rgyal gyi chab srid kyi lte gnas su bsgyur/ grong khyer nang gi hwa rje a so hphe a lha khang (57618 30961 tha zalko4khri༅)yang i si lam chos lugs kyi phyag khang la bsgyur/ 1461lor/ ro ma shar ma'i shul lhag sa khul gzhan dag kyang thur khi yis dbang 'og tu bsdus/ro ma btsan rgyal shar ma rtsa med du song rjes/ thur khi yis mu mthud du mnga' khongs kyi rgya bskyed pa dang / dus rabs 16pa'i dus stod la slebs dus/ thur khi ni stobs shugs shin tu che ba'i dmag don bkas bkod rgyud zlordonā sdi /tsan rgyal zhig tu gyur pas lo rgyus steng shugs rkyen chen po bzhag 185

rje rgya'in si the rsān/dzirgyal khab cig nyams chung ji 'dra yin rung / drang bden dang mi rigs kyi 'tsho gnas kyi ched du 'thab pas na/ de ni 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal khab cig yin no/ the hphanaro ma ne ya'i (2018ba1 7 7675)mi yi mes po ni ḍa si a sgo the'i mi (001800 stu1 7rsā༅gloṣṭha)red/ spyi lo dus rabs dang po'i dus su/ḍa si a'i mi yis rang gi rgyal khab btsugs yod/ dus rabs 9par slebs pa dang ro ma ma ne a'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs su bsgyur ba'i brgyud rim gyi 'go bcoms/ dus rabs 14par thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba mu mthun du 'phel rgyas byung bas/ rdo no (20ba25 lkolko )gtsang po'i byang phyogs dang khar pha then ri bo'i ((8798 618ba po༅67)sa khul du so sor srid skyong ba'i rnam pa'i ro ma ne ya'i mi'i gung rim gyi rgyal phran gsum ste/ wal la cha (gag75068 ca'ire'i(6krokhru)dang mol rdo wa (5016078ṭwāṃshā khurterdogle/ )the ran sil wa ne a (178231178ba1 'a cha༅077༅)bcas dus rabs 14par o si man thur khi pas yo rob la btsan 'dzul byas pas/ sbol khon gling phran phyed ma'i steng gi rgyal khab mang che ba thur khi pa'i lag tu shor/ stobs shugs che ba'i thur khi'i dmag dpung mu mthud du yo rob dbus ma dang yo rob byang mar bskyod pa'i dus su/ ro ma ne ya ni kho tsho ma bsditā /bas med kyi bar lam yin pas/ ro ma nee ya'i rgyal phran gsum ni

sngar byung ma myong ba'i dgra chen po'i 'jigs skul la 'phrad 'dug1369lo'i zla 11par/ o si man btsan rgyal gyi dmag dpung gis thengs dang por ro ma ne ya'i gung rim rgyal phran la btsan 'dzul byas kyang pham ste phyir 'then/ yin na'ang skabs der ro ma ne ya'i gung rim rgyal phran so so'i bar 'gal ba gcig thog gnyis brtsegs yod pas phan tshun bar dmag 'khrug brgyab te khe dbang 'phrog res byed bzhin yod/ phyi dgras btsan 'dzul dang nang zing gi rkyen gyis sol rdo wa gung rim rgyal phran ni brtan po min pa'i gnas bab su lhung yod/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'di lta bu'i 'og tu/ rje chen si bye phon /rdo 05 ba zo lo)de mol rdo wa'i chab srid gar stegs thog 'a gasdu 41 7/ra/ si the hphan ni mol rdo wa'i rgyal po'i khyim rgyud du 'khrungs shing /khong gi spo bo 6 mi bzang mi a li khe gzan sder ni gong ma'i go sa'i steng lo 32ring bzhugs te/(1400— 1432lo) 1432lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 1nyin sku gshegs/ mol rdo wa gung rim rgyal phran la gtan phab byas zin pa'i gong ma'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i lam lugs sheg med pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang nang gong ma'i dbang cha rtsod pa'i 'thab rtsod byung / gling log dang dbang rtsod/phan tshun phyir 'bud gtong res/ lkog gsod sogs kyi don rkyen du ma byung stabs/ rgyal khab yongs dus yun ring por zing cha'i nang gnas la/ srid dbang 'pho 'gyur thengs 11byung / rje chen si the hphan gyi pha sbo sge ḍan (20668sa 7)ni a le khe gzan sder gyi byi phug yin/ khos rgyal po'i pho brang nang phan tshun gsod res rgyag pa'i skabs te/ 1449lo'i zla 10par thun mong du srid dbang 'dzin pa'i pha gcig ma mi gcig pa'i gcung po phe the a ron dang tsha bo a le khe gzan sder gnyis phyir skyod btang nas gong ma'i dbang mablangs te sbo sge ḍan sku rabs gnyis pa'i rgyal rabs btsugs/ lo1 /ltos

'gor rjes/ a ron gyis phyi rgyal nas rta dmag skor zhig khrid de kha rog tu rgyal nang du 'ongs nas lo legs thob pa'i dus ston gyi zhabs byor zhugs pa'i sbo sge ḍan bzung nas mgo bcad de khrom ston byas/ lo na 13la son pa'i rgyal sras si the hphan gyis dngos su skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas tshul de mthong zhing yid gting nas dgra sha len rgyu sems thag bcad/ khong ma yum dang mnyam du pha yul las bros bshol du mon the ne a'i rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ si the hphan gyi ma yum ni rlabs che ba'i bud med cig yin la/ khong mos rang gi bu nar son rjes sngon rabs rnams kyi dpa' bo'i mdzad rjes rgyud du bzung nas blo dkar sems dkar sgos rgyal khab la sri zhu byed par re 'dun byas yod/ si the hphan gyis lo 7la mi'i ngo bsus nas 'tsho ba rol rjes/ khong ni shes yon dang blo gros rmad du byung ba'i na gzhon zhig tu skyes shing / khong rang bzhin du spyang grung dang blo gros ldan zhing dpa' ngar che ba'i steng dpe deb mang po bklags te/ dka' sdug che ba'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug khrod blo brtan 'gyur med dang dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi pho gsar zhig tu gyur/phe sde a ron gong ma'i go sar bsdad rjes/ rang gi go gnas sra brtan dugatong ched rgyal khab chen por rgyab gtad ched pho lan sde la gnya' bsgur nas de'i zur gtogs byas nas bdag dbang phyir btsong byas/ rgyal khab nang du ham 'phrog slu len byas pas/ mi dmangs kyi sdug skad kyis la lung khengs 'dug 1455lor/ o si man btsan rgyal gyis su'u chen mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas phe sde a ron la lo rer gser sgor 2000de 'bul dgos zhes bka' btsan po babs pas/ a ron de la zhed nas 'bul dngul grangs ka bzhin ma sprod ga med byung zhing / da dung o si man btsan rgyal dang 'dra mnyam min pa'i chings yig thengs dang po bris stabs/ mol rdo ba mi dmangs ni sdo sdug bzod bral gyi gnas su lhung /

1457lo'i dpyid kur/ si the hphan gyis dpa' rtul 1000zhig bsdus shing dmag sbyong byas nas/ dgra bo bcom zhor du phyir rang yul du phebs pa dang / rgyal nang gi mi dmangs kyis gnas tshul de thos pas na dga' spro'i ngang dang du blangs nas khyim dang bral nas dmag dpung nang zhugs stabs/si the hphan gyi dpung sde mi grangs 6000lhag tu 'phel/ zla 4pa'i tshes 12nyin si the hphan gyis rdo le si the nas thad kur a ron gyi ches mtho'i dmag spyi khang gi phyogs su brgyugs shing / tshes 14nyin ol sbe kho (016100 lo77)ru shul lhag dgra bo yod tshad rdul du brlag si the phen gyis rgyal kha thob pa'i dmag dpung khrid de rgyal sa su'u cha wa (5500757 777)ru phebs/ chos dpon chen mo yis khong la gong ma rgyal po'i cod pan bsnams pa'i mdzad sgo'i gtso 'gan bzhes te/ rgyal po'i codapan si the hphan gyi dbu la mnabs/dus de nas bzung / si the hphan mol rdo ba'i rgyal po'i go sar bzhugs nas rgyal phran de'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i dbang sgyur par gyur cing / rjes rabs pa rnams kyis khong la rje chen si the hphan zhes 'bod/ khong la rmad du byung ba'i kun spyod ldan pas/ lo rgyus kyi yig cha'i stong tsa khong la skyon bral legs 'dzoms kyi gshes rgyud yod cing / las la brtson zhing mkhas pa/ rang gcun bag chags bzang ba/ gang bzhud sgyu 'phrul che ba/ g.yul gyi bkod 'doms la byang ba/ sku dngos su g.yul ngor song bas dmag mi'i spobs sems bskyed pa/ rgyun du dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha len pa/ pham kha myangs pa'i dus su yi thang mi chad par slar yang dgra bor 'thab nas bcom par shin tu mkhas ’ zhes bstod bsngags byas yod/ /mol rdo a la bdag skyong yag po zhig byed phyir/ si the hphan gyis nang khul gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bcad bzung med par bzos nas/ krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig sdud byas/ phyi phyogs su o si man btsan ༵༵ gyi

btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byas nas/rgyal khab kyi rang btsan srung skyob byas/de'i phyir khong gis gsham gyi phan nus can gyi byed thabs lag bstar gnang /dang po/ rgyal khab gcig gyur dang thon skyed gong spel/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas su btang /si the hphan gyis sa khul so sor dpon po bsko mngag byas te/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' gzhis kyi las don la the gtogs byas nas/ zhing rmetsho bdag chen po'i mnga' zhabs sa cha la tshod 'dzin dang / mnga' bdag tsho'i khyad dbang med par bzos nas/ rje chen si the hphan/zhing pa dang lag shes bzo pa/ grong khyer gyi sdod mi'i khe phan la srung skyob byas nas tshong las dar rgyas yong bar skul spel byas/ khong gis da dung zhing 'debs srol legs bcos byed pa'i bya 'gul dar spel btang ba dang / phyi phyogs tshong las 'phel rgyas su btang nas tshong las dar rgyas yong bar byas pas/ rgyal yongs dpal 'byor mgyogs myur du 'phel rgyas byung zhing / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba la'ang mthor 'degs byung / gnyis pa/ mkhas 'dems 'jon bsko dang srid gzhung bsgyur bcos bya/ ༷sa/ the hphan gyis nus pa dang yon tan ngo ma yod pa'i shes yon can

bdams nas rim pa so so'i las 'gan 'khur du bcug cing / khong gis da dung khrims lugs la shugs snon byas nas/ nye skyor khrims 'gal mi byed par khong nyid kyi gnyen mi sha nye khrims las 'gal ba dag la'ang nyes chad drag po bcad nas gu yangs gtong mi srid/gsum pa/ chos lugs rig gnas dar spel dang lo rgyus deb ther rtsom sgrig byed du bcug pa/si the hphan ni ye shu'i chos lugs kyi dad ldan pa zhig yin pas/ chos lugs bstan bcos mang po zhig dpe skrun byas/ khong gis bka' gnang nas ro ma ne ya'i dus rabs rim byung gi lo rgyus dang po ste(mol rdo wa'i lo rim lo rgyus〉rtsom sgrig byed du bcugabazhi ba/ brjid chags nyams dga' ba'i chos lugs bzo skun gang mang ba/ spya ༵/na gyis sa khul mang po ru brjid chags lta na sdug pa'i ye shu'i chos khang dang lha khang bskrun pa dang de la thun mong ma yin pa'i mol rdo wa'i khyad chos yod/ 1470lor phu the nā chos khang bskrun/ de'i bzo bkod la rab brjid mdzes nyams ldan zhing / mtshon mdangs sna tshogs bkra ba dang rgya khyon rab tu che bas phyi rabs pa tshos de la 6 mi rigs la go rtogs sad du 'jug pa'i chos stegs mi zer/lnga ba/ hur brtson sgos phyi 'brel gyi bya 'gul spel ba/1459lor/ si the hphan gyis pho lan sde dang o wer he le wu tshi chings yig bzhag nas mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba btsugs te/ pho lan sde yis yul 'khyar du song ba'i phe the a ron la rgyab skyor byed mtshams 'jog tu bcug de nas the lan si wa ne a ru yul 'khyam du yod pa'i a ron la dmag don phar rgolabyas nas/ mi ngan de bzung nas srog khrims bcad de mngon menā spyan

rkyen ye nas med pa bzos drug pa/ rgyal srung stobs shugs che ru btang ba/si the hphan gyis stobs shugs che ba'i dmag dpung zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas shing / de'i nang rgyal po'i pho brang gi srung dmag 1000dang / sku drag chung 'bring dang zhing pa phyug po las grub pa'i srung dmag 3000dang / rang dbang zhing pa las grub pa'i rta pa'i blos blangs dmag 4000yod cing / da dung zhing pa phal ba las grub pa'i rta dmag sum khri/ zhing pa dbul po las grub pa'i rkang dmag chig khri bcas 'du/ si the hphan gyis da dung dmag don mkhar rdzong brtsigs nas rgyal srung sra brtan du btang /ros nee ya'i gung rim rgyal phran so so'i gtso dgra ni o si man thur khi btsan rgyal red/ mol rdo wa yis o si man gyi su'u tan la rten 'bul dngul 'bab mi ster bar thag bcad de/ 'thab jus thog gi gnad che'i sa cha btsan rdzong dkar po dang rje ri a mkhar rdzong brtan srung byas pas/ o si man gyi su'u tan mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis par khong khro bslangs/ mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas 1462lor dmag gru'i ru khag btang nas rje ri a mkhar rdzong la drag rgol byas rung phab ma thub/ 1474lor su'u ri man pha gza' la mi grangs chig 'bum nyis khri yod pa'i dpung chen po khrid de sol rdo wa la btsan 'dzul byed du bcug ste si the hphan cham du pham nas gnya' bsgur du 'jug pa'i re ngan bcangs/ mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung la se kho i dang hang ga ri/ pho lan sde bcas kyi dpung rogs bsnan par bsdoms pas dmag mi lnga khri tsam yod/ dmag shugs la gnam sa'i khyad par yod rung / si the hphan gyis dpa' ngar zhum med sgos dmag dpung sbyong brdar dang srung dmag bkod sgrig nan tan mdzad pa ma zad/ da dung rgyal yongs kyi dmag dmangs kyi/ byis dmar dang tshe srog spyad de rgyal khab kyi rang btsan la srung skyob bya

dgos pa'i skul brda gnang /dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms ma thag gi dus su/ thur khi'i dmag dpung rngam rngam brjid brjid ngang rdo no chu bor brgal nas thogs med shar skyod du 'ongs nas/ mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung zil gyis nan pas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du pham nas phyir 'then brgyab pas si the hphan nyen gnas su lhung ba'i gnas bab byung / de lta bu'i nyen kha ha cang che ba'i gnas tshul 'og si the phen gyis yul gru stong bar bzos nas mkhar rdzong brtan srung dang dgra bslus dkyil khrid kyi 'thab jus spyod rgyu blo thag bcad de/ thur khi'i dmag dpung wa si lu'e (723151 7797)yi nye 'gram gyi na 'dam sa rgyud du khrid/ yul de kho wa chu bo dang sper la sde (21 1126 4 poṣṭhaṣṭha)chu bo gnyis kyi 'dres mdo ru yod cing phyogs gnyis bzhur chu yin la/ chu'i 'gram ngogs kyi spang lung gi zheng dog pas/ dpung tshogs chen pos g.yul 'gyel mi bde zhing chur brgal bar zam pa mthon po gcig pu ma gtogs med/ 1475lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 10nyin/ char pa zim zim babs pa dang lam ngos 'dam thob kyis khengs stabs thur khi'i dmag dpung rkang pa yar 'degs thub mi thub ngang rim bzhin mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gi 'jab rgol byed yul du bskyod/ si the hphan gyis bka' babs pa dang / rang nyid sku ngo mas dmag mi'i sngon du mchongs nas phyogs kun nas phar rgol byed pa'i 'go brtsams/ sol rdo wa'i dmagadapung gis dmag rnga dang ki ldir khrod dpa' ngar zhum med du dgra bo cham la pham/ de'i nang gi rta dmag ru khag cig mtshon cha yang mo bzung nas g.yul la zhugs nas ches mdun phyogs su brgyugs/ thur khi'i dmag dpung niganam lcag thog mda' 'gog khom ma yod pa 'dra ba'i gnas su lhung pas/pha rol pos bskor sdem 'og 'thab 'dzing gi shugs phud mi thub pas de ma thag phan tshun rkang brdzis gtong zhor yar bros mar bshol byas/ nyin zhag1 /snam

la dmar 'thab byas mthar thur khi'i dmag dpung yongs su pham pa dang dmag dpon gtso bo tshang ma 'dzin bzung byas/ dmag dpon de dag gis blu yon mthon po byin nas tshe srog blu snyam rung si the hphan gyis gtan nas khas ma mchis/ mtho zam yul gyi g.yul chen la rgyal kha chen po blangs pa des/ o si man btsan rgyal gyi smyo ham che ba'i btsan 'dzul gyi 'char gzhi rtsa ba nas med par bzos/ o si man gyis sngar nas da bar pham kha de 'dra chen po zhig bzas ma myangs par khas mi len ka med byung / dmag 'khrug mjug rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ mi rnams kyis si the hphan ni zu ngo mtshar che ba'i dpa' bo zhig red ’ ces dang smyo nga rang tsho'i dus rabs 'di'i nang thur khi dang 'thab nas gzi 'od 'phro ba'i rgyal kha chen po len mkhan gyi rje bo dang po red ’ ces bstod bsngagasabyas/ rgyal kha chen po de la yo rob tu spobs pa dang spro ba rgya chen po bslangs pas/ chos rgyal gong mas kyang si the hphan la 'phrin yig springs nas 6 khyod kyi dmag 'thab byas rjes kyis khyod kyi zil shugs dang snyan grags che bar btang pas/ khyod kyi ming ni mi rnams kyi khrod du rgya chen por khyab par 'dug ’ ces gsungs/o si man btsan rgyal gyis mtho zam yul du pham pa bzas pa'i sdug mi 'khur pa ci bshad/ rgyu mtshan ni dmag 'khrug de pham pas o si man gyis yo rob lho ma dang sbe la khe rgya mtsho (21806 562 lha)sa khul gyi 'thab jus go gnas la nyen kha bslangs pas red/ si the hphan gyis don de gsal por mkhyen yod pas/ khong gis yo rab kyi rgyal khab stobs ldan rnams la/ o si man gyis da dung mol rdo wa la slar yang dmag don btsan 'dul byed par the tshom med pas/ yo rob kyi ye shu'i chos lugs la dad pa'i rgyal khab kyis mnyam 'brel 'gog srung bya dgos nges red ces tha tshig bsgrags/19)ngos su yang de lta yin te/ 1475lo'i zla 5par thur khi'i dmag gru ru

khag ni mu ham sme sde yis dngos su sna 'dren byas 'og khon si than then pho nas lam la chas te/ mol rdo wa la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms/ cung ma 'gor bar thur khi'i dmag gru'i ru khag gis khe rim sme a ((11471 tha mtshosko༅)yi lho khul gyi kha hpha gru kha blangs/ kha hpha gru kha ni sge no wa (60ba052 rdoṣṭhatsho)yi mi ser spel yul gyi sa cha yin zhing de ga'i tha thar pa tsho (12 873 mo cha༅)o si man gyi ngan grogs su gyur/ dmag 'khrug ni mig gi rtsa khar thon pas/ si the hphan gyis hur brtson sgos dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas dmag 'khrug la gra sgrig byas/1476lo'i zla 5pa'i zla stod du/ o si man btsan rgyal gyi pho nya yis a si (1331 khupo)ru si the hphan dang mjal nas/ o si man gyi gong ma'i srid gzhung gi zur gtogs byas nas dpya mjal rten 'bul dgos pa dang /mkhar rdzong phul te khong gi bu mi gta' la bzhag nas o si man ru khrid dgos zer/ sa the hphan gyis pho nya la bka' bkyon drag po gnang ste o si man gyi lugs med re ba la gtan nas khas ma mchis/ zla 5pa'i tshes 13nyin mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas dngos su dmag dpung nyis 'bum tsam khrid de rgya chen po'i sgo nas mol rdo wa la btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug brgyab/ si the hphan gyis dmag dpung chig khri nyis stong tsam khrid nas dgra dpung chen po 'gog par phebs/ dgra dpung chen po las rgyal pa'i phyir du khong gis nges par du gzengs su thon pa'i dmag 'thab 'char gzhi zhig gtan la phab dgos/ si the hphan gyis khan yangs sar dgra dmag dang gdung thug tu zad gron dmag 'thab rgyag rgyur bshol pa dang / dgra bo nges par du brgyud dgos pa'i yul du yul gru stong bar bzos thog mkhar rdzong brtan srung byas nas/ dgra bo ngal dub dmag 'khrug nang lhung bar brten dgra bo'i skye ldan stobs shugs pham par gtong rgyu thag bcad gnang / 195

zla 7par/ thur khyi'i dmag dpung mol rdo wa'i dbus khul du bskyod kyang / mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gis yang yang 'jab rgol byas pas/ thur khi'i dmag dpung gi skyod tshad shin tu dal mor gyur/ tshes 26nyin nags tshal gyis khengs pa'i gzhongs sa ru gting thag gcod pa'i g.yul chen po brgyab/ sol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gis shing sdong bkag dngos byas shing brag khung 'gebs srung 'dzing rags byas nas/ dpa' ngar zhum med sgos dgra bo dang drag tu 'thab kyang / mthar thug nyung bas mang po ma thub pas thur khi'i dmag gi dmag tshur rgol 'gog ma thub la/ mol rdo wa'i 'thab mo ba mang pos rgyal khab srung skyob byed pa'i ched du rang srog blos btang pa red/yin na'ang / o si man thur khi'i mis kyang chab srid dmigs 'ben mngon du 'gyur ma thub/ mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gis dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyis 'gog rgol byas pa dang / thur khi'i dmag dpung nang byi nad 'gos pa'i steng / the ran sil wa ne a'i (118031178ba1 76༅0774)dpung rogs kyang thon la khad yod pas/ mu ham sme sde sku rabs gnyis pas dmag don btsan 'dzul gyi mtshams bzhag nas rang gi dmag dpung mol rdo wa nas phyir 'then byed par bka' mi 'bab ga med byung ngo //rjes su/ o si man dang pho lan sde/ hang ga ri bar zhi chings bzhag pas/ rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul mol rdo wa la mi phan pa'i phyogs su 'khor/1484lor/ thur khi'i dpung chen pos mol rdo wa slar yang btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug brgyab te/ sol rdo wa'i dpal 'byor gyi lte gnas gal chen dang dmag 'thab gnas gzhi gal chen se rje ri a dang mkhar rdzong dkar po btsan len byas/ si the hphan gyis mkhar rdzong de gnyis phyir len par gang nus hur 'bad byas kyang len ma thub/ de nas khong gis o si man btsan rgyal gyi bzhi/ sna'i dbang char khas mi len thabs med byung bas/ o si man gyi gong

ma'i gzhung la khral mjal rten 'bul byed rgyu khas blangs/dus yun cung tsam 'gor rjes/ pho lan sde dang tang ga ri gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag can du gyur/ mol rdo wa sngar pho lan sde'i mnga' 'og tu zhugs myangs na'ang / thur khi'i dmag dpung 'gog pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod tang ga ri dang mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba btsugs/ da dung pho lan sde yis mol rdo wa la dogs sems bzung yod pas/ pho lan sde dang hang ga ri gnyis bar dmag 'khrug byung ba'i skabs su/ si the hphan ni hang ga ri'i phyogs su langs/1479lor pho lan sde'i rgyal po 'jon al sber the yis dmag dpung btang nasasu'u cha wa (5500878 lo 7)la tshul gol byas nas/ rang nyid kyi gcung po si rje si mun sde (51 61375ba poshā rtsa)zhes pa mol rdo wa'i gong ma rgyal por 'jog rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/ si the hphan gyis spyod grags gnyis ldan gyi blon po rgan pa gnyis mngags te pho lan sde la mol rdo war dmag mi 'dren par kha ta bslab bya rgyag tu bcug mod/ gdug rtsub can gyi pho lan sde'i rgyal pos srung dmag la bka' babs nas pho nya gnyis bzung nas lcags thag gis bkyigs nas bkag sdom byed du bcug si the hphan gyis gnas tshul de thos pa dang 'phral du rgyal khab yongs gnas bab dza drag can tu thon pa khyab bsgrags byas nas/ pho lan sde btsan 'dzul pa'i gdung bsus nas dmag 'khrug rgyag par gra sgrig byas pa'i steng / the rin sil wa ne a la dpung rogs mngags dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ rgyal khab de'i dmag mi chig khri nyis stong dpung rogs su btang / pho lan sde'i dmag dpung la dpa' ngar rtul phod kyi 'gog rgol rdung deg thebs pas/ 'dum 'grig byas nas dmag dpung phyir mi 'then thabs med byung / zla 10pa'i tshes 26nyin/ pho lan sde'i dmag dpung phyir 'then nas kho si men (20371 7lo7)nags tshal du thon skabs mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gi 'jab rgol thebs/ pho lanā /'i

dmag dpung la rdung deg drag po thebs pas mgo 'thoms phyogs 'dzol gyi gnas su lhung bas la lung du bros shing / mi mang po zhig mol rdo wa'i dmag dpung gi shing zlum dang bab rdo/ mda' mo sogs mtshon cha'i kha ru tshe srog shor/ si the hphan gyi rgyal kha dang bstun dmag dpung khrid de dgra bo thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i bar drag rgol byed par mtshams ma bzhag pho lan sde'i rgyal po yang sdar ma wa mo ltar du phyir rgyal nang la bros pa dang / kho pa'i btsan 'dzul gyi 'char gzhi yang rtsa ba nas pham pa red/ 1499lo'i zla 7par/phyogs gnyis kyis zla gsum ring gros mol byas rjes/ zhi chings bris te sol rdo wa dbyi pho lan sde'i bar gyi bdag po dang mnga' 'og gi 'brel ba ye nas med pa ba rjo che/ na si the hphan gyis blo brtan 'gyur med kyi hur thag 'bad brtson byas 'og mol rdo wa yis dus yun ring po'i nang dka' spyad 'thab rtsod byas nas/ o si man dang pho lan sde sogs rgyal khab chen po'i btsan 'dul dpung 'jug rdul du brlag pas/ rang gi stobs shugs sngar las lhag tu je ngar du song / yin na'ang mi yi tshe thag gnam gyis kyang bsring dka' zhes pa'i dpe bzhin/ 1504lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 2nyin/ rje chen si the hphan dgongs pa rdzogs/ khong gis mes rgyal srung skyob kyi ched du dmag 'khrug chen mo 36brgyud de mi rigs rang btsan phyir du rang nyid kyi yod tshad thams cad phul ba red/ ro ma ne ya'i lo rgyus steng / rje chen si the hphan ni drang bden dang rang btsan gyi mtshon byed du gyur pas/ mi rnams kyis nam yang khong la rjes dran byed par 'dug go/198

mar kho zho 'o krung go rubazhugs tshul/1271lo'i dbyar dus su/ dbyi tha li yi mdzes sdug grong khyer we ne dzi a (50ba621 tha 77)ni nyi ma'i gzi 'od kyis khengs shing / san ma kho chos khang yang nyi 'od khrod du 'od 'tsher 'tsher du lhang du mngon/ brjid chags al pha si (4193 ༅7sgyuglo)ri rgyud ni bkag dngos chen po zhig dang 'dra bar we no dzi a'i rgyab phyogs su 'gyings nger langs/ grong khyer de'i sngon phyogs ni rlabs phreng chil chil du 'phyo ba'i a sde ri a (46712 244tshe yo)rgya mtsho red/ nyin zhig rgyang ring yul du skyod pa'i gru zhig yod pas gru 'dogs lcags kyu yar 'then nas rlung g.yor mthon por btegs nas phar phyogs su skyod grabs yod cing / gru 'go ru skyes pa dar ma gnyis dang byad snying rje po can gyi gzhon gsar zhig gis phebs skyel byed mkhan rnams la lag pa g.yug g.yug byas nas sems 'phreng nas 'bral mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin 'dugalo na 17can gyi pho gsar de'i ming la mar kho pho lo (57700 9010 9ma 77)zer/ mi dar ma gnyis ka ni pho gsar de'i pha ne kho lo mar kho dang khu bo ma hphe a mar kho red/ ne kho lo dang ma hphe a gnyis ni we ne dzi a'i tshong pa phyug po gnyis yin zhing / rgyun du dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'gram yul gyi rgyal khab so sor song nas tshong las gnyer/ 1263lor kho tsho a she ya dkyil ma'i sbu kha ra (7566818 loṣṭhaṣṭha)nas lam du chas te krung gor skyod 'go brtsams shing / dka' ngal khri stong mang po brgyud sog po'i gong ma chen po se chenā /la

po'i rgyal sa hrang tu'u (47)(da lta'i nang sog rang skyong ljongs kyi to lun)la slebs/ se chen rgyal pos kho tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang dga' bsu byas shing / rgyang ring yul gyi yo rob kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod byas par zhib tu gsan/1269lor tshong pa gcen gcung gnyis phyir we ne dzi a ru log de ring khong gnyis kyis mar kho pho lo khrid de slar yang krung gor bgrod pa'i lam du chas so//kho tsho'i mtsho grus dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho 'phred du bcad de thur khi (15760skya gzo)nas a she ya skam sa chen po'i stong slobs/ de nas i ran (118sa tsho)brgyud de/ ha lam tsa dar gos 'grul lam ded nas shar phyogs su bskyod/ mi med lung stong dang ri tshogs g.yang gzar khrod kyi kyag kyog rkang lam phra mo ru kho tsho'i rkang rjes bzhag 'dzam gling yang rtse mi ru 'bod pa'i pha smir mtho sgang brgal rjes/ khong tshos rnga mong zhon nas mtha' klas pa'i tha khe ra ma rgan bye thang gyi lho phyogs mtha' khul bcad de mu mthud du shar phyogs su bgrod/ de nas lo pu'u po (7lo7)dang tun hong / yus min/ ci'u chon/ nying zha sogs sa khul brgyud mthar/ 1275lo'i zla 7par mong gol gyi rgyal sa snga ma hrang tu'u la slebs yang / skabs der sog po'i gong ma se chen rgyal po yis yon rgyal rabs btsugs nas rgyal sa tā tu'u byas/(lkos da lta'i pe cin)mar kho gcenag cung dang mar kho pho lo phebs par se chen rgyal po'i thugs shin tu dgyes te/ khong gi dbyar sa hrang tu'u yi pho brang nang dga' bsu'i tshogs chen bsdus nas gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams/ se chen rgyal pos pho lo nyer gcig la son zhing bzhin ris dwangs shing mdzes pa'i steng spyang grung 'tsher bzhin pa'i mar kho pho lo la shin tu dga' po skyes pas/ rang gi sku mdun du zhabs zhu byed du bcug/20/nga tu'u yi gnam gshes 'jam zhing yul ljongs shin tu mdzes pas/

mar kho pho lo yis de ru rdo ka ma ru dang rig dbang 'phrog pa'i rdo rigs mdzes pogazhan gyis bzos pa'i pho brang mthong ste khong gi sems pa yongs su bkugacung ma 'gor par mar kho pho lo ni se chen rgyal po'i sku rjes su 'brangs nas rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor/ de ga'i brjid chags mdzes sdug ldan pa'i pho brang dang tshad mthor thon pa'i shar phyogs shes rig gis khong rang ha las su bcugam kho pho lo yis pho brang de'i brtsigs dngos gtso bo brjod pa'i dus su/dzirgyal po'i pho brang ni jam nyams brjid du chags shing / bzo lta yid dbang 'gug la/ de'i nang mi mang po ji snyed kyis gsol ston bshams chog pho brang nang du phan tshun 'brel ba med pa'i brtsigs dngos du ma yod pa 'char bkod lugs dang mthun la/ sgrig gzhi 'phrod por snang bas lta na sdug cing / ar las lag rtsal ni lha'i bzo rtsal las kyang mkhas pas 'dzam gling gi yang rtser son/ rgya thabs steng tshon dog sna tshogasate dmar po dang ljang khu/ sngon po/ dmar smug sogs kyis rgyan yod pa dang /bzo sgrun brtan zhing mkhregs pas dus yun ring po'i lo zla'i bgam pa 'khyol thub pa byung 7zhes gsungs yod/tā tu'u ni yon rgyal rabs srid gzhung gis sngar gyi cin rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa krung tu'u (ltas)zhes pa'i shar byang khul du gsar du bskrun pa'i grong khyer gsar pa zhig yin te/ 1256lor skrun 'go bcoms shing 1283lor da gzod yongs su grub/ mar kho pho lo krung gor phebs pa'i skabs su tā tu'u yi che bzo rags tsam thon yod/ khong nyid gsar du skrun bzhin pa'i rgyal sa grong khyer du khad kyis 'khyam 'khyam du song ba dang / grong khyer de'i brjid nyams mdzes sdug dang / gra 'grig gcig 'gyur gyi rnam pa mthong pa'i tshe/ de ni 'dzam gling yongs su dkon pa'i grong khyer chen po zhig yin pa'i snang tshor drag tu shar pas khong gis/rgyal sa gsar pa'i dbyibs ni gru bzhi'i tshul du mngon zhing / gzhi khyon 27 spya le

38yod cing mtha' re rer ha lam spyi le 10yod/ mtha' 'khor du sa las bzos pa'i mkhar spyang yod par gyang rting gi zheng la gom pa 10lhag yod pa rim bzhin je chung la song nas byang rtser thon tshe gom pa 3tsam las ma yod/ mkhar gyang thams cad kha dog dkar po yin zhing / grong khyer yongs kyi jus 'god yod tshad drang thig spyad de 'char gzhi bzos pa dang / srang lam yod tshad phal cher drang por sngon phyogs su bsrings nas gyang rtsar thon/ mi zhig mkhar sgo'i steng 'dzegs nas phar phyogs su bltas tshe/ pha ga'i mkhar gyang gi mkhar sgo mthong thub/ mkhar nang gi spyi spyod srang lam gyi logs su tshong khang rnam pa sna tshogs dang thang bkram tshong mas yod/ grong mkhar nang gi sdod dmangs la gnang ba'i khang sa yang gru bzhi'i dbyibs yin pa ma zad/ da dung drang por gral du bsgrigs yod/ khang sa re re yid khengs tsam yod pas de ru bzo bkod legs shing phyi dbyibs mdzes pa'i khang pa dang ra skor/ me tog tham ra sogs skrun chog grong khyer yongs gru bzhi'i dbyibs su bkod pas/ mig mangs gi rtse ris zhig dang 'dra/jursha 'a/spya legs shing mdzes pa de skad cha tsam gyis brjod dka' ba zhig yin no 7zhes ba da ma/ kho/ pho lo ni snying rus che zhing slob sbyong la dga' ba zhig yin pas/dus tshod thung ngu'i nang sog po'i yul srol goms lugs dang / rgya nag skad dang sog po'i skad sogs skad rigs bzhi la byang / se chen rgyal pos mar kho pho lo ni skyes thob kyi shes rab can zhig yin par mthorngo nas/ las ka dngos nang gzhon nu de'i las don sgrub nas la tshod nyams len dgos dgongs/nyin zhig se chen rgyal pos mar kho pho lo hwa ra cang zhes pa'i yul thag ring sa zhig tu mngags nas rgyal srid kyi don chen zhig thag gcod byed du bcugamar kho pho lo yis rang gi spyang grung dang blo gros la brten nas don de legs por bsgrubs pos/ se chen rgyal pos gzigs mthong chen po byas nas blo gtad sa'i mi ru gyur pas/ krung dbyang srid gzhung nang las ka bsgrub tu bsta/ri

mar kho pho lo ni rgyal po'i bang chen byas nas rgyal yongs sa khul so sor phebs te gzigs zhib gnang ba dang las 'gan lag tu bstar/ gong ma rgyal pos mar kho pho lo krung go'i nub khul dang nub lho'i sa khul kha shas su mngags nas gzigs zhib byas myangs/ thengs shig rgyal sa nas lam la chas te/ yung ten chu bo'i (lkolham)'gram du thon tshe/ 1192lor bskrun pa'i ming grags can gyi gzhu dbyibs rdo zam te lu'u ki'u zam pa mig sngon du gsal ler mngon pas ngo mtshar chen po skyes te/ 6 de ni 'dzam gling steng du do zla bral ba'i zam chen zhig red/ zam pa'i ring tshad la gom pa 300lhag yod cing zheng tshad la gom pa 8tsam yod/ skya mi bcu'i dpung gshibs nas song yang lam dog pa'i snang ba med/ zam pa'i 'og tu sgo sgor mo 24yod pa dang / zam gdan 25chu nang du btsugs pas zam pa yar btegs/ sgo sgor mo ni rdo brtsigs nas grub cing de las zam pa bzo pa'i lag rtsal bla na med pa ma tshon yod/ mizhes dang che zam pa'i rdo'i ka ba'i bar la rdo ka ma ru'i rdo leb bting la/ de'i stong ri mo spus legs kyi ri mo brkos yod pas/ zam pa yongs ni 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du brjid chags mig dbang 'phrog pa'i tshul du snang ngo mi zhes zhib gleng byas/ khong ni phal cher krung go'i gzhu dbyibs rdo zam yo rob la ngo sprod byed sdu// /kā ༵ /spya shā ༵ chezhe/ sa sdi /sdo /kyi mis da lta'i bar du lu'u gi'u zam par mar kho pho lo ni gro'o kro'u ( tsho7)dang tha'e yon (86)sogs su 'gro myangs la lo rgyus 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rma chu'i 'gram ngogs su phebs nas rba rlabs chil chil du bzhur pa'i chu bor gzigs nas/ 6 chu bo'i gting zab pa dang chu ngos kyi zheng che bas de la zam pa brtan po zhig bzo thabs ye nas med ’ zhes brjod/ de nas rma chur brgal nas lho phyogs su bskyod de snga rjes su 'i an (oṣṭha)dang han krung (17)du phebs pa dang de nas chin lebye/ /rngo

thun)ri rgyud brgal nas si khron (༅///)gyi khrin tu'u mkhar (treḥs)du slebs/ khrin tu'u ru mar kho pho lo yis thengs dang por rlabs che ba'i 'bri chu la rgyus len byas pa ma zad da dung zhib tu zin bris gnang / khong gis chu chen phra bzhur dang chu'i yan lag du ma 'dus nas gtsang po chen po grub te shar phyogs nas rgya mtsho'i nang bzhur pa dang / 6 gtsang bo'i 'gram ngogs gnyis dang nye mar kho pho lo/'khor du/ grong brdal dang mkhar rdzong du ma yod/ gtsang bo'i khrod kyi gru dang rlung g.yor ni grog ma brgyugs pa bzhin mang la/ de dag gis tshong rdzas mang po skyel 'dren byed ces gsungs/ de nas mar kho pho lo khrin tu'u nas lam du chas te nub phyogs su bskyod de/ ri bo mthon po dang chu bo chen po du ma brgal nas/ mi nyung yang yul gru che ba'i bod mtho sgang la slebs pas/bod kyi sa khams khor yug dang / chab srid dpal 'byor/ yul srol goms lugs sogs la gzigs zhib gang legs mdzad/ khong gis yon rgyal rabs kyis khyon yongs su shog sgor spyod kyin yod rung / bod du shog sgor ma dar bar da dung snye tshwa ni rgyun spyod sgor mo yin mi pa mthong zhing / de las bod du tshwa la rin thang che ba mtshon yod/ mar kho pho lo da dung yun nan (rtotshe)sogs sakhul du phebs nas nub lho'i grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la gzigs zhib gswāhā /sa/ de ga'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba/ dad pa/

gomasasrol ste dper na khron pa las tshwa len pa dang lus la ri mo gtsag pa/sprul 'dzin pa sogs la gson nyams ldan pa'i zin bris mdzad yod/mar kho pho lo bang chen du phebs pa'i lam gzhan zhig ni/ tā tu'u nas lho la phyogs nas bar lam du len ching (/lo )dang cis nan (ṣṭhatshe)tung phen (lkog)sogs brgyud de cang su'u (77)la slebs nas de ga'i grong khyer du mar phebs myangs/ dbyang kri'u (67)ru srid gzhung gis bsko 'jog byas pa'i srid dpon gyi 'gan bzhes te lo gsum ring bzhugs myangs/khongad dung kre cang (glo1)dang cang nan (1tshe)rmu can (rsā4)sogs zhing chen du phebs myangs/ hang kri'u (77)ni sngar nan sung (tshelko)rgyal rabasakyi rgyal sa yin/(rgyal rabs de 1279lor yon rgyal rabs kyis meg med du btang) mar kho pho lo thengs du ma la 6 lha yul midu 'bod pa'i shar phyogs ming grags can gyi grong khyer der gzigs skor du phebs myangs/ khong gis da dung smyo grong khyer de ni brjid rngam mdzes nyams ldan pas/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi grong khyer gyi gtsug rgyan red/ de ru gna' shul gnas mchog shin tu mang zhing / mi rnams la lha yul du 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i tshor snang ster zhes dang / mdzes sdug yid du 'ongs pa'i zhi hu'u (khro )mtshe'u dang /mtshe'u steng gi spro bsang gtong byed kyi gru gzings la bstod pa'i ngag yang yang shor de che rnam pa 'di 'dra mthong ba na/ yid spro bag phebs kyi snang ba dang lus sems kun tu bzi ba'i tshor ba ster zhes brjod pa ma zad/ da dung sngar de ru skabs tsam gzhis chags pa'i nan sung rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur pas gnas skabs kyi bde bar zhen chags nas/ bag med rgyas spros kyi rul sungs 'tsho bar g.yengs pas mthar thug rgyal po'i khri thog nas mar lhung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dpyis phyin pa bstan yod/yon rgyal rabs srid gzhung gi bang chen byas te/ mar kho pho swā 0sbya na

phyi'i rgyal khab tu las 'gan gnyer du song myong pas/ 'jar pan (/'ji babras)dang rgya gar/(ṭhaṣṭha) sgra wa/(3 878 lo4) selon/(00110ba pa)'bar ma/(20772 lo7) la'os/(2803 67 ) khethonam (71 rngu ba la7tshe)sogs a she ya'i rgyal khab dang sa khul mang por phebs myangs/ khong gis yul gru de dag gi gnas tshul gsal zhing zhib pa se chen rgyal po'i snyan la phul pa ma zad/ da dung lo rgyus kyi don rkyen kha shas zin bris btab yod de/dper na yon rgyal rabs srid gzhung gis 'jar pan la dmag brgyab tshul dang / nang pa chos lugs dar tshul/ yon rgyal rabs kyis sing blu la ru bang chen mngags nas ston pa'i tshems gdan drangs pa la sogs pa zhib por zin bris mdzad yod/rgyal nang du gzigs zhib tu phebs pa'am phyi rgyal du bang chen du phebs pa gang rung / mar kho pho lo yis phebs yul gang du thon kyang las 'gan legs por bsgrubs pa'i steng / da dung yul khams de dag gi yul srol goms lugs dang yul gru gzhan gyi ngo mtshar gtam rgyud sogs sdud len dang bcar 'dri byed par do snang mdzad/ las 'gan grub te phyir phebs rjes zhib gsal sgos se chen rgyal po'i snyan du 'bul/ de bzhin du lo zla ni rim gyis phyin la mar kho pho lo yis mi lo 17la yon rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung la las ka bsgrubs/dus yun ring du byin pa dang / mar kho pho lo'i pha dang khu bo gnyis lo na rgas pa'i thog rang yul dran pa'i sems pa'ang nyin re bzhin je drag tu song zhing / mar kho pho lo rang nyid kyang de las ma 'da'/ dus mtshungs su/ khong gsum gyis gser dngul rgyu nor yang gang mang zhig bsags pas/ phyir pha yul du log nas 'tsho ba skyel bar sems 'khrul bya mi dgos/ de bas na/mar kho pho lo yis 1292lor se chen rgyal por phyir rang yul du log nas gnyen nyedri // 'phrad du 'gro ba'i re 'dun zhus/ de dus pho gzi (26731 tha ṣṭhaglo)

dang a she ya chung ba lte gnas byas pa'i el khan ( smo smostu ba 716ma ching ke si rgyal po'i tsha bos btsugs pa'i rgyal khab cig sgyur pa pos/)rgyal khab kyis pho nya mngags nas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tshang la mna' ma bslangs/ se chen rgyal pos gnyen nye'i nang nas mo lo 17la slebs shing mdzes sdug yid du 'ongs pa'i sras mo mkho mkho sbyin zhes pa yul khams der bag mar gtong rgyu thag bcad de/ mar kho pho lo pha bu dang a khu gsum gyis sras mo srung skyel byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang / de nas khong tsho rgya mtsho'i steng nas su sme the ra (3572 zung smo/ )lho )dang rgya gar sogs brgyud de pho gzi ru slobs/mar kho pho los las 'gan de yongs su grub rjes phyir pha yul du log pa'i lam du chas shing / 1295lor lo ngo 24la kha bral ba'i we nee dzi a ru slebs la/ de dus khong nyid dgung lo 41ru son 'dug go/1298lor dbyi tha li'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis te we ne dzi a dang sge no wa (60baX lnga sa76༅)gnyis bar rgya mtsho'i steng dmag 'khrug thengs sheg brgyab/ mar kho pho lo ni 'thab 'dzing khrod sge ne wa'i dmag gis 'dzin bzung byas nas btson khang nang bcug btson khang nang du khong gis shar phyogs su 'grum pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar can brjod pas/ btson grogs rnams kyi yid sems dbang med du bkug de'i nang ming la ru si thi kha no (21 3 101800 67 )zhes pa yod pas/ hpha ran si'i ye ge ru ngo mtshar lo rgyus thams cad zin bris btab nas/ ming grags che ba'i mar kho pho lo'i yul skor brjed tho〉zhes pa'i dpe cha grub/ 1299lor mar kho pho lo btson las bkrol pas phyir we ne dzi a ru phebs shing / 1324lor snyun gzhi'i rkyen las sku gshegs shing de dus dgung lo 70yin no//mar kho pho lo krung go ru lo ngo 17la bzhugs te/ yon rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung la las ka phan ldan du ma bsgrubs/ 〈mar kho pho lo'i yul skor ri~X/da

tho〉zhes pa'i dpe deb nang / shar phyogs kyi 'byor phyug dang shes rig shin tu dar pa'i rnam pa brjod yod pas/ krung go'i sngon thon rig gnas yo rob la ngo sprod byas stabs/ des yo rab la shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod/ mar kho pho lo yis krung go dang nub phyogs bar gyi rig gnas brje res la bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod/ khong ni dus rabs bar ma'i ljongs rgyu mkhan byas nas/ khong gi brjed tho〉des yo rob kyi mi'i mig rgya bskyed pas/ dus rabasabar ma'i mi rnams kyi sa khams shes bya phun sum tshogs par btang ba dang / snga mo'i dus kyi yo rob sa khra 'bri bar shugs rkyen zab mo bzhag yod/yo rob kyi mi mang pos brjed tho〉bklags rjes/ shar phyogs su rgyu nor 'tshol du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po skye ru bcug pas/ dus rabs 15nas 16bar gyi yo rob mtsho 'grul las don mgyogs myur du 'phel bar skul spel byas yod do//208

shar zugs gu gseragatshochuthar phyin pa'i thog ma'i rkang zhes/〈mar kho pho lo'i yul skor brjed tho〉zhes pas mar kho pho lo yis shar phyogs kyi mthong thos gsal por yo rob pa tshor brjod pas/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang sku drag btsun pa tshos shar phyogs kyi 'byor phyug la ha las ngo mtshar skye ru bcug krung go dang rgya gar du yul khongs thams cad gser gyis khengs pa'i gtam rgyud kyis kho pa tsho'i sred zhen gyi 'gram chu 'dzad/ ma rtsa'i thog ma'i gsog 'jog gi 'go bcoms pa'i dus su/ yo rob kyi mi la mtshon na/ gser la phal cher ngo mtshar do zla bral ba'i stobs shugs shig yod pa 'dra ste/ sa khe pher (568ji0968707tsho ༅)gyis zhib 'bri byas pa bzhin du/ gser gyis nag po dkar por bsgyur thub la/ btsog po snying sdug tu gtong thub/ nor 'khrul bden par bsgyur thub cing / dman pa mthon por 'degs thub pa/rgan khog gzhon nur bsgyur nus shing / sdar ma dpa' bor bsgyur nus pades da dung jag rkun la go gnas mthon po yang thob tu 'jug 'dod rngam che ba'i nub phyogs yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tsho la/ ngang sgug byed long med par shar phyogs su 'gro bar brel ba skyes/ nyen kha chen po gang la 'phrad kyang the tshom med par/ de ga'i yul grur bkang ba'i gser 'phrog tu 'gro bar brel/yin na'ang / ji ltar shar phyogs su 'gro rgyu ni gnad don chen ༵ /ga

me rdzas nyer spyod byas pa'i rkyen gyis mtsho lam gsar pa gtod par dngos po'i cha rkyen bskrun pa red/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i nang / phor thi'u gal (207 56ma mu〉kha)gyi mi ni rgya mtsho'i phyi ru mi ser spel pa'i gdung mchong mkhan du gyur/ snga mo'i dus kyi dus rabs 15pa'i dus stod du/ kho tshos (dper na nā we sga rdor (50bkro19500 775668607lhas/)lta bu)mtsho skyod lam gsar 'tshol ba'i nyen kha'i bya 'gul spel pa dang /rjes su ḍi a si (281 010brku05 7123 7sgro )yang bya 'gul de 'drar zhugs pa ma zad rtsa 'dzugs kyang byed myangs/nā we sga rdor ni phor thi'u gal gyi rgyal sras yin zhing / 1415lor phor thi'u gal gyis a hphe ri kha'i nub byang mtsho 'gram gyi khe'u tha (005 8྅khulhameji)mkhar grong blangs rjes/ kho rang de ga'i tsung tu'u ru bskos/ de nas bzung /yul de phor thi'u gal gyis mtsho phyir btsan 'dzul byed pa'i gnas gzhir gyur/nā we sga rdor tshe gang por rgyang thag ring ba'i mtsho skyod thengs gcig la'ang zhugs ma myong mod/ kho ni phor thi'u gal gyis mtsho lam gsar pa 'tshol ba'i bya 'gul rtsa 'dzugs byed mkhan red/ khos mtsho skyod slob grwa zhig btsugs nas mtsho skyod mi sna du ma sbyong brdar skyed bsring byas/ 1418lo nas bzung /khos 6 myul dpyad ru khag mi rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ a hphe ri kha gling chen gyi nub phyogs mtsho 'gram ded de shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i mtsho lam btsal/1432lor a rdzo re si (420163 krokhrutshoṣṭhapo)gling tshom btsan len byas/1434lor sbo sgra rdor (2038607 677po )mtsho zur blangs shing /1445lor wer sde (50770 lta'i2ces(mi lko))mtsho zur blangs/ 1471lor ku'i nee ya (651 ba07 7ltarsā)ru thon/ de'i 'phror phor thi'u gal gyis bstud mar a hphe ri kha nub ma'i 6 pho ba ris mtsho 'gram ’ dang 6 ba so~X /tsho
