zur gyi kha nā ri a si gling tshom (28281183 10molko/sa se phan la gtogs pa)nas 'jar pan bar mtsho le 2400las med cing / gling tshom de nas krung go'i bar mtsho le 3350las med par 'dod/ kho lom sbo yis da dung nor 'khrul sgos yo rob nas nub phyogs su bskyod na a she ya dang bar rgya mtsho chen po gcig las med par snyam/ gling chen de gnyis bar da dung skam cha chen po ste a me ri kha gling chen po yod pa khos rtsa ba nas shes med pa red/kho lom sbo mtsho skyod byed pa'i mtha' ma'i dmigs 'ben ni rgya gar red/khos sems su rgya gar ni krung go dang 'dra bar yul gru yongs gser gyis khengs 'dug snyam/ kho lom sbo yang skabs de'i yo rob kyi dbang sgyur pa dang nyen mchong ba thams cad dang 'dra ste/ gser dngul rin po che la bzod dka' ba'i rngam zhen skyes yod/ khos gser ni kun las lhag pa'i dngos por brtsis te/ 6 gser ni tshong rdzas yod dgu'i nang gi rin po che yin zhing / gser ni rgyu nor yin te/ su la gser yod tshe de la 'dzam gling steng mkho ba'i dngos po mtha' dag thob thub la/ dus mtshungs su rnam shes kyang dmyal ba'i nang las skyob thub pa ma zad/ de ni rnam shes kyis slar yang lha'i yul gyi bde skyid rol ba'i thabs shes kyang red zer/1484lor/ kho lom sbo yis phor thi'u gal gyi rgyal po 'jon sku rabs gnyis pa la rang gi 'char gzhi'i yig cha phul nas rgyu dngos kyis rogs ram byed pa'i re ba zhus kyang / phor thi'u gal ni skabs der a hphe ri kha bskor nas shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i mtsho lam 'tshol bar brel bas/ kho lom sbo yi 'char gzhi la nges gtan med ces te chog mchan ma gnang / de nas kho lom sbo khong khro'i ngang li si sbon dang bral nas se phan du gnas spos te/ pha lo si (2106༅༅༅)gru kha'i nye 'khor gyi ye shu'i chos khang zhig tu gnas bcas/ kho lom sbo ༵༵ se phan gyi tshong pa dang gru dpon/ gong ma'i pho brang nang gi mi rnams la

rang gi 'char gzhi 'ud sgrog byas pa dang / mi de dag brgyud nas rang gi 'charagazhi se phan gyi rgyal po dang btsun mor phul/ yin na'ang skabs der rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis se phan gyi mor pa (70013 po)ru 'bod pa'i i si lam chos lugs la dad pa'i mi dang dmag 'khrug rgyag par brel bas kho lom sbo yi 'char gzhi la zhib 'dri byed long ma yod/ 1492lo'i zla 1por/ se phan gcig gyur du btang rjes/ se phan rgyal pos gling chen phyi ru mi ser spel rgyu dang 'phrog len bya rgyu/ gser 'tshol rgyu sogs gros rim nyin tho'i thog la bton/ btsun mo i sa spel la ni kho lom sbo yi 'char gzhi la spro sems chen po byung bas/ pho brang nang gi blon po la las ngo rgol byas rung 'char gzhi de la rgyab skyor byas te/ mi sger gyi ming las dngul skor zhig phul nas kho lom sbo la rogs ram byed rgyu thag bcad/ kho lom sbo yi nub phyogs su skyod pa'i 'char gzhi gzhi nas se phan gong ma tshang gi chog mchan thob pa ma zad/ da dung〈san tā hphe chod yig〉zhes pa kyang bris/1492lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 3nyin/ 6 san rma ri a ’ rtags can dang /lha phen tha ’ rtags can/ 6 ne nā rtags can gyi gru gzings gsum dang gru pa 88yod pa bcas 6 mtsho steng dmag dpon mikho lom sbo yi sne khrid 'og se phan gyi pha lo si (2203 3rma )gru kha nas lam du chas nas/ kha nā ri a si ((80811 83 10lkolko/)gling tshom phyogs su bskyod/ zla 9pa'i tshes 6nyin/ kho tsho'i gru starakha nā ri a si gling tshom dang bral nas nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i steng bskyod 'go brtsams/ gru gsum po shar byang rlung dang bstun nas drang mor nub phyogs su bskyod cing zla 1tsam 'gor kyang kho tshos nyin mtshan res mor mig lam du mthong ba ni mu mtha' bral ba'i rgya mtsho las ci yang ma yod/ dus yun ring mor 'grul skyod byas kyang skam sa lag mthil tsam yang ma mthong bas/ gru pa tshos dbugs ring 'byin zhing sdug skad bton nas sos mi bde bar zing zing du gyur/ dka' khag che ba'i skabs te zla lha//pa'i

tshes 12nyin gyi zhogs par/ 6phen tha mirtags cam steng gi gru pa zhig gis glo bur du skad chen por skam sa/ skam sa mi zhes 'ur brgyab pas/ gru pa tsho mi lam yul nas sad du bcug pas/ yar gru gcal steng brgyugs nas nub phyogs su bltas tshe/ dngos nas skam sa zhig mthong bas tshang mar dga' sbo shod dka' ba zhig skyes so//cung ma 'gor bar/ gru gzings mtsho 'gram du bcar ba dang / kho lom sbo yis dmag chas dmar po zhig gyon zhing / gru dpon gzhan pa gnyis kyis stong du so sor stu (se phan gyi rgyal po hpher nan rdo'i mtshon rtags)dang 61 (btsun mo i sa sbel la'i mtshon rtags)yi ge gnyis gtsags yod pa'i dar ljang khu gnyis khur nas gru pa tsho khrid de skam sa'i steng babs/ kho tshos rgya mtsho'i gram pa'i steng pus mo sa la btsugs nas lha'i dbang por gsol ba btab rjes/ kho lom sbo yis se phan rgyal po dang btsun mo'i tshab tu gling phran de blangs pa khyab bsgrags byas/ khos ral gri phyung nas shing sdong 'ga' gtub tebatsan 'dul byas pa'i mtshon byed byas shing / gling phran de'i ming la cu san sal wa rdor (mgon skyabs kyi don)zhes btags/don dngos su kho lom sbo slebs pa'i sa cha ni a me ri kha dkyil ma'i sba hwa ma (2868183 khutsho6)gling tshom gyi wa the ling si (ya 11023 477)gling phran yin rung / kho lom sbo yis kho rang a she ya ru slebs song bsams nas yul de rgya gar gyi gling phran zhig yin par rlom pas/ yul de'i sdod mi la en rdi an si zer/ (1261 thabaci gzo༅( de ni rgya gar la /ba618 lnga zer pas rgya gar pa zhes pa dang don gcig yin) da lta'i bar du a me ri kha gling chen gyi yul sdod pa tshor en di an gyi mi zhes 'bod kyang / de ni lo rgyus stang shā nor thebs pa'i don zhig yin te nor bcos byed thabs med pa zhig tu gyur wa the ling si gling phran steng gi sdod mi tsho skabs der da dung gdod ma'i kung hre'i spyi tshogs dus rim du gnas shing / sger la dbang pa'i rgyu nor med la/22zhung drang bab chags dang gtong phod che la mgron por dga' ba zhig

yin pas/ se phan gyi mis rin gong dma' ba'i dngos po chung gi rigs te shel ril gyi phreng ba dang gri chung la sogs pas kho tsho'i rtsa chen dngos po ji snyed slu len byas/ kho lom sbo yis yid la dran dran ni gser 'tshol rgyu yin pas/yul de'i sdod mi tshos rgyan cha kha dog ser po can spras yod pa mthong nas de dag gang las thob pa yang yang dris/ sdod mi tshos lag brda brgyab pa ltar na/nub lho phyogs kyi sa cha zhig tu gser 'bor chen thon pa'i tshor snang byin pas/kho tshos gdug rtsub sgos yul mi 6btsan khrid byas nas lho phyogs su gser 'tshol bar lam khrid du bcugazla 10pa'i tshes 15nyin/ kho lon sbo ra mu gling phran du 'byor zhing gling phranablangs pa khyab bsgrags byas/ tshes 28nyin khu sba (65ne te༅)gling phran du slebs shing / de ni gling phran shin tu chen po zhig yin par/ kho lom sbo yis krung gor slebs song bsams rung / ya mtshar che ba zhig la yul de ru mar kho pho lo yis bshad pa'i lha yul dang 'dra ba'i yul ljongs dang mig dbang 'phrog pa'i gser/ dri ngad phyogs bzhir ldang pa'i dri zhim rdzas gcig kyang mthong rgyu ma byung / kho lom sbo yid chad de mu mthud du mtsho skyod byas pa dang /zla 12pa'i tshes 26nyin/ kho tsho he thi gling phran (281 1 lo7)du slebs/yul de ni shin tu 'byor phyug 'jon thang can zhig yin pas rin po che mang po thon kyi 'dug se phan pa tsho ni mtsho jag bzhin du ham 'dod che bas yul de'i sdod mi tsho'i dngos po yod tshad 'phrog bcom byas/de nas lho phyogs su bgrod pa'i skabs su/ kho lom sbo sdod sa'i 6 san rma ri a ’ rtags can la chag skyon byung bas/ khos gru gzings kyi chag hril gyis skam sa'i steng ra ba zhig bskor du bcug ste/ a me ri kha gling chen gyi mi ser spel ba'i gnas gzhi dang po btsugs shing / de'i ming la 6 ye shu'i 'khrungs skar grong zhes btags pa dang de ru skyogs chen bkod cing gru pa /sprasang

dmag tu bzhag rjes phyir log pa'i mtsho skyod kyi 'go brtsams/1493lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 15nyin/ kho lom sbo phyir pha lo si gru sar slebs/ dpa' bo rgyal kha blangs nas phyir log pa nang bzhin gyi dga' bsu gzab rgyas thob/ sngar sus kyang mi shes pa'i mi phal ba kho lom sbo ni da lta rta mchog cig la zhon zhing kha dog dmar po can gyi dmag lu gyon nas/ btsan du khrid 'ongs pa'i en rdi an gyi mi dang 'phrog len byas pa'i gser sogs rin po che khyer nas se phan gyi rgyal por mjal bar song / rgyal po dang btsun mo/ bka' blon mang pos gzab gos gyon nas kho lom sbo la bsu ba byas/ kho lom sbo yis thengs de'i mtsho skyod kyi gnas tshul yar zhu byas te/ shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i mtsho lam rnyed song ba dang / de ru 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rgyu nor yod pas mi rnams song nas gsar 'don byed par bsgugs yod pa dang /rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis kyis kho rang slar yang de ru 'gro bar chog mchan bkod par mkhyen zhes zer/lo phyed tsam phyin rjes kyi 1493lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 25nyin/ g.yor gru 17dang 2 gru pa ’ 2000 las grub pa'i thengs gnyis pa'i rgyang skyod gru ltar lam la chas/ thengs 'di'i rgyang skyod la rngam zil shin tu che/ mi mang pos ma dngul gyis rgyab skyor byas pa ma zad/ da dung rgyu nom pa mang po thob par re ba bcangs pa'i sku drag gi bu phrug dang chos spel mkhan/ tshong pa bcas bung ba'i tshogs 'khor pa bzhin 'ongs nas mi ser spel ba'i ru khag de'i nang zhugs rgyur re ba byas/gru star de thog mar rdo smi ne kha (20410102 77sko༅meb)sogs gling phran du slebs/ zla 11pa'i tshes 27nyin thengs gnyis par he thi (54 1 loṭha)gling phran du slebs/ kho lom sbo ha las pa zhig la/ de ga'i 6 ye shu'i 'a~X skar grong mi ni zhig ro tsam las lhag med/ de snga shul du bzhag pa'i gru

pa 39pos gling phran steng bag med ham shed sgos gser dang bud med 'phrog pas/ en rdi an gyi mi la khong khro bslangs pas gru pa de tsho gcig kyang ma lus par rtsa med du btang / de nas kho lom sbo la khong khro me ltar 'bar bas/ he thi gling phran la gdug rtsub ngang mi ser spel ba'i drag 'dul byas/ kho'i nu bo yul de'i 6 zhing chen gyi gtso bzhugs mi su bskos te/ a me ri kha gling chen du se phan gyi mi ser spel ba'i las khungs thog ma btsugs shing / lo na 14yan chad kyi en di an gyi mis gser dang ras sogs lo rer phul nas rten 'bul byed dgos la/ gal te ma phul na gsod rgyu yin zhes bka' babs/ da dung yul de'i sdod mi tsho btsan 'ded byas nas se phan mi ser spel mkhan la g.yog las byed du bcug cing / de'i nang las mi 500phyir se phan du bskyal nas bran g.yog tu btsong / en rdi an gyi mis ngo rgol tsam byas na de la mtshon gyis drag gnon byas/lo rgyus kyis ra sprod byas pa ltar/ kho lom sbo thengs 'gar rgyang skyod byas nas thon pa'i yul ni/ rgya gar ma yin la krung go lhag tu ma yin par/ de ni 2 skam sa chen po gsar pa mi ste a me ri kha gling chen red/ khos rmi lam du thob na 'dod pa'i rgya gser gyis bkang ba'i yul khams shā kyang ma rnyed/ yin na'ang / kho la yi chad ma skyes par/ 1498lo'i zla 3par slar yang phyir se phan du log pa dang / lo de'i zla 5pa dang 1502lo'i zla 3par thengs gnyis su nub phyogs su mtsho skyod byas kyang / thog mtha' bar gsum du a me ri kha dkyil ma dang lho ma'i gling phran dang skam sa chen po'i mtsho 'gram sa khul so sor phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa las/ cis kyang pha nā ma (28ba la ༅rsā6)brgal nas mu mthud du nub phyogs su skyod pa'i mtsho lam zhig ma rnyed/ de bzhin du kho lom sbo yang sems pham la yid skyo ba'i ngang phyir se phan du mi log ga med byung / 227

1506lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 20nyin/ kho lom sbo ni skyo sdug dang mnyam du se phan gyi wa ri a rdo ri grong du tshe las 'das shing / kho'i gser gyi mi lam dang lus po gnyis mnyam gcig tu 'jig rten 'di ru med par yal/mar khe sis gsung don/ ra 'phrog bcom zhes pa ni se phan gyi nyen dpyad pa tshos a me ri kha gling chen du bzung ba'i dmigs bya nyag cig red/ kho lom sbo yi mtsho skyod las don la'ang / gong smos kyi ngo tsha khrel med kyi dmigs yul de bzung yod/ kho'i bya 'gul yongs kyis a me ri kha gling chen gyi bdag po ste yen di an gyi mi la sdug bsngal chen po bzos yod pas/ kho ni mingadon gnyis mthun gyi mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs pa zhig yin pa mtshon yod/ yin na'ang / de ni 'go btsams pa tsam yin te/ rjes su yo rob kyi rshaser spel mkhan mang po lus dogs sngon 'tshang byas nas 6 skam sa chen po gsar pa ru 'ongs nas snying 'jags kyi sa gzhi chen po 'di me dang khrag gi brdzis pa red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ kho lom sbo yis mtsho lam gsar pa zhig gsar du btod de/ yo rob pa tshor shes med pa'i a me ri kha'i gling chenayod pa shes su bcug pas/ ma rtsa'i thog ma'i gsog 'jog je mgyogs su btang ba dang / yo rob kyi gsar byung 'byor ldan gral rim la tshong ra gsar pa zhig 'don sprod byas stabs/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas dang / yorob dang a me ri kha gling chen bar gyi rig gnas brje res la skul spel gyi phananus bton yod do// 228

sa'i gogar thengs dang porabaskor babargyabags mtsho skyod byas la/1519lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 20nyin/ se phan lho phyogs kyi san lu'u khar (58ba 65081 2 〉rdoṣṭha )gru kha ru smyogs chen gyi sgra ldir ldir bsgrags pa dang / dmag gru'i ru khag cig gis gru 'dog lcags kyu yar 'then zhing rlung g.yor mtho ru btegs nas/ skyel ma tsho dang bral nas sprin smug che la mtha' klas pa'i nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i stong rim bzhin yal/ de bzhin du mi'i rigs lo rgyus steng thengs dang por sa'i go lar skor ba brgyab nas mtsho skyod byed pa'i dpa' nyams ldan pa'i bya spyod de'i 'go brtsams so//thengs 'di'i mtsho skyod la se phan rgyal pos rgyab skyor dang chog mchan gnang rjes 'go bcoms pa dang / / sa khams gsar rnyed chen po'i ’ lo rabs su/ 'byor phyug ldan pa'i shar phyogs su song nas gser dang rin po che/dri zhim rdzas 'tshol bar spro ba'i lo zla'i nang / 1492lor kho lom sbo yis rnyed pa'i 6 skam sa chen po gsar pa yis se phan la rgyu nor 'bor chen khyer yong ma thub kyang / 1499lor phor thi'u kul gyi mi ḍa rga ma (78300 77 677tha mamaṣka'i cha)rgya gar yul ngo ma nas phyir li si sbo a (21 3608 tshomolha)ru log pa des/ phor thi'u gal gyi dbang sgyur ba ming don gnyis mthun gyi hob thob phyug gsar du gyur/ se phan gyi gong ma tshang gis bltas bltas rig rig tu lo rer gser dang dri zhim rdzas/ ba so/ bran g.yog 'bor chen khyim mtshes rgyal khab tu bskyel pa mthong bas sred zhen gyi 'gram chu ldang /22sbyar

thi'u gal gyis bkag sdom ma byas pa'i phyogs shig nas a she ya 'phrog len byed hāgos snyam nas/ u tshugs su nub phyogs nas mtsho lam gsar pa 'tshol bar na/ skabs ded / phor thi'u gal gyi skya mi dbul po zhig se phan la yong zhing /1518lor se phan gong ma rgyal po la rang gis rang nyid 'os sbyor byas nas/dmag gru ru khag cig khrid de mtsho lam gsar pa gtod 'dod yod tshul bshad/mtsho lam gsar pa 'di ni a hphe ri kha gling chen bskor nas shar phyogs su bgrod rgyu ma yin par/ yo rob gling chen la bral ba dang thad kur nub phyogs su bskyod de a me ri kha gling chen lho ma bskor nas dri zhim rdzas mang po thon sa ste smo lu kha gling tshom (50/500thasgokhupyomeb)sgrol slebs rjes/ mu mthud du nub phyogs su bskyod 77 cing a hphe ri kha'i lho sne bskor nas byang phyogs su 'khor nas a hphe ri kha nub ma'i mtsho 'gram ded nas phyir se phan du log rgyu byas/ de ni snying stobs che zhing nang don gsar pa'i 'char gzhi rshazhig yin pas/ de lta na a she ya ru skyod pa 'i 〉(mtsho lam gsar ju zhig rnyed pa'i ma tshad/ da ridung sa'i go lar skor ba gcig kyang rgyag thub pa red/ smi rje lin/skya mi de la smi rje lin (526052ba dzramenasmo6 cho0྅ 1458—1521lo)zer/ kho ni nyams rgyad du song ba'i phor tshom reX/ skabs der gling tshom de la drizhim rdzasakyiglingatshom zerazhing da lta'i yen ri sna si a 'i 75670230

thi'u gal gyi skya mi'i khyim tshang zhig tu skyes pa red/ lo na 12steng rgyal po'i btsun mo'i g.yog phrug byas pas/ rgyun du rgyal po dang btsun mo'i rjes 'brangs nas sa cha so sor yul skor du song nas yul ljongs sna tshogs mig gi bcud du len myangs/ 6 sa khams gsar rnyed chen po'i mi dus skabs su/mtsho skyod dang nyen dpyad bya 'gul bcas kyis kho'i sems pa ring nas bkug yod/ 1496lor/ kho rang rgyal khab kyi mtsho skyod las don khang du mngags pas/ mtsho skyod skor gyi shes bya sbyong 'go brtsams te/ kho lom sbo dang ḍa ṅga ma sogs kyi mtsho skyod phyogs kyi ma rgyu la zhib tu rgyus lon byas yod/ 1505lor/smi rje lin phor thi'u gal gyi thengs dang por rgya gar tsung tu'u yi 'gan 'khur mkhan al me sda (me/701 spu masarsā 7)yi rgyang 'dul ru khag tu zhugs shing / de ni kho rang gis thog mar spel ba'i mi ser spel ba'i bya 'gul yin la/tshe gang por mtsho skyod nyen dpyad kyi las don sgrub pa'i 'go yang de nas brtsams/ rjes su rgya gar dang sme la kha/( 501828 thol ) smo lu kha si (5༷/50083 sgo zlokhyemeb)gling tshom/ nyin ḍū ne si a sogs su/ thengs du mar mi ser spel ba'i dmag 'khrug gi gdung mchong mkhan byas te/ 'phrog bcom dang 'thab 'dzing la zhugs pas thengs gsum la lus por rmas skyon phog myangs shing / 1513lor da gzod phyir li si spon (21 360ba ༅spos)du logalo brgyad ring gi rgyang skyod bya 'gul des smi rje lin gyi mtsho skyod kyi shes bya phun sum tshogs par btang ba dang / kho yang sa'i go la ni zlum ril dbyibs yin pa dang / yo rob nas mu mthud du nub phyogs su bskyod tshe/ mthar thug sa'i spya la~X skor ba brgyab te phyir 'go bcoms pa'i yul du 'byor thub par yid sa py-i /rje lin phyir li so sbon du slebs skabs kho rang nyam thag dbul phongs su gyur pas/ phor thi'u kul gyis smo ro kho (5010000 sgo cha)la 2)/ba

pa'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug nang mi zhugs ga med byung zhing de la pham nyes byung rjes/ kho rang a sbo tho la gnas spos/ 1515lo nas bzung / rang nyid rgyang ring yul du mtsho skyod byed par 'char gzhi bkod/ kho'i dmigs bya gtso bo ni yo rob nas dri zhim rdzas kyi gling tshom du 'gro rgyu de yin mod/ nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo nas a me ri kha gling chen ji ltar brgal dgos pa dang / a me ri ka gling chen nas dri zhim rdzas kyi gling tshom bar gyi rgya mtsho'i zheng la tshad ji 'dra zhig yod pa sogs ni skabs de'i mi rnams la cha rgyus med pa red/yin na'ang / dpa' ngar ldan pa'i nyen dpyod pa kha shas kyis smi rje lin la rin thang che ba'i rgyu cha 'don sprod byas/ 1513lor se phan gyi mi sbal sbo lku(21608 3poṣṭha༅)nipha nā ma (28ba la khursā6)yi zheng ches dog sa brgyud de a me ri kha gling chen gyi mtsho 'gram nub mar slebs te zu lho'i rgya ma chen mo ’ (zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo) rnyed pas/ mi rnams kyis a she ya ni de'i phar phyogs su yod pas rgyang thag ring po med par snyam/ 'o na nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo dang lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo gnyis bar 'brel ba'i mtsho lam te mtsho 'gag gang du yod ce na/ 1514lor phor thi'u gal gyi mi le si pho a yis lho'i 'phregathig gi tshad 40ru a hphe ri kha'i ches lho sne'i re smon mtsho zur dang mtshungs pa'i mtsho zur ram mtsho 'gag cig rnyed pas/ yang mi rnams kyis de ni nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo dang lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo 'brel byed kyi chu lam red snyam/ gsar rnyed de dag gis smi rje lin la skul lcag chen po thob/ khos a me ri kha lho kha bskor nas lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo 'phred du bcad de dri zhim rdzas kyi gling tshom bu bgrod rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos mod/ lho'i rgya mtsho chen po'i zheng tshad ni nub mirgya mtsho chen mo'i tshad tsam med par bsams pas/ lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo na shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i lam thag gi ring tshad ni/ a hphe ri kha bskor nas so~X 12 las da rung ha cang nye nges red snyam mo//

sdom pas gru pa 265yod/ gru ltar yongs gru gzings lnga las grub cing de'i theg tshad tun 500yin/ gru gzings de dag 6 ha cang rnying hrul midang 6 lhan pas bkang ba'i ’ gru rnying yin pas sgrig chas shin tu zhan/ de bas mi rnams kyis gru gzings de dag la 6 mtsho khar g.yengs pa'i mi ro zhes 'bod/ gru star de mu mtha' bral ba'i nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i khrod yal pa'i dus su/skyel ma chos kyang a tsi tsi kho tshor las skal ci 'dra zhig 'ongs sam zhes sems khral mi byed mkhan gcig kyang med do//gru star de 1519lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 29nyin nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo brgal nas a me ri kha gling chen gyi skam sa chen po'i lho sne'i lhar dzil gyi re si hphe (2631 (0 zam )ru slebs zhing / de nas a me ri kha gling chen lho ma'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram ded nas lho phyogs su bskyod/ phyi lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 24nyin ar gin thi nā (4766sa 1 ba ༅cho༅)yi san thi a si gru khar 'byor/ de ni le si pho a'i bshad pa'i lho'i 'phred thig gi tshad 40ru yod pa'i 6 mtsho 'gag mi red/smi rje lin gyis de nas lho'i rgya mtsho chen mor bgrod pa'i mtsho lam ma rnyed par/mu mthud du lho phyogs su bskyod de/ zla 3pa'i tshes 31nyin san sgruku li an ru ngal gso byas nas dgun kha btang /gru khar ngal gso ba'i skabs su/ smi rje lin gyis thengs du mar mtsho 'gag btsal yang ma rnyed pa'i steng kho tsho'i bro kha yang chad la nye bas/ gru pa tshor re thag chad pa dang ma 'dod pa'i rnam pa mang po byung / gru pa mi nyung ba zhig gru dpon kha shas dang chos pa la las dkrug shing brgyab par nyan nas ngo log byas pa'i don rkyen byung / smi rje lin gyi drag gnon byas te gte bo tshor srog khrims bcad/ 6 khan se phu'u son ’ rtags can gyi gru dpon khe sa sda dang 6 san an thon ne o rtags can gyi gru dpon khal tha sme nā/ chos pa i nā gswā/ /ma yang phyir yong mi chog pa byas nas rgyang skyod btang /

zla 8pa'i tshes 24nyin/ gru star san sgrubu li an gru khar bral ba dang /6 san sdi a kho mirtags can gyi gru gzings ni zla 5par mtsho lam 'tshol ba'i skabs mtsho gting du nub pas/ da ni gru gzings 4las lhag med/ zla 10pa'i tshes 21nyin/ kho tsho lho'i 'phred thig gi tshad 52yin sa nas zheng che ba'i mtsho 'gag cig la zhugs te nub phyogs su bskyod dus/ shar nas nub du brgyugs pa'i rlabs rgyun la 'phrad pas/ rba rlabs drag po dgung la 'byur pa'i mtho tshad smi bcu phrag du ma yod par thug pas nyen kha shin tu che/ lha san an thon ne o mirtags can gyi gru gzings kyi gru pa tsho mu mthud du mdun du skyod par re thag chad pas/ mtsho lam 'tshol ba'i skabs dang bstun nas gru gzings btsan bzung byas shing gru dpon btsan 'gog byas te kha phyir 'khor nas se phan du log pa red/ gru gzings lhag ma gsum po smi rje len gyi sne khrid 'og nyin 28lhag gi dka' spyad mtsho skyod byas mthar mtsho 'gag de las brgal pa sa na/ da gzod mu mtha' med pa'i lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo de kho tsho'i mig mdun du gsal ler mngon 'ongs/ da ni mtsho chen mo gnyis 'brel ba'i chu lam rnyed song bas/ smi rje lin la dga' spro'i mig chu thon/ rjes rabs pa tshos mtsho 'gag de la 6 smi rje lin mtsho 'gag ces 'bod do//kho tsho shar mar nub phyogs su bskyod nas lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo 'phred du bcad/ 1521lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 6nyin kho tshos skam sa zhig rnyedacing de ni sma ri a nā (5811 thab 64༅7)gling tshom red/ de dus kho tsho bstud mar mtsho skyod byas nas zla 3lhag 'gor yang char rlung drag po dang rba rlabs chen po gcig la'ang ma 'phrad pas/ smi rje lin dang gru pa tshos smyo lho'i rgya mtsho chen mo mi la che zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo ’ zhes bos/ yin na'ang zla ba 'di gsum ring ni mtsho skyod kyi go rim hril po'i nang ches dka' sdug che shos kyi zla ba gsum yin te/ gru'i steng gi kha zas dang tshwa med chu tshar bar nye bas/ gru pa chos meshā sna'o

sgo nas khas ma blangs/ 'dod rngam che ba'i se phan gyi mi ser spel mkhan tshos mig dbang 'phrog pa'i legs skyes mthong bas na/ chog shes med par gyur pas dmag dasbyang phyir 'then rgyu phar zhog mu mthud du rgyal sa the no chi thi the lan du sna spyi spya zlonā ཿsna /mar mi ser spel ba'i gnas gzhi btsugs te ming la we ra khe ru si btags pa ma zad/ da dung se phan gyi rgyal por 'phrin yig bskur nas/ rang gis btsan rgyal chen po zhig ste si phan gsar pa (mo zhi kho bstan pa)rnyed yod ces 'ud shob brgyab te/ kho rang yul gru'i de'i spyi dpon du bsko dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ de'i 'phror khos mon the su'u ma yis dbang 'og tu bsdus pa'i tho tho nā khe pa dang a dzi the khe pa mi rigs gnyis bar dkrug shing brgyab pa dang / tho tho nā khe pa bed spyod byas nas a dzi the khe pa btsan 'dul byed pa'i skog g.yo ngan jus bkol/1519lo'i zla 8par/ kho the si yis dmag dpung khrid de mo zhi kho yi dbus khul du bskyod de the la khe si kha la (1185077 77767)mkhar gyi sngon du slebs/ zla 9pa'i nang / phyogs gnyis bar 'thab 'dzing drag po byung la/ se phan gyi mi la rdung rdeg chen po thebs te mi chig stong du ma'i srog shor bas/ mi mang po'i dpa' zhum pas de tshos mo zhi kho las 'bral dgos pa'i re ba bton/ rjes su kho the si yis lkog g.yo ngan jus spyad de the la khe si kha la'i tsho dpon dang zhi chings bzhag pas kho'i dmag mi tsho da gzod gnas bab nying 'jags su btang / zla 11pa'i tshes 8nyin/ kho the si yis dmag dpung the no chi thi the lan du drangs/ rgyal po mon the su'u ma yis mi dmangs rtsa 'dzugs byas nas btsan 'dzul pa bkag 'gog ma byas pas/ a dzi the khe'i mi la chag sgo dang sdug bsngal chen po bzos/ si phan mi ser spel mkhan tshos rgyal po'i pho ༵༵ba nang gi rin thang bral pa'i gser dngul rin po che 'phrog bcom byas pa

ma zad/ gang sa gang du me gtong btsan g.yem byas thog rgyal po mon the su'u ma yang bzung ba red/yin na'ang rgya che ba'i a dzi the khe'i mi yis gnya' chag mgo sgur ga la byed/ kho tsho'i sems khongs su khong khro me ltar 'bar pas dpa' ngar sgos btsan 'dzul pa la ngo rgol byas par mi ser spel mkhan tsho'i drag gnon thebs/1520lo'i zla 5pa'i chos lugs kyi dus chen zhig tu/ rgyal sar yod pa'i a dzi the khe'i mi rnams kyis dus chen gyi gos shom spras nas/ pho mo rgan gzhon tshos ske ru me tog gi phreng ba dang zhwa mo/ gser gyi rgyan cha spras te/ glu len gar rtsed byed zhor mchod stegs kyi thang chen du lha chen por dmar mchod byas/ kho the si'i mnga' 'og gi dmag dpon al wa rdo ra tho yis dmag dpung khrid de sgo chen bzhi bkag pa dang / glo bur du a dzi the khe'i mi la drag rgol byas te ral gri 'phyar nas gang sod gang rgyag byas/ go mtshon khab tsam yang med pa'i a dzi the khe'i sku drag dang mi ser drug brgya lhag khrag dmar nang shi bas thang chen stong khrag gis bkang / a dzi the khe'i mi la khong khro gnon thabs med pa zhig skyes pas/ phyi nyin drag po'i 'os langs byas nas/ mi ser spel mkhan tsho'i sdod gnas bskor nas/ de tsho'i kha zas dang 'thung chu bcad pa ma zad/mon the su'u ma'i gcung po khu i the la hwa khe kho tsho'i gtso 'dzin du bskos/kho the si nyen gnas su lhung bas/ khos btson du bzung ba'i mon the su'u ma sngon du btsan phud byas te a dzi the khe'i mi la gtam bshad du bcug ste a dzi the kha'i mi la se phan pa tshos phyir gtong du 'jug pa'i re ngan bcangs/ yin na'ang / a dzi the khe'i mi rnams kyis mon the su'u ma ni sna rkang 'dren pa/ blun mo/ snar ma :zhes sdig mo byas shing kho'i blo log gi bya spyod la gshe gshe btang ba ma zad/ kho'i steng la rdo char pa babs 'dra brgyab pas/ nyin gsum ma 'gor bar mon the su'u ma'i srog shor/ de nas a dzi the khe'i mi yis ༵ sar

spel mkhan tsho dang dmar 'dzing lhag tu chen po byed 'go bcoms/ mi ser spel mkhan tshos skyogs chen brgyab rung a dzi the khe'i mi la 'jigs skrag ci yang med par dgra bo'i phyogs grangs las 'das pa'i mda' 'phangs te gang thub ci thub kyis phar rgol brgyab/ mi ser spel mkhan tsho'i gnas bab nyin rer je sdug tu song ba dang / kho tsho'i kha zas dang me mda'i 'bar rdzas sogs kyang tshar la nye bas/ da ni skor ba las thar thabs ma byas ga med byung / zla 6pa'i tshes 30nyin gyi mtshan mor char rlung shin tu chen po babs pa dang / kho the si yis dmag mi tshor rgyal po'i pho brang nang gi gser dngul rin po che 'phrog bcom byed du bcug rjes/ mkhar gyang la brgal nas phyir 'bro 'go bcoms kyang / kho tsho'i 'gro skyod a dzi the khe'i mis rtogs nas sbrul rnga brdungs pa dang stag shar stong phrag du mas ki sgra sgrog gin phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas brgyugs yong nas/ gzhu bkang ste mda' mo grangs las 'das pa dgra bo'i steng du 'phangs/ mi ser spel mkhan tsho'i mi phyed tsam la shi rmas phog pa dang /mi mang po zhig 'phrog yong ba'i gser dang mnyam du the si kho kho mtshe'u nang bying nas shi ba dang mi mi nyung ba zhig bsad pa'am 'dzin bzung byas/ kho the si yis pham dmag lhag 'phro kha shas khrid de the ra khe si kha la ru bros/ the no chi thi the lan srung ba'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs pa ni/ a dzi the khe'i mis mi ser spel ba'i btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byas par blangs pa'i ches 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha zhig yin pas/ se phan mi ser spel mkhan tshos de la kho tsho'i lo rgyus steng gi ra yid skyo ba'i mtshan mo zhes 'bod pa red/kho the si pham pa myong bar yi ma chad de/ dmag shugs bskyar sgrig byed ched dmag bsdu rta nyo byas/ 1521lo'i dpyid gar se phan gyis dmag mi 1000dang dmag rta 86lhag tsam/ phyogs chen 12bsdus pa'i steng / phan tshu/ 〉krug shing rgyag pa'i ngan jus spyad de en rdi an gyi tsho sde kha shas dang
shālko tsho7— / snangaX/ci halha hūṃ snas/1 9slo nga / 9 rdo ci/ rdodzodarto 418/su//hūṃ 〉(15

2par kho the smo khe dmar gsod byas/ kho the smo khe ni en rdi an mi dmangs kyi se phan mi ser spel ba'i btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i dpa' ngar ldan pa'i gtso 'dzin zhig yin pas mo zhi kho mi dmangs kyi gus 'dud thob rkyen/ mo zhi kho yi mis khong la li ma'i sku brnyan mtho zhing che ba zhig bzhengs pa da lta'i bar da dung mo zhi kho grong khyer du krong nger langs 'dugase phan mi ser spel mkhan pa tshos the no chi thi the lan phab rjes/ grong khyer nang me btang ba dang 'phrog bcom byas te/ lha khang dang lha sku du ma brlag cing grong khyer nang gi sdod mi mang che ba bsad pas grong khyer de zhig ro tsam du btang / kho chos da dung grong khyer nye 'khor gyi sa khul so so btsan 'dul byas kyang / meg se ko yi mis gtan nas gnya' chag mgo sgur ma byas par mu mthud du byed thabs sna tshogs spyad de se phan gyi mi ser spel ba'i btsan 'dzul pa tshor rdung deg byed pa'i 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas so//254

mar ben lu ther gyis chos lugasagazurabacos byasatshul/dus rabs bar ma'i dus mjug tu/ yo rab skam sa chen por rim bzhin ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed 'brel ba btsugs/ 'jar man du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis dbang sgyur go gnas bzung yod na'ang /ma rtsa ring lugs kyi ngo bo ldan pa'i bzo tshong las rigs la 'phel rgyas byung ba spyan tu mgyogs shing / sde khag kha shas ni yo rob kyi sngon thon chu tshad du slebs da/ rgya gar nas 'go bzung ste dbyi tha li brgyud shar mar yo rob byang phyogs su bgrod pa'i lam ni gna' bo'i tshong lam zhig yin la/ 'jar man ni de'i bar gyi nges par du brgyud dgos pa'i lam zhig red/ dus rabs 15pa'i dus mjug tu slebs tshe/ gna' bo'i tshong lam da dung sngar mus su dar zhing rgyas pas/ 'jar man gyi tshong lam de la brten nas 'phel rgyas byung ba'i grong khyer kha shas te/ dper na le pha dzi (231 921 rtsa ma )pho lan khe hpher (718 ji(51 ṣṭha༅mas)sogs ni yo rob byang ma dang nub ma'i nyo tshong lte gnas su gyur/ lam de'i lho phyogs kyi grong khyer mang po'i tshong ra la'ang shin tu dar rgyas che/ u sge si sgor gi (sa5636025 moṭha)ni sngar bzhin du dbyi tha li'i dar zab thon rdzas dang / rgya gar dri zhim rdzas/ shar phyogs kyi rin thang che ba'i tshong rdzas kyi bsdu 'grem byed pa'i lte gnas yin no//'jar man ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas de grong khyer tshong las dpal 'byor las mtshon pa ma zad/ da dung gter 'don pa dang / lcags lha/snas

bzhu ba/ 'khul 'thag dpar skrun sogs bzo las sde khag nas de las kyang gsal por mtshon yod/ dus rabs 15pa dang 16pa'i bar gyi lo 80lhag gi ring / 'jar man gyi dngul gyi thon tshad ldab lnga yi je mthor song yod/ dus rabs 16pa'i dus stod du yo rob gling yongs ('jar man de'i nang mi the ba)kyi steng a me ri kha gling chen gyi dngul gyi thon tshad bsnan yang 'jar man gyi dngul gyi thon tshad kyi 407tsam las zin med/ skabs der 'jar man gyi gter 'don bzo ba'i 'bor grangs la sa ya gcig lhag yod/ de bas/ en ke sis kyang / smyo 'jar man ni 1470 — 1530lo'i bar du dpal 'byor phyogs yo rob kyi 'go gral gyi go gnas yang dang po bzung yod ’ ces gsungs/yin na'ang / 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la do mi snyom pa'i rang bzhin dang thar thor gyi rang bzhin yod pas/ chab srid steng kha thor bkad bzung gi gnas tshul je drag can du song bas/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig ma bzod pa'i sa gnas tshogs khag tu gyur 'dug rgyal yongs su che 'dems chog rgyal phran ’ 7yod pa de dag gis rgyal pham thag gcod byed pas/de dag kho nar 'jar man rgyal po 'dems bsko byed pa'i dbang cha yod/gzhan yang / rgyal yongs su da dung rgyal phran chen po bcu phrag 'ga' yod pa dang rgyal phran chung ba 200lhag dang skya mi'i sger btsun du bzung ba'i sa cha chig stong tsam yod/ rgyal phran dag gis dus rgyun gong ma rgyal por 'gran rgol byas pas/ gong ma tshang gi stobs shugs rim bzhin nyams pas ming tsam du gyur 'dug rgyal phran che chung so sos rang gi dbang bsgyur pa'i mnga' khongs nang 'gag sgo btsugs nas sger gcod dbang sgyur byas pas/ tha na rgyal yongs su gcig gyur gyi dngul lor yang med/ 'jar man gyi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor la mu mthud du 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur dka' khag shin tu che ba godā )3 las gsal por shes thub bo//

'jar man dpal 'byor gyi bkag rgya gzhan zhig ni chos lugs kyi stobs shugs red/ ro ma chos kyi gong ma dang 'jar man gnam bdag chos lugs kyi chos tshogs kyis/ 'jar man gyi chab srid stobs shugs kha thor du song ba dang bstun nas gang thub sgos rang gi stobs shugs je cher btang nas gong ma tshang yang dbang du bzung / gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi gong rim btsun pa tsho ni/ don dngos su sku drag chen po'i tshogs khag cig yin la zhing bdag chen po yang red/ chos tshogs kyis rgyal yongs kyi sa gzhi'i 173bzung yod/ bogs dngul bsdu len byed pa'i steng da dung dbya khral yang gang 'dod du bsdu ste/ dper na bcu zur dpya khral che ba (lo tog gi khral)bcu zur dpya khral chung ba (sngo tshod kyi khral) khrag gi bcu zur dpya khral (khyim bya'i khral)sogs rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ mtho rim btsun pa tsho ni rgyal phran so so'i phyug po yin pas/ chog shes med par longs spyod byed pa ma zad/ tha na rgyal skugs pa dang g.yem sbyor byed pa/ skyed lci'i bu lon gtong ba/ chos kyi go sa btsong ba sogs mi las dgu las mi byed pa med/ro ma chos kyi gong ma ni 'jar man mi dmangs kyi mgo ru zhon pa'i 6 mngon med dbang bdag mi tu gyur/ 6 gzhung phyogs 'jar man ni ro ma gyi ches blo sems dkar ba'i bran g.yog yin (mar khe si'i gsung ) las/tsa chos kyi gong ma'i bzhon ma ’ ru gyur/ chos kyi gong mas 'jar man gyi 'dems chog rgyal phran 7nang gi 3dang chos tshogs yod rgu dbang 'og tu bsdus yod/ chos kyi gong mas lo rer 'jar man nas btsir len byas pa'i rgyu nor ni 'jar man gyi rgyal po'i lo re'i yong sgo las kyang ldab 'ga' las mang /gnas tshul de la 'jar man gyi zhing pa dang grong khyer gyi mi ser rnams kyis ngo rgol byas steng grong mi (grong khyer nang gi bzo tshong las rigs kyi rim pa ste 'byor ldan gral rim gyi snga ma bstan pa) dang skya mis ngo rgol byas pa ༵ zlod/

zla 10pa'i tshes 31nyin/ we ten pho chos khang gi phyi rol du/ gsol mchod 'bul bar yong ba'i mi rnams kyi sems ni/ chos khang gi sgo khar sbyar ba'i shog bu chen po zhig gis bkug shog bu de'i steng la then yi ge spyad de〈nyes dag yi ge'i nus shugs〉zhes pa'i rtsa 'dzin rang bzhin gyi nang don ring po bris shing / bsdoms pas tshan pa 95yod pa dang shog ngos kyi zhol du 'bri mkhan mar then lu ther (587 1༅ 65 667 91 ༅7)zhes bkod yod/khong ni chos lugs slob gling gi dge rgan chen mo ba yin la grong khyer de'i ye shā'i cho~X khang gi dpon po gzhon pa yang yin pas mi rnams khong la cha rgyus na tulu the/ ra gyis rtsa 'dzin khrod/ chos kyi gong ma la nyes pa med du bzo ba'i dbang cha gcig kyang med par/ lha'i dbang pos nyes med gu yangs btang ba khyab bsgrags sam bden min dpyad pa'i dbang cha tsam las med de/ rgyu mtshan ni nyes pa med par gnang ba ni lha chen po'i dbang 'ba' zhig yin pas so/ de lta na nyes dag yi ge yis nyes pa dag thub pa'i shod tshul 'di nor 'khrul yin no zer/ lu ther gyis rtsa 'dzin gyi tshan pa 28par gsungs par/6 sgor dngul sgrom nang lhung bar ting sgra grags pa'i skabs su/ rngam sems dang 'dod sred je mang du btang ba mngon gsal red mi ces chos kyi gong ma'i nyes dag yi ge btsong ba'i dmigs yul ther 'don byas/ rtsa 'dzin gyi tshan pa 86par/ lu ther gyis tshig rnon po'i ngang tsa chos kyi gong ma ni phyug po yod rgu'i nangagi phyug po red/ rang gi rgyu nor spyad de san phe the chos khang zhig gso mi byed par/ snying rje ba'i dad ldan tsho'i dngul bkol dgos don ci yin mi zhes nan 'dri byas nas/ mi rnams la nyes dag yi ge nyo mi dgos pa dang / ro ma chos lugs gong ma'i gzhung gi mi la mgo skor gtong ba'i 'chal gtam la nyan mi rung ba'i skul brda btang / khong gis gsungs don 6 ye shu la dad ma~X su

yin yang / lhag sems rnam dag sgos 'gyod bshags byas pa'i snang ba yod na/nyes dag yi ge ma nyos kyang nyes pa dag pa'am yang na chad pa ci yang med par 'ongs/’ lu ther gyis da dung slob grwa chen mo ru nyes dag yi ge'i skor la lha'i rig pa'i rtsod gleng byas pa red/ gong smos de dag gis ro ma chos kyi gong ma la 'gran bsdur bslangs pa dang chos tshogs la rdung rdeg drag po byas pa ma zad/da dung 'jar man mi rigs kyi bsam tshul la'ang shin tu mthun 'phrod byung /lu ther gyis rtsa 'dzin de myur du 'jar man gyi yi ger bsgyur nas mgyogs par phyogs so sor bkrams pas/ mi re res 'phrog rtsod byas nas klog bzhin yod pas/ gza' 'khor gnyis tsam gyi ring du rgyal yongs kun tu khyab/ 6 lu ther gyis btang ba'i glog zhags kyis spang rgod du me sbar stabs/ 'jar man mi rigs yongs 'gul skyod de'i nang zhugs (mar khe si'i gsung) lu ther gyi rtsa 'dzin mi rnams kyi bya spyod kyi thun mong rtsa 'dzin du gyur pas/ chos lugs bsgyur bcos kyi bya 'gul zhig de bzhin du 'go brtsams/ lu ther rang nyid ma bsam sa ru ngo rgol phyogs khag mthun sgril byed pa'i lte gnas dang chos lugs bsgyur bcos kyi gtso 'dzin du gyur/mar then lu ther ni 1483lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 10nyin 'jar man gyi ma thes khe son sa khul gyi e si le nyin ma na lu ra/(21316660 〈mo stso)du sku 'khrungs shing / mes po tsho ni zhing pa yin/260

/zlo ༵༵༵༵ nasdu 〉〉 〉kā di zlo /kā /shā/ ga// pazlos po 〉spya ṅgi nā rnyi / gyis lcags bzhu ba'i lte gnas de ru bzo ba byas pa dang / rjes su lcags bzhu ༵༵ sdu losnying masdi kā / ༵ hā/ tram̐ ༵ / ༷/ py-i zlobakyi grwa sdu/ mo/ phyursha hārsha tram̐ gyuje /ni 'jar man gyi skad grags che ba'iphya slob grwa chen mo zhig yin la/ nyag nyog mtshan nyid rig pa'i lte gnas yin pa ma zad/ mi tshul ring lugs pa chos bya 'gul spel ba'i gnas gzhi kyang yin/ de ru lu ther dang mi tshul rigs lugs pa① tsho dang 'gro yong mang bas khong la de dag gi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod/ khong rang dpe cha klog par hur brtson che bas/ 1503lor slob grwa nas mthar phyin te lha rig pa'i hro hri'i thob thang blangs/ lo de'i dbyarakhar/ lu ther e si le lhan gyi u sgu si then chos khang du phebs nas lha rig pa'i dpe char klog 'don dang zhib 'jug gnang zhing lo gnyis 'gor rjes de ga'i chos bshad mkhan gyi 'gan bzhes/ 1512lor khong gis lha rig pa'i po hri'i thob thang blangs shing / cung ma 'gor bar we then pho slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang lha rig pa'i dge gon chen mor gdan 'dren zhus/rjesna su lu ther gyis dus yin ring por slob grwa de ru dge rgan gyi las 'gan ba sa/lu ther la lha rig pa'i phyogs kyi shes rgya gting zab po yod pa ma zad/da dung rje khi khe ((20061 0 shā 11)chos lugs bsgyur bcos mkhan hu si gnonasdong sa/ /sna hūṃ /nāswā 1/sdo nā smri rgozi snyisna sdi 〉pa sngu / cana' kū sdopa /pa ṭā sku tso nd+ra /shā // kū sna/ /lda sgrasgyu byas nas/ rag gzhung /ba trirtag bya /'am das spel byas nas/tsoḥsam zlar rang dbaju yospya pa dang sang sashes sdogoju pa'i nāswāsgyu sbri /snyan/ /sa yo/ carsha / dadag zlo blo tshurmi'i kṇi smug sa rsha snar bzhag par da da la // /ba bya

sogs kyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen thebs yod pa'i steng chos kyi gong ma dang chos tshogs rul sungs su song ba dngos su mthong bas/ chos rnying pa'i (ro ma gyi gnam bdag chos lugs) dad pa la dogs pa skyes nas/ rim bzhin rang nyid kyi chos lugs lta ba byung ba red/ khong gis thugs su/ mi'i rnam shes skyob dgos na/ rang nyid kyis lha dbang por lhag bsam rnam dag sgos dad pa byas pas chog ste/ chos kyi gong ma dang chos tshogs brgyud mi dgos la/ da dung nyag nyog gi chos lugs kyi cho ga mi dgos dgongs/ lu ther gyi lta ba de skabs de'i ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma dang gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis dril bsgrags byas pa'i 6 chos tshogs ni mi dang lha'i dbang po'i bar phan tshun 'gro 'ongs byed pa'i spyan red mices pa'i lta ba dang ldog zlar song / lu ther gyi lta ba des skabs de'i 'jar man gyi gsar byung 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bcings thag las bkrol nas/ rang dbang du dar rgyas yong ba'i re ba dngos su mtshon pa red/ khong gi tshan pa 95pa'i rtsa 'dzin du phyogs bsdus sgos bsam blo de mtshon par 'dugamar then lu ther gyis rtsa 'dzin nang ro ma chos rgyal la ngo rgol byas med pa dang / rtsa ba nas nyes dag yi ge la ngo rgol byed pa'i nang don med rung /de'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo ni/ 'jar man spyi tshogs steng gi chos rgyal gyis 'phrog len byas par ngo rgol drag po byed pa'i bsam tshul dang mthun po byung bas/chos rgyal gyi nyes dag yi ge btsong rgyur gnod pa chen po thebs/ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma la khong khro chen po skyes nas/ lu ther la chad pa gcod rgyu thag bcad/ 1518lo'i zla 8par chos kyi gong ma des lu ther ro ma du yong nas 'dri dpyad dang len byed dgos pa'i bka' babs/ 'on kyang sa khe son 'dems chog rgyal phran rgyal po sogs kyis lu ther la srung skyob byas pas ro ma byā zlobs ma dgos byung / phyi lor mar then lu ther dang khong la rgyab skyor

byed mkhan tshos/ le phi rdzi (261 921 rtsa ga )ru chos kyi gong ma'i sku tshab dang rtsod gleng byed pa'i tshogs 'du bsdus/ ma then lu ther gyis mi mang po'i sngon du rang nyid hu si'i lta bar phyogs pa'i bsam tshul bton/ 1520lo'i zla 6par/ chos kyi gong mas phyogs kun tu brda sbyor btang nas/ ma then lu ther gyi lta ba la dgag pa brgyab pa ma zad/ da dung lu ther gyi gzhung lugs ni 66log lta yin zhing / ma then lu ther kho rang ni 6 bdud 'dre dang gcan gzan red ces bsgrags te/ mar then lu ther gyi gsung rtsom me la bsreg dgos pa dang / mi su dang su la'ang mar then lu ther dang de'i rjes 'brangs mkhan tsho 'dzin bzung byas nas ro ma du skyel pa'i 'os 'gan yod ces bsgrags pas/ chos kyi gong ma dang mar then lu ther bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag can du gyur/ mar then lu ther gyis 'jar man gyi chos lugs bsgyur bcos byed pa'i skor la dpyad rtsom gsum te/ 〈'jar man gyi ye shu'i chos lugs kyi sku drag tshor springs pa'i yi ge〉dang chos tshogs kyi sba sbi lon btson 'jug〉dang ye shu'i chos lugs pa'i rang dbang smra ba〉spel/ dpe deb nang du khong gis chos kyi gong ma'i dbang char khas ma blangs pa dang / ye shu'i chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan re rer dam pa'i chos dpe klog pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang / lha'i dbang por dad pa byed par brten sems khams la rang dbang thob pa dang / chos tshogs kyi gus lugs rnyog po la ngo rgol byas nas 6 stabs bde dwangs gtsang gi chos tshogs mi 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba bton/ de nas ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma lhag tu khros te lu ther chos lugs nang las phyir skyod btang ba khyab bsgrags byas/ mar then lu ther gyis zla 12pa'i tshes 20nyin we then pho ru mi mang po'i sngon du chos kyi gong ma'i bka' shog mer bsregs pas/ mar then lu ther gyi chos lugs kyi bsgyur bcos kyi bya 'gul ni ches mtho shos kyi tshad du slebs so// 263

de'i rjes su/ chos kyi gong ma dang 'jar man rgyal po gnyis lkog g.yo ngan 'brel byas nas/ mar then lu ther la nyes thag gcod rtsis byas kyang /snga sa nas chos kyi gong ma la yi ma rangs pa'i rgyal phran rgyal po tshor mar then lu ther la nyes thag gcod par yid 'thad ma byung / rjes su mar then lu ther ni sa khe son rgyal phran rgyal por rgyab rten bcol nas/ rang ming ngo ma gsang nas wa the pho ru bzhugs nas dam pa'i chos dpe 'jar man gyi yi ger bsgyur/mar then lu ther gyis dam pa'i chos dpe 'jar man skad du bsgyur pa des 'jar man gcig gyur gyi skad yig grub par mdzad rjes chen po bzhag pa'i ma tshad/ 'jar man gyi zhing pa dang grong khyer gyi mi ser phal ba tsho'i chos lugs bsgyur bcos byed pa'i las 'gul la shugs ldan mtshon cha zhig sprad pas/ kho tsho'i dam pa'i chos dpe nang gi skad cha bkol nas spyi tshogs re ba 'don par bden dpang 'dren thub pa byung /chos lugs bsgyur bcos las 'gul 'phel rgyas su song ba dang / rgya che ba'i zhing pa dang grong khyer mi ser phal ba tsho'i re ba nyin re bzhin thal drag tu gyur pas/ mar then lu ther gyi chos lugs bsgyur bcos kyi khyab khongs las drag tu brgal/ rlabs che ba'i 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gis chos lugs khyab khongs kyi bsgyur bcos de da yod bshu gzhog lam lugs kyi mgo rting slog pa'i chab srid gsar brje zhig tu gtong bar re ba byed pa'i skabs su/mar then lu ther ni som nyis bsdams nas de nang ma zhugs dang de dang rgyab 'gal du song bas/ khong rang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal phran rgyal po'i phyogs su song nas/ de tsho'i smyo kha la nyan pa'i g.yog por migyur nas de dag la thabs 'don jus 'god byas te/ zhing pa'i 'os langs la drag gnon byas/1546lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 18nyin/ dgung lo 63la son pa'i mar then lu ther ni ༵༵ gi pha yul a si le ston du dgongs pa rdzogs shing / kho'i pur we thon pho

yi chos khang gi dur sar bcugs yod/ 1555lor ye shu'i chos lugs kyi mar then lu ther phyogs khag la khrims dang mthun pa'i go sa thob/mar then lu ther gyi chos lugs bsgyur bcos las 'gul ni 'jar man lo rgyus steng gi lo rgyus don rkyen chen po'i nang gi gcig yin la/ las 'gul de mgyogs myur du yo rob yongs su khyab/ ro ma gyi gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab las brgal ba'i lha dbang gi dbang sgyur de rtsa ba nas mjug sgril du bcug mar then lu ther gyi chos lugs bsgyur bcos bsam blo yis yo rob kyi chos lugs la khrag gsar drangs pas/ gsar thon gyi 'byor ldan gral rim la zhabs 'degs zhu 'go btsams/ mar then lu ther kho rang gis spyi tshogs rnying ba sgul 'dod spu tsam yang med na'ang / rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyis mar then lu ther gyi bsgyur bcos kyi go skabs la bstun nas khyab rgya che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi bya 'gul spel ba red/ mar then lu ther gyis chos rgyal gyi dbang cha la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'bod skul des grong mi tsho skul slong byas nas/ sa gnas rang bzhin gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de mi rigs yongs su khyab pa'i 'thab rtsod du 'gyur du bcugagazhan yang mar then lu ther gyi bsgyur bcos las 'gul gyis yo rob yongs la shugs rkyen shin tu chen po bzhag pa ni/ yo rob mgyogs por bkas bkod // lhadzin ring lugs nas ma rtsa ring lugs su brgal bar skul spel byas pa de 265

rlabs cheri'i'ajar man gyizhang pa'i dmaga'akhrug4kye hud/ nga ni dbul po khon ra sde yin/chos kyi gong ma dang sku drag dmag ltar gyis rtsa med gtong dgos/bdag pos rta lcag gis brabs nas sha sdur du btang ba su la 'chad/nga tsho'i lhags pa gson por bkog pa'i steng chung ma la'ang brnyas bcos thob/kye hud/ nga ni dbul po khon ra sde yin/sdoḥrsha ṭā shā /sna /lha / py-i hā sdong/ /mar then lu ther gsar brje la blo log pa'i dus su/ 'jar man gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul ni da dung mu mthud du rgya je cher 'gro bzhin 'dug1524lor/ rgya dbul po khon ra sde'i 'thab klu'i 0 glu sgra'i khrod du rlabs che ba'i 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms pa red/ de ni yo rob dus rabs bar ma'i lo rgyus steng gi rgya khyon ches che ba'i zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin zhing / de la rlabs che ba'i nyams brjid che zhing lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan/ 'os langs kyi 'go khrid ni phul du byung ba'i zhing pa'i gsar ༵༵ /rdon tho ma si mun rdzor (160183 550707 76mo lngalkoṣṭha)zhes mun rdzir ni (phal cher /4(30— 1525lo'i bar)'jar man gyi si thol du dbul po khon ra tsā ni 'jar man gna' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i zhing pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig yin zhingad131/dīkā/ kur thing sbor du sa langs byas/

sgor (5 016576 7676)zhes pa'i yul gyi lag shes bzo pa zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs/ lo na gzhon pa'i dus su mar then lu ther gyi chos lugs bsgyur bcos byas pa'i rjes 'brang rgyur spro ba zhig red/ yin na'ang / mar then lu ther mi dmangs las 'gul gyi dgra zlar langs rjes/ mun rdzer gyis rbad de mar then lu ther dang de'i phyogs khag gi 'gro lam dang tha dad du 'gro rgyu thag bcad/ 1520lor mun rdzir gyis dzi wi khe khu (281 0625 cho lko)grong khyer gyi chos khang du chos bshad mkhan gyi 'gan bzhes/ yul de ru khong dang zhing pa dang bzo ba dbul phongs mang por 'brel ba byung bas/ de dag gis skyel bzhin pa'i sdug bsngal 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs steng gi 'dra mnyam min pa'i gnas tshul gsal por mthong stabs/ rbad de gsar brje byed pa'i lam du song nas mi dmangs la 'os langs byed du 'jug rgyur blo thag bcad/1521lo'i dpyid kur khong gis rdzi blu khe khu'i lag bzo ba tshor 'os langs byed du bcug kyang pham pas rdzi khi khe ((200610 77)pharagi (218350 777)ru phebs nas/ hu si'i (/thab 553 lo7)phyogs khag pa tsho dang 'brel ba btsugs/ mun rdzir gyis(pha ra gi bsgrags yig 〉 (de la〈rje khi khe mi dmangs la btang ba'i bsgrags yig〉kyang zer/)spel nas/ drag shugs kyis spyi tshogs bsgyur bcos dang gsar brje las 'gu'i spel ba6( bsam :ga gsa'i/ tsho rtomipor bton/ khong gis cung mi 'gor ci ba'i ma 'ongs par/ srid dbang ni tho ma si mun rjer/nam yang mi dmangs la dbang nges 267

yin ’ zhes gsungs/ 1522lor mun rdzir phyir 'jar man du log ste/ thu ring rgyan du ye shu'i chos bshad mkhan byas/thu ring rgyan du mun rdzir gyis mu mthud du gsar brje dril bsgrags byas nas/ drag shugs kyis ro ma gyi chos tshogs dang sku drag la ngo rgol byed pa'i skul brda btang ba ma zad/ da dung mang tshogs khrod du gsang ba'i tshogs pa ste ru ye shu'i chos kyi mna' 'brel ’ zhes pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ mun rdzor gyi bsam blo la drag skyod kyi shugs shin tu che/ mar then lu ther gyis chos tshogs bcos bsgyur tsam byed pa'i bsam blo bton nas 6 stabs bde dwangs gtsang gi chos tshogs mi 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba tsam bton mod/ mun rjer gyi 'dod blo ni de lta tsam ma yin te/ khong gis〈dam pa'i chos dpe〉ni go rtogs sad 'jug gi bstan bcos nyag cig yin par khas mi len par/ mi su yin yang bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro thub par 'dod/ khong gis gnam bdag chos tshogs la ngo rgol byas nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs gtor nas/ mi yul du phugs re'i spyi tshogs te 6 yun brtan bde ba'i zhing zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i dgongs 'char bton zhing / de ru gral rim med pa dang sger la dbang ba'i rgyu nor med cing / mi dmangs dang dgra zlar langs pa'i rgyal khab kyi srid dbang yang med/ 'di ni mun rdzor stong sems spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam blo'i mtshon byed yin no//mun rdzir gyis zhing pa'i khrod du gsar brje'i las 'gul rgya chen por spel pas/ khong rang grong brdal bcu phrag du ma dang zhing sde brgya phrag du mar 'gro myong ba red/ khong gis mi rnams la 6 yun brtan bde ba'i khams ni ngal rtsol mi dmangs te thog mar zhing pas btsugs shing / skabs thog gnas bab la shes rtogs med pa'i dbang sgyur pa tsho phyir skyod gtong ba'am yang na da~X /sod rgyag dgos zer/ mun rdzir dang khong gi slob ma tshos thad kur

med/ de bas/ dam pa'i chos dpe gzhir bzung na/ nga tshor rang dbang yod pa dang /nga tshos kyang rang dbang thob par re ba byed kyin yod/ nga tshor dogs snang ci yang med pa ni/ khyod tsho (chos tshogs)gal srid ye shu'i chos lugs pa ngo ma yin na dam pa'i chos dpe'i nang nga tsho bran g.yog byed dgos pa'i bden dpang ma rnyed tshe/ nges par du nga tsho bran g.yog lam lugs las bcings 'grol gtong dgos/ 'di ni bran g.yog lam lugs med par bzo dgos pa'i 'bod skad red/gzhan yang don tshan nang da dung bcu zur dpya khral med par gtong dgos pa dang / sa bogs dang 'u lag la tshod 'dzin/ mnga' bdag gis btsan 'phrog byas pa'i nags tshal dang phyugs ra phyir sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton/wa si sten gyi zhing pa'i dmag la thog mtha' bar gsum du gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid cig grub ma thub pas/ so sos rang tshugs kyis dmag brgyab pa dang / 'grig lam yang lhod pas mthar thug zla 4pa'i zla mjug tu dgra bos la gtor lung gtor byas/hpha ran khe nee a'i 'os langs ni 1525lo'i zla 3pa'i zla mjug tu 'go brtsams shing rgya khyon yang shin tu che/ zhing pa'i dmag dpung gis chos khang dang mkhar rdzong mang po phab te zhing bdag dang yul gyi gshed ma la drag gnon byas/ de'i nang gi zhing pa'i dmag gi gtso 'dzin re en rol sba ho yis ngo 'dzin spu tsam yang ma byas par pa'o rim mtshan can gyi sku drag cig la srog khrims bcad/ rgyu mtshan ni sku drag des 'os langs pa mang po dmar gsod byas pa dang ngan las du ma byas myong bas red/ don rkyen des g.yo 'gul chen po thebs su bcug ste sku drag mang po zhig gis phyi ngos nas 'os langs la rgyab skyor mi byed ga med byung / yin na'ang / phyis su grong mi rim gras khe phan gyi 'thus tshab hi phu le yis zhing pa'i dmag gi 'go khrid las 'gan blangs rjes rol sba ho zur 'bud btang / zla 5par hel sbru ron (261 1610ba swāhāṣṭha

7)du tshogs pa'i zhing pa'i dmag gi tshogs chen steng / hi phu le yis bsgyur bcos kyi rtsa 'dzin zhig bton zhing de la 〈hel sbu ron rtsa 'dzin〉zer/ rtsa 'dzin de las grong mi rim gras kyi re ba mtshon pas de la 'byor ldan gral rim gyi ngo bo yod/ rtsa 'dzin 'di la gros bsdur byed pa'i skabs su/ 'jar man rgyal phran rgyal po'i dmag spyi thu ru hi se yis (11506368 70 yama'i6076cha lkokṣa)dmag dpung khrid de hel spu ron la tshur rgol byas/ grong mi tsho 'os langs dmag la blo log nas dgra bor mkhar sgo phye nas dgra bo mkhar nang du brgyug tu bcug pa dang / hi phu le gar song cha med du bros shing / 'os langs dmag kha thor sna thor du song bas so so rmeg med du btang / rol sba ho ni dgra bos mer bsregs nas bsad/ 1525lo'i zla 6par/ hpha ran khe ne a'i 'os langs der mthar thug drag gnon byas pas pham pa red/thu rin zhen dang sa khe son sa khul gyi 'os langs ni mun rjer gyi thad kur 'go khrid mdzad pa dang / de ni 'jar man zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod 'thab rtsod la rbad sems che zhing skad grags dang brjid nyams che ba'i sa khul red/ 1525lo'i zla 3pa'i zlas smad du/ mun rdzer gyis mi ser dkyus ma dang gter 'don bzo ba/ zhing pa sogs khrid nas sku drag srid dbang gi mgo rting slog nas smul ho sen bcings 'grol byas te/ gsar brje'i srid dbang 6 yun ring tshogs chen mi zhes pa btsugs/ mun lder gyis chos tshogs kyi rgyu nor gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / zhing ba'i bu lon med par bzos shing /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi khyad dbang med par btang ba yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas/ khong gis grong khyer gyi sdod mi rtsa 'dzugs byas nas dmag sbyong byed du bcug pa dang / lcags bzhus nas phyogs chen bzos te 'os langs dmag la drag chas spras/ zhing pa'i las 'gul gyi rngam zil gyi gzhi khyon che ru banātā zlos/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tshor 'jigs skrag skyes nas

sdod long med pa tsam du gyur/ sa khe son gyi 'dems chog rgyal phran rgyal po la skabs der mnga' khog gi mi'i snyan zhu zhig 'byor ba'i nang du/ 'os langs dmag la rngam brjid che bas/ kho tshos 'thab rtsod kyi mdung rtse ngan pa rgu 'dzoms kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag dang zhing bdag la gtad pa mthong /shā/sa /shā gā'i khuspya dū rnyi/ ba'i mtha' 'khor du jag pa'i tshogs (de ni zhing par dma' 'beb byed pa'i tshig yin)kyis gang / har tshe ri yi chos khang sum bcu lhag jagapa tshos bcom zhing rdog brdzis btang / yul lung de dag dang / nye 'dabs su yod pa'i mnga' zhabs sa cha dang mnga' gzhis nang gi chos khang gcig kyang lhag med/dzi rjor rji gung rim dpon gyi dbang 'og gi sa khul gyi mnga' bdag che chung tsho'i mnga' 'og gi 'bangs mi ha lam 1300lhag gis kha sang dus gcig tu gyen log byas/ kho tsho skor tshogs skor tshogs byas nas rmu ran khen ho sen phyogs su bskyod cing /gongasas kyi las don sgrub rgyur dam bca' 'jog gin yod/ mi ni tshogs gin tshogs gin je mang yin la/ dngos min gyi go thos ltar na/ mi 6000lhag de ru tshogs yod skad/ 4skul ho sen (5561 yas ba lo lko)kyi mang tshogs chig khri lnga stong las mtshad la/ kho tshos a dbyi si sprel sde'i khul du phar yong tshur 'gro byas nas gza' 'khor gcig ring zing cha bslangs/ sku drag kha shas kyi khyim gzhis mer bsregs nas gtor brlag btang / khyer thub pa'i dngos po yod tshad 'phrog bcom byas( zhing pa'i 'os langs kyis 'jar man gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs la rdung rdeg drag po byas/ he sen (50336ba lko)mnga' sde'i pa'o rim go sa can gyi hphe li phu'u yis 6 sprul ho sen ni 'gal rkyen dang ma 'dod pa yod rgya'i gzhi rtsa dang 'byung khungs red/ ngo log zing 'khrug gi bya 'gul thams cad ni chu mig bzhin du yul de nas phyir 'phyur song ba red ’ zhes 'drog skad brgyab/ zla 4pa'i zla mjug tu/ thu ren zhen dang sa khe ༵༵ gyi

rgyal phran dag gis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i dmag dpung ni/ hphe li phu yi bkod 'doms 'og 'os langs dmag la drag gnon byed du phyin/ sa khe son gung rim dpon pos kyang dpung sde zhig dmag rogs su mngags/ mu rdzir dgra che por thug pa'i skabs der/ gter 'don bzo ba tshor/ zhing pa dang mnyam 'brel byas nas thun mong gi dgra bor ngo rgol byed dgos pa'i skul brda btang /khong gis 6 mdun du skyod dang / dpa' ngar gyi me lce 'bar ba'i dus su mdun du skyod dang / khyod tshos gri kha'i khrag dmar skam du ma 'jug par 'thab 'dzing gyis dang zhes gsungs/ skul brda des rgya che ba'i bzo pa dang zhing pa yar bslangs nas mi grangs 8000lhag gi dpung sde grub/1525lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 16nyin/ rmu ran khen ho sen (778060ba'i 5300 7༅ lko)gyi nye 'khor du/ mun rdzir gyi 'os langs dmag gis dgra bo dang rgyal pham gting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug brgyab/ dgra bo'i stobs shugs che ba dang rang phyogs stobs shugs zhan pa'i steng/ 'os langs dmag la mtshon cha dkon pas/ dmag 'khrug la dka' sdug chen po byung / mun rdzor gyis 'os langs dmag la shing rta chen pos 'gog srung 'dzing rags bzo ru bcug ste dgra bo'i tshur rgol btsan 'gog byas/ dgra dmag gi dmag spyi hphe li phu ni shin tu g.yo sgyu can zhig yin pas/srubad sgos mgo bsgur du 'jug pa dang 'os langs dmag kha bral du gtong ba'i jus ngan spyad/ hpha li phu yis gal srid 'os langs dmag gis mun rdzer tshur sprad na tshang mar nyes med lhod gtong bya nges yin zer bas/ 'os langs dmag nang gi g.yo 'gul ba kha shas kyis mun dzer dgra bor sprad de dgra bor mgo bsgur rgyur yid 'thad yod ces ku co brgyab/ skabs der mun rjer dpa' ngar dang bcas yar langs nas che khyod tshos nga bkyigs nas dgra bor spraX nās nyes chad med pa gyis zhes re ba zhus kyang / rgya che ba'i 'os langs

dmag gis de lta byed par yid 'thad ma byung bar/ kho tshos 'thab nas rang srog shor yang rang gi gtso 'dzin dgra bor sprod rgyu gtan nas min zer/ mun dzer gyis kyang rgya che'i 'os langs dmag mi tshos re 'dod ltar/ mgo sgur dgos zhes dkrug slong rgyag mkhan gyi blo log pa gnyis la srog khrims bcad/de bzhin du hphe li phu yi lkog g.yo ngan jus don thog tu ma babs pas/ sngar las lhag pa'i drag rgol gyi 'go btsams kyang / 'os langs dmag gis srog la ma 'dzem par bkag 'gog byas rung / dgra bo'i stobs shugs che drag pas ma khog par 'os langs pa 5000lhag gis rang srog blos btang / mun rjer gyi mgo la rmas phog pas dgra bos 'dzin bzung byas/dgra bos mun dzer la nyes rdung drag po btang yang khong la gnya' sgur du 'jug ma thub/ mun rjer gyi 'chi bar mi skrag pa'i dpa' bo'i snying stobs la dgra bor thabs shes ci yang ma yod pas/ mun rdzir ni 6 lam nor ldog mi shes mkhan mi dang 6 khog la 'dre zhig pa'i mi zhig red /ces lab pa las thabs ma byung bar khong la srog khrims gcod rgyu'i thag bcad/ zla 5pa'i tshes 27nyin ni mun rdzor la nyes khrims gcod pa'i nyin yin la/ lag dmar gyi lag gi rno gri'i sngon du khong gis 'gyod bshags ci yang mi byed par skad gseng mthon por 6 'dzam gling stong gi yod tshad thams cad spyi la dbang ba yin ’ zhes dang 6 yun gtan bde ba'i khams ni nges par du mngon du 'gyur nges yin ’ zhes sgrog bzhin dpa' ngar zhum med sgos rang srog blos btang zhing de dus khong dgung lo 36 la ma gtogs thon med/blo thag rbad bcad kyi 'go khrid cig med pa dang grong khyer grong mi'i rim gras kyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis gsar brje ma byas pa'am gsar brjer blo log byas pas/ 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gzhi nas pham pa red/ yin na'ang 'os langs pa tshos gnya' mi chag pa'i 'thab rtso〉 spyas/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs kyi lam lugs la rdung deg drag po byas shing / gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi stobs shugs la'ang rdung deg drag po byas te/ 'os langs pa tsho'i zhum med dpa' bo'i spobs nyams dang gsar brje'i snying stobs ngoms pas/ zhing pa gral rim ni 'jar man gyi gtso shugs dmag dpung yin pa mtshon yod do//'jar man bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag tshos tha shal gyi 'khon lan sprod pa'i sems khams bcangs nas/ 'os langs pham pa'i rjes su gdug rtsub sgos zhing pa tshor ya nga med par dmar gsod brgyab pas/ zhing pa chig 'bum lhag dgra bo'i mtshon khar shi/ mnga' bdag tshos gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi sa gzhis du ma blangs nas/ sa khul so so nas slar yang zhing pa bran du bkol pa'i lam lugs btsugs pas/ 'jar man ni sngar bzhin bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bcad bzung gi rnam par gnas so//'jar man zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs rjes/ sa khul kha shas kyi 'thab rtsod 1527lo'i bar du rgyun 'khyongs byas/ 1534 —1535lor/ 'jar man nub khul gyi mun si the grong khyer gyi 'bangs gyen langasabyas nas srid dbang 'phrog pa dang 'thab rtsod de lo ngo bcu drug tsam rgyun 'khyongs byas/rlabs che ba'i 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gis phyis kyi 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje la rin thang che ba'i nyams myong dang bslab bya bton pa dang thad kur shugs rkyen yang bzhag yod/ de'i phyogs la en ke sis kyang cu grong khyer sdod mi dang sku drag tshos lag 'dzing byed pa'i skabs su/'jar man gyi zhing pa'i dmag 'khrug gis lung ston nang bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i gral rim 'thab rtsod bstan 'dug rgyu mtshan ni 'jar man gyi zhing pa'i daswākta /khrug gis 'os langs byas pa'i zhing pa gar stegs thog drangs pa ma
thang na ཿ

tsa lug gis mi sha zaphab mi dang tsa khragasngos brotshoba'i khrims lugs/mi khyod tsho'i lug ni dus nam yang g.yung mo yin pas/ lto yang rgyag tshad sdud sla pored/ go thos la deng skabs srid zhen che zhing gdug rtsub can du gyur 'dug pas/tha na mi sha za ba ma zad/ da dung khyod tsho'i sa zhing dang khyim gzhis/ grong khyer la rdog brdzis byas nas zhig ro tsam du bsgyur 'dug zer skadaka rshatho ma si morasmyo lug gis mi sha za ba ni dbyin ji'i bsam blo pa grags can tho ma si mor (160—83 66mo cholo 1478 — 1533lor)gyis bsam btsugs nas rtog bzo byas pa'i go na skyi g.ya' ba'i 6 gsar 'gyur miyin nam zhe na/rtsa ba nas ma yin te/ dus rabs bar ma'i dus smad kyi dbyin ji ru/ dngos su don de 'dra byung myong zhing / de ni lo 400lhag gi ring rgyun ma chad pas/dbyin ji'i mi dmangs la sdug bsngal brjod mi tshar pa zhig bzos pa red/mtsho lam gsar pa rnyed pa dang smyo skam sa chen po gsar pa mirnyed pas/yo rob kyi dpal 'byor ni mgyogs por dar rgyas chen po yong du bcug a she ya dang a hphe ri kha/ gling chen a me ri kha ru/ yo rob kyi tshong rdzas kyis rang la tshong ra rnyed yod/ rgyal spyi'i bar gyi tshong las 'gro 'ongs shin tu mang / yo rab kyi srol rgyun phyi btsong tshong rdzas te snam bu dang bal ni 'dzam gling sa cha so sor btsong ba nyin re'i las nyen rer je mang red/ yo rab skam sa chen po'i ches skad grags che ba'i bal 'thag bzo las kyi lte gnas ni hpho lan sder si (7/lha/6673 ༅ po dalta'i sgyel jam2612157 77)lo)yin la/ de

ru lo rer bal ha cang mang po'i dgos mkho yod cing mang che ba dbyin ji las bskyel nas yong ba red/ dbyin sge lan ḍi nas mcho gru'i nang bal bcugs nas hpho lan sder si la bskyel/ grong khyer gnyis kyi bar du zheng dog pa'i rdo wer (20 07777)mtsho 'gag las med pas skyel 'dren shin tu stabos bde bo yin/ dbyin ji'i bal phyir 'dren byas pa des/ hpho lan sder si'i bal 'thag las rigs kyi dar nyams thag gcod pa ma zad/ yo rob yongs kyi dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas phyogs kyang thad kur shugs rkyen 'jog gin 'dugadabyin jis nges par du bal gyi thon skyed nyin re nas nyin rer je mthor btong nas phyir btsong dgos pa byung / da dung lhag tu gnad don chen po zhig yod par/ dus rabs 15nas bzung dbyin ji rang gi bal 'thag bzo las gong 'phel du 'gro 'go brtsams pas/ lag shes bzo las kyi bzo khang chung chung mang po gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung stabs/ bal gyi dgos mkho nyin re las nyin rer je mang du song /de bzhin du bal gyi rin gong yang myur du je mthor song / 1430rko1540lo'i bar gyi lo ngo chig brgya lhag gi ring bal gong ldab gnyis tsam 'phar/lug gi rmig pas 'dam sa gser du bsgyur thub ’ zhes pa nang bzhin/ lug 'tsho ba dang bal las thon pa'i khe spogs de zhing las gnyer ba'i ldab gcig las brgal/ dus rabs 15pa'i dus mjug dang dus rabs 16pa'i dus stod du/ dbyin ji'i sku drag gsar pa'iXstobs shugs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas/ kho tsho dbyin ji spyi tshogs kyi gces phrug 'dra bar gyur pa dang / kho tsho ni da dung 'dod sred chen po'i ngang 6 dngul lor dbang cha gnyer bar dga' ba'i skor tshogs shig kyang yin no//pa'i 'aXr kṣiṃ zlo /sdu rdu yi bodu /na sna/ bye /sna rā pa// sna/ tna ༵ sgrotā /sngusna spyo bye // /sna // gzhiX //gas

lug 'tsho rgyu ni sku drag gsar pas mnyam 'jog byed yul nyag gcig tu gyur pas/ 6 sa zhing phyugs rar bsgyur dgos zhes pa ni kho tsho'i bya 'gul gyi 'bod tshig red/ dus rabs 15pa'i skabs su/ dbyin ji'i zhing pa'i ru khag gi rmang gzhi ni rang rmos zhing pa yin/ kho tshor grub cha gnyis yod de/ skor gcig la 6 rang dbang ldan pa'i zhing pa zer zhing / kho tsho sngar zhing pa rang dbang can yin/ skor cig shos la snye gzhung yig ldan pa'i zhing pa zer zhing kho tsho sngar zhing bran yin pas/ mnga' bdag khrims khang gi yig cha'i zur deb kyis zhing sa yod pa'i bden dpang byed cing / de dag ni rang rmos zhing pa'i gtso shugs yin/ zhing sde khul gyi sa zhing ni skor gsum la bgos yod de/ mnga' bdag (sku drag gsar pa)gis thad kur bzung ba'i sa zhing dang / rang rmos zhing pas bzung pa'i (yang na bogs zhing)sa zhing / zhing pa yongs kyis spyod bzhin pa'i spyi dbang sa zhing ('brog sa/) nags tshal/ rdzing bu/ spang thang sogs)bcas yin/ rgya chen por sa zhing bcad bzung byed pa'i las 'gul ni dus rabs 15pa'i dus mjug nas spyi dbang sa zhing las 'go bcoms shing dus rabs 17pa'i dus smad kyi bar ni sa zhing bcad bzung gi dus rim dang sbya red/ /sa rim gnyis pa ni dus rabs 18pa nas dus rabs 20pa'i dus da ba/ zhi/ /bcad bzung las 'gul ni thog mar dbyin ji'i shar lho'i khul gyi zhing sde nas 'go tshugs pa dang / yul de yo rab skam sa chen po dang rgyal spyi'i tshong ra'i bar 'brel ba ches dam po yod/ sku drag gsar pa tshos dang thog zhing pa yongs la dbang pa'i spyi dbang sa zhing la rib ma'i ra bskor nas rang rmos zhing par bkol spyod byed du ma bcug kho tshos rib ma'i ra skor nang lugā ༵༵sa nas bal btsong ste ma rtsa ring lugs rang bzhin gyi bdag gnyer

byas pa'am yang na zhing bdag dang phyugs bdag la glas te gla cha blangs/ rjes su sku drag gsar pa tshos rang rmos zhing par dbang ba'i sa zhing la ra brgyab te ches gdug rtsub dang rtsing po'i thabs shes spyad de grangs las 'das pa'i zhing pa tsho'i khyim gzhis med par bzos/ spyi yig ldan pa'i zhing pa zhig gis sku drag gsar pas sa zhing btsan bzung byas par bris pa'i 6 gtug yig mi las khrag dmar 'dzad 'dzad gyi dngos don de mtshon yod pa gsham gsal/mgrong gseb kyi sku drag des thog mar dbang shed btsan gsig gi thabs shes bkol nas/ rib mas phyugs ra dang nye 'dabs kyi sa zhing la ra brgyab/ de nas gdug tsubadang g.yo sgyu'i thabs kyis zhing pa'i sa zhing dang bogs mar blangs pa'i sa zhing /sil ra dang khang pa 'phrog tha na khang pa kha shas bshig pa dang mer bsregs nas bdag po tsho btsan por phyir skyod btang bas/ de dag skal cig tu mgo ru sa rdza leb tsam med cing sa na zhing sa tshun gang tsam med pa'i dbul por gyur/ skabs kha shas su/ grong gseb kyi sku drag tshos btsan shugs sgos khyon chung zhing sa rgyu zhan la rgyang thag ring ba'i sa zhing ngan pa dang zhing pa'i sa zhing bzang po gnyis btsan brje byas/ zhing pa mang po zhig sngar las lhag tu dbul por gyur/ la la'i tha na khyim gzhis kyang shor/ gnya' mi bskur pa'i zhing pa la/ grong gseb sku drag des btsan dzig dzig ngang dngos su ral gri dang dbyug pas drag chas pa'i rgyug khyi bdun brgyad khrid yong nas/ zhing pa de'i khyim gzhis bskor te/ btson mul du 'jug rgyu zhes 'jigs snang bskul/ zhing pa de shin tu skrag nas sgo dam po gtad de bsdad kyang / jag pa de tshos sgo dang sge'u khung gtor nas nang du brgyugs te gzhung yig 'phrog kyang zhing pa dang khyim mir gcad rdung drag po byas/zhing pa kha shas kyis phalha chen po dang ye shu'i mkhyen dang / sku ngo lags/ 'di ni ci'i phyir yin zhes dris pa'i tshe/ grong gseb kyi sku drag des gnas lugs med pa'i sgos nas dzigong ma rgyal pos chos bshad mkhan po dang slong ba'i chos pa/ chos bshad mkhan ma bcas kyi sdod khang bshegs song ba khyod tshos shes med dam/ de ring nged cag gong gseb sku drag tshos khyod tsho lta bu'i dbul po sgyid lug can gyi sdod khang bshig reswā 71 thon

yod 7ces 'chal gtam bshad/ phyir bskrad pa'i zhing pa tshos rang la srung skyob bya mi thub pa ma zad/ rang nyid sang gson gnangs gson gang yin la sems khral byed kyin 'dug pas/ rgyang ring yul du mi 'khyams ga med byung ( sa zhing bcad bzung byas pa des zhing pa 'bor chen zhig 'khyam po dang sprang por bsgyur pas spyi tshogs brtan po med par zing cha byung stabs dbang sgyur gral rim la dngangs skrag skyes nas sos mi bde bar gyur/ dbyin ji rgyal podamag gi 'byung khungs med par 'gro bar skrag nas bogs khral je nyung du btang / 1489lor dbyin ji'i rgyal po lhan re sku rabs bdun pas sa zhing bcad bzung bya mi chog pa'i bka' khrims dang po khyab bsgrags byas pa dang /rjes su mu mthud du bka' khrims bsgrags nas sa zhing bcad bzung gtan nas bya mi chog pa byas rung / phan nus ma yod par sa zhing bcad bzung bya rgyu je mang yin pa las je nyung la ma song / 1485 — 1517lo'i bar mnga' sde 23gyi sa zhing bcad bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul spel ba ltar na/ sku drag gsar pas bcad bzung byas pa'i sa zhing la dbyin smu'u 101290yod cing de'i nang lo tog 'debs chog pa'i sa zhing dbyin smu'u 56883yod pas 56 2chubazung / phyugs 'tsho ba'i rtswa sar bsgyur nas bcad bzung byas pa'i sa zhing la dbyi smu'u 30986yod pas 30 6slobazung / khyim tshang 1733gyi khang pa bshig grong sde 1072mi stong spang rgod du gyur/ zhing pa 6808phyir skyod brgyab/1593lor e li gzi sgye (211 2866 5707 0)rgyal mos skabs shig sa zhing bcad bzung bya mi chog pa'i bka' khrims mi dgos pa byas pas/'phral du mi rnams smyos pa bzhin du gang sa gang du sa zhing bcad bzung byed par zhugs pas/ las 'gul de ches mgyogs po'i sgo nas sngar las lhag pa'i rgya rdonā por myur du spel/ spyi sdom byas pa ltar na/ 1607lor slebs tshe/

dbyin ṅge lan ḍi'i dbus khul gyi mnga' sde 14ru kho na ru dbyin smu'u 386810lhag yod pa'i sa zhing bcad bzung byas/dbyin ji'i rgyal pos bka' khrims gsar pa bsgrags te sa zhing chung ngu dbang pa'i mi la srung skyob mi byed ga med byung / bka' khrims nang / mnga' zhabs sa cha gcig tu lug 2000yan las gso mi chog par thag bcad rung nus pa ma thon par/ phyugs ra'i bdag po kha shas kyis lug 24000tsam gsos yod/ grong sde zhig la sngon chad rmo zhing dbyin smu'u 1500yod pa'i nang gi dbyin smu'u 1450bcad bzung byas nas lug 'tsho sa byas/ si kho thi lan ḍi (500 /thab lo ༅)ru sku drag gsar pa zhig yod pas rmo zhing phyugs rar bsgyur ched/ grong sde la me btang nas bsregs rjes/ drag shugs kyis zhing pa 15000phyi yul du btsan skyod btang / de'i nang rgan mo lo lon zhig phyi yul du ma song ba mer bsregs nas bsad/dus rabs 17pa'i rjes su/ dbyin ji'i rgyal pos sa zhing bcad bzung byed mi chog pa'i bka' khrims der don dngos su nus pa ci yang med/ dus rabs 18pa nas bzung / gros tshogs chen mor sa zhing bcad bzung bya chog pa'i khrims la gros 'cham byung bas/ sa zhing bcad bzung las 'gul gyi dus rim gnyis pa'i 'go bcoms te slar yang sa zhing bcad bzung byed pa'i las 'gul de zing zing du spel ba red/sa zhing bcad bzung las 'gul ni thon skyen 'brel ba'i bsgyur bcos thengs shig yin la/ dbyin ji'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thog ma'i gsog 'jog gi rmang gzhir gyur stabs/ zhing las khrod kyi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'brel bas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa zhing dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi tshab byed par skul spel byas yod/ yin na'ang / 'gyur ldog de'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni drag shugs dang btsan dbang gis zhing pa 'bor chen zhig gi lag nasdu sbyan

skyed ma rgyu dang 'tsho ba'i rgyu cha 'phrog rgyu de byas yod do//lug khyus 6 bzas pa'i ’ khyim shor zhing pa 'bor chen zhig las skal ci 'drar thug par dmigs nas grong rdal du yong / de'i nang gi mi mang po zhig nyin rer 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i lag shes bzo las kyi bzo khang du song nas/ gla cha chung ba'i ngal rtsol pa mi byed thabs med byung / da dung mi mang po zhig 'khyams po dang sprang po/ tha na 6 jag rkun mi du gyur/ skabs der mi 'bor chig 'bum tsam yod pa'i lun ton du 'khyams po ldom po lnga 'bum lhag yod pa red/ de bas na dbang sgyur gral rim gyi spyi tshogs 6 sgrig lam mi la nyen kha chen po byung na'ang / srid gzhung gis sa zhing bcad bzung la sngon 'gog bya thabs bral pas/ phyir ldog nas 6 'khyams por chad pa gcod pa'i khrag dmar 'dzar pa'i bka' khrims (mar khe si'i gsung)khyab bsgrags byas te/sa zhing shor ba'i zhing pa la mnar gcod btang / dus rabs 16pa'i lo rabs 30pa nas 40bar de lta bu'i bka' khrims gsum khyab bsgrags byas/1530lo'i bka' khrims su/ mi rgan pa dang ngal rtsol gyi nas pa shor ba'i mi kho nar zas slong chog pa'i lag 'khyer ster pa las/ lus po thang zhing lus shed che ba'i mis zas slong mi chog de las 'gal na 'dzin bzung byed pa dang / shing rta'i mjug tu btags nas lcag gis brabs rjes phyir rang yul du bskyal rgyu yin zhes bsgrags/ 1547lo'i bka' khrims su/ slar yang sngon ma bskyar bshad byas te/ thengs gnyis su khrims de dang 'gal bas na 'dzin bzung byas nas lcag gis 'brab pa dang rna cog phyed ka 'dra ba'i chad pa gcod rgyu/ thengs gsum par khrims dang 'gal na srog khrims gcod rgyu zhes bsgrags/ 1547lo'i bka' khrims la de bas lhag pas gdug rtsub che/ zla ga/sdu / nang las ka mi rnyed pa'i 'khyams po zhig yod pa zhu sbyor byas tshe/

'khyams po de zhu sbyor mkhan gyi bran g.yog tu khrims gcod byas te lcag dang lcags sgrog 'og sdug las bya dgos/ gal srid bran g.yog te bros nas nyin 14'gor na/ de'i thod pa dang rgyab gzhong du yig 'bru bya (dbyin yig51850bran g.yog zhes pa'i yig 'bru dang po) yi bsregs tham brgyab rjes bdag pos gang 'dod du btsong chog thengs gsum la bros pa'i bran g.yog la srog khrims gcod rgyu yin/ nyin gsum la las ka mi las pa'i bran g.yog phyir rang yul du skyel rgyu yin la brang khar yig 'bru 5 (dbyin yig786860bsku ma ༅lko 'khyams po zhes pa'i yig 'bru dang po) bsregs tham brgyab rjes lcags sgrog bskon nas srang lam du dmag la zhugs par bsgugs dgos zhes bsgrags/ khrag dri bro ba'i khrims yig des/ nyen re sku rabs brgyad pa'i ( 1509 — 1547lo) dus su/ sa zhing shor ba'i zhing pa 72000lhag la srog khrims bcad/ e li gzi lha'i skabs su ( 1558 —1603lo)lo rer mi sum brgya nas bzhi brgya lhag la srog khrims bcad pa red/sa zhing bcad bzung byed pa'i las 'gul des rgya che ba'i zhing pa dbul phongs tshor yod tshad 'chor du bcug la/ tha na tshe srog kyang ma dbang pa byas/gson po tsho ni drag shugs dang 6 khrag dri bro ba'i khrims yig gis gla cha nyung ba'i gla ba byas te ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo grwa'i 'byor med gral rim du gyur/yin na'ang / de ni phyogs gcig yin zhing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas las ka ci yang ma rnyed pa'i mi khri khri 'bum 'bum yar langs nas sa zhing bcad bzung byed par ngo rgol byas pas/ 1549lor rgya khyon ha cang che ba'i ro sgye the khe thi 'os langs byung / rjes su 'os langs pham na'ang bkas bkod rgyud 27rdon

lam lugs la rdung deg chen po byas te/ zhing pa'i sa zhing gi dbang char srung skyob byas pas/ nor sprol khe (701101smo glo ma)mnga' sde sa khul du rang rmos zhing pa sngar mus su gnas yod pa dus rabs 17pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i skabs kyi gros tshogs dmag gi gtso shugs su gyur pa red/

don dngos su/ si phen dang dbyin ji'i bar du de las lhag pa'i 'gal ba zab mo yod/ sme ri si thu ar thi bsad pa des dus yun ring por bsags pa'i 'gal ba de thol gyis byung du bcug pa tsam yin no//dus rabs 16pa'i dus dkyil nas bzung / dbyin ji'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi myu gu 'bus pa dang 'phel rgyas byung bas/ phyi phyogs tshong las dang mi ser spel ba'i 'phrog len byed pa'i rgya khyon nyin re las nyin rer je cher song / dbyin ji'i tshong pas nyo tshong kung si chen po du ma btsugs te/ phyi gling gi sa khul kha shas su tshong las gnyer pa dang 'phrog bcom byas/ dbyin ji'i rgyal pos tshong khang de dag gis phyi gling du 'phrog bcom byed par rgyab skyor byas pa ma zad rang nyid kyang nang du zhugs/ 1558lor/ lo na 25la son pa'i e li gzi bho rgyal po'i go sar bsdad de dbyin jir dbang sgyur pa'i rgyal mor gyur pas/ sger gcod ring lugs kyi srid dbang sra brtan du btang / 1593lor/kho mos sa zhing bcad bzung byed mi chog pa'i bka' khrims mi dgos pa byas rkyen/ dbyin ji'i sa zhing bcad bzung gi las 'gul lhag tu 'phel rgyas su song la/ rang khyim nas phyir skyod btang ba'i 'khyam po tshor gdug rtsub sgos snying rje med par chad pa bcad/ de dag thams cad dbyin ji'i ma rtsa'i dang thog gi gsog 'jog la phan pa byung bas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su btang / e li gzi dhe yis da dung rgya mtsho'i steng 'phrog bcom byed pa la'ang skul 'ded byas/(de ni ma rtsa dang thog gsog 'jog byed pa'i thabs shes gzhan zhig red) dbyin ji'i mtsho jag gis 'phrog bcom byed pa'i dmigs 'ben gtso bo se phan gyi mtsho gru dang se phan gyi mi ser spel yul byed/ sdi re khe (718ba013 07 smos rsā༅)ni dbyin ji'i mtsho jag gi gte bo ming grags can zhig yin/ 1577 — 1580lo'i bar/ sdi re khe yi gru star klidī spyan a me ri kha'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs kyi se phan gyi mi ser spel

yulachi li ((61 /0 lko1)dang / phe ru (2615 7 )yi mtsho 'gram du brgyugs nas/ se phan gyi da dung lam la ma chas pa'i gru gzings nang gi dbyin sgor khri tsho bcu phrag du ma'i rin gong can gyi dngos po 'phrog pa dang /de'i mang nyung dbyin ji'i gong ma tshang gi lo gcig gi yong sgo dang gcig 'dra yin/ se phan gyis dbyin ji la mtsho jag sdi re khe la nyes chad gcod dgos pa dang dngos por skyin tshab sprod dgos pa'i re ba zhus dus/ e li gzi bhe yis sa khul so sor sdi re khe skam sar slebs dus rku dngos sbed rogs byed dgos pa'i gsang ba'i bka' babs/ sdi re khe 66gser shwa mi rtags can gyi gru gzings nang 'phrog thob rgyu nor gang khyer nas phyir log skabs/ e li gzi sgye dngos su bsu ru song nas rten 'brel zhus pa dang / da dung mtsho jag de la 6 rje si ’ zhes pa'i go gnas kyi ming rtags byin/ sdi re khe yis 'phrog bcom byas pa'i rgyu nor gyi 407gong ma rgyal mor phul ba dang / rgyal mo des sdi re khes 'phrog dngos nang gi rdo rje pha lam gyis rang gi cod pan la phra brgyab pa red/ 1585lor/ rgyal mos sdi re khe slar yang rgyang skyod byed par mngags shing / thad gar dbyin sgor nyis khri ma dngul du btang / mtsho jag gi gte bo gzhan pa 'jon ho khen si (57761 bca rsā༅lo)ni phu ri smu si'i gru bdag cig yin/ kho rgyun du se phan gyi mi ser spel yul du song nas bran g.yog gi sding sdug par mkhas/ de la'ang e li gzi sgye yis rgyab skyor dang skul 'ded ba hā li/ gzi bho rgyal mos rgyab skyor byas 'og dbyin ji'i nas shugs gang yod sgos phyi tshong dang mi ser spel ba'i 'phrog bcom bya 'gul spel stabs/dbyin ji dang se phan gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba ni nyin re nas nyin rer dza drag can du gyur/ dus rabs 16pa'i dus dkyil gyi se phan ni 'dzam gling steng du grags che ba'i ‘ mtsho thog btsan dbang can midang ches stobs shugs ca18 gyu mi

ser spel ba'i btsan rgyal zhig yin/ de la mi 'bor bye ba gcig yod cing /mi ser spel ba'i stobs shugs ni yo rob dang gling chen a me ri kha/ a she ya bcas gling chen bzhi ru khyab yod/ se phan la da dung ches stobs shugs che ba'i dmag gru ru khag yod pas 'dzam gling sa khul so sor 'gog thub mkhan med pas rang dgar 'gro 'ong byed/ rjes su dar ba'i dbyin ji ni/ mi ser spel ba'i btsan rgyal rgan pa se phan dang 'gran thabs med rung / dbyin ji'i ma rtsa ring lugs la 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / phyi phyogs tshong las dang mtsho jag gi bya 'gul gang mang spel pas se phan gyi khe phan la gnod pa chen po btang / dbyin ji'i gong ma tshang gi blon po zhig gis/ dbyin ji'i mtsho jag gi 'phrog bcom bya 'gul ni 4 se phan gyi rgyal po'i ske la thag pa bskon pa 'dra mi zhes zer/ dbyin ji dang se phan bar gyi 'gal ba des mtshon cha'i kha nas rgyal pham zhig rtsod du 'jug nges stabs/ g.yul chen po rgyag rgyu ni bshol thabs med pa'i gnas bab zhig tu gyur to//hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis pas se phan gyi 6 mtsho steng dbang shed 〉kyi go gnas la srung skyob bya ched/ dbyin ji 'dul bar blo thag bcad de/ dmag gru'i tshogs chen po zhig rtsa 'dzugs bya dgos pa'i bka' babs/ 1588lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 18nyin/ hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis pas gung rje si rdo nee a zhes pa dmag gru yongs kyi dmag spyi la bskos pa'i bka' yig bsgrags shing / zla 4pa'i tshes 25nyin/ rgyal sa li si snyen (21 360ba tshomolha)gyi chos khang chen mo ru/ si phen rgyal pos ming du 6 skal bzang dmag gru'i ru khag ’ zhes par dar cha gnang ba'i mdzad sgo tshogs pa dang / rjes rabs tshos gru tshogs de la 2 do med dmag gru'i ru khag zer/ 4 skal bzang dmag gru'i ru khag la dmag gru 130dang chu pa dang phyogs chen 'phen mkhan bcas mi 8000yod/sdugā ༵༵ pa dang bzung dmag bran g.yog rang dbang can gyi 'bangs mi
