sogs 2100lhag gis gru skya brgyab/ dmag mi 19000dang / dang blangs mtsho skyod mkhan (skya mi dang sku drag dang de tsho'i zhabs 'brangs pa) 1544yod cing / chos lugs mi sna 180yod/ zla 5pa'i tshes 28nyin/ si rdo nee a sdod pa'i 2 san mar then rtags can thog mar bgrod 'go bcoms nas li si snyen gyi gru khar bskyod pa dang / de'i 'phror dmag gru gzhan pa dag kyang mnyam du lam la chas shing / ru do med dmag gru'i ru khag mi de gru kha las phyir bud de dbyin ji'i phyogs su bgrod pa tsam la nyin mtshan gnyis kyi dus tshod dgo sa pa byung / gnas tshul de lun ton du 'byor pa dang / rgyal mo e li gzi sgye yis dgra bo bsu dgos pa'i bka' babs/ dmag gi sgrig chas steng dbyin ji se phan la mi do na'ang / si phen gyis btsan 'dzul byed par thug pa'i gnad 'gag skabs su/ dbyin ji'i rim pa so so dang chos lugs kyi grub mtha' so so sdeb langs byas/ nang sgos su gling phyi'i nyo tshong dang mi ser spel bar spro ba'i tshong pa tsho mi su las kyang hur brtson che bar mngon/ mtsho 'gram grong khyer dag gis dmag gru rang sgrig byas shing mi yang gang mang yong nas dmag la zhugs/ gong ma tshang dang gru bdag tshong pa/ mtsho jag sogs kyi mtsho gru mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas dmag gru'i ru khag bsgrigs par/ gru che chung 140dang / g.yul la zhugs mkhan 9000'dus/ mtsho jag gi gte bo sdi re khe dang 'jon ho khen si gnyis bkod 'doms pa byas/ rgyal mo e li gzi snye'i sku ngo mas dpon dmag tshor skul 'ded rang bzhin gyi gtam bshad byas te/ kho mo dang dpon dmag tsho mnyam gson mnyam 'chi yin pa bshad pas/dmag mi tshos spobs sems lhag tu mtho ru btegs/si phen gyi 66skal bzang dmas gru'i ru khag ’ ni lam du chas ma thag rkyen ngan chen por thug zla 6pazhi tshes 19nyin/ dmag gru ru khag ni nt+razlo rden

dang drag rlabs la 'phrad pas gru gzings kha shas 'phral du nye 'dabs kyi lā khu'u ru ne a (28 2075ba lo14 tsho4)ru char rlung g.yol bar phyin yang /gru gzings kha shas mtsho nang du bying pa red/ sang nyin zhogs par rlung dang rba rlabs zhi 'jags su song rjes/ tsa do med dmag gru'i phyed ka tsam gar song cha med du gyur zhing / tshes 24nyin la slobs tshe da rung gru gzings 33 (de dag steng mi 8449yod)grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu ma yod/ gung rje si rdo ne as gnas tshul de mthong rjes mgyogs por rgyal por hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis par rgyang 'dul gyi mtshams bzhag ste/ dgra bo dang 6 gzi brjid ldan pa'i mi 'os med 'grig thabs byed pa'i snyan zhu mi zhu ga med byung / yin na'ang hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis pas de la ma nyan par mu mthud du rgyang skyod byed dgos pa'i bka' babs/ zla 7pa'i tshes 22nyin/ gung rje si rdo nee a yis lā khu'u ru nee a dang 'bral dgos pa'i bka' mi 'bab thabs med byung /si phen dmag gru'i tshogs dbyin ji'i mtsho 'gag la slebs pa'i skabs su/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis g.yul ngor dgra bor bsgugs yod cing si phen dmag grus ci byed la rig pa bsgrims nas do snang bya bzhin 'dug tshes 30nyin/ gung rje si rdo ne a yis phu li smu gzi (215705 'i rsālko/zomo)gru kharadamag don tshogs 'du bsdus nas/ gal srid gnas tshul yag ste bya ba lam du song ba na/ phu li smu gzi la phar rgol byed pa dang / gal srid de las ldog ste gnas bab ma yag na mu mthud du mtsho skyod byed rgyu thag bcad/skabasader dbyin ji'i dmag gru'i khyu tshogs kyi spyi dpon ho wa sdes dmag gru 80yis lkog nas si phen dmag gru'i ru khag bskor dgos pa dang / gzhan yang dmag gru 11gis mtsho 'gram nas bskor nas tshur bcar dgos pa'i bka' babs/ dbyin ji dmag gru mgyogs shing stabs bde la/ gru chung zhing ri~X ༵༵ steng mdel shugs drag po yod cing gang la gang mkho bzhin bgrod

thub na'ang / si phen dmag gru'i gzugs che zhing lci che bas skyod tshad dal pa'i thog mtho tshad kyang shin tu mtho stabs/ dbyin ji'i dmag gi dmigs 'ben du gyur sla/ gung rje si rdo nee a ni dmag gru ru khag gi spyi dpon yin rung g.yul 'gyed pa'i nyams myong med pa ma zad da dung gru gzings mi 'phrod par maspya yom 'khor bas bkod 'doms byas pa yang ha cang thabs rdugs por ma na/tshes 31nyin skya rengs shar pa dang gung rje si rdo ne a yis gru'i sge'u khung las phyir bltas tshe/ gral ring bsgrigs pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag gru mthong ba dang phar rgol bya dgos pa'i bka' babs/ se phan dmag gru gzhu dbyibs su gral bsgrigs nas dbyin ji'i dmag gru dkyil khug tu thon pas na bar thag nye sa nas skyogs chen gyi mdel shugs btsan pos pha rol po mnan nas rgyal kha len rgyur re ba byas/ dbyin ji'i dmag gru'i sbyi dpon ho wa sde yis pha rol po'i ngan jus shes song bas dmag gru gral gnyis su phye nas se phan gyi dmag dpung thag nye sa nas ma 'thab par rgyang ring nas phyogs chen 'phangs pas/se phan gyi dmag gru'i g.yul ngo'i sgrig star gtor ba dang / bkod 'doms dmag grur smyogs mdel phog nas gseg la yo zhing dmag gru gzhan las lhag par nyen skyob kyi me mda' gcig 'phro gnyis mthud du 'phangs pa red/ gung rje si rdo ne a yis dngos su se phan gyi dmag gru zu san sal wa rdor rtags can la dbyin ji'i me skyogs phog nas dmag mi tsho me lce chen po'i nang gson bsregs thebs pa'i yid skyo'i gnas tshul mthong / phyi nyin ‘ san sal wa rdor ’ mtsho gting du bying / zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin/ si phen gyi dmag gru'i ru khag gis dbyin ji'i dmag gru'i spyi dpon gyi dar cha bsgrengs pa'i dmag gru la khyon nas drag rgol byas kyang pham kha chen po myangs/ de nas gung rje si rdo ne a thabs zad 'u thug gi gnas su lhung bas/ shul lhag dmag gru thamasdu /da

g.yul sa nas phyir 'then nas kha le si ((743 10lko )gru khar skyod dgos pa'i bka' babs/ mtshan gong la slebs pa dang rgya mtsho'i steng smug pa stug po 'thibs shing si phen dmag gru'i steng gi dmag mi tsho rmi lam du zhing du bzhud/dbyin ji'i mis skabs de dang bstun nas tshong pa'i gru gzings rnying pa drug gi nang 'bar sla'i dngos po blugs shing steng du 'ba' cha byugs rjes me bsgron te rlung shugs la brten nas si phen gyi dmag gru'i phyogs su skyod du bcug pas/skad cig tsam du si phen gyi dmag gru mang por me 'bar pas mtsho ngos yongs su me lce chen pos bkang / gung rje si rdo ne a yis brel 'tshub ngang gru'i sbrel thag gcod du bcug nas bros song la/ mthar thug dmag gru du ma me ru bsregs pa dang dmag gru kha shas bros bshol byed pa'i skabs phan tshun thug brgyab nas rgya mtsho'i gting du nub/phyi nyin skya rengs shar ma thag khā le si ((ma 1 3 10lko)dang don kher khule (75 smo61950 77/lo7)yi bar gyi sge su'e spu lan si ru dbyin ji dang si phen phyogs gnyis kyis ches mtha' mjug gi gting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug brgyab/ phar tshur la skyogs chen 'phen pa'i skabs su/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis rang la yod pa'i dge mtshan de thag ring du me phyogs 'phen thub cing 'ben la gzas pa thog tu 'bab nges pa'i nus pa bton nas drag rgol byas/ si phen gyi dmag gru ni pha rol po'i nye sar thon dka' ba dang me phyogs kyi thon tshad kyang nye bas phar la rgol rgyu phar zhog tshur rang thog tu sgogs mdel du ma babs pas kho tshor god ka tshabs chen thebs/ phyi dro gung rje si rdo nee as shul lhag dmag gru khrid de phyir hpho lan sder si ru mi log ga med byung / dbyin ji'i dmag grus gang nus gang thub sgos skyogs mdel tshar ba'i bar du tsha 'ded drag rdung byas/29)sa kyi zla gnyis tsam gyi dus tshod nang / si phen gyi zu do med dmag gru'i

ru khag mi ni ri dwags gis rngon pa mthong ba lta bur/ dmag 'khrug rgyag ma phod par si kho thi lan ḍi dang ar lan ḍi bskor nas phyir si phen du log lam bar du 6 do med dmag gru'i ru khag :yang thengs gnyis la drag rung dang ni/byer pa/ cadasna smra snro kharta/pa can lta bu)chu 'og brag rdo dang āoṃ thug nas rgya mtsho'i nang bying / rdzo dmag gru kha shas 'a11bsdo ba dang tsho tshokha shas drag rlung gis ded de 7 7gar song cha med du bor/ gung rje si rdo ni a mi rang la yang tsha /sdo ༵༵ sbya satsha phog nas shi la 'a1588lo'i zla 10par/ si phen gyi dmag gru'i ru khag gi rā byu shul lhag dmag gru phyir rang — —sa rirarig rangayul si phen du 'byor/ skabs ga yongabang ———noder tsa do med dmag gru'i ru stong — 'ang bang — khag mi chen mo de'i shul du cu 'thor la khad gyi gru chag 8 hi ro nā ’ rtags can gyi dmag gru mtsho 'og 43las lhag med/ mi chig khri brag rdo dang thug nas mtsho nang du bying ba/tsam gyis tshe srog shor pas dmag gi dpung chen de ha lam rtsa med du song /de'i dmag spyi gung rje si rdo ne a ste dmag 'khrug las pham pa'i dmag dpon des rgyal po hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis par skad cig bskur nas go sa lasdu snab

dgos pa dang phyir rang gi gzhis kur log rgyu'i re ba zhus/ kye nyid/ sku drag de pham nas bzod lta shor pa'i nyams la ltos dang /ham shed sger gcod che ba'i si phen gyi rgyal po hphe li phe sku rabs gnyis pa ni/ da dung rdung rdeg drag las sad rtogs thob par/ sna nga la de 'dra'i 'dod pa yod tshe/ da dung dmag gru'i ru khag chen mo zhig 'dzugs rgyu las sla mo red mi ces 'khrul gtam lab/ don dngos su dus de nas bzung / 6 mtsho steng gi btsan dbang can si phen mgyogs por nyams dmas su song /dbyin ji rgya mtsho'i steng gi ches stobs shugs can gyi 'gran ya las rgyal pas rgya mtsho'i steng gi rgyal po stobs shugs can du gyur stabs/ sngar las lhag par ma rtsa'i dang po'i gsog 'jog dang mi ser spel ba'i khongs rgya skyed pa'i go rim je mgyogs su btang nas/ ma rtsa ring lugs gong spel byas so//296

rtan then dang khong gi 〈khyad dugazhags pa'i sgros gar〉/phabakas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dus rabs bar ma'i mjug sgril pa dang deng rabs ma rtsa ring lugs lo rtsis kyi 'go brtsams pa la rlabs che ba'i mi zhig gis mtshon byed byas yod/ mi de ni dbyi tha li pa rdan then yin zhing / khong ni dus rabs bar ma'i ches mtha' ma'i snyan ngag pa yin la dus mtshungs su dus rabs gsar pa'i ches thog ma'i snyan ngag pa yang yin nosawa en ke si/dus rabs 14nas dus rabs 17pa'i dus stod du/ thog mar dbyi tha li nas 'go brtsams shing / rjes su nub phyogs yo rob kun tu 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul zhig byung la/ las 'gul de lo 300lhag gi ring rgyun 'khyongs byas/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig lo rgyus steng gi 'gyur ldog chen po zhig yin la/ des tsa ghi ri si dang ro ma gyi rig gnas ’ slar gso byed pa'i dar cha bsgrengs pas/ lo rgyus stong de la 6 rig rtsal bskyar dar zer/rig rtsal bskyar dar ni gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyis rig gnas khyab khongs su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byas pa'i 'thab rtsod red/ de'i nang don la rgya shin tu che ste/ dus rabs bar ma'i chos grwa'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang btsun pa ring lugs dgag pa dang / smyo mi chos ring lugs ’ gsar du dar pa/ yul skad rtsom rig byung ba/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos bcos bsgyur byas pa/ stong sems spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam blo byu19 bying /

da dung rang byung tshan rig dang nyer spyod lag rtsal la dar rgyas chen po byung bas khyab spel rgya chen por byas pa sogs nang don 'du'o// smyo bskyar dar mi zhes pa ni 6 snyi ri si dang ro ma gyi dpe mtshon rig gnas bskyar gso ’ byas pa ma yin par/ nye rabs rig gnas gsar pa dar spel byas pa de yin no//rig rtsal bskyar dar ni dus rabs kyi thon dngos shig yin la/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi 'gyur ldog byung ba'i ldog med 'bras bu zhig yin/dus rabs 14pa nas bzung / thog mar dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs (khyad par du i ṭha lha'i grong khyer)su ma rtsa ring lugs 'byung ba'i thog ma'i myu gu 'bus shing / rjes su rim bzhin nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab so sor dar khyab tu song / bzo tshong las rigs dar pa'i grong khyer ni dpyid kyi dpal yon ltar yo rob skam sa chen por 'phel rgyas byung / grong mi'i nang las ches thog ma'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa byung / gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyis rang dbang du bzo tshong las rig gi dpal 'byor spel 'dod skyes pas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bkag rgya rab rim gtor dgos pa'i re ba bton/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi khyab khongs su/ dus rabs bar ma'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin chos tshogs kyi bsam blo'i brtsi bya dang / chos grwa'i tshad nyid rig pa/ btsun pa ring lugs/ 'dod spang ring lugs bcas ni/'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'jig rten lta ba dang mi tshe lta tshul la mtshon na lcags sgrog dam po zhig yin pa smos med yin pas/ gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol dang chos lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul zhig spel zhing / de ni spyi tshogs kyi rlabs rgyun dang mthun pa'i sngon thon gyi las 'gul zhig yin no//dbyi tha li'i pho'o rin dze (71 dzra bsnus ༅79)yi snyan ngag pa rdan thegā ༵ ཿli dge ri (1265 — 1321lo)ni yo rab rig rtsal bskyar dar las

'khril spyang sdi tshul ring lugs kyi sngon byon pa'i rmad du byung ba'i 'thus tshab mi sna ga da/ tha li/ ni nub phyogs yo rob kyi rig rtsal bskyar dar las 'gul gyi 'byung gnas yin/ dus rabs 11pa nas 13bar gyi rgya gram rtags can dmag gi rgyang 'dul de chos lugs dmag 'khrug byas nas pham na'ang / nye shar du bgrod pa'i tshong lam btod pas/ nub phyogs (dbyi tha li nang du 'du ba)dang shar phyogs kyi rig gnas brje res byas shing / dbyi tha li yi dpal 'byor rig gnas dar rgyas su 'gro bar skul spel byas yod/ ming grags can gyi grong khyer tha'e rin dze ni ches gal 'gangs che ba'i bzo las kyi lte gnas shig yin/ ma rtsa ring lugs ni ches dang por tha'e rin dze nas dar pa dang /de ni da dung spyi tshogs 'thab rtsod ches dza drag che ba'i yul zhig kyang yin pas gang sa gang du gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyis khengs 'dug dus rabs 13pa'i skabs su/dbyi tha li ni chab srid steng kha 'thor ba'i tshul du gnas shing / dbyi tha li ru chos kyi gong ma la stobs shugs ha cang chen po yod/ chos kyi gong ma des rang gi dbang bsgyur sra brtan du gtong ched/ dbyi tha li'i mi dmangs kyi khe phan btsong bar yang ma 'dzem par/ hpha ran si'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi stobs shugs la brten nas grong mi la kha gtad 'jal ba dang de dag gi ngo rgol la drag gnon byas/ de bzhin du dbyi tha li'i rno ngar che zhing rnyog 'dzing ldan pa'i spyi tshogs chab srid 'tsho ba'i khrod/ hpha ran si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi rigs 'thab rtsod kyang 'dres yod/ thun then ni gos mas dus skabs nang mi yul du 'khrungs/rdan then ni pho'i ren dze'i nyams rgyad du gyur pa'i sku drag chung chung zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs pas/ spyi tshogs kyi go gnas dma' zhing chung ngu'i ༵༵ su

'tsho ba shin tu skyo po yin/ pha ma gnyis snga sa nas tshe las 'das stabs/ gna' bo'i sku drag gi thob thang gis khong la snyan grags dge mtshan ci yang ster ma thub pa ma zad da dung dngos yod spyi tshogs nang sdug bsngal che ba'i 'tsho ba rol du bcug lo na nyer bzhi la thon pa'i dus khong rang pho'i rin dze'i grong mis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag la ngo rgol byed pa'i sgang bha sde dmag 'khrug nang zhugs myong zhing / de las khong nyid spyi tshogs 'thab rtsod la zhugs pa'i 'go bcoms/ khong gis ming grags che ba'i bho rdan then/lon a (20106ba ṣṭha ༅)slob grwa chen po'i nang gna' gzhung slob gso thob pas shes bya gting zab pa zhig sbyangs/ de dag gis khong gi rjes kyi spyi tshogs chab srid bya 'gul dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom la shugs rkyen zab po bzhag yod/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs kyi dbang bsgyur dang hpha ran sis dus yun ring por btsan 'dzul byas pa des dbyi tha li la gnod 'tshe chen po btang / rdan then gyis mes rgyal gyi sdug bsngal mthong bas sems khongs su me ltar 'bar ba'i khong khro skyes te gsham gyi snyan tshig 'di bris/kye hud/ bran g.yog gi dbyi tha li/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas yul/char rlung drag po'i nang kha lo bsgyur mkhan med pa'i gru gzings/khyod ni thams cad kyi bkur pa'i lha mo min par smad tshong ma ru gyur/307de ru sdod pa'i mi yis phan tshun dmag 'khrug rgyag/

grong khyer gcig tu gnas yang mtshon gyis 'dzing resakhyed/snying rje ba'i dbyi tha li lags/khyed kyis phyi rol yul la mig rgyang phongs dang spyorgya mtsho 'gram nas khyed kyi lte ba'i gnas su dag gtsang zhi 'jags kyi yul zhig gang du yod/sgang bha sde dmag 'khrug gi rjes su/ tha'e rin dze grong khyer nang gi gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'thus tshab sger spru tang ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'thus tshab ce sgye len tang las rgyal te/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid dbang btsugs/ dan then yang hur brtson sgos srid dbang gsar pa'i 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba'i nang zhugs/ 1259lar grong khyer gros srid las khungs tsa mi brgya'i tshogs 'du ’ yi nang zhugs/ 1300lor srid 'dzin 'go gtso 7las grub pa'i ches mtho'i srid 'dzin tshogs 'dur zhugs/ yin na'ang lo der chos kyi gong ma'i rgyab skyor 'og bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sku drag tshos ro langs kyi bya 'gul smyon pa ltar gang sa gang du spel/ chos kyi gong ma'i tha'e rin dze ru mngags pa'i myul ma 3'dzin bzung byas nas nyes chad bcad/chos kyi gong mas myul ma de dag phyir gtong ba'i re ba bton yang / ldan then gyis srid 'dzin 'go gtso'i las 'gan ltar grong mi tshos myul ma tshor drang bden gyi nyes khrims gcod par chog mchan bkod/ chos kyi gong ma la kha skyengasarlung langs te hpha ran si'i dmag mi la drag gnon bya dgos pa'i ngan skul btang / dbyi tha li skyob pa'i phyir rdan then ni dpa' ngar zhum med sgos mi rang gi nyen khar ma bltas par tshur phyogs kyi pho nya'i 'gan blangs nas ro ma gyi chos skyong gzhung du gros mol byed par phebs pa dang / ro ma la slebs pa dang ngo tsha med pa'i gnam bdag chos kyi gong ma des dus yun tsam la rdan then bkag nyar byas/ phyi lor/ hpha rin si'i dmag dpung tha'i ri/ 0rdo ru

slebs pa dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi stobs shugs dang mnyam gcig tu grong mi tsho la dmar gsod dang 'phrog bcom byas/ mi mang po zhig la nyes khrims bcad pa dang phyir skyod btang / rdan then la'ang nyes pa du ma bgrangs nas phyir skyod brgyab/ dus de nas bzung / khong gis yul gyar pa'i 'tsho ba rol 'go brtsams shing rang gi pha yul tha'e rin dze la phyir log ma thub pa red/khong nyid lo ngo 20lhag la gzhan yul du 'khyams pa'i dus skabs nang / grong khyer mang po zhig tu phebs myong ba dang skyo sdug dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba skyel bzhin mthar thug lā wan nā ru tshe las 'das/ khong gis gsung don/dzirdo ma gyi gces pa'i nor bu tha'e rin dze'ishu dmangs kyis kho bo 'jam zhi bro skyid ldan pa'i pang nas phyir skyod btang rjes/ kho ni 'khyams po zhig dang mtshungs pa ma zad/than sprang po zhig dang 'dra bar gang sa gang du ldom nas/ mi gzhan par rang la drang bden min pa'i las bskal gyis gtses pa mi 'chad ga med byung / kho bo ni dngos gnas gdos bu med pa'i gru zhig dang 'dra bar/ skyo gdung gi dbul phongs las g.yug pa'i rlung bu'i nang / 'gram ngogs dang gru kha brgyud de 'pho nyul byas('di ni dngos gnas yid skyo ba'i gegs bar zhig yin la/ des khong nyid kyis mi tshe snying bo rtogs su bcug pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi rim pa so so'i mi sna ngos 'dzin pa'i tshad je zab tu btang pa ma zad/ da dung dbyi tha li dang tha na yo rob yongs rdzogs stobs shugs gsar rnying gi phan tshun 'gog rtsod khrod gnas 'dug pa gsal por shes su bcug khong gi sems kyi gting nas mes rgyal dang mi'i rigs kyi las bskal la thugs 'phral gnang gin 'dug rdan then la yi mug re chad kyi bsam pa ma skyes par/ khong rang mi ring ba'i ma 'ongs par dbyi tha li la zhi bde dang gcig gyur byed pa'i rlabs che ba'i gtso 'dzin zhig byung bar yid ches yod/ khong gis 'gro ba mi yis lo rgyus steng rlaXsdu ༵ ba'i phugs 'dun yod cing blo brtan 'gyur ba med pa'i dpa' bo

mig dper bzung nas/ snying rus hur skyed sgos 6 le lo dang byol mi nas 6 dka' ngal yod tshad khyad du bsad ’ de/ rang gi las bskal gsar skrun bya dgos gsungs/ mi tshul ring lugs kyi lta ba gzhir bzung nas/ rdan then rang nyid kyis khur ba'i lo rgyus kyi las 'gan ni/ dngos yod 'tsho ba ther 'don byas nas/ mi rnams la sad rtogs thob tu bcug nas/ dbyi tha li la chab srid dang kun spyod stong bskyar dar gyi lam zhig ston rgyu de red/ de'i phyir snyan ngag pa dan then ni phyir skyod btang ba'i lo de nas bzung / bla na medapa'i brtsams chos〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉zhes pa brtsam 'go tshugs shing khong nyid sku gshegs pa'i sngon tsam du da gzod yongs su grub/〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉ni rlabs che ba'i sgrig tshags dam pa'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom zhig yin/ snyan rtsom yongs la tshig rkang 14300yod cing〈dmyal ba'i yul〉dang〈dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong bsnyadang lha yul〉bcas skor gsum las grub/ skor gcig rer le'u 33yod cing gleng gzhi dang brtsis pa'i bsdoms pas le'u 100tag tag yod/(khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉gyi gtam rgyud brjod don ni 'char yan gyi rnam par bris yod/ snyan rtsom ring po de ru brjod pa gsham gsal yin te/ ldan then la nags tshal chen por lam nor thebs kyang rjes su nags mtha' ru thon/ glo bur du gzig dang seng ga stag gsum gyis khong gi 'gro lam bkag nyen gnas su lhung ba'i skabs der/ ro ma gyi snyan ngag pa we rje le'u si (2061103 7215143 5810 07)phebs pa dang / khong ni ldan then gyi chung ngu'i dus kyi dga' ma sge a sde le si yis mngag bcol ltar rnan then skyob tu yong ba dang / de nas rdan then dmyal ba'i yul dang dmyal ba'i yul du sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul la ltar mor khrid/ de'i 'phror bhe a sde le si yong nas rdan then khrid de lha yul du 'grim par song / rtsom pa pos 3//sa

khams mi 'dra ba gsum du 'char yan du ljongs rgyur song ba las/ dus rabs bar ma yongs kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang skabs de'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes mtshon zhing / skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa gsal por mtshon pa ma zad/ da dung dngos yod 'tsho bar skyon brjod gnang ba red/rdan then thog mar dmyal ba'i yul du 'grim pa dang / khong gi mig mdun du mngon pa ni/ mun pa nag cing 'jigs su rung la/ dmyal yul gyi sgo chen stong 2 khyod tsho nang du shog dang / re ba thams cad rgyab tu g.yug dang ’zhes bris yod/ sgo chen klad du dar cha zhig btsugs pa rlung chen po'i khrod g.yo bar 'dug dmyal ba ni rim pa dgu ru mngon la sa'i go la'i snying dkyil du brtal 'dug dmyal bar yod pa'i mi tshang ma nyes pa can tsho'i rnam shes red/ sdug nyes ji 'dra che na dmyal yul du lhung ba de 'dra zab cing / de dag gis rim tshad mi 'dra ba'i nyes chad myong bzhin yod/ rim pa dang po ru ye shu'isngon gyi gna' rabs chos lugs tha dad pa'i snyan ngag pa dang tshad nyid rig pa tsho yod cing / rim pa gnyis pa ru mi yul du yod dus 'dod par spyod spro ba'i mi rnams yod pas ser bas rdung deg myong bzhin yod/ rim pa gsum par mi yul du yod skabs nag chang dang rtsed 'jor g.yeng pa'i mi rnams yod pa kho tsho 'dam rdzam nang du char rlung gis mnar gcod byed bzhin 'dugarim pa bzhi pa'i nang sred zhen che zhing bag med longs spyod byed mkhan tsho yod/rim pa lnga par khong khro langs sla ba'i mi rnams yod pas phan tshun la rdung res dang so rgyag gin 'dug rim pa drug par me lce drag pos bsreg bzhin pa tsho ni log bshad byas nas mi sems slu ba'i chos log pa tsho red/ rim pa bdun par drag shugs spyod mkhan tsho yin la/ de'i nang mi ngan gdug rtsub can dang / rgyal po gtum po/ rang srog gcod mkhan sogs yod/ rim pa bsditā ༵ ni gang sa gang du smyo sdig 'obs mi yin la/ de la 'obs chen po bcu

yod par brnyas bcos gnya' gnon byed mkhan dang bshu gzhog byed mkhan/dge sems can gyi mi dmangs la nyes med nag 'gel byed mkhan/ spyi tshogs la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i mi ngan yod do cog de ru 'du la/ de'i nang da dung bud med la mgo bskor nas log g.yem byed mkhan dang / kha dga' ngo bstod byed mkhan/ dpon po'i go gnas dang chos kyi go sa nyo tshong byed mkhan/skar rtsis ded de ma 'ongs lung ston byed mkhan/ skyed lci'i bu lon gtong mkhan/ dpon ngan za rngam can/ zol po/ jag rkun/ ston 'dzugs zhu gtugs dang ma nyes kha g.yogs byed mkhan sogs 'du/ rim pa dgu ba'i nang mna' bza' dge bcom gyi blo log pa tsho bcug yod/ rtsom pa pos khong khro chen po'i ngang nyes spyod tshabs lci mo can gyi mi ngan la 'brab rdung tsha ngar canakhyas yod/ chos kyi gong ma nee kho ra sku rabs gsum pa dang skabs der gson por 'tsho ba'i chos kyi gong ma sban ne hpha khe sku rabs brgyad pa dmyal ba'i yul gyi rim pa brgyad par bcug yod cing / kho tshos dmyal ba'i nang khrims gcod thu mo myong bzhin 'dug rung / rdan then gyis de tshor/yokhyod tshor 'dodasred ham pa che drags pas/ /'jig rten 'di ru skyo sdug nang du lhung / /mi bzang rdog rdzis mi ngan yar la 'then/ /zhes gshe gshe btang /ldan then gyis mi de tshor smyo nyes khrims bcad pa ni drang bzhag cig red ’ zer/ 'di las snyan ngag pa des dpon ngan za rngam can dang chos kyi gong ma/lugs med btsun pa tshor sdang sems bzod thabs med pa skyes yod pa gsal por mtshon yod/2 dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong ba ni tshad rim bdun du bgos shing /rgya mtsho'i ngos su bud cing phyi 'gram du mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bye thang yos 01 ni

sdig nyes yang ba'i mi rnams kyis sdug bsngal myong sa yin la/ der yod rnam shes dag lha'i yul du 'pho thub mod/ 'on kyang dka' sdug du ma myong nas hur brtson 'bad thag byas tshe gzod yang rtser thon thub/ rdan then rim pa bdun pa'i steng gi 6 mi yul dga' tshal mi du slebs pa dang / glo bur du shar phyogs nas gzi 'od 'phros shing bkra shis kyi sprin bzang 'khrug cing mdzes sdug yid du 'ong pa'i a sde ri si bar khams nas 'phur 'ongs nas rdan then tsa lha yul ’ du 'grim par khrid/tsa lha yul ’ ni bde skyid pa tsho sdod pa'i gnas yul yin la khams dgu ru phye ste/ zla pa'i khams dang lhag pa'i khams/ pa sangs kyi khams/ nyi ma'i khams/ mig dmar gyi khams/ phur ba'i khams/— then pa'i khams/ brtan skar gyi khams/ chu shel gyi khams bcas yod/ bde skyid pa de tsho ni rang srog blos gtong bar mi skrag cing dpa' bar che la gzhung drang ba'i mi dang ye shu dang lha'i pho nya sogs yin/rdan then gyi(khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉du brjod pa'i khams gsum khrod snyan ngag pa'i brtse dung zab mo bsres 'dug rtsom pa pos khams gsum po'i ngo bo mi 'dra ba gzhir bzung nas/ khams gsum la ngang tshul dang tshos gzhi bkod yod de/ dmyal yul ni sdug bsngal dang re thag chad pa'i gnas khams yin pas de'i tshos gzhi 'od zhan zhing mun nag tu mngon/dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong sa ni zhi 'jags dang re ba'i gnas khams yin pas de'i tshos gzhi ni zhi zhing 'jam pa'i rnam par mngon/ lha yul ni yid sems spro ba'i gnas khams yin pas de'i tshos gzhi ni gzi 'od 'phro ba'i rnam par bkod/ 〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉khrod kyi ches gting zab pa dang ches skyon brjod kyi stobs shugs ldan sa ni/ snying stobs chen po'i sgo nas bsdo/ ༵ gral rim gyi sdug nyes che ba'i dbang bsgyur de ther 'don byas yod pa

de red/ dus rabs bar ma'i dus kyi ro ma gyi chos lugs srid gzhung dang chos tshogs ni mun nag stobs shugs kyi 'thus tshab red/ thun then la ye shu'i chos lugs kyi lha'i rig pa'i bsam blo yod kyang / khong gis skyon brjod kyi mdung rtse chos tshogs phyogs bskor phod pa de/ don dngos su skabs de'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol dang / chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i bsam blo dang gcig mthun yin pas/ mi dmangs mang tshogs dang grong khyer 'byor ldan gral rim gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa dang chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod la phan nus yod cing dus rabs kyi sngon thon 'dod mos la'ang mthun pa red/dbyi tha li'i yi ger bcoms pa'i〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉'di'i tshig sbyor mdzes shing brjod don gson nyams ldan la/ snyan zhing 'jebs la tshig shugs ldan pa zhig yin pas/ mi yi sems pa 'gug pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi stobs shugs ha cang che/ brtsams chos 'dis dbyi tha li mi rigs kyi skad cha gcig gyur du yong bar nus pa chen po bton pas/ rdan then ni mi rigs snyan ngag pa dang po yin/〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉ni dus rabs bar ma'i dus kyi rig rtsal bskyar dar dus skabs kyi ches rmad du byung ba'i dpe mtshon brtsams chos shig yin la/ dus rabs du ma'i ring la 'dzam gling yongs kyi mi dmangs kyis skad rigs mi 'dra ba du mas klog 'don byed kyin 'dug de ni rlabs che ba'i 'byor med gral rim gyi slob dpon mar khe sis klog par ches spro ba'i brtsams chos shig kyang yin/ mar khe sis phal cher nyin rer〈khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar〉thengs rer klog pas/ de'i nang gi ngo mtshar can gyi dum bu mang po blo ru 'don thub cing / nam rgyun khong nyid kyi gsung rtsom nang 'dren ༵ /da/

khong gi gsung rtsom(ma rtsa'i rnam bshad〉kyi sa bcad dang po'i par skrun thog ma'i gleng gzhi la khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos garasminang gi snyan tshig cig mjug rdzogs pa'i tshig tu bris yod pa gsham gsal/dzitshan rig skyon brjod kyi bsam 'char gang la'ang kho bos dga' bsu byed/ kho bosasnga sa nas gtan nas gzur bshol mi bya ba'i gleng phyogs kyi phyogs zhen zhes par/kho bos da dung rlabs che ba'i tha'e rin dze'i snyan ngag pa'i legs bshad de/ rang lam /sdoXgar song dang / mi rnams kyis ci zer shod du chug ces par brtsi sung bya rgyu 308 ca

le'o shār rdo rda wen khi dang 〈mnga' mjug gi dgong da〉zhes pa/dbyi tha li yi tha'i rin dze ni/ dus rabs bar ma'i dbyi tha li'i skad grags can gyi dpal 'byor lte gnas yin pa ma zad/ da dung sngon thon bsam blo ste mi tshul ring lugs kyi lte gnas kyang yin/ de ru dpe deb ji snyed nyar ba'i dpe mdzod khang yod cing / brjid nyams bstar du chags pa'i rtsig dngos kyang mang / rig gnas rig rtsal dang tshan rig las rigs kyi mtshan snyan grags can mang po de ru 'dus yod/ mi chen ming grags can du ma lhan cig tu 'dzoms pas dpa' nyams kyi gzi 'od phyogs bzhir 'phros/ pho'i rin dze ru ldan then lta bu'i snyan ngag pa chen po byung ba dang / lo ngo nyis brgya lhag gi rjes su slar yang 6 bsam gzhigs nus shugs dang spro sems/ gshis ga'i phyogs dang / yon tan kun 'dzoms/ shes rgya che ba'i phyogs kyi mi bo che mi (en ke si'i gsung)zhig gso skyong byas pa ni/ le'o nār rdo rda wen khi red/(26008760 68 7) za'itsha lha zo 1452— 1519lo)dus rabs 15pa'i dus mjug tu/ dbyi tha li yis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol dang chos tshogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod ni dza drag che sgang du thon zhing / rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi las 'gul yang shin tu dar ba'i dus skabs su slebs yod/ zing cha che ba'i dus skabs der rda wen khi ni tha'e rin dze'i nye 'dabs kyi wen khi grong rdal gyi zas gos 'dzoms pa'i 'byor 'bring gral rim gyi khyim tshang zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing khong gi yab ni khrimasdu /da

pa zhig yin/ rda wen khi chung ngu'i dus su —rgyun du grong sde'i phyi'i spang thang du song nas dzo ji rtsed mo rtse bas khong la rang byung khams kyi 'ang ma la /shugs rkyen zab mo thebs shing / des khong renganyid rjes su rlabs che ba'i ri mo ba zhig tu cide/lcu/zadi pazado ṭaXs pa cerngan po brtenan mthod/ khong ) skagi shul bzhag〈zin tho〉yi nang / lha rang byung / dizhes pa'i ri mo ba thams cad kyi ches mtho'i 1 5 ji lam khrid mkhan 'di bskyur te yul gzhan ( ( 9 7)zhig tu tshad gzhi dang mtshon dpe 'tshol ba'i mi rnams kyis ni sems shugs stong zad du le'o nār rdo rda wen khi/btang ba las med mi ces gsungs pa mthong thub/1466lor lo na 14la thon pa'i rda wen khi tha'e rin dze ru phebs pa dang mi tshul ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen thebs 'go bcoms/ khong nyid sgyu rtsal bzo grwa zhig tu zhugs nas/ bzo grwa de'i gtso 'gan 'khur mkhan ri mo ba ming grags can dang brko ris mkhas chen an sdi re wer ro chi o (sa 616 761700061 0 0774)dge rgan du brten nas ri mo sbyangs/wer ro chi o yis rang gi slob mar dngos yod ring lugs kyi ri mo 'bri ba'i rmang gzhi sbyong brdar byed du bcug khong gis rda we khi la sgru rtsal dang tshan rig dam sbrel byas nas tshan rig gi nges lugs brgyud sgyu rtsal de tshad gsar pa zhig tu mthor 'degs yong du 'jug dgos pa dang / khyad par sarda wen khi la dus rabs bar ma'i srol rgyun sgyu rtsal gyi tshad gzhi ste/ mi dang lhang gnyis bar dbye mtshams yod pas phan tshun 'brel thabs med ces pa lasade ba/rdo slob thub byas nas/ mi yul gyi mi tshe'i bde skyid dang rang byung khams

kyi brjid nyams la bstod bsngags byed dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang / wer ro chi o yis thog ma nyid nas na gzhon rda wen khi la gzab nan dang tshan rig gi rmang gzhi'i sbyong brdar byas shing / khong gis rda wen khi la gting zab cing rtogs dka' ba'i ri mo 'bri ba'i gzhung lugs ma khrid pa ma zad/ da dung rda wen khi la gzhan gyi ri mor lad mo yang byed du ma bcug par/ bya de'i sgo nga zhig bzhag ste nyin re bzhin sgo nga 'bri ru bcugadang thog rda wen khi yis spro nyams dang bro ba ldan pa'i sgo nas bya de'i sgo nga ri mor bris/ 'jam zhing zlum pa'i bya sgong la ngo mtshar shin tu che bas/ rda wen khi bya sgong ri mor phab par shin tu dga' bas ri mo gcig bris tshar bas na dge rgan la dag bcos byed du 'jug nyin gcig nyin gnyis 'gor pa dang / de nas gza' 'khor gcig nas gnyis byas phyin yang / dge rgan gyis da dung sngar bzhin du bya sgong 'bri ru bcug pas/ rda wen khi la sun snang skyes te 6 dngos po gzhan pa zhig bris pas mi chog gam/ nam yin yang bya sgong kho na bris pas ci byed/ ri mo gang legs shig bris kyang dgos mkho ci yod ’zer nas sems mug nas 'dug pas/ khong gis bris pa'i bya sgong yang de 'dra yag po ma yin par tha na nyag nyog tsam bris nas dge rgan la sprad pa red/dge rgan gyis gzab na sgos rda wen khi la 8 khyod kyis nan tan ngang ri mo mi 'bri ba ci yin/ bya sgong chung chung 'di ni las sla mo zhig ma yin te/ bya sgong 1000gcig nang bya sgong gnyis gcig 'dra yin pa gtan nas med/ bya sgong gcigakho na yin rung phyogs mi 'dra sa nas bltas tshe de'i dbyibs la 'gyur ldog yod/ shog gu'i steng bya sgong ji ma ji bzhin mtshon rgyu la hur sbyong ma byas pas ga la chog yang dang bskyar du bya sgong ri mor 'bri ba brgyud de mig dang lag pa gcig thog tu 'ongs pa'i tshe/ rjes su dngos po gang zhig bris kyang gang la ci 'os kyi kha gtad 'jal thub nges yin/ bya sgong 'bri bar 3rdosang

chung bya ga la rung zhes bslab bya gnang / dge gon gyi gsung gas rda wen khi la sad rtogs zab po thob pas/ dus de nas bzung khong gis dka' spyad brtson sbyong sgos ri mo 'bri ba'i lag rtsal byang chub pa zhig sbyangs/rda wen khi ni dge rgan wer ro chi o la lo ngo 11ring brten zhing /1477lor sgyu rtsal bzo grwa de dang bral nas spyi tshogs steng 'gro 'go tshugs shing /kher rkyang du sgyu rtsal gyi byed sgor zhugs pas mi tshul ring lugs kyi sgyur rtsal pa dang mkhas pa mang po ngo shes/ khong gis pho'o rin dze dang smi lan (51 /thab skomo)gnyis su ri mo mang po brtsams/ ri mo yag po zhig 'bri ba'i phyir khong gis nam yang rang byung khams la lta dpyad dang rtog zhib gnang / srog chags kyi 'gul skyod dang 'dab chags kyi 'phur tshul bcas kyis khong gi sems pa gting nas bkug mi'i lus phung gi bsdur tshad dang sgrig gzhi gtan la phab ched/ khong gis chos lugs kyi bkag khrims la ma 'dzem par gshag dpyad rig par zhib 'jug gnang ste/ sku ngo mas mi ro 30lhag gshag las byas/dus yun ring po'i sgyu rtsal lag len khrod/ rda wen khi yis mi tshul ring lugs pa byas nas ngo mtshar che ba'i smyu gu spyad de/ tshan rig gi nges lugs ltar du ri mo'i nang gi mi sna mtshon du bcug khyad par du mi sna de dag la gshis ka gnang zhing / tshugs ka dang rnam 'gyur las de tsho'i sems nang gi dran tshul mtshon yod/ de bzhin du khong gi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom de legs 'dzoms skyon bral gyi tshad cig tu slebs 'dug khong gi phyag bris gnang ba'i ri mo mang po zhig ye shu'i ma yum yin mod/ sngar gzhan gyis bris pa'i 'phags ma nang bzhin 'khyag shur shur dang 'jigs snang ster ba'i gzugs sku la ma 'dra bar/byams sems che zhing mchog gyur gyi dgongs pa yod pa'i skyes ma zhig tu bzhengs pas mdzes sdug yid du 'ongs pa zhig tu mngon/ khong gis mtha' masta/ 2gi dgong ja〉(1495 — 1497lo) dang 'dzam gling yongs su grags

pa'i 'dra par bris ma(mon nā li gsa'〉(1503 — 1506lo) phyag bris gnang zhing / rjes ma des sgyu rtsal gyi khyab khongs su lha gtso snying byas nas chos lugs kyi brjod bya 'bri dgos pa'i rnam pa bsgyur nas/ mi gtso snying du 'dzin dgos pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi lta ba bton/ ri mo'i ngos kyi mon nā li gsa' yis 'dzum dmul ngoms pa'i rnam 'gyur rang bzhin du mngon zhing / mi rnams la dngos yod ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes snang zhig ster ba red/rda wen khi'i mtshan snyan grags che ru rgyas te dbyi tha li dang yo rob yongs kyisnar rtsal gyi mkhas dbang chen por gyur/ yin na'ang / dbyi tha li'i chos skyongagazhung dang sku drag spyi tshogs kyis spro po byed pa'i brjid nyams ldan zhing mdzes rgyan rab tu spras pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos de rda wen khi dang gtan nas mthun po ma yong pas/ chos skyong gzhung gis rda wen khi'i tshan rig tshod lta ni 6 sgyur 'phrul mi red ces dma' 'beb byas/ 1517lor rda wen khi dbyi tha li dang bral nas hpha ran si'i gong ma'i gdan drangs pa bzhin hpha ran si la phebs nas khu ru bho ru ri mo gsar bzheng byas/ de dus lo na rgas pa'i rda wen khi la snyun gzhi dang dbul phongs gnyis rtseg tu 'khel nas/ spyi lo 1519lo'i zlaḥpa'i tshes 2nyi// gzhan yul du 'grul ba'i tshul du grogs med khor rkyang du las hūṃ /sna khi'i// shul bzhag brtsams chos mang po med kyang yod pa thams cad kun legs skyon bral gyi tshul du mngon/ de'i nang〈mthar mjug gi dgong ja〉ni kun gyis khas len pa'i rig rtsal bskyar dar dus kyi ri mo'i nang gi yang rtser son pa'i brtsams chos shig yin/ri mo de'i brjod bya mi rnams la gsal cha che ba'i dam pa'i chos dpe las byung ba gsham ltar yin/ye shu la slob bu 12yod cing de'i nang ming la yi'u rda (snyi ri si'i ༵ spya ru

/// byu kyi zla sa /ji sgyujiming grags can gyi ri mo(mthar mjug gi dgong ja 〉zhes pa/1 6 1 6 7〉 zhesa'abre sgyurabapos) zhes pas mashu'i00 83 3 8710 65 ——— chos lugs je mi rigs kyi dbul po'i khrod du khyab gdal du 'gro bar ngo rgol /ji/ spyo riste rdo tsho ga/sre/ /je( //// :re//rdos 1ཿthod pa' ma' da 'a na las khungs la ga zhu byas nas rang ba da na g.yo 'tshong byas/ ye shu yis don de mkhyen rjes thugs skyo gdung gis khengs te/slob bu 12dang mnyam du mthar mjug gi dgung ja gsol nas/ khong slob bu tshor zhal gyes mdzad pa dang da dung 6 khyed tsho'i nang gi mi gcig gis bdag g.yo 'tshong byas song ’ zhes gsungs la/ phyi nyin ro ma'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis ye shu 'dzin bzung byas nas srog khrims bcad/dus rabs bar ma nas bzung / gtam rgyud 'di sgyu rtsal pa tshos ri mo'i steng thengs du mar bkod cing / khyad par du kha si tha yo (1390— 1437lo)yis bris pa'i ri mo〈mthar mjug gi dgong ja〉la hru'e rin dze ru ming grags shin tu che/ yin na'ang sgyu rtsal pa de dag gis bris pa'i ri mo mang che ba'i nang ye shu dang slob bu tsho gor gor du bzhugs tshogs gnang ba'am yang na ye shu slob bu tsho'i mdun du bzhugs yod pas/ slob bu 12nang khyad par du yi'u 314

rda'i sems khong gi dran pa don dang mthun pa zhig mtshon thub med pa red/1495lor rda wen khi yis smi lan gyi san rma ri ya ye shu'i dge sgrub khang gi mngags bcol ltar/ ye shu'i dge sgrub khang de'i zas gsol khang du ldebs ris chen mo(mthar mjug gi dgong ja〉'bri bzheng gnang ba'i skabs su/khong gi las 'gan la dka' ngal shin tu che bas nges par du thabs shes byings dang mi mthun pa zhig btsal nas sngon byon pa tsho las lhag pa'i ri mo sheg 'bri bzheng gnang dgos pa byung / lo gnyis tsam gyi gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi las ka bsgrubs rjes/ da gzod 1497lor bla na med pa'i ri mo'i btsams chos 'di mi rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsi ru thon/ de ni sngar med kyi rmad byung ri mo'i brtsams chos shig yin pas/ mi sems gting las sgul thub pa'i nus shugs ldan la/ mi'i rigs yar thon la phyogs pa'i skul spel gyi stobs shugs chen po yod/ mdzes dang mi mdzes pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba bcas drag tu dpyad bsdur byas nas/ rda wen khi yis drang bden dang 'od zer la bstod bsngags gnang zhing ngo tsha khrel med kyi blo log pa la snying rje med par ther 'don mdzad yod/ldebs ris 'di'i ring tshad la smi 8 8yod cing mtho tshad la smi 4 6yod/thog mar mi rnams kyi mig sngar shar pa ni dkyil du bzhugs pa ye shu yin zhing khong ni bar gyi sge'u khung las 'phros pa'i nub kha'i nyi ma'i 'od zer 'og tu kun las gsal zhing / khong gis tshe srog mjug sgril rgyu mkhyen yod cing rnam 'gyur zhi zhing dul la/ zhal gsal gting gsal du mig mdangs mar phyogs su 'phangs nas bzhugs te/ thugs rnal du phab te mi rnams ha las su 'jug pa'i skad cha de 4 khyod tsho'i nang gi mi gcig gis bdag g.yo 'tshong byas song ’ zhes gsungs pa red/skad cha des g.ya' dwangs nam mkhar glo bur 'brug sgra sgrog pa zlohā ba

zhig tu gyur pas/ slob bu bcu gnyis por 'jigs yer ba zhig tu btang /6 su red/’ slob bu tshor 'phral mar lan 'debs par brel ba 'gog thabs med pa zhig skyes/ ri mo'i brtsams chos des ye shu'i slob bu tsho'i lo tshod dang /las ka/ gshis rgyud mi 'dra ba gzhir bzung nas mi re res ye shu yi gsung skad thos rjes mngon pa'i rnyog 'dzing che ba'i sems khams kyi 'char snang de gsal por mtshon yod/ri mo'i steng du slob bu bcu gnyis ni g.yas phyogs nas g.yon phyogs su tshan pa bzhi ru bkar cing tshan re rer mi gsum re yod/ tshan re re'i bar phar brkyangs pa'i dpung ba'am yang na lus phung yo ba las sbrel nas 'gyur ldog khrod du gcig gyur yong thabs byas 'dug ldebs ris de g.yas sne nas bzung tshan dang po'i nang lo na gos shing klad pa seng ba'i si mon gyis lag pa'i spar mo yar bskor nas phyogs gnyis su phye nas smra ra can gyi rda the la 6 da 'di ci yin ’ zhes 'dri pa dang 'dra la/ rda the yis nyan zhor dang lag pa g.yas pa yar bkyags nas mu don ngan de su yis las ’ zhes shod bzhin yod par mtshungs shing / mar khe spro thung langs pa dang yar langs nas si men phyogs su yo nas lag pa gnyis ye shu'i phyogs su brkyangs nas smyo slob dpon g.yo 'tshong byed mkhan zhig ngo ma yod dam zhes 'dri bzhin pa 'dra'o//ldebs ris de'i tshan pa gnyis pa'i nang lo na gzhon pa'i hphe li phe yisalag pa gnyis brang khar sbyar nas lhag bsam rnam dag ngang rang gi slob dpon la 6 bdag gis de lta bu mi byed kho thag yin zhes gsal bshad byed bzhin pa dang / yā ke che bas dpung ba gnyis brkyangs nas cog tse'i steng sdang mig 'phen bzhin 'dug cing bsam bzhin ma yin par phor ba 'gyel du bcugakho'i rgyab phyogs su yod pa'i rdo rma yis ye shu phyogs mdzub mo zhig bsgrengs nas 6 slordzu spyapon lags/ mi ngan de lta bu zhig dngos gnas yod dam mi zhes 'dri

bzhin yod pa dang shin tu mtshungs/ ye shu'i g.yon phyogs kyi tshan gsum pa'i nang / gshes ka 'jam pa'i 'jon dang spyod pa gtum po can gyi phe sdi gnyis las tha dad kyi gshes rgyud gnyis gsal por mtshon zhing / 'jon gyis mgo bo phe sdi phyogs yo nas skad cha nyan bzhin yod cing kho'i mdzub mo bcu phan tshun bsnol nas sgrog tse'i stong bzhag cing mig gnyis kyis mar phyogs su bltas nas ru de ni su yin nam zhes bsam gzhig gtong gin yod par 'dra/ phe sdi'i g.yon lag ni shugs stobs ldan pa'i ngang 'jon gyi phrag par bzhag cing nang du gug pa'i g.yas lag gis zas gri zhig dam du bzung yod pas/ dpa' ngar che zhing rtul phod ldan pas blo log pa dang 'thab dgos snyam bzhin pa 'dra bas/ kho'i ngan par dgra ltar sdang pa'i gshis ka mtshon yod/ phe sdi'i mdun ngos su blo log pa yi'u rda yod cing de'i gzugs dbyibs btsog cing rtsing bor mngon la/ ri mo'i ngos kyi mi bcu gsum nang e'u rda'i ngo ni mun nag nang yib yod pas de'i g.yo sgyu dang tha shal gyi gshis ka lhag par 'bur du mngon yod/ ye shu'i yi skad cha des kho la dngangs skrag bskul pas ci bya 'di bya med par lus po phyir dgye nas/ lag pa g.yon pas mthe bong dang gong mdzub so sor phye ba las kho'i sems gting nas sos mi bde bar gyur pa mtshon zhing /lag pa g.yas pas rang dbang med par rang gi slob dpon g.yo 'tshong byas par thob pa'i gser sgor de dam du bsdams yod/ blo log pa des khe mthong sduden skyur byas pa'i ngo tsha med pa'i kha ngo la sdang sems mi skye ba'i mi su zhig da/ ldebs ris kyi g.yon phyogs kyi ches mtha' ma'i tshan pa'i nang / lo na rgas shing byams sems che ba'i an sdi re yod cing khong ha las nas lag pa gnyis yar la bsgrengs te 6 ci 'dri'i ngo tsha med mkhan ang mi zer bzhin du yā ke chung ba la sems gso byed zhor dang phyogs gcig nas lag pa g.yon ༵ snan

sdi re'i rgyab tu bsrings nas skyor te/ an sdi re yi gshis ka gtum po 'phar nas zing cha yong bar 'gog gin 'dug pa dang 'dra/ ldebs ris kyi ches g.yon phyogs su yod pa ni gzugs phung che zhing thang po yin pa'i rma the yin la/kho yar langs nas lag pa gnyis kyis sgrog tser gtad de lus po sngon phyogs su cung bsgur nas don rkyen 'di ma gzhi ci 'dra zhig yin par do snang bya bzhin 'dug mtha' mjug gi dgong nga〉yi nang du/ mi sna so so'i gshis ka dang dmigs bsal can gyi bsam blo'i brtse dung ni/ zlos gar gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i skad cig tsam gyi skabs de gsal zhing dod pa zhig mtshon yod pas/dngos gnas mi rnams kyi sems pa dbang med du 'phrog 'gro pa ma zad bsam gzhigs kyang yang yang dgos pa'i 'char snang ster ba red/rda wen khi yis grub 'bras 'di lta bu zhig blangs te/ ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rlabs che ba'i ri mo'i brtsams chos shig gsar rtsom byed thub pa 'di ni las sla mo gtan nas ma yin par/ de ni khong gis dka' sdug du ma myangs pa dang ngal rtsol ji snyed byas pa'i mjug 'bras yin/ khong la 'phrad pa'i dka' khag ches chen po ni blo log pa yi'u rda'i btsog po'i gzugs brnyan ji ltar bzhengs 'bri gnang rgyu de red/ rda wen khi yis ri mo ma bris gong yang dang bskyar du gnad don rab dang rim par bsam blo btang ba dang /yi'u rda'i btsog gzugs brgya phrag du ma bris / khong tha na smi lan gyi zing cha che ba'i grong khyer dkyil du phebs nas rgyal skugs mkhan dang tha shal pa/ mi ngan g.yo zol can tsho'i khrod du song nas yi'u rda'i gzugs brnyan 'tshol sdud byas myangs/ san rma ri ya dge sgrub khang gi 'go gtso yis rda wen khis dus ring po zhig tu las 'gan mi sgrub par srang lam che chung mang por nyul ba mthong nas yi ༵ stung par smi lan tā gung gi mdun du rda wen khi'i spyod pa mi gtsang pa dang

rang 'khri'i las 'gan snang med du bzhag 'dug ces zhu gtug byas/ dge sgrub khang 'go gtso des rda wen khi yis ri mo gsar rtsom la snying rus chen po'i ngang blo bkod rgyag bzhin pa dang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan 'tshol bar 'dug pa gang nas shes/ stabs legs pa zhig la smi lan tā gung gis rda wen khi yis ci byehā shes yod pas khong la rgyab skyor byas thog da gzod brtsams chos 'di grub pa dari/ mo 'bri ba las gzhan rda wen khi'i mi tshe gang bo'i nang phyogs mang po nas grub 'bras du ma blangs/ rang byung tshan rig sna tshogs te dper na rtsis rig dang gshag bcos rig pa/ ar las rig pa/ 'od rig pa/ shugs rig pa/ sa gshis rig pa sogs la khong gis zhib 'jug gnang ba ma zad/da dung gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi mdzad rjes gnang / shugs rig pa'i phyogs su khong gis tshad brgal shugs kyi nges srol bton/ gnam dpyad rig pa'i phyogs su khong gis snga sa nas sa'i go la lte bar smra ba dam dgag byas/ sa dpyad rig pa'i phyogs su khong gis sa'i go la'i tshangs thig la dbyin le 7000tsam yod pa rtsis brgyab/ khong gis gsar gtod byas pa yang shin tu mang bas/ rda wen khi ni rig rtsal gsar dar dus skabs kyi mkhas pa chen po snro/ byi/ ṅgi dang mi'i rigs kyi blo gros phyogs kyi mtshon byed cig yin pa smos 319

6 dus rabs kyi bla srog mi ste hre khe si ge'ar/dbyin ji'i dbus khul gyi si thi ra spror ḍi (5 181016 — 0ba me 0bamoṣṭhaṣṭharsā)grong rdal gyi hen re sum lam gyi 'gram du so phag dang shing gi sgrig gzhi can gyi khang pa nyis rtseg cig yod par nag chil chil gyi ka ba dang gdung ma yod cing / gyang thams cad dkar por mngon zhing sge'u khung gi gze dbyibs shel la rgyan par nyi 'od 'tsher 'tsher du 'phro bzhin 'dug pa des mi rnams kyi mig dbang bkug thog khang de'i rgyab phyogs su zhi dal khal 'jam gyi skyed tshal zhig yod par/ rgya se me tog btab par rlung bus en tsam skyod par dri zhim bad ni phyogs kun tu khyab kyin 'dug 1564lo'i zla 4tshes 23nyin dbyin ji'i rig rtsal gsar dar skabs kyi ches rlabs che ba'i snyan ngag pa dang zlos gar 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan we lem hre khe si phe'ar/(yo1 smo18ku5687639616 tsho ṣṭha 6khusgro) thog khang 'di'i nang sku 'khrungs/hrekho si phe'ar 'tsho ba'i dus skabs ni/ dbyin ji'i spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba'i dus skabs shig yin te/ dus rabs 16pa nas bzung / dbyin ji'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lag shes bzo khang drag tu 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / phyi yul du mi ser spel nas khongs rgya skyed 'go bcoms shing / sa zhing bcad bzung gi 'gul skyod 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin du mchis zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs dang dpal 'byor 'thor bzhin yod/ dus mtshungs su/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi stobs shugs kyi sge ༵༵da rul sungs dang / gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi sred rngam

dang sger sems bcas kyis mi dmangs la gnod 'tshe chen po btang bas/de dag dang mi dmangs mang tshogs bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag can du gyur/dus skabs der rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi 'gul skyod kyi 'byung gnas te/ dbyi tha li ni nyams rgud du 'gro 'go tshugs/ yin na'ang dbyin ji'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas chen po byang ba hre khe si phe'ar/dang rgyal khab gcigashe gyur yin pas/ 'byor ldan gral rim dar rgyas bya yul gyi khongs rgya chen po zhig btod cing / rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi rba rlabs mthon por yong ba dang zu mi chos ring lugs mi kyi bsam blo rgya chen por khyab gdal du 'gro bar skul spel byas yod/ mi chos ring lugs ni 'byor ldan gral rim kyi bsam blo'i ma lag cig yin la/ mi chos ring lugs pa'i phugs 'dun ni/phyogs yongs nas phul du byung zhing lus po dang bsam blo'i ngo bo'i steng shin tu legs pa'i mi skyed sring bya dgos pa de red/ mi chos ring lugs kyi rtsom rig la de las drag skyod kyi bsam blo ldan par/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed dgos pa ma zad/ da dung ma rtsa ring lugs la'ang skyon brjod byas nas/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs la brtse dung zab mo bcangs yod/ rde ༵ si

phe'ar ni dbyin ji'i rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs kyi mi chos ring lugs kyi rtsom zlog /ra rgyas su 'gro ba'i skabs kyi rmad du byung ba'i mtshon byed mi sna zhig na si// thi ra spror ḍi ni mi 'bor nyis khri tsam las med pa'i grong rdal zhig yin/ hre khe si phe'ar gyi a pha ni yi ge mang po mi shes pa'i lag shubs kyi tshong pa zhig yin la/ zhor du phyugs las gnyer ba dang grong rdal gyi grong dpon yang byed myangs/ hre khe si phe'ar gyi a ma ni zhing pa zhig gi bu mo yin/ hre khe si phe'ar slob grwa chen por 'gro ma myangs par grong rdal de'i khrims khang du khrims lugs kyi shes bya nyung shas sbyong myangs pa dang / brda sprod slob grwa ru la then gyi yi ge dang rtsom rig snyan ngag gi shes bya tsam sbyong myangs kyang / rjes su a pha'i ma rtsa dib pas slob grwa las phyir mi 'bud ga med byung / lo na 18la thon dus khyim mtshes kyi zhing pa'i bu mo an mun he si we dang gnyen sgrig byas shing / bu mo de hre khe si phe'ar las lo brgyad kyis che la rjes su kho mor bu phug gsum btsas/ hre khe si phe'ar pho lo 20thon dus sku drag cig gis gsos pa'i shwa ba la rgyag nyes shor te rmas su bcug pas rgyal sa lun ton du bros pa dang /yul de ru khong gis rim pa so so'i mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba rgyus lon byas pa dang /spyi tshogs la byung ba'i shes rtogs kyang rim bzhin je zab tu song / dang thog khong gis kha gso thabs bya ched 66'dzam gling zlos gar khang mi du g.yog las brgyab nas zlos gar la lta mkhan tsho'i zhon rta la bdag gnyer byas/ 1590lo yas mas su zlos gar tshogs par zhugs nas 'khrab mkhan gyi brjod gtam 'dzin mkhan dang dpung bu chung 'khrab pa byas kyang / rjes su 'khrab ston pa dngos ma dang zlos gar khang gi ma rkang can du gyur/ 1591lor/ hre khe si phe'ar gyis mi gzhan du 'brel nas 'khrab gzhung bcos sgrig byas/ cung ma 'di/ snar rang gis 'khrab gzhung bcoms pa dang zhor du snyan tshig kyang bris/

khong gi 'khrab gzhung gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'khrab ston byas pas/ khong gi mtshan snyan grags kyang lun ton yongs su khyab/ hre khe si phe'ar gyis zlos gar khang de ru lo ngo 5la bya ba bsgrubs rjes/ 1613lor pha yul si thi ra sgor ḍi ru log cing / 1616lor dgung lo 5 2stong tag tag rang gi skyes skar nyin rang khyim du tshe las 'das/ lo bdun gyi rjes su khong gi grogs pos hre khe si phe'ar gyis btsams pa'i 'khrab gzhung phyogs bsdus byas nas dpar skrun byas/ de nas bzung mi sems dbang med du 'phrog pa'i bcoms chos de dag 'dzam gling yongs su khyab te 'khrab ston byas shing mi rnams kyi khong la 4 dus rabs kyi bla srog ces 'bod do//hre khe si phe'ar gyi mi tshe gang por 'khrab gzhung 37btsams pas/ dbyin ji'i rig rtsal bskyar dar dus skabs de yang rtser son par bskul/ khong gi zlos gar 'khrab gzhung gsar rtsom gnang ba'i dus skabs ni dus gsum du bgo chog ste/ thog ma'i dus skabs (1590 — 1600lo) su gtso bo lo rgyus zlos gar dang dgod spro'i zlos gar bcoms te/ rang gshes bcings 'grol byed dgos pa'i bsam blo dar spel byas pas/ skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar zhing nyams dga' bag yangs kyi bsam blo mtshon yod/ dus skabs gnyis par (1601 — 1608lo) gtso bo skyo ba'i zlos gar bcoms te/ dus rabs kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs mtshon phyir/ spyi tshogs 'thab rtsod bris nas bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba'i rtsa don ni nges par rgyal kha lon par spobs sems yod dgos pa yin pa mtshon zhing / dus skabs de ni khong gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi yang rtse yin/ dus skabs gsum pa'i dus (1609 — 1612lo)su khong gis gtso bo lha sgrung zlos gar brtsams/ brtsams chos la ngo mtshar 'char yan gyi khyad chos ldan la/ brjod bya mang che ba gu yangs gtong ba yin pas/ khong gi 'dun pa u tho phi a (pu 091 7 6677)yi rnam pa'i phugs re'i rgyal khams ༵༵ ma

'ongs pa'i na gzhon tshor bcol yod pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi mdun lam dang mi chos ring lugs mngon du 'gyur bar yid ches bcangs yod/ hre khe si phe'ar gyi mtshon byed bcoms chos shin tu mang zhing / lo rgyus kyi zlos gar la〈lhan re sku rabs drug pa〉(stod cha bar cha smad cha gsum) 〈char le si sku rabs gsum pa〉 〈gong ma 'jon〉 〈char le si skur rabs gnyis pa〉 〈lhan re sku rabs bzhi ba〉 〈hen re sku rabs lnga bsnyadang / dgod bro ba'i zlos gar la we ne rdze a'i tshong pa〉 〈don med rtsod slong〉 khyod bzang nga dga'〉〈mtshan mo bcu gnyis〉dang / skyo ba'i zlos gar la(hom ri tho〉dang o se ra〉〈li ar wang〉 〈the khe phe sa〉sogs yod/lo rgyus kyi zlos gar ni dbyin ji'i lo ngo gnyis brgya nas sum brgya ring gi lo rgyus brjod byar bzung / hre si khe phelar gyis lo rgyus la lta zhib nan tan byas na ma 'ongs pa legs por ston thub par dgongs/ khong gis lo rgyus kyi zlos gar gsar rtsom byed pa'i dus skabs ni/ phu e li gzi sgye'i skal ba bzang po zhes pa'i dus yin pas/ dbyin ji ni rang gi do zla gtso bo se phan las rgyal stabs/ rgya mtsho'i steng gi btsan dbang can du gyur pa dang / rgyal nang du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sku drag gi shul lhag stobs shugs la mu mthun du rdung ga btang ste/ gsar dar sku drag dang 'byor ldan gral rim dang sger gcod rgyal dbang bar gyi 'gal ba da dung dza drag can du 'gyur med pas spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba ni cung zad zhi 'jags su gnas/ de'i dbang gis hre khe si phe'ar gyi zlos gar nang spro snang ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i khengs la/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi tshul ring lugs mngon du 'gyur bar sems gting nas yid ches byas yod/ lo rgyus kyi zlos gar khrod/ khong gis yang dang bskyar du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sger gcod dang bcad bzung la dgag pa brgyab nadī/24rje bo blo rgya can gyi bsam blo dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi rigs la

rgya dang rgyal gces ring lugs dril bsgrags byas/ dper na/ mtshon byed kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi zlos gar nyen rus sku rabs bzhi ba〉zhes pa'i nang / rul sungs kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs 'og tu kun spyod legs bcos byas pa brgyud yid smon rje bo 'byung thub pa dang / mi 'khyam po zhig kyang 6 mkhas mdzangs ldan la byams sems yod pa'i mi rgyal po zhig tu 'ongs thub pa 'ud sgrog byas yod/hres si phe'ar gyi dgod bro'i zlos gar gyi rmang gzhi'i brjod don ni pho mo'i brtse dung dang gnyen don/ mdza' brtse sogs yin zhing / brjod don de dag gis gtso bo spyi tshogs dngos don la zur za byas pa ma yin par/ mi tshul ring lugs pa'i phugs 'dun mtshon pa dang / 'tsho bar dga' spro dang bde skyid thob par bstod bsngags byas te/ 'byor ldan gral rim ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs kyi kun spyod dang phyogs zhen las rnam par rgyal pa mtshon 'dug cing / zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung de dag las da dung 'char yan ring lugs kyi brtse dung yang mtshon yod pa red/(we ne dze a'i tshong pa〉zhes pa'i brjod don gtso bo ni/ sger sems med pa'i mdza' brtse dang / lhag bsam rnam dag gi pho mo'i brtse dung dang ham sems/ phrag dog sha 'khon/ gdug rtsub bar gyi 'gal ba red/dgod bro ba'i zlos gar de'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo ni we nee dze a'i tshong pa an thon nee o yin la/ tshong pa des grogs po sba sa nee o yi gnyen don 'grub pa'i ched du/ skyed lci'i bu lon 'jog mkhan sha lo thi la sgor mo bskyis/ sha lo thi la phrag dog che bas skyed khe mi dgos khul byas rung / dus tshod ltar du dngul phyir sprod ma thub na/ yan thon nee o'i lus phung steng nas sha phon ḍigrigang ༷ phon ḍi gcig spyi80454yin sgyur paponas/ 325

dras nas skyin tshab sprod dgos pa'i kha dan 'jog tu bcug sba sa nee o'i gnyen gan can gyi mdza' mo khrims rtsod par brdzus nas khrims sar phyin te/sha lo thi la an thon ne no yi lus phung las sha dras chog mod kha dan ji bzhin sha'i lci tshad la yang lci ci yang 'chor mi chog pa dang / khrag 'dzar mi chog la an thon ne o yi tshe srog la gnod pa gtong mi chog ces rtsod bsher dag 'bul byas pas sha lo thi gyod kyi gtug bsher las pham song pa red/(khyod bzang nga dga'〉zhes pa ni mtshon byed rang bzhin gyi dgod bro ba'i zlos gar zhig yin/ zlos gar de las/ bcos ma min pa'i pho mo'i brtse dung dang / grogs po'i bar gyi lhad med mdza' brtse/ rang srog blos gtong thub pa'i snying stobs dang phan tshun sems khur byed pa'i bsam blo la bstod bsngags byas la/ mdza' brtse rdzun ma dang pho mo'i brtse dung bcos ma/ rang khe rang phan/ gzhan la mi dga' ba'i spyod ngan la skyon brjod byas yod/zlos gar khrod du/ hre si phe phe'ar gyis phugs re'i rgyal khams shig dang ngo mtshar che ba'i kun spyod kyi stobs shugs ldan pa'i rang byung khams shig gsar bzhengs gnang yod/dgod bro'i zlos gar khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo mang che ba ni/ gshes bzang gzhung drang dang dpa' ngar ldan pa'i gzhon nu dang / yang na gshis 'jam blo brtan/ dwangs gtsang gi brtse dung ched du sa g.yo gnam g.yo'i las don zhig bsgrubs pa'i yid 'ong gzhon nu ma tsho yin/ zlos gar khrod du dgod bro zhing blo rig grung la kha mkhas pa'i dgod slong mi sna'i 'khrab ston bar bcug tu bcug yod pas/ lta mkhan rnams la bag phebs sems skyid dang spro ba 'phel pa'i snang ba ster thub/hre khe si phe'ar gyi gal 'gangs che shos dang nang don gting zab shos rla sdu ༵ shos kyi brtsams chos ni khong gi skyo ba'i zlos gar red/ zlos gar de

dag ni dus rabs 17pa'i ches thog ma'i lo 'ga' shas nang yongs su grub/skabs der dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan gral rim dang rgyal dbang bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag can du gyur yod/ khyad par du 1603lor sgram se sku rabs dang pos (/7703 1 cha)rgyal po'i go sa bzung rjes/ de la dbang cha shin tu chen po yod stabs khrims lugs dang rgyal tshogs la mthong chung byas pas/'byor ldan gral rim dang rgyal dbang bar gyi 'gal ba mngon gsal du thon/'byor ldan gral rim gyis ngal rtsol mi dmangs la gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog byas pa yang nyin re las nyin rer je drag tu song / spyi tshogs la zing cha byung bas rlung kha'i mar me lta bur gyur pas/ mi tshul ring lugs kyi blo rgya dang kha thag je ring je ring du song / hre khe si phe'ar gyis 6 kun spyod stobs shugs la brten pa tsam gyis spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba thag gcod mi thub par shes rtogs zab po byung bas skyo snang ring lugs kyi dra ba'i nang du tshud/ hre khe si phe'ar gyi bcoms chos de dag gis dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i sngon gyi spyi tshogs kyi dngos don dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi chos ring lugs pa'i skyo snang gsal por mtshon yod/ skyo snang can gyi mi sna la rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi phugs 'dun bcol ba dang mi sna de tshor kun spyod steng snying stobs chen po gnang yod/ mi sna gtso bo de dag mthar mjug mun pa'i stobs shugs kyis sdir mid btang rung / spyod lugs phyogs nas cis kyang rgyal kha blangs yod pa da/ 1601lor gsar rtsom gnang ba'i〈he sme le thinyini gal ches che shos kyi skyo ba'i zlos gar zhig red/ de'i brjod bya gtso bo'i ma rgyu'i yong khungs ni dus rabs 12pa'i dus mjug gi ten mag (7007276 77)gi lo rgyus yin/zlos gar de'i nang / ten mag gi rgyal sras he sme le thi ni 'jar man gyi mi chos ring lugs kyi lte gnas we then pho slob grwa chen mo ru slob sbyong la phebs/32/nga

gi a khu khe lo sdi si yis skabs de dang bstun nas ha sme le thi'i pha la dug drangs nas lkog gsod byas rjes rgyal po'i go sa g.yo 'phrog byas pa ma zad/ gcen po'i btsun mo rang gis chung mar blangs/ he sme le thi phyir rgyal nang du log rjes pha'i rnam shes kyis rang gi tshe srog shor tshul gsal por smras pas he sme le thi yis dgra sha len rgyur sems thag bcad/ khe lo sdi si yis dang thog he sme le thi la dogs pa skyes te blon chen spo lu nye si'i bu mo ste he sme le thi'i mdza' mo o hphe li a mngags nas nyams tshod blangs pa ma zad/ da dung hpha smi le thi'i slob grogs gnyis myal zhib mkhan du btang nas nyams tshod blangs mod so sor te sme le this rtogarā song ba red/ he sme le thi yis a ma la a khu khe lo sdi si dang blo sems je ring du gtong dgos pa'i zhu ba zhus shing o hphe li a'i pha gon yang khe lo sdi si la nor nas gri khar bsad/ cung ma 'gor bar khe lo sdi sis he sme le thi dbyin jir dpya khral bsdu bar mngags te dbyin ji'i rgyal po'i lag pa g.yar nas nye sme le thi gsod dgos snyam/ he sme le this lkog g.yo de shes rjes lam bar nas phyir rgyal nang du log de dus o hphe li a ni rang gi pha rgan mdza' grogs kyis bsad pa shes nas smyos pa bzhin du rang srog bcad/ khe lo sdi sis skabs de dang bstun nas o hphe li a'i gcen po le i thi si la ral gri'i rtsal 'gran bsdur byed par kha g.yar nas/ dug byugs pa'i ral gris he sme le thi gsod dgos zhes phra ma brgyab/ ral gri 'gran bsdur byed skabs he sme le thi dang le i thi si/ khe lo sdi si/ he sme le thi'i a ma bcas kyi tshe srog mnyam du shor/ skyo ba'i zlos gar 'di las hre khe si phe'ar gyis sdig nyes dang btsan shed la khong khro skyes pa dang / mchog tu gyur pa'i mi chos ring lugs kyi phugs 'dun khas len byas thog yid skyo ba'i ngang phugs 'dun de mngon du 'gyur ba'i dus skabs ni da dung thon med par shes rtogs thob yod/ zlos gar 'khra32)zhung nang mtshon pa'i hre khe si phe'ar gyi mi chos ring lugs kyi phugs

bsam ni spyi mtshan tsam yin pas/ gdug rtsub che la ya nga med pa'i spyi tshogs kyi mdun du stobs shugs ci yang med par gyur 'dug khong gis rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs 'thab rtsod ni/ spyi mtshan gyi bzang mi bzang dang dge mi dge bar gyi 'thab rtsod yin par snying bsdus byas te/ sdig nyes med par bzos nas phugs bsam mngon 'gyur byed pa'i thabs lam ni mi rang nyid (dper na mi tshul ring lugs pa he sme le thi lta bu)'ba' zhig la brten dgos pa las mang tshogs kyi stobs shugs la brten mi dgos snyam/ de bas na/ nye sme le thi yi dgra sha len pa'i spyod lam la skyo gdung gi mtha' 'bras shig las ci yang ma thob pa red/grekhi si phe'ar gyi zlos gar 'khrab gzhung gi dus rabs kyi don snying ni/mi sna mang po zhig gis gzugs brnyan de khyon rgya che ba'i spyi tshogs bzo ljongs steng du/ gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas dbyin ji 'byor ldan gral rim gyis srid dbang ma 'phrog sngon gyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba rnam pa sna tshogs mtshon pa dang / dus rabs bar ma'i dus kyi nub phyogs yo rob kyi rgyal khab so sor yongs khyab tu yod pa'i gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal dbang gi bar/ bshu gzhog gral rim dang mi dmangs mang tshogs bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod mtshon te/ mi rnams kyi mig mdun du dus rabs de'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba gsal zhing dod po zhig mngon du bcug ste/skabs de'i rgya che ba'i mi dmangs kyi bsam blo dang re ba mtshon yod/ hre khe si phe'ar gyis khong gi rlabs che ba'i brtsams chos kyis nam yang 'jig rgyu med pa'i rdo ring zhig bslangs pa dang / khong gis skad cha la yid dbang 'gug pa'i nus stobs dang mtshon byed kyi nus shugs ha cang che/ khong gi zlos gar khrod kyi mi sna la 'tsho ba'i mngon tshul gyi nyams che bas da lta'i bar du 'dzam gling yongs kyi gar stegs thog 'khrab ston bya bzhin yod pas gang sa gang du mi rnams kyi sems pa dbang med du 'phrog bzhin 'dug go/ 329

lha'i dbangayor sog thug gtong zod pa'i mi ste khu pher ne khu si/dzirang byung tshan rig ni rang rkya 'pher ba zhig yin pa khyab bsgrags byas pa'igasar brje'i bya 'gul ni/ khu pher nee khe si yi nyams pa med pa'i gsung rtsom dpe sgrunabyas pa de yin zhing / khong gis gsung rtsom de spyad de rang byung bya dngos phyogasakyi chos tshogs kyi dbang grags la 'gran bsdur bslangs/ dus de nas bzung rang byung tshan rig ni lha rig pa'i khrod nas bcings 'grol bya 'go brtsamasa'iwa men ke si/gong du en ke sis gsungs pa'i 6 nyams pa med pa'i gsung rtsom ni pho lan ḍi (2018sa7 74)yi rlabs che ba'i gnam dpyad rig pa ba nee khu la khu pher ne khu sis (2090ngas1053 2lhakhri rme07)bcoms pa'i gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉zhes pa red/〈gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉ni phal cher 1530lor yongs su grub/ yin na'ang 4 chos tshogs dbang grags mi kyis gsung rtsom de chu log dang gcan gzan lta bu'i god chag chen por brtsis nas/ dus yun ring por dpar skrun byed du ma bcug lo ngo sum brgya lhag 'gor rjes ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung gis 6 mig sngar gi gnam dpyad rig pa ba rnams kyi gcig mthun bsam 'char miltar dpe skrun byed du mi 'jug thabs med byung / de nas yang lo brgya tsam 'gor rjes da gzod gsung rtsom 'di'i nang don yongs dzo/lha /phyor khyab bsgrags byas/

khu pher nee khe si yi gsung rtsom gyis stabs bde'i tshan rig gi bden don zhig ste nyi ma ni 'jig rten (nyi ma'i khyim rgyud)gyi lte gnas yin shing / sa'i go la ni nyi mar bskor nas 'khor ba khyab bsgrags byas/ yin na'ang gsung rtsom 'bri 'go brtsams pa nas dpe skrun byas pa'i bar dus rabs bzhi tsam gyi dus yun ring po zhig dgos pa byung zhing / dus yun ring po de'i nang kyag kyog dang rnyog 'dzing gi 'thab rtsod du ma byung /1473lor khu pher ne khe si ni pho lan lke yi wi si wa (ya1 318 mo7)chu bo'i 'gram ngogs kyi tho ron (1075ba 6྅)mkhar du sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus su pha ma gnyis ka tshe las 'das pas/ zhang pos stor skyong byas nas nar son/ pho lo 18steng khong rang rgyal sa chen po ste skabs de'i yo rob kyi ches skad grags can gyi rig gnas kyi lte gnas khi ra kho hphu (5nga smo64 khrisalko)du phebs nas khi ra kho hphu slob grwa chen mor zhugs nas rig gnas sbyangs shing slob grwa de ru khong gi sems pa rtsa ba nas gnam dpyad rig pas bkus pa red/khu pher ni khe si yis thog mar sbyong pa ni gna' rabs ghi ri si'i gnam dpyad rig pa ba chen po tho le smi (101075 67 7)yi sazhung lugs yin/ spyi lo dus rabs 2par tho le smi yis 6 sa'i go la ni 'jig rten gyi lte ba ’ yin pa'i gzhung lugs spel nas/sa'i go la ni snying 'jags 'gul med du 'jig rten gyi lte bar gnas shing / zla ba khu pher nee khu si/dang phur bu/ mig dmar/ spen pa/ nyi ma/ pa sangs/ lhag pa sogs rim 331

pa bzhin du sa'i go la bskor nas 'khor bzhin yod zer/ de ni tshan rig steng bshad na nor 'khrul zhig yin na'ang / dus rabs bar ma'i lha rig pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul dang tho le smi yi lta ba de tag tag gcig mthun du mngon pas/ lha rig pa ba tshos shugs gang yod sgos tho le smi yi gzhung lugs la 'ud bstod byas te/ nyi ma ni sa'i go lar bskor nas 'khor ba dang de ni lha'i dbang pos nyi ma bskrun pa'i dmigs yul ni sa'i go lar 'od 'phro ru bcug nas mi'i rigs la thugs khur gnang bas red zer/ lha dbang gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i dus rabs bar ma'i nang / tshan rig dang ldog pa'i log lta 'di lo ngo 1400ring bden don du brtsis/ tho le smi yi gzhung lugs la dogs pa bslangs na lha chen po la phog thug btang ba red bsams pas/ mi rnams kyis de 'dra ba bya phod pa'i mi zhig byung tshe de ni lugs 'gal goms ldog gi mi zhig tu brtsi ba red/khu ther nee khe si yis tho le smi yi gsung rtsom la zhib 'jug nan tan gnang rjes khong gis tho le smi yis snang tshul dang ngo bo gnyis tha dad du 'byed thub par/ dngos min snang tshul dngos yod du brtsis pas de ni nor 'khrul gyi lta ba zhig yin pa shes/ de nas khu pher nee khe si yis gnam dpyad zhib lta bya ba'i 'go bcoms te/ gnam dpyad rig pa'i skor dang rtsis rig pa'i skor gyi dpe debyi mang po 'tshol sdud byas nas bklags shing mchan 'grel yang gang mang ma~X/6lor khu ther ne khe si ni al phe si ri bor brgal nas nyi 'od rnam par 'phro ba'i dbyi tha li ru 'ongs nas/ sbo lun a slob grwa chen mor zhugs nas lha chos tshogs bca' khrims mi sbyangs/ 'on kyang khong gis gnam dpyad rig par zhib 'jug bya bar mtshams ma bzhag par/ mu mthud du gna' za~X ñdza gnam dpyad rig pa'i skor gyi dpe cha gang mang bklags nas/ snga

rabs mkhas chen rnam gyi phul du byung ba'i lta ba bsdu len byas/ 1506lor/phyi gling du slob sbyong byed pa'i dus chad la thon pas phyir mes rgyal pho lan ḍi ru log pa dang de dus khong gi shes bya ha cang phun sum tshogs par gyur yod/skabs der/ spen pa dang phur bu gnyis ma 'ongs par bar snang khams su mnyam 'dzoms yong ba'i ma 'ongs lung ston de glo bur du la lung kun tu khyab pas mi su yin yang don de lab bzhin 'dug don dngos su de gnam dpyad kyi snang tshul zhig yin la/ shin tu dkon pa tsam las ha las rgyu ci yang med mod/ blun rmongs chos tshogs kyis 'di ni lha'i dbang pos mi yul du bsgrags pa'i tha tshig nan po yin te/ mi yul du mngon shes pa rdzun ma zhig byung rgyu yin la/ chu log dang nad yams gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung rgyu yin pas/ spyi tshogs la zing cha langs pa dang rgyal khab kha 'thor du 'gro rgyu red ces 'chal gtam lab pas/ mi rnams la 'jig rten 'jig la nye ba 'dra ba'i skrag snang skyes ru bcug de bas na phyug po tshos gang 'dod du bag med longs spyod byas nas zhed snang las byol thabs byas shing / dbul po tshos khyim gyi rgyu nor btsong nas chos tshogs las 4 nyes dag yi ge nyos nas shi ba'i rjes su sdig nyes med par 'bad/ yin na'ang khu pher ne khe si ni chos tshogs kyi 'chal gtam la ma rlom par/ gnam dpyad rtog zhib byas par brten/ chos tshogs kyi rdzun gtam ther 'don bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ gzab nan dang rtog 'dzing che ba'i rigs 'gre rtsis rgyag byas mthar/ khu pher nee khe sis spen pa dang phur bu gnyis 2 mnyam 'dzoms ’ byed pa'i nyi ma nam yin rtsis brgyab nas ma nor yang dag tu gsungs pa ma zad/ nyin der khong gis mthong dka' ba'i gnam dpyad snang tshul de la yang yongs su dpyad zhib gnang thub pa byung /yin na'ang chos tshogs kyis bsgrags pa'i skar ma gnyis tsa mnyam 'dzoms mi byed pa'i dus tshod de zla gcig tsam gyi ring song bas/ chos tshogs gyu snan

gtam rdul du brlag pa dang thengs der khu pher nee khe si la rgyal kha thob/de nas khu ther ni khe si yis 6 nyi ma lte bar 'dzin pa smra ba'i gzhung lugs kyi ma lag gi rmang gzhi 'ding 'go brtsams/ khong gis gnam gzugs 'khor skyod kyi tshod dpag skor rags tsam gleng pa〉zhes pa'i gnad bsdus sheg bris te 6 nyi lte smra ba'i ’ gzhung lugs spel nas/ gnam gzugs yod rgu nyi mar bskor nas 'khor ba dang / nyi ma ni 'jig rten gyi lte gnas yin zhing /sa'igo la ni rgyu skar zhig yin de yang rgyu skar gzhan pa dang 'dra bar nyi ma bskor nas 'khor ba red ces gsungs pa ma zad/ da dung sa'i go la ni nyin mtshan gcig la rang 'khor skor ba gcig rgyag cing / lo gcig la nyi mar bskor nas skor ba gcig rgyag zer/ sgrub byed 'di dag ni gzhung lugs /sna bye /lha ༵ gu yin yang da dung mu mthud du lta dpyad byas pa'i ma rgyu yis ra 1512lor/ khu pher nee khe si hpho ro ma sbor sge (77016076 sa 2)ru phebs pa dang / smug pa che zhing mu mtha' bral ba'i sbal thi khe (2ma 1 0)rgya mtsho'i 'gram du rang nyid kyi las sgrub khang btsugs shing / de'i nang gnam dpyad stegs bu chung ngu zhig dang rang gis bzos pa'i stabs bde'i 'phrul chas kha shas yod/ mtshan mo'i skabs su khu pher nee khi si yis las sgrub khang gi ches mtho sa nas thog khang gi skar khung las snying 'jags ngo mtshar che ba'i nam mkha' la lta zhib gnang zhing / mtha' yas pa'i nam mkha'i mthongs su 'od 'tsher 'tsher du gnas pa'i skar tshogs kyis dpa' ngar ldan pa'i tshan rig gi dpa' bo 'di la rang rang gi gsang ba mngon sum du bstan/ dus tshod ni nyin re re dang lo re re byas nas phyin pa dang khu pher ni khe si yis ngal ba ma shes par bgrang bya 30ring ste rang nyid kyi tshe srog rdzogs pa'i bar du gnam gas/sdu la tshad 'jal lta dpyad mdzad/

1525lor/ khu pher nee khe si yis dpyad gzhi'i yi ge 'bor chen zhig gzhir bzung nas gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉zhes pa'i gsung rtsom 'bri 'go bcoms shing / dka' ba khyad bsad dang hur thag 'bad brtson byas mthar khong gis sde tshan drug yod pa'i gsung rtsom zhig yongs su grub pa dang de'i nang don gtso bor/ 'jig rten gyi chags tshul dang / rtsis rig pa'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa/ brtan skar gyi re'u mig sa'i go la'i 'khor skyod/zla ba dang rgyu skar gyi 'khor skyod sogs 'du/ dpe gzhung des tshan rig rang bzhin du nyi lte'i ma lag la rgyas bshad byas pa ma zad/ da dung〈sa'i go la lte gnas smra bar dgag pa〉zhes pa'i le'u nang / gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis yongs su bkur pa'i tho le smi yi gzhung lugs la rgyud rim yod cing stobs shugs zlo/ /sbya / ṭwāṃ sna /nga maḥ/ sdo/da ༵ trī rsha kāg da dī kā /dung/ por dgag nas de dag gi do zlar langs pas/ dpe skrun bya dgos na nges par du chos tshogs kyi bkag 'gog dang gnod 'tshe btang ba las thar thabs byed dgos/snying rje med cing gdug rtsub che ba'i chos lugs khrims gcod khangaX gis kho tshor 6 dogs pa mi bslangs pa'i dpe cha yod rgu me la bsregs/ khu pher ne khe si ni chos lugs kyi las 'gan yod pa'i mi zhig yin la/ hpho ro ma sbor sge (71016012 sgrosgotshe'imunt+ra)chos khang chen mo'i chos pa yin pas/ chos bdag chen po tshos khong ni chos tshogs kyi blo log pa red zer nas/ khong la lta rtogs 'dzinaḥd py-i spya durnyi nāshā1 tārsha sau 〉tso ///sa barshakta ཿsa sna/ /ngakyi khrigāswā shāsnrusag (rnyi rnyi nā ཿkāswā shātna/ lhasdo tnaskyu/ rshaswā /kaushā 5rā/ ñtsā ba sdudagāl 4〉/ smu ru pyas nirnying ཿmi drodi /sna/ byi di kā sna ཿpa /sas/ shā sbyo/pa/ ga/ skyu/ / sdu tram̐ twe two twe 3phyi rī //sgyu 〈〈( spri/ sda spri/ twe bye tre/sna spyo sgyu / sna / ba/ sapa kau ཿ/spya sgyunā 〉spyan ṭī //shā

nan mo byas shing khong gi nye 'khor du myul ma mngags nas go skabs yod tshad spyad de gnod 'tshe gtong thub thub byas/ ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma'i rna bar khu pherasge khe si yi 6 nyi lte smra ba migo ba tsam la/ 'jigs snang chen po skyes pas/gang thub ci nus sgos khu pher ne khe si'i gsung rtsom dpe skrun byed par bkag 'gog byas/ 1536lor chos tshogs kyis khu pher nee khu si la gsung rtsom gyi ma yig sprod dgos pa'i bka' babs kyang khong gis bka' de la gtan nas khas len ma byas/ khu pher ne khu si yis dus tshod dam 'dzin byas nas chos tshogs kyis gnod 'tshe ma yong gong gsung rtsom dpar du bcugagasung rtsom phyag bris gnang ba'i go rim nang / khu pher ne khe si la rang tshang gi bud med gnyer pa an nā zhes pas rogs ram chen po byas/ an nā ni sngar khyim tshang chen po tshang zhig gi sras mo yin la/ kho mos khu pher ne khe si yis tshan rig gi ched du yod tshad phul pa'i snying stobs chen por yid smon nas stobs 'byor ldan pa'i khyim tshang las sgor thon te/ tha mal pa'i mthong phyogs la ma 'joms par khu pher ne khe si'i gam du 'ongs/ lo ngo bcu ring khong gnyis kyis mnyam gcig tu 'tsho ba rol ba'i ring / khong mo yang khu pher ne de si yi med du mi rung ba'i bza' zla dang las rogs pa ru gyur/ log spyod chos tshogs kyis〈gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉dpar du skrun par sngon 'gog bya ched an nā la'ang gnod 'tshe chen po btang / chos gtso chen po ḍan thi khe chen gyis btsan shugs sgos khu pher ne khe si la an nā dang 'brel ba med pa byedadagos zer/ chos gtso chen po des khu pher ne khe si rgol gtam drag po btang bar ma nyan par/ btsan gyis an nā hpho ro ma sbor sge nas phyir skyod byas/ khu pher ne khe si la khong khro me ltar 'bar na'ang / an nā yis khu pher ne khe si'i gsung rtsom yongs su grub nas dpe skrun bya ched/ kho mos khu pher ne de rdi stu hpho ro ma sbor sge la 'bral mi rung zhes sems gso dang kha ta byas pas/

khu pher nee khe si yis grogs med kher rkyang du rang nyid kyi las don mi sgrub ga med byung ngo //rjes su 'jar man gyi lo na gzhon pa'i dge rgan chen mo ba le thi khe zhes pa khu pher ne de si dge rgan du brten nas/ khong gi gsung rtsom gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉yi ma yig la dag bcos bya rogs mdzad pa dang /khu pher ne khe si'i grogs po chos gtso the sde sman rji sgre yis kyang khong la rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byas nas gsung rtsom de snga sa nas dpe skrun bgyi e thub thub byas/ 1543lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 24nyin/ gegs bar sna tshogs khyad bsad byas pa brgyud rlabs che ba'i tshan rig gi gsung rtsom 'di dpar tshar bas spro ro ma sgor sge ru bskyal/ yin na'ang skabs der khu pher nee khe si lags nad kyis mnar pas nyal sar bzhugs te tshe las 'das la khad du slebs 'dug khong gis rang nyid tshe gang po'i sems shugs spyad de grub pa'i gsung rtsom la phur phur gnang bzhin chu tshod gcig gi 'phror sku gshegs pa red/ (mi la las shod tshul du khu pher ne khe si yis cung snga ba'i dus su ma dpe tsam ma gtogs tsam mthong ma thub zer/)mi yul du mi bzhugs pa'i khu pher ne khe si yis mkhyen med pa zhig la/dpe deb la chos tshogs stobs shugs kyi skog bkod btang 'og nu'u non sber sge (75ngas7076 776)yi dpe skrun tshong pas ngo tsha med par g.yo bcos byas te/ lha rig pa'i 'chal gtam dang 'os mthun yong ba byas nas da gzod dpe skrun byed du bcug lhag par du khu pher ne khe si'i gzi 'od 'phro ba'i gleng gzhi lkog tu brjes yod pa red/ de'i phyir khong gi grogs po the sde sman la khong khro bzod med skyes pas gtug bsher byas kyang rgyal kha ma lon/'on kyang stabs legs kyi don zhig la/ skabs der le thi khe yis 3)snang

rtsom de'i ma yig nu ron sper sge nas phyir blangs pas/ lo ngo 300lhag gi rjes su ma yig de rje khe'i phu ra sge (273650 777)yi mi sger gyi dpe mdzod khang zhig tu rnyed song ba red/ mi'i rigs rig gnas steng gi 'od stong 'phro ba'i shog nye de god chags tshabs chen mang po brgyud rjes mthar thug nyar tshags byed thub pa byung /873lor gnam gzugs 'khor skyod smra ba〉yi kha gsab ma dpe skrun byas shing / de nas lo 80'gor rjes kyi 1953lor gsung rtsom de'i nang don yongs rdzogs kha gsab byas nas dpar skrun byas stabs/ da gzod mi rnams kyis rlabs che pa'i tshan rig gsung rtsom de kha tshang du klog thub pa'i bskal ba byung / khu pher ne khe si'i rlabs che ba'i gsung rtsom dang thog dpe skrun byed dus g.yo bcos byas yod rung chos tshogs stobs shugs kyis sdang sems bcangs nas dus yun ring por klog mi chog pa'i bkag sdom dpe cha'i nang bcug kyang /tshan rig la blo sems dkar pa'i dpa' rtul tshos (dper na sbu ru no dang sga li le)bkres la zas dang skom la chu ltar du khu pher ne khe si'i gsung rtsom bklags nas/ rang nyid kyi zhib 'jug dang tshod lta/ tha na yod tshad thams cad blos btang nas gsung rtsom de la srung skyob byas/ khu pher ne khe si'i gzhung lugs kyis mi'i rigs la tshan rig gi sgo nas 'jig rten ngos 'dzin bya bar mdzub khrid gnang zhing / 'jig rten gyi phyi ngos su g.yogs pa'i dus rabs bar ma'i lha rig pa'i phyi lu de rim pa re re byas nas bkog 'don mdzad/ khu pher ne khe si'i rlabs che ba'i mdzad rjes ni nam yang nyams pa med pa'i lo rgyus kyi deb ther steng bkod yod pa red/338

66me'as nga rang 'dul mi thub /wa wasbu ru no yis tshan rig gi bden don ched du rang srog btang ba/1600lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 17nyin/ dbyi tha li'i ro ma gyi me tog thang chen du so pa mang po langs shing / thang chen gyi mtha' ru mi mang pos bskor nas kho tsho'i mig nang skyo gdung gis khengs te thang chen dkyil gyi mer bsregs nasasrog khrims gcod sa'i ka ba'i stong lo na lnga bcu lhag la thon pa'i rgan khog cig bsdams yod par lta bzhin 'dug mi de'i smra ra skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur cing / zhal gdung la rgas gnyer gyis bkang yod/ yin na'ang mgo bo yar bsgrengs pa dang mig 'od chem chem du 'phro ba de las mi de'i dpa' ngar zhum med kyi snying stobs mngon par 'dug me bsreg ka ba'i mtha' 'khor du 'bud shing spungs yod/ cung ma 'gor par rgyas spros kyi shing rta zhig srung dmag gi bskor nas thang chen du thon pa dang chos kyi gong ma khi re mon the sku rabs brgyad pa shing rta las mar babs nas/ skabs bzos stegs bu'i steng bsdad de/ lha min 'dre min gyi rnam 'gyur cig ston zhor du/ 6 rgad po blo gyong de mgyogs por me la sregs dang mizhes skad co brgyab pa dang / me bsreg ka ba'i mtha' 'khor gyi 'bud shing la me bsgron pas me lce drag tu 'bar ba dang du ba long long du 'phyur bas thang chen gyi bar snang bkang / mi rnams kyi 'ur sgra'i khrod ka ba'i steng bcings pa'i rgan pa des skad gseng mthon posache me yis nga rang 'dul mi thub/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus rabs kyis bdag gi rin thang shes nges yin zhes bsgrags shing / skad sgra de ni glog dmar 'khyug pa'i 'brug sgra bzhin chos kyi gong ma'i snying du zug pa red/ 339
