dogs sems bslangs / khong nyid tshan rig gi bden don la yid ches brtan po byung bas de'i don du mi tshe gang por 'bad brtson bya rgyu sems thag bcad/sbu ru no yis no a'i gru chung〉sogs dpyad rtsom nang khu pher nikhi si'i gzhung lugs dril bsgrags dang khyab spel byas yod/ 1573lor chos lugs khrims ra chig brgya lhag gis sbu ru no yi gzhung lugs ni 66log bshad mi red ces nyes bgrang zhu gtug byas/ ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung gis spu ru no la 'gyog bshags byas nas 66log lta spongs dgos pa'i bka' babs kyang / sbu ru no yis gtan nas khas ma blangs/ 1576lor/ sbu ru no chos khongs nas phud de chos khang las phyir skrod btang bas/ dus de nas bzung lo na gzhon zhing blo kha brtan pa'i spu ru no ni la lung kun tu ldom nas 'tsho ba skyel zhing / rgyal khab dang yul khongs mi 'dra ba du mar 'grim pa'i skabs su mu mthud du bden don dang 'od gsal 'tshol zhib gnang ngo //1577lor sbu ru no si we tshi (505701 2 lo stsa)ru phebs na'ang / rje nee we (60005 thamatho)mtshe'u 'gram gyi mdzes sdug yul ljongs su khong la thob pa ni skyo sems kho na yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni yul mi rnams kyis 6 log lta'i ’bsam blo can gyi spu ru no la dga' bsu ye nas mi byed pas red/ de nas khong nyid 'khyams nas hpha ran si ru slebs pa dang / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la de ru khong la mi rnams kyi dga' bsu thob pas/ thu lu si (10010236rwa mo)slob grwa chen mos khong nyid dge rgan chen mo ru gdan 'dren zhus/1583lor/ khong nyid dbyin ji ru phebs te lon tun gyi skad grags can gyi o kho si spror ḍi (071016 rdo ma༈)slob grwa chen mo'i 'chad stegs thog tu ci dgar rang nyid kyi bla na med pa'i lta ba dril bsgrags byas pas/ shes byar re ba'i na gzhon slob ma mang po'i sems pa bkug nas yul de ru tshogs/ dbyin jir lo gsum la bzhugs skabs sbu ru no yis na gzhon mkhas pa mang ༵ sbyod

bsring byas pa ma zad/ da dung gsung rtsom gal chen gnyis te〈rgyu mtshan dang 'byung rtsa/ gcig gyur smra bsnyadang tshad med rang bzhin dang / 'jig rten dang yul khams so so〉zhes pa brtsams nas/ khong gi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rtenalta ba spel/sbu ru no yis spro sems 'khol pa'i sgo nas khu pher ne khe si'i nyi lte smra ba dril bsgrags byas shing / gzhung lugs de gong spel btang ba ma zad da dung nor bar yo bsrang yang gnang / khong gis 'jig rten ni dus tshod dang bar khams steng tshad med yin pas/ smyo nga tshos gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas/'jig rten yongs kyi gang sa gang du lte gnas yod pa red ces tshig thag gcod thub ’ ces dang / nyi ma'i khyim rgyud ni 'jig rten khrod kyi brtan skar ma lag cig yin la/ nyi ma ni 'jig rten gyi lte gnas kho na ga la yin/ sa'i go la yang 'jig rten khrod kyi phra rdul zhig red ces kyang gsungs/ khong gis gom gang mdun spos sgos/ 'jig rten ni gcig gyur gyi dngos gzugs khams shig yin la/ dngos gzugs ni bya dngos rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gdos bcas yin pa ma zad da dung yun gtan yang yin/ sa bon rdog bu gcig 'bru rigs su 'gyur la/ mi'i khog tu 'ju ba dang sdud len byas mthar dngos po gzhan zhig tu 'gyur nges red/ dngos po gcig ni dmigs bsal can gyi dngos gzugs sna tshogs su mngon yang / de ni gsar gtod bya mi thub pa dang med par gtong mi thub pa zhig red ces gsungs/ sbu ru no yi sngon thon gyi 'jig rten lta ba des chos tshogs kyi 'jig rten lta bar rtsa ba nas khas ma blangs pas/ ye shu'i chos lugs kyi 'tsho rten rmang gzhi la g.yo 'gul chen po btang spyi/ tshogs lo rgyus lta ba'i phyogs su/ sbu ru no yis mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshokāswā spya mu mthud du 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin dang sngon skyod bya bzhin yod

cing / gna' snga mo'i dus skabs ni snye rdzogs ldan gyi dus rabs mi shig ma yin zhes gsungs/ khong gas dngos yod bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi mun nag rul sungs la snang sems tshad med bcangs pas de nges par du bsgyur bcos bya dgos snyam/sbu ru no yis skabs de'i dbang bsgyur pa'i go gnas bzung ba'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi chos khang mtshan nyid rig pa ba la snying rje med par zur za dang dgag pa brgyab te/ kho tsho ni tha shal pa dang dgod slong zlos gar pa red gsungs/ khong gis da dung bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tsho dang chos rgyal ni shes rmongs yin pa'i thog da dung dul sungs ngan lhung du gyur yod pa la'ang snying rje med par ther 'don byas yod/sbu ru no ni dus rabs kyi rlabs rgyun gyi ches sngon shos su langs pas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sger gcod lam lugs dang chos tshogs stobs shugs kyi dgra zla la gyur/1586lor sbu ru no phyir hpha ran si ru log yang / khong gis dbyin ji'i dus su mtshon pa'i 'thab 'dzing gi snying stobs kyis gang sa gang du lha'i dbang po dang chos tshogs kyi do zlar langs pas/ da res hpha ran si ru khong la dga' bsu byed mkhan ma yod pas/ khong nyid slar yang yul gyar pa ru gyur/1591lor da gzod 'jar man gyi hphu ren khi sgor (778baji107 ṣṭha༅༅rsā)du gnas bca'o// sbu ru no la shes rgya yangs shing 'jon thang che rung / khong dang skabs de'i rnying zhen che ba'i spyi tshogs rig gzhung tshogs gnyis me spu dgra gshed kyi dpe ru gyur pa dang lhag par du yo rob chos lugs stobs shugs yongs kyis khong la sdang sems bzung ba red/ sbu ru no yis gnam dpyad rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo dril bsgrags gnang ste/ 6 kun nus ༵ sna'i

dbang po ni 'jig rten rigs gzhung so so ru khyad nus med pa gnang ba ni/ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung la 'gran bsdur tshabs chen bslangs pa yin pas/dbyi tha li'i chos lugs stobs lugs kyis sbru ru no la phu snying chen ham las mi byed du ga la 'jug de bas na/ yun ring ngan gra sngon sgrig byas rjes chab srid kyi gnod 'tshe zhig mthar thug thon byung ba red/we ne dze a'i dpe khang zhig tu/ sbu ru no yi gsung rtsom bshams yod/1592lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 23nyin/ yul de'i sku drag dmo srin ni sge zhes pa dpe khang de'i nang 'ongs nas spu ru no yi gsung rtsom lag tu blangs nas blta tsam byas rjes/ rdzu ma yin yin khul du dpe khang gi bdag po la/ 2 dpe cha 'di bris pa shin tu legs/ gal srid rtsom pa po dang mjal nas dngos su bka' slob zhus na de las kyang legs so mi zhes zer dus/ dpe khang gi bdag pos 6 khong nyid da lta dbyi tha li ru mi bzhugs par hphu ren khe spror du bzhugs/khong phyir dbyi tha li ru mi log pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phal cher chos skyong srid gzhung las bar gegs gtong bar dogs par 'dug :zhes lan slog skabs dmo srin ne sge yis 'phral du cu bdag gis khong nyid gdan 'dren zhu 'dod yod/bdag gi gzhis ga'i nang bzhugs na chog ste/ chos skyong srid gzhung sku drag gi khyim du brgyugs nas mi la gnod 'tshe gtong ba ma red mices lab/ dpe khang gi bdag po ni sku drag de'i skad char rlom nas/ mgyogs por sbu ru no la 'phrin yig cig bskur nas gnas tshul de bshad/ sbu ru no yis lhag bsam rnam dag dang spro sems khengs pa'i 'phrin yig de bklags rjes sems 'gul chen po thebs/ phyi rgyal du lo ngo 16lhag la yar 'khyams mar 'khyams byas pa'i 'tsho ba rol ba des khong gi thugs ni kher lus dang skyo sems gi snang bas gdung pa je drag yin la/ nam yang pha yul dang mes rgyal dran par 'dugakhod ni thugs su nam yang rig gzhung steng byas rjes bzhag nas 'bras bu yod

rgu rang gi mes rgyal la phul dgos snyam yod/ bsam pa de lta bu la brten nas sbu ru ni mi rang nyid kyi nyen kha la ma 'dzems par gra rgyas 'du 'dzi che ba'i we ne dze a grong khyer du phebs/sku ru no yi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ khong la mgo skor thebs song la/ khrel med kyi g.yo thabs 'og tu tshud pas/ khong nyid we nee dze a ru thon ma thag ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung gis btson du bzung / dmo srin ni sge zer pas sku drag des g.yo zol ngan thabs bkol pa dang 'phral du lkog zhu byas par chos skyong srid gzhung gis mi ngan de la bya dga' mang po byin/de rjes kyi lo ngo 8lhag ring sbu ru no ni btson khang nang du bzhugs/ mi chos dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ba dang nyes rdung drag po/ 'jigs skul ngan slu gang rung myong ba dang / tha na snum gdus ma lus po'i steng blugs pa'i btson las myangs kyang / khong nyid kyi tshan rig gi dad sems la g.yo 'gul tsam yang ma byung / khong gis dpa' ngar zhum med sgos ‘ kho khi gzi a'i 'khyags ro ma gyis nga'i sems khongs kyi me lce mi sod/ nga rang me lce'i nang shi yang 'gyod sems ci yang med ’ ces gsungs pa red/ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung ni blo brtan 'gyur med kyi dpa' bo de'i mdun du ci bya gtol med du gyur pas/ 1600lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 9nyin sbu ru no la mer bsregs pa'i srog khrims bcad pa yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas/chos lugs 'dri gcod khang gi shin tu ring pa'i〈bcad khra〉yi nang spu ru no yis lha'i dbang por mthong chung byas pa dang / chos tshogs la dma' 'bebs btang ba sogs kyi ru nag nyes mang po bgrangs/ tha na de'i nang da dung sbu ru no yis phyi rgyal du 66khrims med lugs med dang bdud 'dre lta bu'i 'tsho ba rol ’ zhes kyang brnyas bcos btang yod/ mthar thug chos lugs 'dri gcod khang gis gdug rtsub sems gnag sgos mi skya'i khrims ra la/34snro ru

no ni smyo gang thub ngang zhi 'jam dang khrag mi bzhur ba'i thabs su thag gcod bya dgos mizhes pa'i bsam 'char bton/ de dag gis smyo zhi 'jam ’ dang 2 khrag mi bzhur ba zer pa ni me'i nang gson bsregs rgyag dgos pa'i don yin no/sbru ru no yis bag spro ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis smyo bcad khra yi nang don nyan tshar pa dang dpa' ngar zhum med kyi nyams kyis zu khyod tshos nga la bcad khra 'don skabs/ ngas de la nyan pa las lhag pa'i 'jigs skrag cig khyod tsho rang la skye bzhin 'dug ’ ces gsungs so//zla 2pa'i tshes 17nyin/ gdug rtsub che zhing 'jigs dngangs nad phog yod pa'i lag dmar zhig gis spu ru no yi lce sne gtub pa dang / de nas ro ma yi me tog thang chen du krong nger bslangs pa'i shing gi rgya gram 'og tu khong nyid chos tshogs kyi sdig nyes me lce des gson bsregs brgyab/ mun nag gi nam mkha'i mthongs kyi brtan skar chen po zhig bar snang du zags/ yin na'ang khong nyid kyi gzhung lugs kyis tshan rig gi 'jig rten lta ba'i 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded kyi byed nas chen po bton yod/ gzhung lugs des gom gang mdun spos sgos tshan rig 'di lha rig pa'i 'chings rgya las bkrol pas/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dang mig rgya lhag tu je cher btang pa red/lo rgyus kyis tshan rig dang bden don gyi ched du rang srog blos btang ba'i dpa' bo 'di'i mdzad rjes ma brjed par/ lo ngo 289rjes kyi spyi lo 1889lor spyi tshogs gleng phyogs kyi gnon shugs chen po'i 'og ro ma chos lugs khrims ra yis spu ru no la dkar 'don dag sel byas pa khyab bsgrags mi byed ka med byung zhing / khong la bcad pa'i gnas lugs 'do zungs med pa'i nyepa ༵༵ med par btang / zla 6pa'i tshes 9nyin/ sbu ru no yis me tog thang

6 sa'i gog ni sngaraltar 'khorabazhinayod /wa wasga li le yis tshan rig las don ched du rang srog skyes su phul ba/1979lo'i zla 11par/ 'dzam gling stong gi ming grags can gyi tshan rig pa kha shas las grub pa'i u yon lhan khang gis slar yang lo ngo sum brgya'i sngon gyi sga li le yi gyon don la zhib bsher thag gcod byas/ zla 11pa'i tshes 10nyin/ ro ma gyi chos kyi gong ma 'jon pho lo sku rabs gnyis pas mi mang po'i mdun du dus rabs bar ma'i dbyi tha li'i tshan rig pa sga li le'o sga li le (6751200811121khrim/lo khrim14)yi gnam dpyad lta ba la chos skyong srid gzhung gis 'dri rtsad dang khrims chad bcad pa ni drang bden ma yin pas da lta khrims chad de rtsis med du dgos nges red zhes khyab bsgrags byas/ de lta na/ lo ngo sum brgya lhag ring gi nyes med nyes 'gel gyi gyod gzhi de da gzod dkar 'don byas pa red/tshan rig pa sga li le ni dus rabs bar ma'i rig rtsal bskyar dar dus smad kyi rlabs che ba'i mi zhig yin la/ tshan rig bden don la brtan srung byed mkhan brtul phod dpa' rgod cig yin/ 1564lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 15nyin/ khong rang dbyi tha li'i gna' bo'i grong mkhar phi sā (21 bya 79)zhes par sku 'khrungs/ khong gi pha ni sku drag cig yin la/ rol mo ba dang rtsis rig pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin/ sga li le la chung ba'i dus nas rig pa rno zhing sbyong la spro ba/ bsam gzhigs gtong bar dga' ba zhig yin/ khong gis ghi ri si dang la then gyi yi ge sbyong myangs/ rol mo dang sgyu rtsal la'ang shin tu dga' ba red/348

1583lor sga li le yis phi sā chos khang du phreng thag gis dbyangs pa'i sgron me zhig g.yo bzhin yod pa mthong zhing / rang gi rtsa'i 'phar tshad smyo chu tshod rtsi chas mi byas nas rtsis brgyab pas na/ ha las pa zhig la g.yo tshad che chung gang yin yang de la mkho ba'i chu tshod nam yang gcig 'dra yin pa mthong / de ni 6 g.yo ’ yi chu tshod mtshungs pa'i nges srol zhes pa red/khyim tshang dbul phongs yin stabs sga li le slob grwa las phyir bud nas khyim du log nas rang sbyong mi byed ka med byung / khong gis rgyug gzugs zhi shugs rig pa dang dngos gzugs ljid lte'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom gnyis bris pas rig gzhung las rigs phyogs kyi mthong chen byas te/ khong gi ming la 6 deng rabs kyi ar khi smi sde si ’ zhes 'bod/ 1589lor pho lo 25la thon pa'i sga li le ni phi sā slob grwa chen mo'i 'chad khrid dge rgan du gdan drangs/skabs der tshad ldan du brtsis pa'i a ri si tho the le si (4113 0 123 yo༅777)yi dngos lugs rig pa la ming grags can gyi 6 rtsa ba'i rigs pa zhig yod pa ni/ dngos gzugs mar lhung ba'i mgyogs tshad dang ljid tshad mthun sdur yin pa de yin zhing / gsal por bshad na/ ljid tshad mi 'dra ba'i dngos gzugs gnyis dus mtshungs su bar khams nas mar lhung na/ lci mo de sngon du sar 'bab nges yin zer ba de red/ tsa rtsa ba'i rigs pa mi 'di la chos tshogs kyis kyang khas len pa red/ yin na'ang / sga li le yis lta dpyad nan zhib byas mthar/ 2 rtsa ba'i rigs pa ’ de nor 'dug pa rtogs/ khong gi bzhed pa ni dngos gzugs yang lci can gnyis ka mnyam du sar 'bab nges pa de red/ tshan rig gi thag gcod cig dgos na/ nges par du tshod lta byas nas ra sprod bya dgos/ 1590lo'i nyin zhig tu sga li le yis mi mang po'i sngon du lhung gzugs tshod lta byas/ tshod lta bya yul ni phi sā'i mchod rten gsog ma yi/ gung / de ni 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa'i ngo mtshar che ba'i brtsigs

dngos shig yin/ 1174lor bskrun zhing / mtho tshad smi 54 5yod cing /ljid tshad la tun 1 4yod/ mchod rten de yongs su grub nas cung ma 'bor par logs su gseg nas lte gnas dang smi 'ga' brdal/ tshod lta de gzigs par gdan 'dren zhus pa'i mkhas pa mang po mchod rten mdun du tshogs shing sga li le rang gi las rogs dang mnyam du mchod rten gyi yang rtser phebs/ de nas tshod lta yi 'go brtsams pa dang sga li le yis lcags ril gnyis (lcags ril gcig gi ljid tshad la phon ḍi (90557 0)100dang gcig gi ljid tshad la yon ḍi 1yod)dus gcig tu thur rang bzhin du lhung du bcug mi rnams kyis lcags ril de gnyis mnyam gcig tu sar lhung ba mthong ba dang / tshod lta da dung thengs gcig byas kyang ngo mtshar che ba la lcags ril de dngos gnas mnyam gcig tu sar lhung bas/ mi rnams 'ur zing nge song la/ a ri si tho the le si'i smyo lhung gzugs kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa la dad pa'i bsam par g.yo 'gul byung / sga li le yis lhung gzugs 'gul skyod chos nyid ra sprod byas shing / lhag tu gal che ba zhig la tshan rig ni chod lta'i rmang gzhi'i steng skrun dgos pa'i gnas lugs de mi rnams rlom du bcug pa de red/yin na'ang / tshod lta des chos tshogs la khong khro bslangs pas/ chos tshogs kyis sga li le ni chos kyi blo log pa red ces dma' 'bebs byas pa ma zad/ da dung sga li le phi tsā slob gru chen mo nas phyir phud btang /cung ma 'gor bar sga li le ni we ne dze a'i pha tu'u wa slob grwa chen mo ru dge rgan du phebs/ de ru rig gzhung la rang dbang che la chos skyong srid gzhung gi stobs shugs cung chung ba red/ khong gis phyogs gcig nas dpe khrid gnang ba dang phyogs gcig nas dngos lugs rig pa'i zhib 'jug bya gzhi gal chen 'ga' la zhib 'jug gnang pas 'bras bu du ma blangs/ lhag tu gal che ba zhig la/ 1609lor khong gis ldab 32rje cher btang ba'i rgya~X sal

zhig gsar skrun byas nas gnam gzugs la lta dpyad tshad 'jal byas pas/thengs dang por 'jig rten gsang ba rtol ba'i gnam mthongs shig phye song /de nas sga li le yis blo rtse gcig tu gzhol nas gnam dpyad rig par zhib 'jug mdzad pas/ gnam dpyad kyi snang tshul rab dang rim pa mang po la lta dpyad tshad 'jal gnang / dper na/ dgu tshigs ni brtan skar mang po las grub cing / brtan skar gyi grangs tshad ni rgyang shel gyi ldab tshad ji 'dra mtho na de 'dra'i je mang du 'gro ba/ zla ba ni 6 ngos 'jam gyi me long zhig ma yin par de'i ngos ni 'bar 'bur mi mnyam par mtho sgang dang spang thang yod pa/phur bu la 'khor skar ba'i yod pa de zla ba sa'i go lar bskor ba brgyab pa bzhin du 'khor bzhin yod pa/ tsha ba gdu ba'i nyi ma'i ngos su 6 nag rdul mi yod pa sogs ni khong gis thog mar rnyed/ 1610lor dpe skrun byas pa'i〈skar ma'i go la'i pho nya〉zhes pa'i dpe cha'i nang / sga li le yis gal chen gsar rnyed de dag bkod yod pas/ gom gang mdun spos sgos khu pher ne khe si'i 6 nyi lte smra ba la ra sprod byas stabs/ chos tshogs kyi sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi lha rig pa la slar yang rdung rdeg shugs ldan thebs pa red/1613lorasga li le yis(nyi ma'i nag rdul gleng ba'i 'phrin yig〉ces pa'i gsung rtsom dpe skrun byas shing / de ni khu pher ne khe si'i lta ba zhib par bshad pa'i tshan rig gi gsung rtsom yin pas/ ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung gis do snang byas/ ro ma gyi chos kyi gong mas sga li le la da nas bzung khu pher ne khe si'i gzhung lugs la yid ches dang / slob khrid/ srung skyong gtan nas bya mi chog la/ de las ldog na chad pa nan mo gcod rgyu yin zhes tha tshig bsgrags/ lo der khu pher nee khe si'i gzhung lugs ni 66log lta mi red ces khyab ba/༷༷ ṭī kā/ ni tshan rig gi bden don la yid ches brtan mo yod pas/

chos tshogs kyis gnod 'tshe gtong bar mi skrag pa dang / lha rig pa'i shes med rmongs bshad la mgo ma bskur par mu mthun du gting zab por zhib 'jug gnang ste/ ngal dub la ma 'dzems par gnam dpyad tshad 'jal mdzad/ 1623lor chos kyi gong ma rgan pa tshe las 'das shing / chos kyi gong ma gsar pa wur pan sku rabs brgyad pa ((768043 677)khri la bkod/chos kyi gong ma gsar pa ni sga li le yi gzhon nu'i dus kyi grogs po yin la/ mi rnams kyis de ni tshan rig la brtsi bkur byed pa'i mi zhig yin par bshad pas/sga li le yis rang nyid kyi gnas bab je legs su 'gro bar dgongs nas/1632lor sga li le yis lo brgyad ring bris pa'i gsung rtsom dpe skrun byas shing /de ni〈tho le smi dang khu pher ne khe si gnyis kyi 'jig rten lta ba bar gyi bka' mol gnang res〉zhes pa yin te/ dpe cha de'i nang du bka' sol tshul du khu pher ne khe si'i gzhung lugs zhib gleng byas nas/ a ri si tho the le si dang tho le smi yi sa'i go la lte ba smra ba la dgag pa brgyab yod/ gsung rtsom le yi mtshon byed rtsom yig kyang yin la/ de'i nang chos tshogs kyi bsam —blo'i ma lag la dgag pa nan mo brgyab yod pas/ chos kyi gong ma wur pan la khong khro shān po bslangs pas 'phral du sga li le khrims sbyor bya dgos pa'i bka' babs sngar sga li le yis rgyang shel gsar gtod byas pa'i skabs su/ chos tshogs kyis de ni 6 gdon 'dre'i sgyu 'phrul mi red ces 'ur brgyab cing sga li le ni tsa mgo skor gtong mkhan ’ red ces ngan gtam lab/ rjes su khong gi gsung rtsom ni khu pher ne khe si'i gsung rtsom nang bzhin 6 bkag sdom dpe cha'i mi nang du bcug nga1633lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 13nyin chos skyong srid gzhung gis sga li le ro ma du bka' 'gug 'dri dpyod byed skabs/ khong nyid dgung lo 70tsam la slebs pa'i rgan 'khog cig yin pa'i steng sku snyun zhing 3sbyangs

nyams 'dug 'dri dpyod ni gsang ba'i tshul du byas shing / shod tshul la ro ma gyi chos skyong srid gzhung gi 'dri gcod khang gis khong gi gzhung lugs ma bskyur na me bsreg srog khrims gcod rgyu zhes 'jigs snang skul myong zer/zla ba bzhi tsam gyi ngo tsha khrel med kyi 'dri dpyod byas rjes/ zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin/ chos skyong srid gzhung gis btsan gyis sga li le chos lugs khrims khang gi tshoms chen nang gi ye shu'i sku brnyan mdun dang khrims dpon gyi sngon du pus mo sa la btsugs/ lag tu dam pa'i gsung rabs〉bzung nas rang gi 6 nag nyes ’ la sna 'gyod bshags ’ byed du bcug pa dang bcad khra〉yi steng rang ming bkod du bcug khungs lung gtan nas med pa'i〈bcad khra〉de'i nang du phaspya sbyishā lha/ zlo /sdo khyosdidī / ches mtha'i nyes chad gcod rgyu/ nga tshos thag gcod dang dbye 'byed byas nas yongs bsgrags bya rgyu la/ sga li le khyod la/ 'di ga khrims ra nas rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na/ log lta'i dogs gnad de/ khyod kyis nor 'khrul dang dam pa'i gsung rabs〉dang 'gal ba'i gzhung lugs la dad pa dang brtsi bkur byas nas/ nyi ma ni sa'i go la'i 'khor lam gyi lte gnas yin pa dang / shar nas nub tu skyod pa ma yin par/ rang dgar 'khor skyod byed cing 'dzam gling gi lte gnas ma red zer/ de bas na gnas bab 'di lta bu'i 'og tu khyod kyis bla na med pa'i chos lugs khrims srol dang thun mong ngam bye brag gi khrims gzhung gi chod don dang khyab bsgrags byas pa'i chad bcad bslab don dang nyes chad 'khur dgos/(de ni mi skya'i srid gzhung la sprod pa dang me la bsregs nas srog len rgyu bstanadi rtsom pa po nas)dziyin na'ang / khyod kyi tshabs dang gnod pa che ba'i nor 'khrul dang nag nyes la chadapa gcod rgyu dang / khyod rang deng phyin chad lhag tu gzab gzab yong ba dang mi gzhan la mig dpe ston pa dang tha tshig sgrog pa'i phyir/ nga tshos khyab bsgrags bya rgyu ni/yongs su bsgrags pa'i bka' las dpe cha gleng mol〉bkag sdom byas pa dang / khyod ranga~Xs skabs btson khang du 'jug rgyu dang / nga tshor yid 'thad byung ba ltar dang

khyod rang gis rang nyid skyob pa'i 'gyod bshags bya ched/ lo gsum gyi ring gza' 'khor re la 'gyod bshags 'phags glu bdun po thengs gcig klog dgos pa'i nyes chad bcad pa yin/ nga tshor da dung gong smras nyes chad la chog mchan bkod pa dang nyung bar gtong ba/yo bsgyur pa/ 'gyod bshags tshang ma'am 'ga' shas med par byed pa'i dbang ṭwāṃ sa ༵/gas khrims 'dum khang gi btsan shes 'og sga li le yis khu pher nee khe si'i gzhung lugs bskyur rgyu khas blangs mod/ yin na'ang khong gis 'phral du blo brtan 'gyur med sgos (ming tho bkod pa'i ci phan/ sa'i go la sngar ltar 'khor bzhin yod pa red ces gsungs/logacig gi rjes su rtsis sprod do dam byas pa'i sgag li le ni hpho lo rin si'i nye 'dabs kyi a si thu li ru yib gsang gi 'tsho ba mi rol ka med byung /khong gi mgo la ma nyes kha g.yogs 'khel na'ang / bden don 'tshol zhib kyi snying stobs ma nyams par/ mu mthud du tshan rig la zhib 'jug gnang bas/1634lor/ 〈tshan rig gsar pa gnyis skor gyi gleng sol〉zhes pa brtsams tshar zhing / de'i nang rang nyid kyi dngos lugs rig pa'i khongs su blangs pa'i grub 'bras la spyi sdom byas yod/ khong gi slob bu zhig gis gsung rtsom de'i ma yig lkog tu a ṭha li las phyi khyer stabs/ da gzod 1636lor ne thar lan ḍi (70 66118263)ru dpe skrun byas/chos tshogs kyis gnod 'tshe btang bas sga li le yi tshe smad kyi 'tsho ba ni ha cang skyo po yin te/ 1634lor khong gi 'tsho bar lta skyong byed bzhin pa'i rang gi bu mo tshe las 'das shing / 1637lor khong gi spyan gnyis kyang zhar pa red/ sga li le yis dbul phongs dang khor rkyang yul po'i tshul du mi tshe'i mtha' mjug gi lo 'ga' btang zhing / 1642lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 8nyin na ka med nyes 'khel du dgongs pa rdzogs/ dbyi tha li ru rlabs che ba'i tshanā /ga
